prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍala granthamālā
mīmāṃsākoṣa:
saptamo bhāga:
(ca-ha)

anukramaṇikā
prakāśakasya nivedanam ... ... ... granthādisaṃkṣepākṣarāṇi tadvivaraṇaṃ ca ... ... 1-5 śuddhipatrakam ... ... ... ... 6-8 mīmāṃsākopa: ... ... ... ... 3633-4542
prakāśakasya nivedanam
ayaṃ saptamo'ntimaśca bhāgo mīmāṃsākoṣasya |
asmadgurucaraṇaiḥ racito'yaṃ kopo- 'smin bhāge hakāreṇa samāptiṃ gacchati |
gurucaraṇāravindinā mīmāṃsābhūṣaṇena āhitā- gninā tāmrai ityupākhyena dattātreyaśāstriṇā asya bhāgasya saṃskāraḥ saṃpāditaḥ |
viśeṣataḥ sarveṣāṃ bhāgānāmādito'ntaparyantaṃ saṃpādanaṃ mudraṇaṃ prakāśanaṃ cāsyatatsahakāriṇā kāryakāri- saṃpādakena śrīraṅganāthaśāstriṇā gadyāsena nirvartitam |
asya bhāgasya mudraṇavyayārthaṃ bhārata- saṃrājyaśikṣā mantrālayena mahāprāprāyaśāsanaśikṣāvibhāgena ca vittānudānaṃ kṛtamiti tadubhayaṃ hārdikīṃ praśaṃsāmarhati |
gurucaraṇaistu asya kośasya viracanārthaṃ kasmādapyanyasmāt vittānudānamasvīkṛtyaiva, etadiracanaṃ svādhyāyarūpaṃ tapa ityevaṃ matvā, bahuvaḥ saṃvatsarā amiśreva kārye samāhitacittai- rvyatītāḥ |
gurucaraṇarṇāpākaraṇamasya kośasya samāpyā niḥśeṣaṃ saṃpannamiti kṛtvā asmatprājña- pāṭhaśālā'maṇḍalamātmānaṃ kṛtārtha

arthabhedādimo'nyaḥ śabdapurvāvanvitaḥ ||
' bhāṭṭa - sarvatra 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ' ityādi kiṃ vidhivata eva devatāśabdasyāgādāvuccāraṇīyaḥ, athavā nāyaṃ niyama iti cintāyām, na tāvacchabda- syaiva devatātvam, taddhi arthamanaṅgīkṛtyāṅgīkṛtya vā ucyate ? na tāvadādyaḥ ; agnyādiṣvabhidhānānāṃmarthatvasya lokavedayoḥ prasiddhatvāt arthaparatvābhāve agnyādi- śabdānāṃ pratipadikasadbhāvāvena vibhaktyādyanāpatteśca |
nāntyaḥ |
arthāvahitatve tasyaiva devatātvopapattī agnyādipade śabdalakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
na ca tatra lapyamānārthoddeśyatvarūpadevatātvāsaṃbhavaḥ, dravya- tyāgakālīnoccāraṇakarmatvarūpa tasya śabdadharmatvāditi vācyam, uddeśyatvasyocāraṇaghaṭitatve pramāṇābhāvena dravyatyāgakālīnājñānakarmatvarūpasya tasyārthe'pyupapatteḥ |
na ca jñānasyāpi śabdoccāraṇadhīnatvamevetyevaṃ niyamo- 'sti |
dravyādisaṃnidhidarśanādinā'pi sati saraṇopapatteḥ |
ataḥ śabdoccāraṇaṃ eva pramāṇābhāve vidhigataśabda- niyamasya durāpāsatvameva |
astu voddeśyatvasya uccāraṇaghaṭitatvam, tathāpyu ccāraṇamātrasyaiva pratipādyatvameva devatātvamiti na tasyārthe asaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca tathāpyuccāryamāṇasya viśeṣa- pekṣayā śrutādidhigataśabdasya niyamo bhaviṣyatīti vācyam, śrataśabdasyārthe vidhitvāt caritārthasya śabda- niyāmakaratvānupapatteḥ |
ākāśyāyāḥ vācakapadamātra- grahaṇenāpi jñānteḥ |
itarathā dravyavācipadasye'pi yatra - 'vrīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ' ityādī vikṛtau maitrāvaruṇādibṛhaspatikaḥ tatra vidhitagataśabdanīyamāpatteḥ |
yadyapi ca dravyasya svarūpeṇa karmaṇi samavāyaḥ, devatā- yāstu śabdadvāreṇyetāvānasti tatrobhedaḥ, tathāpi śruta- śabdasya vidhāya caritārthasya śabdaviśeṣapekṣāyāmupa- sthitatvāttasya niyame tuthyatvameva |
kiñcaivaṃ yatra paryāyaśabdaprayogaḥ, yathā - 'agnaye pāvakāya' ityādī, tatra padadvayaprayogo bhavataḥ |
kathaṃ sidhyet |
tatra hyapekṣāmātreṇaśabdanīyamasyaivopapatti śabda- dvayaniyame pramāṇābhāvāt |
ato na kāpi tyāgādau vidhi- gataśabdaniyamaḥ |
iti prāpte, na tāvaduccāraṇamantareṇaiva jñānamātreṇārthasya devatātvam, tathāve 'agnaye pāva- kāya' ityādāvarthasyaivāpi padena vidhānasaṃbhavaṃ pada- dravyayarthāpatteḥ |

tatrāpi prayogopanipatitamanupātajivirodhaṃ hotṛśabdadeva mukhyatve parigṛhya caramopanipatito virodhaścā prāpto'dhvaryuśabdaḥ kāryalakṣaṇārtho varṇanīyaḥ |
tena hotraiva karaṇīkriyamāṇānuvādinau mantrau prayoktavyā- viti prāpnoti |
na cobhayamantraprayogaṃ kartuṃ yugapadekaḥ śaknotītyaniyamana kadācit karaṇamantrasya kadācit kriyamāṇānuvādino mantrasya hotrā prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |

ke. viśvajiti vidyamānasyaiva sarvasvasya dānam ||

bhāṣyam-- viśvajityeva saṃdehaḥ sarvasvaṃ dadāti, iti kimarjitavopakaraṇānāṃ yāvanti manuṣyasya, yāvanti ca śaknotyupārjitum, sarvāṇi tāni dadyātkṛtāṇḍa- kāni, uta yānyevāsya vidyante tāni sarvāṇi deyāni, nāviyamānāni kartavyānīti |
kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ ? ubhayathā vacanavyaktaḥ saṃbhavataḥ |
yadi caivaṃ dhvanyate, yāni sarvāṇi svāni |
kāni tāni ? yāni puruṣasyopa- kārakāṇi śayanādīni, tāni sarvāṇi dadyāditi vidhī- yate |
yadā yāni svāni puruṣasya dāne śakyāni,

yadi dānaṃ vidhīyate, tato'pradānānāṃ kṛtabhāṇḍakānāmima dānam|
atha sarvatvā vidhīyate, tato vidyamānāmeva|
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? kṛtabhāṇḍakāni deyānīti|
tathā dānavidhāne śrutiranugṛhyate|
itarathā vākyam|
tathośca śruti- rbalīyasī|
tasmāt kṛtabhāṇḍakāni deyānīti|
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ|
nityatvāccittyanairnāsti saṃbandhaḥ|
caśabdo'nvādeśo|

kṛta- bhāṇḍakāni ca na deyānīti|
nityaṃ hi viśvajiti dānaṃ codakena prāptamanūdyate|
aniyāni ca kṛtabhāṇḍa- kānīti na śakyāni sarvāṇi viśvajiti kriyamāṇe upasaṃhartum|
tatra kṛtabhāṇḍakānāṃ keṣāṃcidutpatti viśvajiti dānaṃ pratīkṣeta|
naimittikaṃ tat syāt nityam|
nityavacca taccodakena vidhīyate, na nimitta- saṃyogena|
tasmāt avaśyametadabhyupagantavyaṃ sākalyaṃ deyānāṃ prāptānāṃ vidhīyate iti|
śrutyasaṃbhave ca vākyārtho grahītavya eva bhavati|
tasmāt kṛtabhāṇḍa- kāni dātavyāni|
śā-- 'sarvasvaṃ dadāti' iti kiṃ yatpuṣpopa- bhogyaṃ svaṃ kupyākupyayathāsanagavādi tatsarvaṃ dadāti iti śāstrārthaḥ|
tataśca yasyāpi yannāsti so'pi tadarja- yitvā dadyāt yadyasya vidyate tatsarvaṃ dadātīti saṃśaye yat sarvaṃ svaṃ tat dadātīti śrutyarthavidhilipsayā dāna- vidhiṃ manyate|
codakena tu dānasya prāptatvāt yasya yat asti sa tasmin dvādaśatāmātraṃ dātuṃ pravṛttaḥ san sarva- meva dadātīti sarvatā vidhīyate|
kiñca ayaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ prasiddhatvevena sarveṣu upapannatvāt na asiddhastattvānāṃ ākṣipati arjanam|
tasmāt arjanārjitvā deyam|
soma-- pūrvavat iha nāsti paryudāsaḥ iti pratyaya- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
sūtrārthastu-- dānasya nityatvāt arjanīyānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kadācit alāmena anityatvāt na tadānstya asti saṃbandhaḥ iti|
vi-- 'arjayitvā'pi ki sarvāṃ deyaṃ yadvā yadasti tat|
, sarvadeśavidherāyo na prāpte sarvatāvidheḥ ||
bhāṭṭa-- yatkiñcitpuruṣasya upabhogyaṃ svaṃ kupyā- kupyayathāsanagavādi tatsarvaṃ dadātīti śāstrārthatvāt- yāt yasyāpi yat nāsti so'pi tadarjayitvā dadyāt dhātvarthavidhilābhāt|
iti prāpte, ṣaṣṭhavidhaprakārāpatte- środakaprāptadānānuvādena dvādaśaśatāmātrena sarvatāmātra- vidhānāt prasiddhatvevena sarvaśabdasyopapattau aprasiddha- svārjanārkṣepakatayānupapatteśca nārjayitvā deyam|

'atideśaḥ viśvajiti ṣaḍahagatapṛṣṭhānām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
# viśvajiti pāḍahikarathaṃtarādisāmāṃ madhye vairūpyasya hotuḥ pṛṣṭhastotrārthaṃ niveśaḥ|
sarvapṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaśabdākṣepāt syādekadeśatvaṃ pṛṣṭhasya kṛtadeśatvāt|
bhāṣyam-- idamāmnāyate 'viśvajitsarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti|
tatra ayamarthaḥ saṃśayikaḥ kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ uta ekasya pṛṣṭhadeśe anyeṣāmanyatreti|
kiṃ prāptam ? sarvapṛṣṭhe etasmin sarveṣāṃ sāmāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ|
kaḥ punaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ ? ūrdhvaṃ mādhyaṃdinapavamānāt prāk maitrāvaruṇāsāmnaḥ, idamantarāle pṛṣṭhadeśaḥ|
sa evaiko deśaḥ syātsarveṣāṃ sāmnām|
kutaḥ ? pṛṣṭhaśabdāt|
pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ yatamānasya cāyaṃ kṛto deśaḥ|
tasmāt sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe niveśaḥ|
vidhestu viprakarṣeḥ syāt|
bhāṣyam-- tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati|
evaṃ nyāyena prāptam, vacanādanyathā bhavitumarhati|
ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ vicariṣyedhā parisamākārya|
katham ? pava- māne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ārmabhe bṛhat, madhya itarāṇi- vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ, vairājaṃ brahmasāma, śākkaraṃ maitrāvaruṇa- sāma, raivatamanyāvāk sāma' iti|
evamekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ vidhānamarthavat bhaviṣyati|
yadītareṣāṃ parisamākāryaṃ niveśaḥ|
itarathā, ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ vidhānaṃ nopapadyate, tat mā bhūditi|
ataḥ paśyāma ekasya pṛṣṭhakāryaṃ niveśaḥ, anyeṣāṃ parisamākārya iti|
śā-- 'viśvajitsarvapṛṣṭho bhavati' iti śrūyate|
tatra pāḍahikānāṃ rathaṃtarādipṛṣṭhānāṃ vidhiriti sthitaṃ saptame|
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi sāmnāṃ pṛṣṭha- stutisādhanatvaṃ tatra pṛṣṭhadeśe mādhyaṃdinapavamānāme- varuṇasāmamadhye niveśaḥ, uta vairūpasyaiva tatsādhana- tvena tatra niveśaḥ anyeṣāṃ stotrāntarasādhanatvena taccadeśe prayoga iti|
tatra ṣaṣṭhe teṣāṃ pṛṣṭhasādhanatvena ihāpi pṛṣṭhaśabdena tatsādhanatvavagamāt pṛṣṭhadeśa eva prayogaḥ sarveṣāmiti prāpte, brūmaḥ|
'rathaṃtaraṃ bahiḥpavamāne kurvā- dārbhave vṛhanmadhyata itarāṇi vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe' ityādi- vacanāt vairūpasya pṛṣṭhasādhanatvaṃ itarathā stotrāntara- sādhanatvāni|
na ca pṛṣṭhastutau prayuktānāmeva punarvacanāt stotrāntare'pi prayogo'stīti vācyam|
vairūpasya pṛṣṭhe vidheranarthakyaprasaṅgāt|
kiṃca sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdena lakṣaṇayā pṛṣṭhasādhanabhūtāni rathaṃtarādīni sāmāni pāḍahikāni vidhīyante|
stuteḥ bahutvābhāvena sarvaśabdavidhayavā- saṃbhavāt teṣāṃ ca sāmnāmihāditānāṃ kāryākāṅkṣiṇāṃ vācanikaireva kāryairupapattau kiṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhasādhanatvaṃ kalpayet ? tasmādibhyaiva niveśaḥ|
soma-- pūrvatra codakaprāptasāmnābhyeṣa iha pṛṣṭhaśabdasvarasavalabdhaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe na cābhanīya ityutthiteḥ saṃgatiḥ|
sūtrārthastu-- sarvaśabdai sarvapṛṣṭha iti yāvat|
tatra teṣāṃ sāmnāṃ pṛṣṭhastotrāṇāṃ ya ekadeśat syāt pṛṣṭhaśabdātpṛṣṭhaśabdasya ca niyatadeśatvāditi|
vi-- 'kiṃ sarvapṛṣṭhe sarvāṇi pṛṣṭhadeśe yathokti vā|
, pṛṣṭhaśabdātpṛṣṭhadeśe vacanāttu vyavasthitiḥ|
' bhāṭṭa-- 'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' ityatra pāḍahikāni rathaṃtarādīni sāmnāṃ viśvajidaṅgatvena vidhiriti sthitam|
tatra ṣaṇṇāmapi ṣaḍahe māhendrādyarathapṛṣṭha- stotrasādhanatve kalpitehāpi tameva saṃsvādavat samu- cayena niveśaḥ|
iti prāpte, 'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ ārmabhe vṛhat madhyata itarāṇi vairūpaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe vairājaṃ maitrā- varuṇasya śākkaraṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ raivatamacchāvākyasya' iti vacanena stotrāntareṣu saṃniveśavidhānāt na sarveṣāṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe eva niveśaḥ|
na ca tatra kṛtānāmapyanena vacanena stotrāntareṣu punarvidhānam, viśiṣṭavidhī gaura- vāpatteḥ|
vairūpasya hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe punarvidheyatvaipatteśca|
ataśca kratusaṃbandhitvena prāptānāṃ sāmnāṃ lāghavātstotrā- ntararūpadāsaṃrvamātrakaraṇena sarveṣāṃ klṛptasaṃbandhasyāpi vādhanam|
na caivaṃ rathaṃtarādidharmāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhāpūrvasādhanatve klṛpta- tvemeha stotrāntare tadanāpattiḥ|
'pradhānaṃ nīyamānaṃ hi tatrājñānyapakarṣati' iti nyāyena āvaśyakastotravādyanu- rodhena ca sāṅgatyaiva rathaṃtarasya rathaṃtarapadena lakṣaṇayā vidhānādihaiva pavamānātparvasādhanatvopapatteḥ|
maṇḍana-- 'pratyahaṃ na dvidhāmātvam|
' dvidhāmātvaṃ sāmadayaprayogaḥ|
pratyahaṃ sarvaiṣaḥ yu na bhavatīti saṃbandhaḥ|

# viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe tatpūrvakatvājyatīti- ṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhānyasti ca pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ|
'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭho bhavati' iti śrūyate|
tatra sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvāde vidhiriti vicāre anuvāda iti pūrvapakṣamāha|
viśvajiti yāge syameva sarvapṛṣṭhe sati sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdena punastatra sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ vidhinaṃ saṃbhavati|
kathaṃ viśvajiti : sarvapṛṣṭhatā ? tatpūrvakatvāt jyotiṣṭomapūrvatvatvāt jyotiṣṭomaprakṛtatvāt jyoti- ṣṭomikāni pṛṣṭhāni pṛṣṭhāyastotrāṇi viśvajiti codakena prāpnuvanti|
tasmāt sarvapṛṣṭha eva viśvajit|
jyoti- ṣṭome ca catvāri pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi māhendrādīni, tāni vidha- jilapi|
asti ca māhendrādiṣu stotreṣu 'saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni' iti pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ|
tasmāt viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvāda iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ|
ṣaḍahatvā tatra hi codanāḥ|
'viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti sarvapṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ anuvādaḥ, jyotiṣṭomāt viśvajiti pṛṣṭhātideśaḥ iti sūtraprāptaṃ pūrva- |

ṣaḍahāt pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśo viśvajiti, na jyotiṣṭomāt|
iti yasmāt tatra ṣaḍahe 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādyāḥ rathaṃtara-bṛhat -vairūpa-vairāja-raivata-śākarāṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ codanāḥ santi|

'viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ' iti viśvajiti sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ atideśaḥ ṣaḍahādeva na jyotiṣṭomāt iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha|
'pavamāne rathaṃtaraṃ karoti, ārbhavai bṛhat, madhye itarāṇi|
vairūpaṃ hotuḥ sāma, vairājaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya, raivataṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ, śākara- manchāvākasya' iti viniveśapare vākye liṅgaṃ viśva- jiti pāḍahikāni pṛṣṭhāni darśayati|
tasmāt ṣaḍahā- datideśaḥ|
utpannādhikāro jyotiṣṭome |
jyotiṣṭome māhendrādiṣu caturṣu pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ utpannādhi- kāraḥ|
utpannāni stotrāṇi adhikṛtya pravṛttaḥ 'pṛṣṭhaiḥ stuvate' iti ta utpannānāni adhikṛtya|
padyahe tu utpadyamānādhikṛtya pravṛttaḥ|
kiṃca 'bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityevameva pṛṣṭhaṃ vastutaḥ jyotiṣṭome utpannaṃ māhendrādiṣu tu tatra pṛṣṭhaśabdaḥ chandomātreṇa|
tasmāt viśvajiti ṣaḍahādeva sarveṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapi pṛṣṭhānāmatideśaḥ|

ko'yamantyathābhāvaḥ ; ayamanyathābhāvaḥ; śuktikā hi rajatavat prakāśyate |
śuktikā'lambanaṃ hi tat jñānam, na rajatālambanam |
kathamavagamyate ? śuktikā- saṃpukte cakṣuṣi darśanāt anyathānutpādāt |
nahi anyaḥ śuktikāṃ rajatamiti vyapadiśati |
cakṣuṣmāneva hi śuktikāṃ rajatamiti manyate 'rajataṃnikṛṣṭaṃ me cakṣuḥ' iti |
ataḥ śuktikā'lambanaṃ ca tat jñānam, na rajatālambanam |
na ca apratyakṣajñānapakṣe etat saṃbhavati |
ataḥ avidyamānākārālambanamapi jñānamasti iti pratipattavyam |
seyaṃ pañcavidhā kalpanā |
nanu ca avidyamānākārālambanapakṣe nirālambana- taiva jñānasya prāpnoti |
maivam |
nirālambanapakṣe nahi anyasya anyena vyapadeśa upapadyate |
bhavati cāyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ rajataṃ iti śuktikāyāḥ |
nirālambanapakṣe hi kasya kena ca vyapadeśaḥ, bhinnatvāt śuktikā rajata- jñānayoḥ |
pṛ. 46-46. ṛju-- 'nanu ca...prāpnoti' |

ālambanameva jñāyate na tu anālambanaṃ ityasmin pakṣe anyākāraṃ ālambanaṃ anyākāragrāhi ca jñānaṃ iti nopapadyate |
pṛ. 47. bṛhatī-- idameva hi ālambanasya ālambanatvaṃ yaduta arthākārameva jñānamutpādayati iti |
anyathā hi cakṣurādivat avāptasyāpi jñānotpattau ālambanavyapa- deśo na syāt |
ṛju-- idameva hi ālambanasya ālambanatvaṃ yaduta ātmākārameva jñānaṃ janayati |
yadi punaḥ kāraka- tāmātrameva arthasya syāt tadā cakṣurādīnāṃ jñānotpattau vyāpatānāmapi yathā ālambanabhāvo nāsti, tathā artha- syāpi syāt |
tasmāt yat ālambanamabhimataṃ tadā- kāreṇa jñānenāpi bhavitavyam |
anyathā ālambanatvānu- pattataḥ iti |

anutpattau svalakṣaṇamātrāvagama iti ) |

tacca ' pūrvedyuḥ amāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti ' iti vacanena apakarṣaḥ śrutaḥ pūrvebhāvino'pi havirbhivāsanādīnapakarṣeta, ekaprayogavidhirihatītvena pāṭhasya kramakalpatvāt, amāvāsyāparvasya karmaparatve lakṣaṇāprasaṅgena kālaparatvavāsayāta, havirbhivāsanāttara- bhāvinedikaraṇavidhivaiva paurṇamāsyantātravatvat darśā- jñatvabodhakatvācca ! na ca kāladvayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ, sāmarthyāt, ' vedaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ karoti ' iti śrutatvada- karaṇānvayatvenaiveha ca pūrvedyustvasya prāptatvena anuvādāt |
pradhānapratyāsattilābhāt paurṇamāsyā atītatvācca dāśika- vedikaraṇe evāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ |
ataśca paurṇamāsasādhā- raṇyena pāṭhasya kramakalpakatvāvaśyambhāvāt |
ata eva ca yūpacchedanavelāsaṃsthatvāt tadantātkarṣaṃ prāpte, kālaparatve'pi kālavidhaiḥ prayogavidhitvena dāśikavedikaraṇasya tathaiva prayojyatvāvagamāt tadavagamottaraṃ ca kramāpekṣāyāṃ pāṭhasya niyāmakatvātsaṃbhavāt, śrautakramantarasatvācca na havirbhāvābhanena baddhakramatvam |
ataśca pāṭho'pi pari- śeṣāt paurṇamāsaviṣayaḥ eva |
yadi tu maṇḍapaparvaṇi catu- rdaśyāṃ prātaranvādhānadine vedikaraṇasiddhayarthaṃ lakṣaṇāmapi aṅgīkṛtya amāvāsyāpadena karmaṇocyeta, tadā dāśika- vedikaraṇasya ayameva viniyogavidhiriti havirbhi- vāsanena dāśikavedikaraṇasya sutarāṃ na baddhakramatā |
na caiva pūrvedyuḥ kālaviśiṣṭavedikaraṇasya darśajñatayā vākyena viniyogāt prakaraṇāt paurṇamāsāṅgatvayogaḥ, vedeḥ sarvasādhāraṇyena tatkaraṇasyāpi aṅgatvataḥ apekṣāsahakṛta- paurṇamāsa-raṇena gardabhābhidhānyāmāṭhātasyaiva ākṣepo- patteḥ |

vaidikaṃ karma dvividhaṃ kratavai puruṣārtha ceti|
tantrarale tu lipsāsūtre prathamavarṇake vaidikakarmaṇāṃ traividhya- mukkaṃ kratvarthe puruṣārthe anubhavarūpaṃ ca|
adhyayanaṃ ādhānaṃ ca na kratvartham, na puruṣārthamiti|
śāstradīpikāyāṃ tu tatraiva 'yat bhāvanāyāścābhavapuruṣārthe vidhīyate tat kratvartham, anyat karaṇaṃ phalaṃ ca puruṣārtham' iti granthyena dvaividhyamevoktam|
tat guruṇāmapīṣṭam|
tanmataṃ hi tatra tantrarale evoktaṃ 'adhyayanasya puruṣārthatvamiṣṭaṃ' iti|
traividhye tu mūle dravyarjanavarṇake eva (4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3 bhā.) 'na cādhānavat bhavitumarhati' iti bhāṣyasya (pṛ. 1197) vyākhyāpañcakoktyai vārtike 'yathā ādhānaṃ na kratvartham, na puruṣārtham' iti siddhāntavārtikam|
tat tantrarale 'pratyekena dravyarjanasya yathā puruṣārthatā avagamyate naivādhānasya' ityabhi- prāye vyākhyātam|
ato na vārtikaṃ na (vākyatva) kiñcit traividhye bhūmasti|
dvaividhye tu mūlaṃ 'athātaḥ kratvarthapuruṣārthayorjijñāsā' iti sūtrameva|
atra hi dvaividhyameva karmaṇāmuktam, na naividhyam|
bhāṣyamapi evameva aṅgaṃ kratvarthaṃ, pradhānaṃ puruṣārthaḥ ityādi|
anyattu granthyantaratraividhyadṛṣṭyāpi ca śāstradīpikā- prakāśe anusaṃdheyam|

sa vaimudho nimittopavandhādeva śrutatvāt |
ityeva iti prāpte, ‘ yadyagre nirūpya nānunivepet ’ ityādinā nindāryatvādadarśanārt prārabdhasya aparityāgavacanatvāt ‘ yaccetānālameta vākyasyaiva śira upadadhyāt ’ iti vacanāt puruṣaśīrṣādyupadhānasya ivānityaḥ tatkramaḥ |

saṃkarṣa. 1|2|7 |
oṃ vaimudhādau sāmidhenīsādṛśyapunaḥśravaṇasya anārabhyādhītasādṛśyena upasaṃhāraḥ ||
akaraṇe tu yacchāstraṃ viśeṣe śrūyamāṇa- vikṛtamājyābhāgavat prākṛtapratipadyartham |
bhāṣyam-- anārabhya kiṃcidāmnāyate ‘ saptadaśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt ’ iti |
tat prakṛtau viśeṣavihitena pāṭhādaśabdena bādhitaṃ sarvavikṛtīranuprāptam, kāsucit vikṛtiṣu punaḥ śrūyate vaimudhe, adhvarakalpāyām, paśau, cāturmāsyeṣu, mitravindāyām, traidhātavyāyām, āgra- yaṇeṣvā iti |
tāsu vikṛtiṣu asya śravaṇaṃ kimevamiti vicāryate |
kiṃ prāptam ? akaraṇe yat śāstramā- mnātam, trikuni triśeṣe punaḥ adhikṛtaṃ śrūyate, tat prākṛtamatrajyāt pratipadyam, vaimudhādiṣu saptadaśa sāmi- dhenīranubrūyāt iti, nānyat prākṛtaṃ kuryāt iti |
na caivaṃ vijñāyate vaimudhādiṣveva sādṛśyaṃ nānyatra vikṛtiṣu iti |
tāsu tat pratyakṣaṃ vākyena śrutaṃ na śakyaṃ bādhi- tum |
vikāre tu tadartha syāt |
bhāṣyam-- yadi tu sāmidhenīnāṃ vikāraḥ kaścit śrūyeta, tato vikārārthamātmati gamyeta, na tu vikāraḥ śrūyate |
tasmāt prākṛtapratipadyarthameveti |
vākyaśeṣo vā kratunā'grahaṇāt syādanārabhya- vidhānasya |
bhāṣyam-- vāgnadaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati |
vākya- śeṣo'yaṃ vaimudhādiṣu anārabhyavidhānasya, saptadaśa sāmi- dhenīnūyāt etāsu vikṛtiṣu iti |
tena anyāsa vikṛtiṣu na syāt |
nanu pratyakṣaśrutaṃ anyāsa vikṛtiṣu tatra śakyaṃ bādhitumiti |
ucyate |
satyaṃ pratyakṣaśrutaṃ sāmidhenīṣu, na tu tat kratunā gṛhyate |
kratusaṃbandhā- bhāvāt prayogavacanato'pi na gṛhyate, sati vaimudhādi- saṃbandhakare vākye |
yadetat sādṛśyaṃ anārabhyoktaṃ tat vaimudhādīnāṃ aṅgaṃ iti pratyakṣaṃ vākyam |
tasmāt nānyā vikṛtayaḥ tat gṛhṇanti |
akṛtagrahaṇe ca sati sāmi- dhenīnāṃ sādṛśyaṃ niṣphalatvānna kriyeta |
tasmāt anā- rabhyaviṣaye vaimudhādiṣu vākyaśeṣaḥ |
āha, nanu vākya- bhedo bhavati, sāmidhenyaḥ saptadaśa bhavanti, tāśca vaimudhā- diṣu iti |
ucyate |
dve ete vākye |
pūrveṇa vākyena yo'rtha uktaḥ tasyaiva viśeṣaḥ pareṇa vākyena vidhīyate iti vākyaśeṣaḥ ityucyate iti |
śā-- ‘ klṛptopakārāḥ prakṛtau sāmidhenyo yatastataḥ |
tābhireva nirākāṅkṣā necchanti prākṛtānyam |
sādṛśyaṃ tvanārabhyavādaprāpta- manvyate |
sāmidhenyastu codyante tābhiścāpūrvatā sphuṭā |
bhavedevamapūrvatvaṃ sāmidhenīvidhedi |
sāmadṛśyavidhitveṣa tasmānnāpūrvatā bhavet |
soma-- anārabhyādhīta āhavanīyasya pada- homādiyatiriktiviṣaye saṃkoce'pi anārabhyādhīta ārabhyādhītasādṛśyamitravindādiviṣaye saṃkocaḥ ityu- cyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- akaraṇe yat śāstrāmnātaṃ vikṛtiviśeṣa punaradhītamavikṛtaṃ śrūyate tat ājyabhāgavat codakatvopāyarthamiti |
vaimudhādau 3741 vaimudheṣṭiḥ
vi-- ‘ sāmidhenīsādṛśyaṃ vaimudhādāvapūrvanīḥ |
saṃhṛtau, pakārasya klṛptyā''dau''styājyabhāgavat |
, sāmidhenyaścodakātāḥ sādṛśyaṃ tu vaimudhe |
punarvākyena saṃhāryamanārabhyoktitoditam |
bhāṭṭa-- anārabhyādhītaṃ sādṛśyaṃ prākaraṇikapāñca- daśyāvirodhāt prakṛtau niveśamabhamānaṃ vikṛtau niviśate iti sthitam |
ataśca tat ‘ ya iṣṭyā ’ itivākya- pramitasadyaḥkālatvavat sarvavikṛtyarthatvameva |
tataśca vaimudha- paśu-mitravindā-āgrayaṇādirūpavikṛtiviśeṣe ‘ sapta- daśa sāmidhenīranubrūyāt ’ iti punaḥśravaṇaṃ na tāvat upasaṃhārārtham, sāmānyavākyavaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
na hi atra ‘ puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karoti ’ ityādipat śāntrāntaram |
na ca ekaśākhāsthatve'pi anārabhyādhītena sāmidhenī- saṃbandhaḥ, prākaraṇikena kratusaṃbandhaḥ iti viṣayabhedāt sārthakayaṃ iti vācyam |
ubhayatrāpi sāmidhenīpadasya uddeśyasamarpakatvena tatsvarūpe bhānārthakyaprasaktau lakṣaṇā apūrvasādhanībhūtāmisandhanaprakāśakamantratvasyaiva uddeśya- tāvacchedakatayā viṣayabhedābhāvāt |
apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā- tātparyagrāhakaṃ paraṃ ekatra prakaraṇam, aparatra abhya- caritakratusaṃbandhaḥ ityetāvān bhedaḥ |
na tu etāvatā viṣayabhedaḥ |
ataśca upasaṃhārarūpasādṛśyapadaḥ śravaṇayoḥ janāsaṃbhavāt anārabhyādhītavākyaprāptānuvādamātraṃ sāt- dṛśyapadaṃ aṅgīkṛtya sāmidhenīvidhireva ‘ apsumantā- vājyabhāgau ’ itivat aṅgīkartavyaḥ |
ataśca gṛhamedhī- yādyabhyāyena apūrvatvaṃ vaimudhādīnām |
iti prāpte, sāmidhenīvidhimātreṇa apūrvatvasvīkāre agreḥ api aprāpyatteḥ apūrvayogāt sādṛśyasyaiva kratu- viśeṣe'pyaparvādhītasāmidhenyuddeśena vidhiḥ |
tatphalaṃ ca anārabhyavākyasya svāmātraviṣayatvena upasaṃhāraḥ |
na ca viṣayabhedābhāvāt sāmānyavidhivaiyarthyam, ubhayatra apūrvasādhanībhūtāmisandhanaprakāśakamantratvasya uddeśya- tāvacchedakatve'pi apūrvasādhanībhūtatvasya apūrvā- rthatvasyāpi ārthikatvāt tasmin prākaraṇikavākyasya tātparyam, anārabhyādhītasya tu tatsādhanībhūtārthatve iti viṣayabhedāt, prākaraṇikavākyena eva ubhayasiddhiḥ |
anārabhyādhītavākyavaiyarthyaśaṅkā tu ‘ agrahotraṃ juhoti ’ itivat abhyudayadhiśiraskatvakalpanā parihartavyā |
na ca prākaraṇikasādṛśyavākyena tātparyagrahāt anārabhya- vākyena sarvavikṛtiṣu na atideśaprāptāpadyadasya nityaṃ bādhaḥ |
api tu vikalpena |
ataśca pakṣaprāptasādṛśya- niyamārtha prākaraṇikavākyaṃ arthavat iti evaṃ kiṃ na syāt iti vācyam |
uddeśyatāvacchedakāvacchedena vidheyatvasyāsya śabdasvabhāvasiddhatvena vikalpe tadvādhā- patteḥ |
ataśca abhyudayadhiśiraskatvamapi prakalpya upasaṃhā- ratvameva yuktam |
ataśca vaimudhādatiriktavikṛtiṣu sādṛśyena na pādyadasyavādhaḥ |
maṇḍana-- ‘ sādṛśyaṃ niyamyate |
śaṃkara-- ‘ upasaṃhāravarṇanam |
vaimudhādiṣu saptasvaiva vikṛtiṣu sāmidhenīsādṛ- śyaṃ nānya vikṛtiṣu |

oṃ vaimudhārambhaḥ : ādhānānaṃtarapaurṇamāsyā- meveti na niyamaḥ |
yat ‘ agre nirūpya ’ ityasya paurṇamāsīprakaraṇe pāṭhādaśabdenādhānādyavahitottarapaurṇamāsyeva grāhyā |
iti prāpte, ‘ agrekṛtvā nedānīṃ kurute ’ ityādāvakaraṇa-pūrva- kālamātratāyāśca atraśabdasya paurṇamāsīviśeṣaparatve lakṣaṇāpatteḥ ‘ agre nirūpya ’ ityavākyasya prakaraṇā- drīyatvātsyāṃ kasyāṃcit paurṇamāsyāmupakramya nollaṅgha- vyam |
yājñikāstu vaimudho nitya eva |
aikatanya- bhinnatantrayoḥ paraṃ vikalpaḥ |

vaimudheṣṭiḥ na paurṇamāsyāṃ ‘ saṃsthāpya paurṇa- māsīmindrāgnyā vaimudha puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapati ’ iti paurṇamāsīsamāpanavidhānāt |

vaimu- dheṣṭiḥ paurṇamāsyām, na dvādāṃ ‘ saṃsthāpya paurṇamāsīṃ vaimudhanirvapati ’ ityuktatvāt darśadāṇā''sapta- taraṃ vaimudhamiti viśeṣaḥ |

vaimugdhanyāyaḥ |
vaimugdhaḥ paurṇamāsyeva na darśapūrṇam ||
kulāyāmeva vā samudāyāpūrvaniṣṭhāyāṃ yogyatāyāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe amāvāsyāyāṃ tanmadhye vaimugdhaḥ kārya iti tantrasāraḥ |
tantra, svatantrakālakramayorāmnānāt |
ato'māvāsyāvikāreṇatanideśaḥ prayojanam |
yadā tu pārvaṇahomadaśasyāpi vikutātadeśo neṣyate tadā saṃkape ubhayoretyeva |
siddhānte paurṇamāsyeveti draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayorāmamanti 'saṃkhyāpya paurṇamāsī vaimugdhamunirvapati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimu- bhayāṅgaṃ vaimugdhaḥ, kālāthaiḥ paurṇamāsīsaṃyogaḥ, uta aṅga- prayojanasaṃbandhaḥ iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? evaṃ cet ubha- yārtho vaimugdhaḥ |
kutaḥ ? prakaraṇe ubhayorāmantāsāmarthyāt |
kālavidhiśāstryākhyā saṃsthāpyate |
maṇḍana-- 'paurṇamāsya vaimugdhaḥ |
na śabdaikatvāt |

vairahatyaṃ mahāpāpam |
bāla. pṛ. 60. vairājaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya viśvajiti |
bhā. 7|13|8, vairājaṃ brahmasāma viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe |
10|6|1|4 vairājaṃ sāma, ṣaḍahe caturthe'hani pṛṣṭha- niṣpādakam, viśvajiti ca sarvaśabdena ṣaḍahāt prāptam |
vi. 7|13|
vairājasya stotrāya āgneyo gṛhyate ' ityatra vairājastotrākhyadevatākayāgavidhiḥ āgneya iti nāmadheyam |
iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vairājasya stotrāya ityasya vairājasaṃbandhisatotrāya ityarthaḥ iti saptamyā kālavādaḥ vairājakāle jāyamānastotrārtha ityarthaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

na tasya kṛtsanakratasaṃyogaḥ |

viśvajiti ca sarvaśabdena ṣaḍahāt prāptam |

10|6|12-14. mīko. pṛ. 3690 ' viśvajiti pāḍahikaratha- tarādisāmāṃ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vairupādisāmāṃ bahuvrīhipadanirirdiśanāṃ ukthyā- dikratau hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe eva niveśaḥ, na tu kṛtsne kratau |
10|6|15-21. mīko. pṛ. 1086 ' ukthyā- dikratau bahuvrīhipadanirirdiśanāṃ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

vi. 10|6|16. vairūpasāmā ukthyaḥ iti prakṛtiliṅgena sāma- śabdena vairūpapṛṣṭhaḥ iti gamyate |
bhā. 3|8|22|44, vairūpasāmā ukthyaḥ jyotiṣṭomasya saṃkhyāviśeṣaḥ |
vairūpaṃ ca pṛṣṭhārthameva na tasya kṛtsanakratasaṃyogaḥ |
10|6|15-21. vairūpasāmā kṛtasaṃyogāt trivṛddekasāmā syāt |
ityatra sūtre, ' ukthyo vairūpasāmā ' ' ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī vairājasāmā ' ityatra sarvaprākṛtasāmnāṃ nivṛttimāśaṅkya pṛṣṭhasyutāveva rathaṃtarādimātraṃ nivartyate na sarvāṇi sāmāni, saptāmātreṇa vairupādeḥ ṛtuviśeṣaṇopapatteḥ iti vakṣyate |
ratnākaraḥ 11|8|18 ślovā. vairūpasāmā ṛtusaṃyogāt trivṛddeka- sāmā syāt |
ukthyo vairūpasāmā ' iti śrūyate |
so'yaṃ vairūpa- sāmā ukthyaḥ; ekasāmā syāt |
ekameva vairūpaṃ sāma yasmin sa ekamātrāsāmā syāt |
ṛtusaṃyogāt kṛtsnena ṛtunā vairūpasāmayogasya uktatvāt |
trivṛd yat trivṛdbhavati tadvat |
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pṛṣṭhārthe vā prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt |
' ukthyo vairūpasāmā ' iti kṛtsne ukthye kratau ekameva vairūpaṃ sāma iti pūrvapakṣe vāśabdena vyāvartya siddhāntamāha vairūpasāmā ukthyaḥ iti vairūpaṃ sāma pṛṣṭhārthe pṛṣṭhārthe syāt, na sarvasmin kratau ekameva vairu- pam |
prakṛtiliṅgena sāmaśabdena saṃyogāt vairūpaṃ sāma yasmin so'yaṃ vairūpasāmā iti bahuvrīhiḥ |
teneteṣu sāmasu parisāmatvena satsvapi pṛṣṭhārthe vidyamānena rūpeṇa vairūpasāmā siddhā bhavati |
tasmāt vairūpa- sāmi ukthye pṛṣṭhārthe vairūpaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
vairūpasāmā 3745 vaiśya:
trivṛddiditi cet |
' trivṛddiṃśatiḥ ' ityatra yathā kṛtsne kratau eka eva trivṛt somo bhavati na pañcadaśādirityatra |
tadvat ukthyo vairūpasāmā iti kṛtsne ukthye ekagotra vairūpaṃ sāma syāt nānyat iti uktaṃ iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
na prakṛtāvakṛtatsaṃyogāt |
' trivṛddiditi cet ' (17 sū.) iti śaṅkāyā- muttaramāha - naitadevam |
kṛtsne ukthye na ekameva vairūpaṃ sāma |
prakṛtau dṛṣṭena ' vairūpasāmā ' iti sāmaśabdena liṅgena akṛtsanasaṃyogāt akṛtsanasaṃyogasya gamyamāna- tvāt |
nainaṃ trivṛti prakṛtaliṅgena kenacit saṃyo- 'sti yena akṛtsanatā avagamyeta |
tasmāt trivṛddi- śṭomadṛṣṭānto viṣamaḥ |
tasmāt ukthye vairūpasya na kṛtsanasaṃyogaḥ |
iti siddhāntaḥ |

' athaipa bhūḥ... tasya... dhenurdakṣiṇā ' iti dhenudṛṣṭāntaṃ vaiṣamyeṇa nirākaroti |

dhenuḥ kṛtsnāṃ kratu- dakṣiṇāṃ nivartayet vā iti viśaye saṃśaye tannyāya tvāt tasyāḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ nyāyaḥ rītiḥ yasyāṃ dhenvāṃ sā tanmāyā, tannyāyatvāt syāt dhenurnivartikā |

evaṃ tannyāyatvāt karmāvibhā- gāt dhenuḥ kṛtsnakratadakṣiṇāyā nivartikā iti yuktam |

prayogatopyasyaśāstratvācchabdeṣu na vyavasthā syāt |
bhāṣyam— gaurgāvī goṇī gotolikā ityeva- mādayaḥ śabdāḥ udāharaṇam |
gośabdo yathā sākṣāditi pramāṇam, kiṃ tathā gāvyādayo'pyata neti saṃdehaḥ |
kimatra ekaḥ śabdaḥ avicchinnapāramparyaḥ arthābhidhāyī, itare apabhraṃśāḥ, uta sarve'nādayaḥ ? sarve iti bhramaḥ |
kutaḥ ? pratyayāt |
pratīyate hi gāvyādibhyaḥ sākṣādimānarthaḥ |
tasmādito varṇaśate'pyasyārthasya saṃbandha āsīdeva, tataḥ pareṇa, tataśca paratareṇetyanāditā |
kartā cāsya saṃbandhasya nāstīti vyavasthātvameva |
tasmāt sarve sādhavaḥḥ sarve'pi- tadyam |
sarve hi sādhyantyartham |
yathā hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiriti |
athāyaṃ te uccāryante nādṛṣṭāya, na dveṣā- muccāraṇe śāstramasti |
tasmāt na vyavasthita kaścideka eva sādhuritare asādhava iti |
vā— [pṛ. 252] ekasmāt padāt prayoganānātva- darśanādanekārthapratibhāne sati vikalpadoṣabhayādanekāṣṭa- śaktikalpanāprasaṅgācca gauṇamukhyavibhāgamāśritya vyava-
sthitaśāstraprayogatvena avaśyasthitalaukikaprayogatvāt yavavarāhādiśabdānāmānarthakyaṃ pratipāditaḥ |
evaṃ (yatra) punarekasmin gatrādāvarthe gogāvyādayo bahavaḥ śabdāḥ prayujyante tatra vṛddhavyavahārāvagatapratiśabdasamavāthivācaka- śaktibhedopapatteḥ |
śāstrasya sarvaśabdaprayogāṇāṃ ca laukika- śabdairavirodhāt padapūrva katvācca vākyātmakaśāstravyāpāra- siddhenaṃ padagatasādhusādhutvapratipādane vyāpāre bhavati, itaretarāśrayatvaprasaṅgāt |
tathāhi— ‘lokaprasiddha- śabdārthavaśaṃ śāstraṃ pravartate |
ato na laukikevya- smātsādhusādhutvanirṇayaḥ |
’ vākyārtheṣu hi śruti- smṛtyācāravirodherdīnāt balāvamatvātnurguṇāvaprabhami tu na viparītakramatvāt |
[pṛ. 253] ‘lokādevādhi- gantavyā śabdānāṃ sādhusādhutā |
vākyākāvāca- katvena sā ca nityaṃ vyavasthitā |
dhvanimātrāya- sādhuni varṇā vā kevalatāmanām |
saṃtādho'rthī- napekṣo vā mātṛkāyupadeśāvat |
’ tena bherośabdā- śabdāḥ gakārakarādayaḥ pratyekaṃ tadarthā vā'narthakatvād- paśabdā iti lokavyavahārādevāthaṃ na sādhyantīsādyo gamyante |
gāvyādayaḥ punargavādideva sādhyantyarthaṃ tebhyo- 'pi vā śīghrataraṃ prasiddhataraśabdapratītimutpādayantīti satyāpi ekaviṣayānekaśabdatve hastakarapāṇyādiśabdavadartha- sādhanatvāt sādhutvenāvadhāryante |
‘tataścācācakatvena yadyasādhutvamucyate |
tasya lokaviruddhatvāt prāmāṇyaṃ pratīyate |
adṛṣṭaviṣayā cetsyādeteṣāṃ sādhusādhutā |
vedavākyairanirdiṣṭā na sā'stya- nyapramāṇikā |
’ pratyakṣeṇa tāvuddhabhayātpaviśeṣeṇa varṇāḥ śuddhāḥ pratī- yante |
na tadatte tatsamudāyagate vā sādhutvāsādhutve |
na vā'danubhūtasaṃbandhadādanumīyate |
tannirūpaṇācca tatpūrva- puruṣavacananirākriyā'pi siddhā |
vedavacanaṃ punarvastu- svarūpatadguṇadoṣaṇāvā'naparaṃ vidhipratiṣedhāpekṣaṃ naiva kiṃcidātmanātvena saṃbhavati |
sādhutvāsādhutvayoḥ ana- nuṣṭhānāramakatvāt vidhipratiṣedhāviṣayatvam |
abhidhā- bhāvanākaraṇabhūtayoḥ vidheyatvapratiṣedhatvasaṃbhava iti cenna, pratiśabdamanantavidhipratiṣedhavākyānāṃ kalpanānupapatteḥ |
‘yo hi pratipadaṃ pāṭhaṃ sādhūnāṃ nādhyavasyati |
vidhivākyāni tāvanti sa kathaṃ pratipatsyate |
apaśabdaśca śabdebhyo bhūyastvena vyavasthitāḥ |
na kalādicatteṣāṃ pratiṣedhatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
’ brīhyā- dibhi hi kalaādīni ca niyatajātiguṇādirūpeṇa pari- jñāyamānaparimāṇatvāt [pṛ. 254] vidhipratiṣedha- gocarībhavanti na tu gavādigāvyādīnāṃ jātirūpeṇa vyakttirūpeṇa vā vidhipratiṣedhāvupapadyate |
na tāvat sādhva- sādhutve jātiguṇādyātmakasāmānyarūpeṇa sarvatravyakttyanugate vijñāyete yadātlambanau dvāveva vidhipratiṣedhāvanumīyetāṃ ‘sādhubhiḥ bhāpeta nāsādhubhi’ iti |
‘avibhaktā hi śabdattvajātiḥ śabdāpaśabdyoḥ |
na tvanvāntarasā- mānye kecidvargadvayāsthitai |
’ tena yatraikā vyakti- vidhīyeta pratiṣedhyeta vā tato yāvatpadaṃ vākyānvanumimānaḥ tailaikyaparaṇādapyadhikāni smṛtibhūtalabhūtavā vedavākyā- nyunmimīte |
na ca tāvatāṃ kośitabhāgā''pyamānāt śakyate |
na cānāmnātasya smṛtibhūtatvam, nityānumeva |
śrutimūlapratiṣedhāt |
na ca vācakatvāvācakatvanibandhanau vidhipratiṣedhau saṃbhavataḥ sarveṣāṃ vācakatvāt |
‘vāca- kairbhāṣitavyaṃ hi prāptānvāt vidhīyate |
avāca- kaniṣedhaśca nāprāpteravakalpate |
’ na hyadakaṃ pivediti na pivediti ca vidhipratiṣedhau saṃbhavataḥ |
avaśyaṃ ca vyākaraṇasmṛtimūlabhūtasā''dhuvidhiśrutirāpyupayiṣyati- rubhayaṃ vā saṃyogapṛthaktvāt kalpanīyam |
trividhi ca pakṣeṣu sādhuśabdāsanamātrameva saukaryādāśritam |
yadi dvāśabdapratipattirmūlaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ tataḥ bahu- tvāt adhyavasthitarūpatvācca na svarūpamavagantuṃ śakyate iti ‘pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ’ iti smṛtinyāyena anugataviparītabhāvanapratiṣedho'rthāpattisiddhaḥ smaryate |
sādhuvidhipakṣe tu te eva smartavyāḥ |
ubhayapakṣe tu tadanu- gamādeva itarasiddheḥ pratiṣedhaviṣayatvānopapattiḥ |
sa eṣa vyākaraṇapakṣe'pi ekānugamananibandhanatvāt kathaṃcit saṃkṣepa'vakalpate |
nanu pratiśabdaṃ vidhipratiṣedhāvaklaptiḥ |
anantāvākyapāṭhāsaṃbhavāt ihāsaṃbhavadarthābhāvemeva holākā dhikaraṇe'bhihitam ‘na tasmā''kṛtivacanatā nyāyāthā, na

vyākaraṇādhikaraṇam
vyaktivacanatā' iti |
tasmāt asaṃbhavanamūlatvāt- smṛtiḥ |
'atha prāpnatha yo'rthaḥ syānna sa śāstrasya gocaraḥ |
siddhaḥ śabdaprayogaśca lokādevārtha- lakṣaṇaḥ |
' atha arthalakṣaṇe'pi śāstreṇa dharmāya prayoganiyamāt prayogotpattiśāstraṃ syāditi |
tadanu- papannam |
niyamavighātāsaṃbhavāt |
'yasya hāniyatā prāptistacchāstreṇa niyamyate |
nityaprāptaprayogastu na śabdo niyamapadam |
[pṛ. 255] yasyāpya- tyantamāpnito'nyo na niyamyate |
tatra cā- tyantamāptirgādyāḥ prāptā mama |
' tena pakṣa- dvaye'pi niyamanupapattiḥ |
kīdṛśaścātra niyamaḥ kalpyeta |
kiṃ sādhubhireva bhāṣitavyamuta sādhubhirmāṣitavyameveti |
' yadi sādhubhireveti nāsāvapaprasaṅgataḥ |
niyataṃ bhāṣitavyaṃ cenmaune doṣaḥ prasajyate |
' yadi hi ekāthīḥ sādhvasādhavo vikalpena prāpnu- taḥtaḥ sādhunimāvakādhaḥ syāt |
tanmate tu punaḥ 'atyantāvācaktvāttu naivāsādhuḥ prasajyate |
yannivṛttiphalaḥ sādhorniyamo''rthavān bhavet |
' atha pramādāccittaprasaṅganivṛttiḥ niyamaṃ prayuñjīta |
tadaṣṭat |
' na hi śāstreṇāpi pramādātki- kāritvāt |
nivartyante prayoktāraḥ prayogāditi dṛśyate |
' dṛṣṭopyatradāmārthābhidhāne prayoga iti cet |
ucyate - ' anyo'pyajñinikocādaiḥ prayogo- 'rtheṣu dṛśyate |
tannivṛttiphalaḥ kaścinniyamo na ca dṛśyate |
' na ca niyamānāṃ pratipakṣanivṛttiḥ prayojanam |
parisaṃkhyāprayojanatvāt |
na cāyaṃ pari- saṃkhyāvidhayo yujyate |
yugapatprāptyabhāvāt |
' na vā dṛṣṭārthatvāsya prayogasyopapadyate |
na hi dṛṣṭanirā- kāṅkṣādṛṣṭamapi gamyate |
' na hi tādṛśo adṛṣṭa- kalpanāyāmarthāpattiḥ prabhavati |
parārthatvāt phalasyetyartha- vādatvam |
na cāsati phale śakyamadṛṣṭaṃ kalpayitum |
' na cedaṃ niyamāpūrvamāśritaṃ kecit gamyate |
śabdārtha- śrautatadbuddhivikalpānuccāraṇagocare |
' śabdasya tāvada- tyantaparārthatvāt nāpūrveṇa kaściduupakāraḥ |
satyapi cābhidhānakarmatvena arthasya prādhānye dṛṣṭārtheṣu lokavyava- hāreṣu vinā'pyapūrveṇāṅgābhāvāt apūrvekārānupayogaḥ |
śrotuḥ punarniyamavidhisaṃsparśānantargatatvādeva asatkārya- tvam |
buddhayaśca kṣaṇikatvāt kālāntarāvasthāyyapūrvā- dhāratvopapattiḥ |
' vaktā tu bhāṣaṇe sarvo guṇabhūto vidhīyate |
na tasya niyamāpūrvasaṃskāryatvanirūpaṇam |
na pradhānapadaṃ cātra vidyate svargakāmavat |
[pṛ. 256] na ca ṣaṣṭhyuktasaṃvanyatvātsvāmitvena pradhānataḥ |
yattu diṅniyamapūrva bhojanadiṣu kalpitam |
puruṣārthatvāt tadarthaṃ tatpratīyate |
' na cehoccāraṇaṃ uccārayitha yena bhojanadisamaṃ prati- padyata |
svarūpeṇa punarbhādvitvāt buddhivadevāṃsaṃskāraham |
' evaṃ cāveda mūlatvāt dharmaniyamārthatā |
yuktā śabdasmṛteryukt na cāsyāḥ śāstratā svayam |
' taduktaṃ 'prayogaśāstramiti cennābhiprāyāt' iti |
' na hi vyākaraṇādīnāṃ vedatvena svatantratā |
puruṣādhīnavṛtteśca sāpekṣasyāpramāṇatā |
' sarvatra hi pauruṣeyādanyadevamayaṃ puruṣo vedeti pratyayastena kartṛbhiprāyaprakāśanāttopayuktatvāt vyākaraṇasyaiva śabda- gatasādhyasādhuvibhāgaḥ pratīyate |
' na ca smṛtyantaraṃ kiṃcid dṛṣṭaṃ tatkāryāgocaram |
dṛḍhaṃ śrutyanumānaṃ syāttenopanayanādivat |
' prāyeṇa manugautamasiddhā- dipraṇītāḥ samāneṣvartheṣu dharmasaṃhitāḥ vartante |
tenāvi- gānāt samānārthatvam |
' parasparaṇa cā''cāryai vigītavacanāḥ sthitāḥ |
sutravārtikabhāṣyeṣu kiṃ tatrādhyavasīyatām |
na tāvatsūtrakāreṇa kiṃci- duktaṃ prayojanam |
kathaṃ caitāvati granthe svātantryo- janavismṛtiḥ |
' yeṣvapi tadgrantheṣu vispaṣṭanyādita evā'
vyākaraṇādhikaraṇam
ghātvarthānugamaḥ kaścit |
yena tadācaritatvenāpyupattavadapa- śabdatvaṃ nirūpyate |
yadapi ca 'āhitāgnipathāccaṃ prayujya prāyaścittāṃ sārakhatīmiṣṭiṃ nirvapet' iti |
tadapyanṛta- vādavaidikaśabdacchiābhyāpāpayogāśrayameva veditavyaṃ na tu vyākaraṇāgatatayatiriktaśabdaprayogaviṣayam |
tathāhi 'kathaṃ nāmetsātkāryātsarva evā''hitāmayaḥ |
pravartann kathaṃ cānyairna nindyeranśiṣṭavat ||
' prāyeṇa hi śiṣṭānāṃ dharmācārapraṇitacetasāṃ kaścideva pramādāt alo'ḍānāccaro bhavati |
gādhyādiśabdaprayogeṣu punarna keṣāṃcidyanācāraśuddhiḥ |
na ca kalpādimanthana- vat [pṛ. 259 ] vicikitsā garhā vā dṛśyate |
na cā''hitāmisahasreṣvanyastvadabhimatasādhuśabdaireva vyava- haramāṇo dṛśyate |
'kalpasūtrasmṛtibhyamīmāṃsāgṛha- kāriṇaḥ |
śiṣṭā draṣṭuḥ prayuñjānā apaśab
aucchidye hi sarvāṇi sāmarthyāni yathākramaṃ lakṣaṇe nānugatāni tatra samastasāmarupasiddheḥ nirākāṅkṣatvaṃ bhavati |
brāhmaṇavidhivacanaṃ ca, ṛgantarscanārthānāṃ prastā- vādipañcadhāvibhāgena lakṣaṇopayogaḥ |
padānugamamātrani- vṛttavyāpāreṇa tu vyākaraṇena viśiṣṭadarśanatvākya- saṃghātasvarūpāṇāmasaṃbhavatarkadapyavākyānāṃ mandamiva rakṣita- tathyaṃ dṛśyate ' lakṣyeyaḥ samāpnyātyātpadyavyākyakramān bahūn |
sa lakṣyettaramalpaṃ prakṛtipratyayakramam |
' kiṃca - 'yadi vyākaraṇarakṣāṃ manvīranmedevādin |
vaiyākaraṇageheṣu chidyante vedasaṃśayān |
kakṣāva- lambhinaṃ nityaṃ ko nāma karakaṃ vahan |
tamāhattya śaucārthamanyataḥ kartumarhati |
loke yasya yadarthatva- mātrā vā yatra ye matāḥ |
tena tebhyaśca tadvastu yathāvadavagamyate |
āyurvedaṃ cikitsāsu prāyeṇa viniyujyate |
vaidyāttattvopadhyānaṃ vaidyebhyaścopa- labhyyate |
' na tu vedādhyāni kadācidapyabhiyuktatara- sahāyādhyātirekena vedarthopadyavākyān saṃdehahaviparyaya- vyāvṛttau vyākaraṇaṃ vaiyākaraṇaṃ vopayujyante |
' sahā- dhyāyibhirevāto vedaḥ kātsnyena rakṣyate |
svarā- kṣaravinaṣṭo'pi dvepādatyenai sṛjyate |
tasmāttīte- rūpādhyāyairdiṣṭeḥ kāruṇikādibhiḥ |
na vināśāśiyaṃ vedo labhyate tena rakṣyate |
' tasmādvedaśāstraṃ tāva- dhyādhyeyaṃ vyākaraṇam |
' loke tu sarvabhāṣābhirarthā vyākaraṇātte |
sidhyanti vyavahāreṇa kāvyā- disyapyasaṃśayam |
' [ pṛ. 263 ] yadi tu saṃvyavahāravākyennatupayujya- mānamapi kādyanāṭalakṣaṇaprākṛtavyākaraṇadvipadīrāsakādi- lakṣaṇanyāyena saṃskṛtakādyopayogārthaṃ vyākaraṇamaśrīyeta, tathāpi kādyaprayogopayogimatyapyadhyātvāyaivedhyāmāpi praśnakaraṇasaṃbhavāccedeṣu na vyavasthā syādityucyate |
' kāvyaśobhāstvapi tyetatraivātopayujyate |
vaiyākaraṇe'pipādyaḥ kaṣṭācchabdān prayujyate |
na ca lakṣaṇamastīti prayoktavyamalayauktikam |
lokasiddha- prayoge tu lakṣaṇaṃ syādanarthakam |
' tena loke'pi na kadācidvyākaraṇaṃ śabdarakṣā |
' uhasyāpyanyataḥ siddheruhyā- nūhāvibhāgavat |
' tathā ca - 'mukhyadṛṣṭārthātasvārtha- samavetārthatādibhiḥ |
prayuktāḥ prakṛtau mantrā gatāḥ kāryātideśataḥ |
vikārastha niṣeddhohāḥ |
kāryā- panneṣu pañcadhā |
arthāntare'rdhaṣapūrvārthadvāreṇohaṃ vrajanti naḥ |
etāvatyantyo yasya vinā vyākara ṇānnatiḥ |
jāyeta sa kathaṃ tatra padaṃ yogyaṃ na lapsyate |
veda eva hi sarveṣāmādarśaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ |
śabdānāṃ tata udbhūtya prayogaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |

' sudaivo asi varuṇa ' ( ṛsaṃ. 6|5|7 ) ityatra yadyapi tāvattama vibhaktaya eva sama sindhava iti vyākhyāyante tathāpi tāsāṃ vibhaktisaṃjñāmātraṃ vyākaraṇena kriyate prasiddhameva vā gṛhyate |
yāni tu prayogarūpāṇi tāni loke vede ca vibhāgaśaḥ pratyakṣaṇyeveti na vyākaraṇā- pekṣyaivamabhidhīyate |
yadā punaḥ sama sindhavo naya eva yajñaliṅgyamānapraśaṃsāpakṣe vā sama hotṛgatā vācaḥ sama sāmasvaragata|
staddhikṛtā vā parigṛhyante, tadaitihāsika- yājñikagocarāpannatvādipaya eva vyākaraṇasya |
' saṃskṛtānāṃ ca śabdānāṃ sādhutve parikalpite |
vaktavyaḥ kathaṃ saṃskāraḥ kathaṃ vā kriyate punaḥ |
' vyākaraṇena śabdeṣu saṃskriyamāṇeṇu na jñāyate kiṃ vastu taskriyate vā kā saṃskāraḥ |
utpattiprātivikārapūrvasādhana- sāmarthyadhānānāṃ kriyate iti |
' na tāvadasti śabda- svavarṇatvavavyaktisaṃskriyā |
sarvatrātiprasaṅgena na vyavasthā hi sidhyati |
śabdatve saṃskṛte syādvi- dhvanīnāmapi sādhutā |
varṇatve'pyekavarṇānāṃ gāvyādīnāṃ ca tulyatā |
' etena varṇavyaktisaṃskāraḥ prayuktaḥ |
[ pṛ. 271 ] ' gavādiyu gakārādiryaḥ sakṛtsaṃskṛtaḥ kacit |
gāvyādiṣu sa eveti sādhutā prasajyate |
evaṃ pratyekasaṃskāre na kasya- cidasādhutā |
samudāyāstva nevāsti teṣāmayu- pacchyate |
' yeṣāṃ tāvadvarṇyatvaḥ pradhvaṃsinya eva teṣāṃ vināśotpannānāṃ saṃskārāyogyameva |
' vartamānā'pi saṃskāraṇaṃ naivāvatiṣṭhate |
tāvadeva vinaśyetsā yāvatsaṃskartumiṣyate |
na ca tāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ bhūyaḥ kaścana drakṣyati kacit |
saktūnāmiva saṃskāro homenaiva prasajyate |
' yaṃthaiva homasaṃskṛtāṃ bhasma- sāndrāvatsaktūnāṃ punardarśanaviniyogāsambhavādvitīyā- pratipāditasaṃskāratvaparigrahe saktavo homastadbhāvanā- vidhiriti sarveṣāṃ anarthakatvaṃ prasajyate iti saṃskārānā- śrayaṇam, tathaiva kṣaṇikatvādyaccitsaṃskārapakṣe sarvārtha- karaṇaprasaṅgaḥ |
tataśca yo'dyamayamiyo'bhihito yathaiva nigaḥ śto'dyāpi kārya ubhayathā'pi lakṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃyamiti sa evameva nyāyanirūpaṇabhayāmātrāviṣkaraṇārthaḥ |
śiṣyā- mohanārtho veti na yuktaḥ parigrahītum |
' adūraviprakṛṣṭe ca vastunniyamo bhavet |
śītoṣṇāniyamaṃ brūyātko tu vahneḥ sacetanaḥ |
utpādaścaiva saṃskāraḥ kāryapakṣe bhavedayam |
tataśca sutarāṃ prāptā prayogo- tpatyaśāstratā |
' vyākaraṇaprakriyānugṛhītena vaivā- karaṇenotpādyamāneṣu sādhuśabdeṣu nityavedatvalavatvādi- nirākaraṇaṃ svayamevā''pāditam |
' atha vyākaraṇo- tpattaiḥ śabdairvedo'pi nirmitaḥ |
tato vyākaraṇa- syaiva vedasyāpyapramāṇatā |
śabdaśraupamānatve
kṣaṇācca syātkṣaṇāntare |
tādṛśasya ca saṃskāro na śakyyo nopayujyate |
tasmādanidhamaṃ muktvā nilaḥ saṃskriyate yadi |
vikriyāsyo'pi saṃskārastato naivāsya saṃbhavet |
vinā vyākaraṇādibhiḥ siddhā śrotrasamāthayā |
adṛṣṭārthasya saṃskāro vidhabhāvātra gamyate |
[ pṛ. 272 ] dṛṣṭārtheṣu ca śabdeṣu nādṛṣṭena prayojanam |
na hīṣṭaṃ bhojanānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ prokṣaṇātphalam |
karmaprakaraṇānnātā na ca vyākaraṇakriyā |
yenāpūrvaprayuktānāṃ śabdānāṃ saṃskṛtirbhavet |
hanyādividhivijñāpi saṃbhavī vyākriyāvidhiḥ |
pauruṣeyaṃ kathaṃ vastu vidudhyā- cchrādhato vidhiḥ |
tenānārabhyavāde'pi vidhi- naivāsti tādṛśaḥ |
anārabhya vidhitve ca na karmārthatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
aikāntikaṃ hi saṃskārya yatkatvau syātsutrādivat |
taddvāreṇa kratuprāptirna lokavya- bhicāriṇaḥ |
lokavedagatatvācca śabdānāṃ vyabhi- cāritā |
ato na vyākriyā gacchettadupasthāpitaṃ ṛtum |
ākāśo'vasthitaḥ śabdaḥ saṃskṛtaṃ śakyate katham |
nityāntyavyākhyāva vyomā- śritavibhutvavat |
varṇasaṃskāramātraṃ yadi vyāka- raṇādbhavet |
pratyāhāreṇa tasiddhernauttareṇa prayo- janam |
samudāyasyaivavastutanyāya saṃskāramarhati |
pratyekaṃ ca bhavedyadagnidharmaḥ |
na ca sthalavadārambho varṇaiḥ śabdasya kasyacit |
yena tatsaṃskṛtiḥ sidhyetsa hi pūrvaṃ nirākṛtaḥ |
sphoṭa- gośabdajñāttvaprabhṛtau padakalpanā |
gakārādipada- vyākhyādvāreṇaiva nirākṛtā |
sarvavarṇasamūho'pi na saṃskāryaḥ kathaṃcana |
na tasyārthaprayuktatvamasti ghanamidhānataḥ |
atha tricaturā varṇāḥ saṃskri- yante pade pade |
saṃkhyāmātrasya sādhutvaṃ tacca syāditireṣvapi |
saṃkriyatetānupūrvī cecchabdadharmī na sevyate |
mahoṇoccāraṇe eva saṃskārye yadi manyase |
karmaṇaḥ karmasādhyatvamuparidhāpye- tyate |
[ pṛ. 273 ] vakṣyati hi- ' kartṛguṇe tu karmā- samavāyādākyabhedaḥ syāt ' ( 3|1|10|19 ) iti |
' tālvādidhotrasaṃskāro na ca vyākaraṇādbhavet |
vaiyopadiṣṭasaṃskārasaṃskāryatvāvadhāraṇāt |
mano vā puruṣo vā'tha saṃskārāspadamiṣyate |
śabdātu- śāsanaṃ śāstramiti vyarthaṃ tadā bhavet |
śiṣyānuśāsanatvaṃ hi śāstrāṇāmupapadyate |
śabda- syānuśāsanatvaṃ hi śāstrānuśāsanam |
sphoṭaśabde ca saṃskāraḥ sutarāṃ nopapadyate |
asannau tatra hi syātāṃ prakṛtipratyayāvapi |
vākyasphoṭasya yairiṭaḥ sarvāvayavavarjitaḥ |
nāmākhyātādi ( ādiśabdena nipātopasaṃgrahoḥ parigrahaḥ ) saṃskāryaṃ teṣāṃ śabda- vipāvanatva |
apoddhāreṇa saṃskāro yatrābhyupa- gamyate |
śṛṅgaṃ śaśādapoddhṛtya kiṃ na saṃkriyate manāka |
anyāvayavasamarūpādyāpoddhāro yadi- pyate |
yasyaṅgena sārūpyācchabdasya kiṃ na saḥ |
gavayādiṣu nājñānāṃ sādṛśyaṃ yannidarśitam |
satyāvayavasāmānyāttvādihīpyate tathā |
vākyā- dhikaraṇe caitadvistareṇa nirākṛtam |
tenāpoddhāra- saṃskārakalpanā'pi na yujyate |
anvācakṣīt śāstraṃ cecchabdanāsadopadhutān |
etenaivāpramāṇa- tyamasya māhendrājālavat |
aśiṣyatvādvāśāstra- mevaṃ tāvatpadaṃ prati |
vākyānuśāsanaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ vyākaraṇena ca |
arthena ca prayuktānāṃ śabdānāṃ saṃskṛtiodā |
vākyamevaṃvidhaṃ ceṣṭaṃ na padānyartha- varjanāt |
brāhmaṇādyo yathā nāsti kaści- dvābrāhmaṇakambale |
devadattādyo vākye tathaiva syuranarthakāḥ |
iti bahuprapañcamuktvā kevalasya cāprayogārthaprayuktatvaṃ nirākṛtya vākyānvākhyānārthameva vyākaraṇamapi vyākhyāyatāṃ yuktamāsīt tadanāśrayaṇāttu sūtravārtikabhāṣyakāradeva [ pṛ. 274 ] pūrvāparaviruddhamabhidhānaitaukārairapi sutarāṃ vyākaraṇasya aprayatiputrapraṇītatvaṃ darśitam |
' ato vigānabhūyādiṣṭhadṛṣṭāntamūlavarjitāt |
niṣphalāca vyavasthāṃ śabdānāṃ nānuśāsanāt |
' tataśca-
vyākaraṇādhikaraṇam
cābhiyuktānāṃ guṇayatāṃ avisaraṇamupapannam |
pratyakṣaṃ caitad guṇyamānaṃ na śrūyate iti |
tasmāt yamabhiyuktā upadiśantyeṣa eva sādhuriti, sādhurityavagamyate |
vā-- [ pṛ. 278 ] tulyaprayogapratipattīnāmantya- tarāvadhāraṇamaśakyamiti cet, ata āha-'tatra tattvama- miyogaviśeṣatvāt' iti |
kaḥ punarabhiyogaḥ ? ko vā sadiśeṣaḥ ? kathaṃ vā tena vācakatvanirūpaṇamiti |
taducyate-' lakṣaṇaśravaṇābhyāsādibhiyogaḥ pravartate |
tena lakṣaṇāntarajñānaṃ taddiṣṭeṣo'bhidhīyate ||
pratipadapāṭhe hyanyānyadatyantāśakyatvadabhāve ca lakṣaṇa- nusaraṇamevekaṃ aśeṣalakṣaṇarūpaṇakṣamatve avadhāryate |
' tasmān lokavedābhyāṃ kaścidvyākaraṇādyate |
vācakanapabhraṣṭān yathāvajjñātumarhati ||
tatsā- masyāparijñāne pāriśeṣyānnirūpaṇāt |
arthā- patyā'paśabdānāṃ niścayo nopapadyate ||
lakṣaṇā- nugamānāstu vaha
vyākaraṇādhikaraṇam
vyākaraṇādhikaraṇam
tathā ||
yathā ratnaparīkṣāyāṃ sādhvasādhutvalakṣaṇam |
tathā vyākaraṇārisaddhaṃ sādhuśabdanirūpaṇam ||
pauruṣeyavyākaraṇaparamparāyām ca tadanugatasādhu- tvāntaradarśanāt pūrvadṛṣṭavivekajñānamātraparatvādvā nānya- paramparāvacananyāyaprasaṅgaḥ |
yāvāniha adṛṣṭārthāḥ sa vaidikavidhipratiṣedhadvayādevopapannaḥ |
tatsiddhayarthāviniha- śabdarūpājñānaṃ vedaśiṣyaprayogasaṃvādivyākaraṇābhyāsāna- pāramparyeṇa sadyaḥ phalatvāt sulabhamiti na puruṣakṛtala- nimittadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ |
yattu dṛṣṭārthatvāt khasāmarthyaprāptatvā- deva ' aprāpte śāstramarthavat ' ( 6|2|14|19 ) iti vācakabhāṣaṇāvidhānamanupapannamiti tatrādhikaraṇenaiva uttaraṃ dāsyate 'niyamāthā vā śrutirucyate' ( 4|1|15|14 ) iti |
tacca avācakatvena apaśabdamānasādhryā- vartyābhāve niyamānupapattiriti |
tatrocyate - 'niyamaḥ parisaṃ
[ pṛ. 286 ] ' athāpi smṛtiśabdena nājñānā- mabhidheyatā |
tata'pyeṣāṃ na śāstratvapramāṇatva- nirākriyā |
purāṇaṃ mānavaṃ dharmaḥ |
śāstro veda- śvikitsitam |
' iti hi tulyatvamāmātthyasaramam-- ' api vā kartusāmānyādukto ( 1|1|12 ) nyāyaśca yaḥ smṛteḥ |
pramāṇatve samāno'sau vedā- jñeṣvāpi gamyate |
pramāṇaṣṭakamūlatvaṃ pūrvaṃ caiṣāṃ pradarśitam |
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalatvena tasmānnāstyapramā- ṇatā |
ekasya ca yadā yuktyā samūlatvaṃ nirū- pitam |
pauruṣeyānyataranmūlatā'pi tadeṣyate |
asaṃbhāvitamūlaṃ hi pauruṣeyaṃ yaducyate |
mūle tasyāpratiṣṭhatvaṃ rūpe jātyanyathātvam |
iha tu samūlatvādekāntatitrāmāṇyasiddhiḥ |
yattu sūtravārtikabhāṣyakārāṇāmanyonyavigītavacanatvādapramāṇatva- miti |
tatra abhīyate-- ' smṛtīnāmapramāṇatvaṃ- vigānaṃ naiva kāraṇam |
śrutīnāmapi bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vigītatvaṃ hi dṛśyate |
vigītavākyamūlanāṃ yadi syādvigītatā |
tāsāṃ tato'pramāṇatvaṃ bhavenmūla- viparyayāt |
' mūlānurūpeṇa hi smṛtīnāṃ pramāṇatvaṃ tadavigāne-- ' parasparavigītatvamatastatra na dūṣa- ṇam |
vigānādi vikalpaḥ syānnaitratrāpramāṇatā |
dharmasādhanatāśe ca vigānaṃ naiva vidyate |
anvā- khyānavigānaṃ tu lakṣyabhedāt duṣyati |
' punarukta- tvādinā hi yatsūtravyākhyānaṃ tasya ca punaḥ samādhā- nam |
' tasyādikmūlatvācca kiṃcidapi duṣyati |
ye cāpītyupasaṃkhyāne te ca smṛtyantarāśrite |
na cādhikopasaṃkhyānānnyastasyāpramāṇatā |
tadyathā |
vājasaneyiśākhāyāmāmātharvaṇaṃ carakaśākhāsu ca bahvityetāvatā nālpaviṣayamapramāṇīkurvanti |
tasāda- yamapi na doṣaḥ |
yastu sūtrakārasya prayojanābhidhāno- pālmbhaḥ |
[ pṛ. 287 ] ' sa śrutismṛtisiddha- tvāttropālambhamarhati |
anthānte ca svasaṃvedyaṃ sujñānaṃ tatprayojanam |
' satyavacanaṃ ca sarvaśruti- smṛtiṣu svargasādhanatvena yāgasādhanatvena ca niyatam |
satyaṃ ca dvividhaṃ śabdasatyaṃ arthasatyaṃ ca |
tatra yathaiva
yathāvasthitaviplutātharvacanaṃ śreyaḥsādhanameva yathāvasthita- śabdasatyavacanamapi, yathā cārthasatyaviṣayatvaṃḥ pratyayārthāyaivaṃ viniyogātpratyakṣaśabdatatvavacanamapi |
śabdasādhutvajñānaṃ ca vyākaraṇābhiyogaviśeṣeṇādityuktam |
' tasmāddijāya- mānatvātproktaṃ mūlakṛtā svayam |
śāstreṇa sarva- śabdanāmanvākhyānaprayojanam |
na ca vyākaraṇaprayojanābhiprāyaṃ prati kecidvadante |
sa eva tvabhiprāyaḥ kiṃ nyāyyo netyāntarametat |
' dharmāya niyamaṃ ( lokato'rthasya śabdaprayoge śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ ) cā''ha vākyakāraḥ prayojanam |
vedamūlastu tatraika eko vyāka- raṇārāyaḥ |
' niyamadvayaprayuktaṃ vyākaraṇam |
sādhuśabda- jñānāttatpūrvayogādvā svargopakārasiddhirityetaccāveda- mūlamananyapramāṇakatvāt |
ataścātra tāvadevāsya śāstreṇa dharmaniyamaḥ |
' tathā vyākaraṇasyena sādhurūpaṃ niyamyate |
aviśeṣeṇa siddhiḥ syādvinā vyāka- raṇasmṛteḥ |
tena vedagatasabhyajñātaśabdaprayoge'hamakathaṃ- svena vyākaraṇaprakriyetarkyatavyatā nityavācakaśabdarūpa- jñānaniyamaḥ kriyate |
yacca kātyāyane jñāne dharma iti cecchā''dhadharma iti tantreṇa prasaṅgena vā'śabdajñānā- dharmamatvātpadopanidhāya śāstraprayogāye abhyudaya iti niḥśreyasasiddhayupāye'vadhārite yadunaḥ : parābhyatra bhāṣya- kāreṇoktam, athavā punarastu jñāne dharma ityabhyupetya- vādyamātraṃ tatpūrvako'pi parihārasāmarthyapradarśanāya kṛtvā- cintānyāyenoktam |
paramārthatastvanyataraprasaṅgavijñāta- pārārthyāpāditātharvādāt phalaśrutirna phalaprāpticchinnā vijñāyate |
yathā ' yo'śvamedhena yajate ya u cainamevaṃ veda ' iti jñānamātrādeva brahmahatyādi yadi sidhyetko jātuciddugdhadravyayāyāsādhyamaśvamedhaṃ kuryāt |
tadvidhānaṃ cārthatvameva syāt |
evaṃ śabdajñānācchedamaḥ sidhyetko nāmetyatātvādivākyātpārāyasakhedamanubhavate |
tasmāttra- vadeva jñāna- [ pṛ. 288 ] pūrvayogasyaiva phala kāraṇe kāryavadupacārāttulyade devavarṣavajjñāne ( ' devo varṣati taṇḍulān ' ityatra yathā taṇḍulaśabdaḥ vṛṣṭau upacaryate iti
dṛṣṭāntataḥ ) dharmavacanamāgāditādharmaparihārābhidhāna- śaktimātrapradarśanārthamevopastaṃ na phalatvapratipādanāya |
' drathasaṃskārakarmasu parārthatvāt ' ( 6|1|12 ) ityanena nyāyena jñānasya puruṣasaṃskāratvena nirā- kāṅkṣasya phalasaṃbandhāsaṃbhavāt |
' sarvatraiva hi vijñānaṃ saṃskāratvena gamyate |
parāṅgaṃ cā''satmavijñānāda- nyatraivatvadhāraṇān |
ārambhajñānaṃ hi saṃgo'pṛthaktvāt katvarthapuruṣārthatvena jñāyate tena vinā paralokaphaleṣu karmasu pravṛttirnivṛttya- saṃbhavāt |
tathā ' ya ātmā'pahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satya- saṃkalpaḥ so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ ' tathā ' mantavyo boddhavyaḥ ' tathā ' ātmānamupāsīta ' iti kāma- vādalokavacanaviśeṣe'jijñāsāgamanasahitātmajñānaketra- lāttvodhaparyantaspaṣṭāmatatvajñānavidhānāpekṣitavākyatantro- pāttasiddhivyāmudayataḥ śreyasarūpaphalasaṃbandhaḥ |
' sa sarvāśca lokānapnoti sarvāśca kāmānāpnoti tarati śokamātmavi- tthā sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpadevāsya pitaraḥ samuttiṣṭhanti tena pitṛlokena saṃpadyo mahīyate ' ityādinā tena janyāṇimātrādyaguṇairbrahmaphalāni varṇitāni |
tathā ' sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokamabhisaṃpadyate na sa punarāvartate ' ityapunarāvṛtyākhyaparamātmaprāptyavasthāla- vacanam |
atrakaraṇatvena anaikāntikatvasaṃbandhavā- nā'janyādisuvavākyādiphalaśrutivat arthavādatvam |
' na ca jñānavidhānena karmasaṃbandhavāraṇam |
' pratyāśramavarṇaniyatāni nityanaimittikānyapi pūrva- kṛtaduritakṣayārtha akaraṇanimittāgatapratyayāyaparihārārthaṃ ca kartavyāni |
na ca teṣāṃ bhinnaprayojanatvānninnamārga- tvācca brahmavikalpaparasparājñāḥ saṃbhavanti |
śabda- jñānasya tvaikāntena prayogātpūrvabhāvitvācca na pṛthak phalasaṃbandhasaṃbhava iti jñānapūrvayogaphalatvameva niśvīya- yate |
yattu ādimadhyākaraṇajñānatatpūrvaprayogaphalasaṃba- ndho'nādividhimūle nāvakalpate iti |
tatra yupādikaraṇa- vadyakaraṇaparamparādivāt anupālambhaḥ |
' tasmādeṣā vyākṛtā ' iti ca vyākaraṇavyavahāranityatvamuktam |
' na caiṣā saṃpradāyena vyākṛtyetidhīyate |
tatra hucyata ityeva vyākṛteti tu niṣphalam |
yadapi ca manunā paṅktipāvanamadhye vedādevopalabho- kama |
yaśca vyākurute vācaṃ yaśca mīmāṃsate'dhvaram |
' ( tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau paṅktipāvanapāvanau |
) iti tenāpi pūrvapakṣādākāṅkṣātītavedavadyaśamīmāṃsanavyatirikta- viṣayeṇa satā''vadhayametadeva vyākaraṇamāśrityeti tanniyatatvasiddhiḥ |
tadaśaktikṣānurūpatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- aya yaduktam-- artho'vagamyate gāvyā- dibhyaḥ |

sambandho niyamaḥ kintu svarūpaṃ dhūmādīnām |

na hi niyamaṃ grahītuṃ deśāntarādisaṃbhavo grahītaḥ kuḍyādīnāmiṣa sthiraṃ rūpam |
na hi teṣāṃ kālāntarasambandhaḥ apratyakṣa iti tatpūmapratyakṣaṃ bhavati |

āha ca- 'rajataṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ hi cirasthāyīti gamyate' |
iti |
tada- niyamarūpaṃ gṛhyate iti yuktaṃ pratyakṣatvam |
kīdṛśaṃ punaridaṃ rūpaṃ dhūmādīnām ? niyatojyamaneti niyamaḥ |
yadā yatra dhūmastadā tatrābhiritye |
tasmādupapannaṃ pratyakṣa- viṣayo niyama iti |
tatredaṃ vaktavyam |
kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvaṃ vidyamānopalambhanaṃ ahosvit avidyamānopalambha- mapīti |

ayameva hi dhūmasyāgninā niyamaḥ yadavilambadeśakālavyāpitameva |
yathoktam- 'yo yasya deśakālābhyāṃ samo nyo'pi vā bhavet |
sa vyāpyo vyāpakastasya samo vā'pyadhiko'pi vā ||
' iti |
yattu dhūmasvarūpaniyama ityuktam, asyaitat svarūpamapi tadisaṃntra-vyāptibhārātmakameva |
kaśāsāvavyabhicāraḥ anyadato (?) yāvaddhūmadeśakālamagnisambandhabhavāt |
tathā ca tasmin pratyakṣīkriyamāṇe deśāntarādisaṃbhavaḥ pratyakṣa āpadyeta |
tatsambandhādiriktaṃ tu pāṇḍuratvādivat dhūmagataṃ niyamābhimānamaparokṣaṃ rūpamīkṣate iti saṃviddhi- rūḍham |
yadi cedaṃ rūpāntaraṃ pāṇḍuratvādivat sarvavyāpti- riktaṃ syāt, tasmin pratyakṣagṛhīte'pi sarvadhūmadeśakāla- vyāpitvamagnerhita na syāt |
na hyanyasmin gṛhīte anyadagṛhītaṃ bhavati, atiprasaṅgāt |
agṛhīte ca deśa- kālāvyabhicāre kathamanumānodayaḥ ? kiṃcidaṃ rūpāntaraṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyamāṇaṃ saṃnihitadeśakālavahnayameva gṛhyate iti na kālāntareṇa niyamaḥ sidhyet |
yadapi darśitaṃ kuḍyādīnāmiṣa sthitaṃ rūpamiti, tadapi nirūpaṇīyam |
kiṃ tatra syātvameva gṛhyate ityabhiprāyaḥ |
kiṃvā yadvastṛtaḥ sthāmarūpaṃ tadgṛhyate iti kiṃvā sthitiyogyatā ? na tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ, sthāyitā anekakālavasthānam, sā kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate, tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt |
yadi cedaṃ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate tataḥ sthāyitāsidvaye pratyabhi- jñādaro nirarthakaḥ syāt |
dvitīye tu kalpe kuḍyārūpameva tat nānyat, evamihāpi yadvastṛto niyataṃ dhūmasvarūpameva tatastatkṣametye sidhyet |
na ca tāvatā kiṃcit prayojanamasti, yogyatā tu sarvabhāvānāṃ arthāpattigamyeti pratyakṣagamyatā'nupapattiḥ |
yastu ghaṭakaḍyādiṣu dṛṣṭa- mātreṣu sthāyitvāvagamo laukikānām, sa tādṛśāṃ sthāyi- tvasya pūrvamevānugamādamānikaḥ |
spaṣṭaṃ cāsyānumāni- katvaṃ uktasvarūpatvāt |
tathāhi īdṛśīyamavagatiḥ yadi śabdādinā naitadriyate tataḥ kiyatkiṃcit kālaṃ sthāyya- tīti |
evaṃ rajatādiṣvapyanumānikameva tadrūpasya sthāyi- tvam |
anenaivābhiprāyeṇoktam- 'rajataṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ hi nirasthāyīti gṛhyate |
' etadeva bādhakasyāpi tattvam |
anumānena hyetadavagataṃ rajatasya sato nāksādatadbhāvaḥ saṃbhavatīti atadasya vā tadrūpeti ubhayopi kālyo- rekarūpamevedamiti sthite pūrvamevāvagataṃ rajatamuttara- kālaṃ vyāpnoti uttarakālāvagatatvāt : tatpūrvakālam |
tena samānaniyatyā pūrvāvagatasya rajatasya bhavatyu- ttarakālabhuvā nedaṃ rajatamītyanena bādhaḥ |
yatra tvanumānena ekarūpatvaṃ na kāladvaye'pi vastuno'vagataṃ tatra na bhava- tyeva bādhaḥ |
yathā badaraphale śyāmapratyakṣaṃ pākakāla- śruvā raktapratyayena |
pratyakṣaṃ tu sthāyitvamagne tatrāpi bādhaḥ syāt |
tasmānna pratyakṣeṇa sthāyitvaṃ svadhyava- sānam |
evaṃ niyamo'pi sarvadeśakālavyāptirūpaḥ |
syācca |
nanu svābhāvikalaṃ saṃbandhasya niyamaḥ na tu kālāntarasambandhaḥ, tacca vartamānameveti yuktaṃ yat pratyakṣaṃ gṛhyate |
kiṃ punaridaṃ svābhāvikam ? na tāvat sadātanatvam, kadācitkasya tadayogāt |
atha svarūpa- nimittatvam, amaṃrapi dhūmasambandhe svarūpaṃ nimittamiti
vyāptivādaḥ
vyāptivādaḥ
tasyāpi dhūmasambandho niyataḥ syāt |
nanu ārdradhanādi- kṛtaḥ asya dhūmasambandhaḥ na svarūpanimittaḥ, satyam, ārdradhanādinimittaṃ svarūpamapi nimittameva |
na hyasati sambandhasvarūpe sambandho bhavati |
svarūpadharmatvamiti cet, sa eva doṣaḥ |
amirūpasyāpi dharma eva saṃyogaḥ |
atha svarūpaikanimittakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ, vahnestu dhūmasambandhe svarūpātikto'pyārdradhanādiḥ asyaiva hetuḥ, dhūmasya vahnirsambandhe svarūpameva nimittam, na nimittā- ntaramastīti matam |
evaṃ tarhi pratyakṣagamyaṃ svābhāvikatvam |
na hi tena nimittāntarābhāvaḥ śakyate pratyetavyam, bhāva- viṣayatvātpratyakṣasya |
dṛṣṭādhanāttu nimittāntarābhāvaḥ pratīyate iti pratyakṣagamyatvānupapattiḥ |
api ca dhūmasyāgnisambandhe na svarūpameva nimittam, amārdīnā- mapi nimittatvāt |
tasmāt svarūpāvyabhicāra eva svābhāvikatvam |
abhyabhicāraśca sakaladeśakālavyāti- riti pratyakṣagamyatvānupapattiḥ, tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt |
api ca svābhāvikatvā'pi vartamānasya saṃnihitasya niścetuṃ śakyate, nātītānāgatavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭānāma saṃbandhānām |
santi hi bahavo vahnidhūmasambandha- vyaktāyaḥ, kathaṃ tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ dhūmasvarūpameva nimitta- miti saṃyuktaviṣayeṇa pratyakṣeṇa gamyate |
atha saṃbandha- sāmānyāsya tannimittatvam, na, tasya nityatvena nimittā- bhāvāt |
idaṃ ca sakṛddarśanamapi niyamapakṣe'pi tulyameva dūṣaṇam |
tatrāpi hi saṃprayuktasya hi saṃyogasya dhūmā- bhāvanimittatvā'gamyate, nātītādīnām |
sa na kāla- ntare naṣṭa iti pratyakṣagatasya saṃyogasya rūpanimittaṃ kālāntare'numānam |
tasmāt na kathaṃcit pratyakṣaviṣayatvaṃ niyamasyeti sthitam |
apare tvarthāpattigamyaṃ niyamaṃ manyante |
yadaitacchrayo'mī dhūmadarśanamartho na kacida- pyadarśanam, idamasati dhūmasyāgninā niyamade'nupapannam |
aniyato hi kadācit kvacidagniṃ vināpyagniṃ vyeteti |
tadapyanupapannam |
adarśanaṃ tāvadabhāvādevopapannam |
na tu tāvatā sarvatra anauau śakyamavasitum, pramāṇābhāvāt |
darśanamātramapi tatra bhāvāderopapannam |
na tu tāvanmātreṇa sarvajñāvasyeva dhūma iti svadhyava- sānam |
tasmādatyantaṃ niyame pramāṇam |
ucyate |
kimatra vaktavyam ? yataḥ- svayaṃ vārtikakāreṇa pramāṇamupadarśitam |
bhūyo- darśanagamyā hi vyāptirityabhidhānataḥ |
atrajanno hi pūrvabhāgāṃ mahantaṃ kleśamāśrityānumānā- rūḍhā vaiyarthyamātreṇaikāvagatitvāyenanyāśritāḥ |
niyato dhūmojyaṃ nūnamagnerlakṣaṇarūpaṃ jñānasya saṃvidvirūḍhapratyakṣa- tvāśrayaṇādāstaṃ cāyamyugmābhyāṃ bhūyodarśanagamyo niyama iti |
kiṃ punaridaṃ bhūyodarśanaṃ nāma pramāṇam ? naike kiṃcit niyamaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate |
kintu yainaiva pratyakṣā- dīnāmamyatamena liṅgasya bhūyaḥsāhityaṃ liṅginā gamyate tadeva niyamadarśanasahāyaṃ niyamapramāṇaṃ saṃbhavatīti |
nanu bhūyobhirdarśanaistatra sāhityaṃ gamyate na tu sarvatra darśanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ svaviṣayaparyavasānāt ananta- pratyakṣagamyo hi sarvatra sahabhāvaḥ sa jīvandurlabhaḥ |
vipakṣadarśanādapi pratyāsanneva vipakṣe paramābhāvo gamyate, sarvavipakṣavyāvṛttastu durlabhaiva, dṛṣṭādarśa- nābhāvāt |
adarśanamātreṇa cābhāvāsiddheḥ, tatkathaṃ niyamasya sarvadeśakālavyāptirūpasya bhūyodarśanagamya- tvam ? etacca svayamevācāryeṇa śaṅkitam |
yadāha-- 'anvayo hi prativyāptaṃ vyāpakasya na dṛśyate |
anantena hi labhyeta sa pratyakṣadijanmanā |
' iti |
tathā- 'nāmāvena vipakṣāddhi hetubhāvaḥ pratīyate |
' iti ca |
sarvavipakṣabhāvo na labhyeta ityarthaḥ |
atra ca samarthanamuktam- 'tatrāsyādṛṣṭamātreṇa gamakaḥ sahacāriṇaḥ |
' iti |
tatraiti vipakṣe ityarthaḥ |
etaduktaṃ bhavati- mā nāma sarvavipakṣabhāvo liṅgasya saitsīt, adarśanaṃ tu vipakṣe liṅgasyāsattvam, tāvatā ca sahacārī dṛṣṭo dhūmādiḥ sahacāriṇo'gnyādergamakau bhavati |
yattu saha- cāritvamapi sarvatra durlabhaṃ dṛṣṭamityuktaṃ tatrāpyuttaramuktam- 'durlabhaṃ sahacāritvaṃ sarvatrati yaducyate |
dṛṣṭaṃ na nāma sarvatra dvitriṣvartheṣu dhruvam |
sāhitye mitadeśatvā- tsidve vahnidhūmayoḥ |
vyatirekasya cā'ṣṭergemakatvaṃ prakalpyate |
' iti |
ayamarthaḥ- mā nāma sarvatra saha- cāritvaṃ darśa, dvayostayoḥ pradeśayorbādhakaṃ darśanam |
tāvatā tvasati vyabhicāradarśane bhavatyanumānam |
yadi hi sakaladeśakālavyāptirūpo niyamo'numānāṅgadharmābhi- rūpagamyeta tataḥ syādupālambhaḥ |
na tvevamasmābhirucyate, kintu yatra yatra dhūmādikaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tatra sarvatra niyame- nāmyādisāhityagamyau cādarśanamityetāvadevanānumānādeye kāraṇam, etāvadeva hi laukikānāṃ dhūmo'gniṃ gama- yati |
na tu sakalapakṣaviṣayānvayavyatirekāvagatimepekṣate, yena durlabhaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt |
tena na sakaladeśakālā- pekṣayā niyamābhidhānamapi tarhi itthamāneṣu deśakaleṣu yo liṅgasya liṅgisāhityaniyamaḥ sa eva niyama ityu- cyate |
tasmāttanmātramevānumānāṅgam |
tacca bhūyobhirava darśaneḥ sugamamiti nāmnāṇaṃ liṅgisāhityaniyamaḥ |
yathā āha - 'sahavyaptimātraṃ gamakaḥ sahacāriṇaḥ' iti |
kiñcit punaḥ : sāhityaniyamairanumānam ? ko nāma- tatsaṃbandhe yāvadvirdṛṣṭaṃ tāvadvirdṛṣṭaṃ na tu saṃśayāya vaktuṃ śakyate |
ye'pi bhūyodarśanasahāyapratyakṣagamyaṃ niyamamāhuḥ, ye'pi sakaladarśane'pi gṛhītaṃ niyamaṃ upādhyāyādyuktā- niśakaraṇārthamarthanye bhūyodarśanaṃ te'pi naivaṃ saṃvatsarate tathā vayamapīti na taddoṣaḥ |
kimidānīṃ sakaladhūma- deśakālavyāptitvamemeḥ nāvagantavyamanumitsatā ? satyam, nāvagantavyam |
nanvevaṃ sāmānyato'nvayavyāptisaṃbandhaḥ pakṣa- kadeśīyaṃ kathamiva śatasaṃbandhena abhīyate |
nānyena pakṣadeśino'bhidhānamapi tu dṛṣṭāntaikadeśinaḥ |
tadayaṃ bhāṣyārthaḥ:- anyasminneva mahānasādyekadeśini dhūmāgne- kadeśābhyāṃ jñātasaṃbandhe sati tadekadeśaṃ dhūmaṃ anyatra parvatādau tatraiva vā mahānase kālāntare dṛṣṭādiritu- mīyate, loke tathā darśanāt |
tathā ca jñātasaṃbandhapadena jñātuṃ nirdeśa ityuktvā athavā na pramātuḥ : kintu prameyasya kasyacit nirdeśo na jñāturityarthaḥ |
kasya prameyaikadeśina ityapekṣāyāṃ dṛṣṭāntaikadeśina ityuktam |
yathāhuḥ:- 'ekadeśeyaikadeśābhyāṃ kaścit jñātasaṃbandhaḥ |
tattulyo'nyaḥ sa vā tābhyāṃ vibhāgenānumīyate ||
iti |
sa vā tābhyāmiti kālāntarābhiprāyam |
evaṃ ca vadan jñātasaṃbandhapadena ekadeśīyapadena dṛṣṭāntaika- deśino'bhidhānamityāha |
bhavatu nāmaivaṃ yathā dṛṣṭapradeśeṣu sāhityaniyamādevānumānam |
yatrayatra yatra dhūmastatra tatrāgniḥ iti bhūyodarśano'vagamaḥ ; sa katham ? na asau nāsti na cāpramāṇam, sarvadā sarveṣāṃ dṛḍhatvena jāyamāna- tvāt |
tadayaṃ kasiṃśrityāmeṇaḍantaḥ bhavatīti vaktavyam |
ucyate |
ānumāniko'yaṃ agamo jñātasaṃbandhasya upa- jāyamānatvāt |
parokṣatvāttva naindriyakaḥ, sākṣātkā- rivyāghātāt saṃvidviśeṣāt |
dhūmasya hi bahuṣu deśa- kāleṣu agninā sāhityamupalabhyato bhavati anumānam |
anyeṣvapītānāgataviprakṛṣṭāḥ sarve eva dhūmanto'mi- manto dhūmatvāt paridṛṣṭamahānasādirditi |
tena pakṣādekaṃ pramāṇasāmānyamanusṛtā dharmāntaragatasāhitya- niyamatvena dharmāntare'numānamityavagamya |
āha ca- 'tena dharmāntareṣveṣā yasya yenaiva yādṛśī |
deśe yāvati kāle vā vyāpatā bhāsūnirūpā |
tasya tāvati tādṛk syād dṛṣṭadharmāṃtare punaḥ |
vyāptīnāṃ vyāpakāṃśasya tathaiva pratipādakaḥ ||
' iti |
yādṛśatādṛśaśabdābhyāṃ dṛṣṭāntārtharūpatā nyūnarūpasya na liṅgastvaṃ nāpi liṅgitvamiti darśitam |
na hi vinā dhūmatvaṃ pāṇḍura- vastramātreṇa kapātādibhyaḥ agniṃ anumimate laukikāḥ |
nāpyuṣṇavahnijanitaḥ : tṛṇavikāro hyi dṛṣṭaḥ pratyakṣava- gatadharmāviśeṣatvāt auṣṇyavattve sati anumānameva vanhi- manumāpayati |
yathā loke ca pramāṇagatiḥ parīkṣakaiḥ ranumaraṇīyā, na tādṛśene |
tadanena sarveṣāmaprayojaka- hetunāmābhāsatvaṃ darśitam |
dṛṣṭāntaparidṛṣṭanyūna- rūpo heturaprayojaka ityucyate |
pakṣapakṣasaṃbandhamevamātra tu so'nyam |
sarvānumāneṣu tathā darśanāt |
tadati- riktaṃ tu rūpavikalpamaṅgīkṛtavantyam |
tena niṣiddha- tvamahitasya hiṃsatvasya adharmatvena sāhityamupalabhya brāhmaṇahananādiṣvāta vinā'pi niṣiddhatvena hiṃsatva- mātrātprāṇīhiṃsāyāmadharmatvaṃ anumātuṃ śakyam |
niṣiddhatvasya vinā'pi hiṃsatvena pūrvvajñatvajñāpanādā- vadharmatvasāhityaṃ iti tadanumāpakam |
yathā adhya- yanādikārthavataḥ : śiṣyasyālukupādhyāyāsāhityamavagata- miti na śiṣyamātreṇādhyāpyamānam |
tathā devadatta- tanayānāṃ śyāmatvasāhityaṃ garbhapariṇāmamayopayuktāśita-
vyāptivādaḥ 3797 vyāptisamarthanam
pītādineṣapanimittamiti tadabhāve devadattatanayatvamātreṇa na tattanmātratasya syāmalātumānam |
etena saṃnivedā- viśiṣṭatayā tanutadagnīhādīnāṃ ghaṭādivat upalambha- tarkatvakatvānumānaṃ pratyuktam |
tathāhi yeṣu hastādidhyāpāra- viśeṣeṇa saṃniveśaḥ śakyante racituṃ teṣāmeva ghaṭapaṭa- gṛhādīnāmapalambhitamakartṛkatvam, tadabhāve pāriṇāmi- kānāṃmadehādīnāṃ saṃniveśaviśeṣamabhreṇa kathaṃ tadanumānaṃ pāṇḍuramadrādiṣviva vahyanumānam |
tathā śarīreṃdriyādi- yuktabuddhimatkartṛkatvena sāhityaṃ saṃniveśaviśiṣṭatāmapa- labdhaṃ tacca dṛśyādeśāt dūto'ṅkurakādiṣu niṣiddham |
tasmin niṣiddhe buddhimanmātraṃ dvārādirādirhataṃ ganumānaṃ draṣṭavyam |
tṛṇādidrikādiṣviva hime upalambhyanumānam |
na caivaṃ sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, saviśeṣaparihāreṇa bhūtatva- sāmānyasya vadisasāmānyena sāhityamavagataṃ parvate na tadavikatvameva dṛṣṭamiti yuktaṃ tatra tadanumānam |
sāmānya- bhevānumīyate na viśeṣaḥ, anugamyabhāvāt |
avagatamapi mahānasādī sāmānyaṃ deśāntarakālāntarādau pratyakṣeṇa- vānumānena pratyabhijñāyamānaṃ bhavān prayogamiti na siddhasādhyatā |
sāmānyasyāpi cānyatvaṃ saṃyuktasamanyāya- saṃbandhaḥ parvatena, iti yuktaṃ tatra tasyāmānam |
nanu deśaviśeṣe'pi padārthasvarūpabhavyathā bhavati, kvaciddhi vṛścikadaṃśādi maraṇaṃ bhavati, kvacicca, tathā dhūma- syāpi deśāntare agnirvyabhicāraśaṅkā bhavet |
satyeṣā bhavati, sā tu tattaddeśādāgatyaḥ śrutvā kathyate nirasitu- miti sarvamavadātam |
tena yasya yādṛśasya sāmānyasya viśeṣasya vā yena yādṛśena viśeṣeṇa vā yathā- dṛṣṭeṣu deśakāleṣu sāhityaṃ yena kenāpi saṃbandhena niyata- mupalabhyam, tadeva tādṛśameva deśāntarakālāntarādau dṛṣṭaṃ tasya tādṛśasya sāhityaniyamādeva bodhakaṃ bhavati |
dṛṣṭapradeśeṣu bhūyobhirava darśanairdhanādirādīnāṃ sahāyaiḥ sāhityaniyamaḥ śakyāvagamaḥ : iti siddhaṃ niyamarūpa eva liṅgasya liṅginā saṃbandhaḥ, sa ca bhūyodarśanapramāṇaka iti |
pārthasārathimiśraviracitāyāṃ nyāyaratnamālāyāṃ vyāptivādaḥ samāptaḥ |
ratnamālā. pṛ. 56-62. vyāptisamarthanam |
idānīṃ sakṛdadarśanagamyā vyāptiriti pratipādyate |
saṃyuktādibhyo abhidhūma iti pratipattirasti nirvivādam |
atra ca deśakālabhyāṃ saṃyogena na viśiṣṭamarthirye pratīyate, guṇānāṃ dravya- pagatatvasvabhāvatvāt |
taduktam 'guṇānāṃ ca padārthatvāt' iti |
tacca śabdānāmiva padārthānyaviṣayamiti cet, tasyāpi pratyakṣamūlatvāt |
loke tu yena prakāreṇa padārthānāṃ parasparānvayaḥ pratyakṣairbiniścitaḥ, tathaiva śabdo bravīti, itarathā vedavākyeṣu yathātathārthapari- tyāgena lakṣaṇā gauṇā vā vṛttyā'nyārthavarṇanaṃ kriyamāṇa- mayuktaṃ syāt |
ato'nyathāmātraviṣayo nyāyaḥ na śābda- viṣayaḥ : saṃyogasya na deśakālaśca dravyaviśeṣatvena pratīto sthityā saṃyuktāvagamito idānīmagnidhūmavi- tannayo bhavati, na idānīṃ agnidhūmayoḥ : saṃyoga iti, itarathā saṃyogasya deśakālaviśeṣatvaṃ kimiti nāśrī- yate ? tataśca yāvaddravyabhāvitayā saṃyogasya pratīta- tvāt yatra dhūmaḥ : tatrāśiśeṣeṇa ityenīpādhika eva dhūmasya abhisaṃbandhaḥ sakṛdadarśane eva siddhaḥ |
saṃyogasya ca
vyāptisamarthanam
vyāptyavṛtti
upādhiriti śaṅkāyā vyaktyantare'pi saṃyogadarśanenaiva śaṅkānivṛttiḥ |
nanu dhūmajāterapi vyaktimātre'nvayaḥ |
nevam, yadi sāmānyamantareṇāpi vyaktyagrahabhasti, tadā syāt sāmānyasya guṇabhāvaḥ |
na ca sāmānyamantareṇa kadā- cidapi vyaktaḥ pratītiḥ |
na hi rūpaśūnyā kācidapi rūpabuddhirasti ityuktvāt |
ato jātiviśiṣṭasyaiva prādhānyāt, tena saṃyogasyāvantyāt sarvadhūmavattā sakṛ- devāmisattā gṛhītā bhavati |
taduktam, 'tathā ca sati dhūmasattaiva deśāntare kālāntare vā pramāṇamapekṣate, na ca tathyā satyāmamisaṃyogaḥ' iti |
evaṃ gṛhīte'- pyanaupādhikatve yadyupādhiśaṅkā kasyacit syāt, tadā bhūyodarśanādeva śaṅkānirāsamātraṃ kriyate, na vyāpti- grahaṇam |
nanu upādhyarśana'pi śakkodayādeva darśanamapi śaktameva syāt, evaṃ tarhi atiprasaṅgaḥ, ghaṭādigraha- ṇe'pi bādhakaśaṅkayā ghaṭādigrahaṇasyāpi aniścayaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu arthinā saṃyogasya sakṛddarśanenyāt sakṛddarśa- nenāgninā dhūmānumānaṃ prasāvyate |
naivam, sakṛddarśane- naivāgnerdhūmasaṃyogo'pyanaupādhika iti prāptam, uttarakālaṃ tu āgneyatvādyupādhidarśanāt aupādhikatvaniścayaḥ |
na ca upādhidarśanāt aupādhikatvaniścaye upādhyadarśane'pi tatsambaddhaḥ |
ataḥ sakṛddarśanedeva vyāptigrahaḥ |
na ca sakṛ- darśanasyāśaktau bhūyodarśanasyāpi śaktiḥ, bhūyodarśanā- mapi pratyekaṃ sakṛddarśanatvāt |
na ca darśanānāṃ bhūyastvaṃ āhakam |
ratnatatvagrahaṇe tathā dṛṣṭamiti cet, naivam, na tatrāpi bhūyodarśanasya grāhakatvam, kiṃtu vivecakākāra- grahaṇe pravṛttaṃ tasya ca atisaukhyāt manaḥsamavadhānāya- bhāvācca na tattvaṃ grahītuṃ prabhavati, kevalaṃ ratnamātrameva gṛhṇāti |
evaṃ anekadarśane jāte manaḥsamavadhānādi- sāmagrīsaṃbhavāt arthādavedā tattvaṃ gṛhṇāti |
ato na bhūyodarśanasya tattvagrahaṇe upayogaḥ |
bhūyodarśanasya kāraṇatvābhyupagame indriyasaṃnyadhādivat sarveṣāṃ bhūyodarśana- niyamo'pi syāt |

eva- mekaikatra svapadopāttatvāttvarjanamaunyatvikaṃ śrautaṃ ca, dhātvarthāntarajanatvañcāvi vākyakaraṇalambhyaṃ ca |

nanu dadātipade- 'pyasau punaḥ śrayamāṇā seveti pratyabhijñāyate iti na vaktavyaṃ vākyakaraṇāmyāṃ dadātisaṃbandho bhavatīti |
satyaṃ bhāvanāmātrasaṃbandhaḥ śrutyaiva pratīyate |
yāgānurakta- bhāvanāsaṃbandhe tu na śrutivyāpāro yujyate |
nanu caika- tvādevāsāṃ bhedavyavahāro na yuktaḥ |
kena vā karmabhedapakṣe'pi sāmānyaikatvaṃ nābhyupagamyate |
nanvatra vyaktinātve'pi nāsti pramāṇam |
kathaṃ nāsti ? yadā bhinnadhātvarthasaṃnidhānādau nānātvena pratiśabdamupalabhyate |
nanu ca śabdabhedaiva paropādhiko bhedametyanayo na pāramārthiko bhāvanābhedaḥ syāt |
naitadevam, śabdasyāpi gakārādibhedaḥ pāramārthiko naiva kasyacidaniṣṭadvihāpi yāgādibhede siddhe śabdasthānīyamanuṣṭhānasāmānyāt nirūdhyate |
na ca yathā śabdasya arthāntarabhūtā dhvanayaḥ dugādibuddhimāra- mārgīkīṃ kurvantyevamatra yāgādoṣo'durucyateriti |

na ca tena dānahomau labhyete |

na ca dhātvarthatvam |
āsecanaparatvatvādānāmyadhikatvāt |
na ca tyāgamātralakṣaṇa, svārthavṛttitvenāpi vākyasama- vāyogapatteḥ |
na ca dakṣiṇādi nāma guṇaḥ : kaścitsiddha iti sāmānyādhikaraṇyanāmadheyatvameva yuktam |
ataśca vākyānarthakyaṃ mā bhūditi homo vidhīyate |
dadātinā tu yāgamatraguṇe vidhīyamāne hiraṇyādyasaṃbandhe vākya- bhedaprasaṅgādaguṇādi bhedaḥ saṃbhavatītyekaguṇo nirguṇo vā''dadātirādahartavyaḥ |
śā-- ( asmin adhikaraṇe ) śabdāntarāt karma- bhedaḥ abhīdhīyate |
iha ekaprakaraṇagatāni aparyāyadhātu- niṣpannāni ākhyātāni- ' yajati ' ' dadāti ' ' juhoti ' ityādīni udāharaṇam |
tatra hi satyapi pratyayāṃśasya ekatve dhātubhedāt ākhyātādapi mithaḥ śabdāntarāṇi bhavanti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ- kiṃ ekā eva bhāvanā nānā- dhātvarthānuraktā vidhīyate uta pratidhātvarthaṃ bhāvanābheda iti |
anekāpūrvatvakalpanābhiyā eka eva bhāvanā iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu- ' pratyayāṃśaḥ samāno'pi pratidhātuprayogāt |
tattaddhātusāreṇa bhāvanā- bhedamāhet ||
niṣpadyeta samastabhyo dhātubhyaḥ pratyayo yadi |
tataḥ sarvaviśiṣṭā syāt dvandvo- tyajasubarthavat ||
yadi vā pratyayaḥ śuddhaḥ sarva- dhātupṛthakkṛtaḥ |
śrūyeta kyavatsarvairviśiṣyeta sa dhātubhiḥ ||
' soma-- sūtrārthastu- śabdāntare paryāyānubhede karmabhedaḥ bhāvanābhedaḥ dhātvarthena bhāvanāyā anubandhasya avacchedasya kṛtatvāditi |
vi-- ' dadāti yajatītyādau bhāvanaikyamānayatā |
ākhyātaikātyacedatvaṃ dhātubhedo'prayojakaḥ ||
dhātu- bhedena bhinnatvamākhyāte śrūyate tataḥ |
utsalpakenānukta- tvādintyate bhāvanā bhidhaḥ ||
niyogaikatvataḥ śāstrama- bhinnamiti cenna tat |
dhātubhedāt śāstrabhede niyogo bhidyate balāt ||
' bhāṭṭa-- bhāvanābhedaphalībhūtāpūrvayogibhāvāthārtha- dhikaraṇopapodātprasaktānuprasaktādau samāse adhunā śabdāntarābhedo'bhidhīyate |
jyotiṣṭomādiprakaraṇānāṃ ' romena yajeta, hiraṇyamātrāya dadāti, dākṣiṇāni juhoti ' ityādīnāṃ vibhinnadhātvarthānāṃ bhāvanābhedo'tha- katvamasti na veti cintāyāṃ ' jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta ' ityanena svargakarmakabhāvanāmātre lāghavādrihite tadanuvādena somādivākyaiḥ somādiviśiṣṭayāgādidhā- nāt |
sarveṣāṃ cotpannaśiṣṭatvena guṇanyāyābhāvāt na bhāvanābhedaḥ |
na cānekātvarthānāmekajātīyayatnajanya- tvāsaṃbhavaḥ, bādhakābhāvāt |
na ca pratyayārthānvitasvārthā- bhidhāyakatvāt pratyayānāṃ phalavākyasthenākhyātena dhātva- rthānavicchinna-śuddhabhāvanāvidhānānupapattiḥ, ākhyātena dhātvarthāvicchinnabhāvanābhidhāne'pi tadaṃśe vidhivyāpārā- bhāvāt |
ata eva guṇaphalasambandhasyale dhātvarthānuvāde- nāpi bhāvanāmātravidhānāt |
ata eva ca phalavākye yajiḥ prakṛtasarvadhātvarthopalakṣakaḥ |
jyotiṣṭomapadaṃ ca chatra- nyāyena sarvanāmadheyam |
iti prāpte, kāryamātravṛttitvadharmasya vijātīyatvayāgatvadeḥ kaṃcitpratī kāryatāvacchedakatvāva- katvena tadavacchinnaṃ prati upasthitasya yatnasya vaijātya- parikalpanayā vijātīyayatnenaiva kāraṇatvam |
ataśca pratidhātvarthavaijātyāt bhāvanāvaijātyasiddhiḥ |
vibhinna- dhātvarthameva ca śabdāntaratvam |
ata eva ' tinna āhutīrjuhoti ' ityatra saṃkhyayā homabhede siddhe śabdāntarādeva uktavidhābhāvanābhedaḥ na tu mūlektāditi dhyeyam |
dviṣa prāsamāvanānuvādena somayāgādyaneka- vidhāne vākyabhedapāteḥ tacchrutadhātvarthī bhayaviśiṣṭabhāvanā- vidhānameva tattadākye'ṅgīkartavyam |
tatra ca cāturthika- nyāyena jyotiṣṭomadābhidheyasya somayāgasya svarga- vākyena phalasambandhaḥ anyeṣāṃ tu tadaṅgatvam |
na ca svargavākye eva yāgabhāvanāotpattipūrvakaḥ phalasambandhaḥ somavākyena tu somamātravidhānamiti vācyam |
svarga- vākye rājasūyavākyena iṣṭipaśuyāgānāmeva phalasambandha- pattī yāgāntaravidhāne pramāṇābhāvāt |
tataśca paścādya- varuddhe somavidhivyanupapatteḥ somavākye karmāntaravidhivyayaṃ- bhāvaḥ |
prayojanaṃ somayāgamātraprādhānyam |

tasmāt kāraṇāt agracchāmo na kṛtvā saṃbandhaṃ vyavahāraiḥ kenacit vedāḥ praṇītā iti |
yadyapi ca vissaraṇamupapadyeta, tathāpi na pramāṇamantareṇa saṃbandhārthaṃ pratipadyamahi |
yathā viva- mānasyāpi anupalabdhaṃ bhavatīti, naitāvatā vinā pramāṇena śaśaviṣāṇaṃ pratipadyamahe |
tasmāt apauruṣeyaḥ śabdasya arthena saṃbandha iti |
nanu arthāpatyā saṃbandhārthaṃ pratipadyamahi |
nahi akṛtasaṃjñatvāt śabdāt arthe pratipadyamānān upa- lambhāmahe |
pratipadyeraṃścet prathamaśravaṇe'pi pratipadyeran |

na |
siddhavadupadeśāt |
yadi saṃbandhabhāvāt niyogato nārthā upalabhyeran, tataḥ arthāpatyā saṃbandhārthama- gacchāmaḥ |
asti tu anyaḥ prakāraḥ |
vṛddhānāṃ svārthena saṃvyavahāramāṇānāṃ upalambhato bālāḥ prathamamarthaṃ prati- padyamānā dṛśyante |
te'pi vṛddhā yadā bālā āsan, tadā anyebhyo vṛddhebhyaḥ, te'pyanyebhyaḥ iti nāsyādiḥ ityevaṃ vā bhavet |
athavā na kaścideko'pi śabdasyārthena saṃbandha āsīt, atha kenacit saṃbandhāḥ pravartitā iti |
atra vṛddhavyavahāre sati nārthādapayeta saṃbandhasya kartā |
apica vyavahāravidaḥ pratyakṣamupa- diśanti, kalpayanti itare saṃbandhāram, na ca pratyakṣe pratyārthini kalpanā sādhī |
tasmāt saṃbandhurabhāvaḥ |
( sūtrapadāni yojayati- ) anyatirekaśca |
yathā asmin deśe sāsnādimati gośabdaḥ, evaṃ sarveṣu durga- meṣvapi |
bahavaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kathaṃ saṃsravyante ? eko na śaknuyāt |
ato nāsti saṃbandhasya kartā |
apara āha- anyatirekaśca |
na hi saṃbandhavyatiriktaḥ kaścit kāle'sti, yasmin na kaścidapi śabdaḥ kenacidarthena saṃbaddha āsīt |
katham ? saṃbandhakriyaiva hi nopapadyate |
avaśyamanena saṃbandhaṃ kurvatā kena- cit śabdena kartavyaḥ |

naivātiṣṭhate |

asti cet vyavahārasiddhiḥ, na niyogataḥ saṃbandhā bhavitavyaṃ ityarthāpattirapi nāsti |

dṛṣṭā bālā vṛddhebhyaḥ pratipadyamānāḥ |

bhā. 1|1|5 pṛ. 52-58. bṛhatī- 'atha saṃbandhaḥ kaḥ ? yat śabde vijñāte'rtho vijñāyate' iti kaḥ punarayaṃ saṃbandhaḥ pṛthaśca upanyastaśca ? pūrvoka eveti vadāmaḥ |
nanu cāsau saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tasādayameva saṃbandha iti manyate |
tadyuktam |

nanu ca pratyāyasya pratyāyakasya ca saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandha iti vadatā pratyāyasya pratyāyakasya iti pañcya- bhidhānena saṃbandhavyantaramuktaṃ bhavati |
maivam |

asyevātra hetuhetumattayā vyatirekaḥ |
pratyāyapratyāyakatvaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñilakṣaṇasaṃbandhasya abhidhāne nimittam |
anyathā pratyāyapratyāyakatvayopayo'narthakaḥ |

śabdārthasaṃbandhanityatvavādaḥ 3831 śabdārthasaṃbandhanityatvavādaḥ
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ punaḥ praśnopanyāsaḥ ? idamatra kāraṇam, vivartapakṣe hi (vivartavādine vaiyākaraṇe kṛte ākṣepe ) yutasiddhayoḥ anapekṣatvaṃ na śakyate vaktuṃ iti mantrānasya praśnaḥ |
śakyate hi vṛddhavyavahārasya anādi- tayā anapekṣatā vaktuṃ iti tasyaivopanyāsaḥ |
sa tu kṛtaka iti pūrvoparṇitenaivābhiprāyeṇoktam |
'tasmānmanyāmahe kenāpi puruṣeṇa śabdānāmaiḥ saha saṃbandhaṃ kṛtvā saṃbandha- hetuṃ vedāḥ praṇītāḥ' iti sāpekṣatvaṃ upasaṃhṛtam ( vivarta- vādinā ) |
tadidānīmucyate, 'apauruṣeyatvāt saṃbandhasya siddhaṃ' iti vṛddhavyavahārasya anāditopanyāsaḥ |
kimidaṃ tarhi praśnottaram ? kathamiti pṛṣṭe, puruṣasya saṃbandhurabhāvāt ityuttaramayuktam |
a ( ditrāpi ) tapakṣa- nirāsāyedamucyate |
kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratipakṣatayā āśa- ṅkyate ? bāhyamāśaṅkyate |
anādinā api vṛddhavyava- hāreṇa śabdārthavagamasiddhau yatra kartā upalabhyate tatra ādimataiva balāt prāpnoti 'vṛddhiradaic' itivan |
( ṛju- yadyapi vṛddhavyavahārāditāyāḥ api śabdāt arthāvagama upapadyate, tathāpi sākṣāt saṃketakāraṇādarthena na śakyate anāditā vaktuṃ iti bhanati saṃbandhapuṣpo- palambhane pratipakṣabhūtam ) tasmāt karturupalambho nirā- karaṇīyaḥ |
'kathaṃ punaḥ saṃbandha nāsti' ityasya praśnasya kimi- damuttaramupapadyate 'pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyabhāvāt tatpūrvaka- tvācceteṣāṃ' iti ? kathaṃ nopapadyate ? anumānāderapi prāmāṇatvābhyupagamāt |
( ṛju- tena pratyakṣamātranirā- karaṇaṃ na saṃbandhunāstitāmāvahati ) |
tatpūrvakatvaṃ nāyukaṃ ( śabdasya ) sāpekṣatvaprasaṅgāt |
kriyāhi cānanume- tāpteḥ |

( ṛju- yat loke anyamanasaḥ kathāsu śrūyate- ghoṭārudro bhavato vismṛto ghoṭa iti |
vismṛtaḥ cittādapakrāntaḥ |
smarateḥ karmakartṛvivakṣaya idaṃ rūpam ) |
abhiprāyanabhikṣasya etadaucityam |
kevalnumānātpramāṇatayā tāvat saṃbhavati anādau vṛddha- vyavahāre pratyārthini ( ṛju- to tāvadanumānāgamī ) kevalapratyakṣavyāpāranirapekṣau |
tadgamyatā tāvat saṃbandhu- nai bhavati |
yasmāt kāryataḥ kāraṇātmānaṃ kevalānu- mānam |
śabdācca arthapratītiḥ kāryabhūtā |
sā ca naikā- ntena saṃbandhāntarameva anumāpayitumalama, vṛddhavyavahārā- nāditayā'pi upapadyate |
tathā āgamo'pi svatantratā- vat na saṃbandhamucce pramāṇam, kāryakavipayatvāt |
yadi paraṃ pratyakṣānumānapūrvakaṃ vaktavyaḥ, tatrānumānapūrvaka'pi anādiddhavyavahārapratipattasaṃbhavena kevalānumānābhāvāt pratyakṣapekṣo na saṃbhavati iti |
tasmāt pratyakṣaṃ tatpūrvakaṃ cagamānumānaṃ nirasanīyamiti |
tasmādupapanna- muttaram |
bahuvacanamidānīṃ kimarthaṃ 'tatpūrvakatvāccetta- reṣāṃ' iti ? itareṣoriti vaktavyam |
( uttaram - ) dvayorāśaṅkanīyatayā upanyāsāt |
asaṃbhavanu sarvameva ityupapannaṃ bahuvacanam |
nanu ciravṛttatvāditi asiddhatāmāha |
kathama- siddhatā ? pūrvajānāṃ pratyakṣaviṣayatopapatteḥ |
na hi cira- vṛttaḥ san na smaryata iti na pūrvajñānāmapi pratyakṣamātra saṃbhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ |
yadi syāt pāṇinetva smaryeta |
na ca himavadādikapuruṣāmādavat asmaraṇaṃ bhavitu- marhati |
tatrāsmaraṇe heturupapadyate puruṣaviśeṣādiḥ |
'na ca puruṣaviśeṣaḥ śabdānām' iti kimabhipretam ? kṛtakatve hi tadāmāt prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, na niścayo'janatayā vicchedaḥ, smaraṇopapadyate ityabhiprāyaḥ |
( ṛju- yadi saṃbandhā puruṣaḥ pratyakṣamadhiyamyaḥ syāt tadā tatsaṃketasyapratipatteḥ pratipattavyaḥ |
nahi saṃketavipatti vyavahāraḥ syāt ādyedamilayoḥ kaliśabde |
tena saṃketasaṃpratipatyarthe puruṣaḥ smartavyaḥ syāt |
) tacca pāṇineḥ ślokapanyāsena prakaṭitam |
'yadyapi ca ... pratipadyamahe' ( bhāṣyaṃ ) iti kiṃvipayamidaṃ vismaraṇamupanyastam ? yadi tāvat sādhya- viṣayam, tadedameva pramāṇaṃ yadūta vismaraṇopapattiḥ |

ataḥ saṃskṛtena śabdena yasyendriyaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ sa eva śṛṇoti nānya ityupapannam |
‘yugapaddeśabhedaśca syādekasyāpi sūryavat |
ye vindhyanilayā ye ca kāmarūpe vyavasthitāḥ |

pratyagbhāge tathā''saṃ yanamadhyāhe copari sthitaḥ |
