’ tathā yasminn yāvadūre deśe kaiścit sūryodayo dṛśyate tadeśavartito'nye'pi tataḥ parastāttāvati paśyanti tato'pyasti medābhedaḥ |
na ca sūryanānātva- mādakṣanīyam, na hi kecit bhinnaṃ sūrya paśyanti |
kiṃ punarekadeśasthasya saviturnānādeśopalambhe kāraṇam ? ucyate—atidūravartito'sya yathāvadeṃdā ajānantaḥ svasaṃnidhimapyasyanto deśamedhaṃ vispaṣṭaṃ dhyanta |
tathāhi— yaḥ aparāhne yasmin yāvadūre deśe sūrya paśyati— ‘asmin kṣetre'smin parvate sūryaḥ’ iti, sa savitāmīkṣamāṇa eva tadeśo gatastataḥ parastāttatha taṃ paśyati tenāvagamyate sarveṣāṃ deśānamamataḥ sthito'sau saṃnihitavadavabhāsate iti |
ye cādityāpekṣayā stokadeśāḥ parvatāste'pi dvidhojanasthitānāṃ triyojanasthitānāṃ ca puruṣāṇāṃ tulyavadavabhāsante, tasmādekatve'pi saṃbhavati nānādeśopalambhaḥ |
tathā ekameva mukhaṃ bhinneṣu ādarśeṣu yugapat dṛśyate |
nanu prativimbaṃ nāgāthānnaraṃ tatra dṛśyate |
na |
tasyābhāvādanupalambhacca, nahi mūrtamadhye mūrtāntaraṃ saṃbhavati |
kiṃca darādasyadakaṃ bhūrerupāri nābhidane dhārayitvā tasyoparihādarendredhaṃ smulaṃ kurvandakasā- bhastādaranimātre sulabhaprativimbaṃ paśyati, tasmin deśe pārśvasthāḥ puruṣā na kaṃcidapi paśyanti, tena dṛśyā- darśanirastaḥ prativimbāndhyo'sau na śakyo'bhyupagantum |
tasmādādadhaitejasā jalena ca pratihataṃ nayanaṃ tejaḥ parā- vṛttya gṛhṇatīti yuktam |
tasmādekanitako nānādeśo- palambho na nānātvaṃ śabdasya sādhayati |
nanu savituḥ saṃnidhyādhāsāyāttukā nānādeśāvāptiḥ, śabde tu katham ? sarvaṃgatatvāt, sarvagato hi śabdo bhinnadeśaiḥ dhvanibhiḥ sve sve deśe'bhivyajyamāno bhinnadeśo'vabhāsate, dhvanayo hi śrotradeśamāgalāpi śabdaṃ vyañjanataḥ svopattideśa- miva śabdaṃ bhāsayantīti darśanabalādabhyupagamyate |
nanu prāpyakāri śrotram, na ca dhvanyutpattideśaḥ śrotreṇa prāpyate iti kathaṃ tasya śrotreṇa grahaṇam ? tadagrahe ca kathaṃ tadviśeṣagrahagrahaḥ ? ucyate— nāyaṃ śrotrastadviśiṣṭa- śabdapratyayaḥ, kiṃtu śrotraṃ hi svadeśasthitaṃ śabdaṃ bodhaya- ti na deśaviśiṣṭaṃ bodhayati kiṃtu svarūpamātreṇa, yatastu diśa āgatā dhanayastayā viśiṣṭaṃ śabdaṃ bodhayati, sā hi dik śrotraprāptā śakyate śrotreṇa grahītum, yadyapi na svātantryeṇa diśaḥ śrotragrāhyatvaṃ tathāpi rāve gṛhyamāṇe cadriśopaṇatayā digapi śrotreṇa gṛhyate iti dṛṣṭatvādagṛ- kriyate kālavat |
yathā hi kālo na svātantryeṇendriyai- gṛhyate atha ca vipayeṣu sveṣu gṛhyamāṇe tadviśeṣaṇatayā saṃvairīndriyairgramyate tadvat |
tataścāsyāṃ diśi śabda iti viśiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ tāvatsiddham |
dhvanayaśca krameṇa mandībhavantaḥ pratyāsannāhāradūrarācca deśādāgatāstītraṃ mandaṃ mandataraṃ ca śabdaṃ bodhayanti |
bodhaviśeṣācca dhvanyutpattideśaḥ pratyāsannadūrādirūpe- numānāt hṛdayadeśamāgacchati tatra yaḥ śabdasya paragārtha- deśaḥ śrotradeśastyāgrahaṇāt digviśeṣasya śabdarūpasya dhanyutpattideśaśca grahaṇāt tataḥ saṃsargamadādevividhaḥ pratyayo bhavati, prācyāṃ diśyetāvadantarāle śabda iti, tasmādabhivyañjakadeśabhedopapade nityasyāpi nānādeśopa- labhbhanamityadoṣaḥ |
nanu aya doṣaḥ, yadasati bādhake bhrāntitvam, pratyabhijñāyāṃ vā kaḥ pakṣapāto yena sā bhrāntiḥ syāt |
ayamasti pakṣapātaḥ, nadyasaṃbhavati tadbhrāntitve bhrāntitvamaṅgīkartuṃ yuktam, nānādeśopalambhe- svaparihārya bhrāntitvam |
anityatvapakṣe'pi śrotragata eva paramārthato gṛhyate śrotrasya prāpyakāritvāt, na ca vaktṛmumagato yena tadeśagrahaṇābhrāntitvaṃ syāt |
yadyapi yaugato'pyāpyakāritvamevāṅgīkurvanbhrāntitvaṃ samarthayeta, tadyuktam |
aprāpyakāritve hi saṃnikṛṣṭa- viprakṛṣṭau tu yugapacchabdamupalabheyātām, tayośca krameṇo- palavdhinaṃ kathaṃcidapyaprāpyakāritve samarthayituṃ śakyā |
kiṃca kṣaṇiko vā śabdaḥ syāt sthāyī vā ? yadi kṣaṇika-
stataḥ pratyāsannagṛhītamātro naṣṭaḥ kathaṃ viprakṛṣṭaiḥ paścāt gṛhītuṃ kṣamaḥ |
sthāyitvaṃ tu saugatānāmanabhimitameva |
sthāyitve ca pratyāsannānāṃ śabdaśravaṇaṃ cirakālamanu- vartate |
tasmādaprāpyakāritvasaṃbhavadavajanīye nānādeśo- palavdhernāntitvam |
asatapakṣe tu dhvanīnāṃ krameṇāsanna- dūragamanāt gatvaratvena caikasmin śrotre niranvanasthānādu- papannā krameṇopalabdhiścarakālānuvṛttiśca, tasmāccaikānta- tasmādadityatvam |
arthapratipattanupapatyā tu niyatatvameva yuktam, nahi pratyuccāraṇamanyasyāntyasya kriyamāṇasyārtha- pratyayatvaṃ saṃbhavati, saṃbandhagrahaṇāsaṃbhavādatītasaṃbandhasya cāprāpyakatvam |
na cānyāsmin gṛhītasaṃbandhe'nyasya pratyayatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
nahi gośabde gṛhītasaṃbandhe'śva- śabdaḥ pratyayāyati |
satyam, asadso hi na pratyayāti, yastvanyo'pi gṛhītasaṃbandhena arthavatā śabdena sahaśaḥ śabdaḥ sa pratyayāyati cet, na |
tadasaṃbhavāt |
nahi kaścidapi mukhyo'rthavān saṃbhavati, sarveṣāṃ tulyatvena saṃbandhagrahaṇāt, nahi dvividhaṃ'nupalavdhasya saṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati, anyavyatirekābhāvāt |
atha vyutpattisamaye sadeśu śabdeṣu dvinetrapūlaveṣu paścāt śrūyamāṇaḥ saṃbandhagrahaṇaṃ labdhvā'rthavān bhavati, taduttarakālasātsādayāt pratyayāyanītyucyate |
tadayu- ktam - ya etolabdhaśabdāntareṇa paścāt śrūyamāṇo'rtha- vān ityete sa evāśrutācchabdāntarāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ prathamaśruto- 'narthaka iti virodhāpatteḥ |
taduktaṃ ‘apratītasyaśabdānāṃ tatkāle'sāvanarthakaḥ |
sa evānyaśrutīnāṃ syādartha- vāniti visāvaḥ |
’ iti |
athārthavānevāyam, apratī- tānyaśabdasattvanavyatitarekaikatvādyarthavattvaṃ na jānantītyu- cyate |
tathā sati taduttarakālānāmapi śabdānāmāgevamartha- vattvasaṃbhavitti sādṛśyena pratyayākatvam |
taduktam ‘athāsya vidyamāno'pi’ ityādinā |
athottarakālasya śabdasya kāścidagṛhītasaṃbandhān pratyayapratyayātklādā- narthakamevāśrīyate, tato yo'sāvarthavattvena abhigataḥ śabdo yatsāderadyuttepā pratyayākatvaṃ so'pi keṣāṃcida- pratyayāka ityanarthaka evaiti sarveṣāṃmānarthakyaṃ syāt |
taduktam ‘anarthakatvamasya syāt’ ityādinā |
kiṃca vyutpattikālāvartī śabdo'rthavān |
uccare tu vyavahāra- kālavartinastasmādadyathā'pratyāyayantīti bruvāṇasya viruddha- māpayate, ya eva hi keṣāṃcida vyutpattikālāvartī sa evā- nyasya vyavahārānupātītyekesyārthavattvaṃ sarvasyātadadyā- drauṇamiti virodhaḥ |
taduktam ‘arthavattve'śvatvena’ iti |
tasmāt sādṛśyena pratyāyakatvaṃ ityekameva śabdasā- śrayitvam |
atha galādisāmānyāyekaṃ āśritya vāca- katvaṃ samarthayeta, tatra |
tadabhāvāt, vyaktibhede hi sāmānyamātmānaṃ labhate nānyathā |
kaścitpunarāha— satyapi vyaktibhede niṣpramāṇakameva sāmānyam, yatra hi bhedāvagatau satyāmevābhedāvagatistatra sāmānyam, iha tu sarvatra vyaktibhede nāvagamyate, ato'tra vivekāgrahaṇādeva pratyabhijñā bhrāntitvā nālaṃ sāmānyaṃ sādhayitumiti |
tatrayuktam |
sati hi vyaktibhede kathamantareṇa sāmānyaṃ pratyabhijñā syāt |
vivekāgrahaṇā- diti cet, koḍayaṃ vivekāgraho nāma, yastanādakārāda- dyatanasya gakārasya yadvā'nuccaṃ rūpaṃ tatra gṛhyate ityarthaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi gṛhyate ? ayocarita'pi gakāre'vaśyaṃ kiṃ- vidrūpaṃ gṛhyate |
vyāvṛttaṃ cenna gṛhyate, vyaktamanuvṛttasagrahaṇam |
anuvṛttaṃ ca sāmānyamityucyate |
tatassiddhayati sāmā- nyam |
na ca sādarādayeva pratyabhijñāsidelaṃ sāmānyeneti vaktavyam, avayavasāmānyayogātmakatvāt sādṛśyasya varṇānāṃ cānavayavatvāt |
nanu saṃbandhasāmānyamātraṃ sādṛśyam, ato'nyavayavasāmānyamapi tādṛśyātsthānasāmānyaṃ sādṛśyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
na |
atrāvaṇatvāt, śravaṇajanyā hīyaṃ pratyabhijñā, tadasyāḥ śravaṇagrāhyagālambanaṃ vaktavyam, naca tālvādisāmānyaṃ śrāvaṇam, ato gatvādisāmānya- nitravaneyaṃ pratyabhijñā sidhyati |
evaṃ sati vyaktibhede sāmānyaṃ tadabhāvāttu nāsti sāmānyameva vaktavyam, ataḥ siddhaṃ pratyabhijñāyā śabdasya nityatvam |
kiṃ punaridaṃ pratyabhijñākhyaṃ pramāṇam ? pratyakṣamiti brūmaḥ |
pūrvātnubhavajanitasaṃskārādhīnendriyajanyatvāt grahaṇasyānurūpamidaṃ jñānam, tatra pūrvānubhūtau'dyaḥ samarthe, sārthamāne tu tena sahaikaviśiṣṭaṃ vartamānaṃ rūpaṃ pratyabhijñā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate iti veditavyam, tasmānnityaḥ |
śabdanityādhikaraṇam
śabdanityādhikaraṇam
śabdaḥ |
pradīpe tu prabhāmaṇḍalasyāvayavaviśleṣamantareṇa atyantatanupattirviśiṣṭāvayavasya cāvayavinaḥ avayavabhāvī vināśaḥ, vinaṣṭe ca pūrvasmin pradīpe paścāttanmadayaṃ pradīpāntarameva bhavati, haṭhe ca bhede pratyabhijñā sādṛśya- nimitteti kalpyate |
śabde tu na kiñcidbhede pramāṇa- mastīti viśeṣaḥ |
tasya śabdasya dhvānte'pi vināśo nāsti vataḥ sūkṣma- vināśakalpanā syāt, tasmānnityaḥ śabdaḥ |
prayogaśca bhavati - nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt śabdatvavat |
na ca śabdatvaṃ nāstīti bhramitavyaṃ pratyabhijñānāt, araṇye hi gacchanto'śrutapūrvaṃ śabdaviśeṣaṃ śrutvā prāṇināḥ kasyāyaṃ śabda iti saṃdihate, na ca sāmānyadarśanamantareṇa viśeṣa- saṃśayo ghaṭate |
tathā''vāntarajātirapi vargatṛtīyagakārā- diṣvanuvṛttā kakārādibhyo vyāvṛttā kadācidasti |
tathā vargaprathameṣu dvitīyaṣu caturtheṣu pañcameṣu na yathāsvamanu- vṛttāḥ santi jñātavyaḥ |
kathamavagamyate ? pratyabhijñānādeva |
tathāhi - kiyatyapi dūradeśaṃ ḍakāramuccaritaṃ śrutavatāṃ gakārādiṣu saṃśayo bhavati na cāyaṃ saṃśayo dhvaninibandhano gakārādisvabhāvāt, ato'sti tṛtīyādiṣvanuvṛtta- manyebhyo vyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ yadupalabhyate |
tathā dhakāroccāraṇe bhakārādiṣu saṃśayaḥ, nānyeṣu |
tena caturthe- pyapyasti sāmānyam, evaṃ prathameṣu dvitīyaṣu pañcameṣu ca yathāsvaṃ sāmānyāni tairaiva dṛṣṭāntaiḥ |
śabdasya tu śrāvaṇatvahetunā nityatvānumānam |
nanu śaṅkhādi- nādānāmanityatve'pi śrāvaṇatvādekāntiko hetuḥ |
na |
teṣāmapi pratyabhijñā nityatvāt |
yadi teṣu pratyabhijñā nāsti, tato 'dhvanyanyatve sati' iti viśeṣaṇādapyabhi- cāraḥ |
yadā cānityatvaṃ dhvanīnāṃ, tadā kāryatvānnāsti- tasyānupapatterāśrayabhūtena kenacidvyena bhavitavyam, tasya cānekatve pramāṇābhāvādekatve dravyasyaitacchratistathā- tvāt dravyāntatve śabdasya saṃyogavibhāgayoganapekṣakāraṇa- tvābhāvātkarmatve sati pāriśeṣyāt guṇatvameva dhvanīnāṃ bhavati |
tatra pārthivabhayediguṇatve taraṅgādhyāyadravyaguṇatve vā śravaṇaprāptyasaṃbhavāt tadgrāhātvaṃ sidhyet, tasmānna pṛthivyādiguṇatvam |
vāyuguṇatvaṃ na yuktam |
suvakṣmādi- saṃyogāderīdaṇḍasaṃyogādanyato vā niṣpadyamānā vāyavasta- cchabdaviśeṣaguṇā niṣpannāḥ sarvāsu dikṣu praviśamānāḥ śrotreṇa saṃyujyante, tataśca saṃyuktasamavāyāt tadgataḥ śabdaḥ śrotreṇa gṛhyate |
yasmādevaṃ vāyuguṇaḥ śabdastasmā- dyatkaiściducyate, 'śabdaliṅgamākāśaṃ' iti tannirastam |
varṇānāṃ tu nityānāṃ dhvanyatvamevāṅgīkriyate |
nanveṣāmapi śabdatvāt dhvanyadaguṇatvānumānamiti cet |
na |
varṇā na guṇāḥ |
dhvanyanyatve sati śrāvaṇatvācchabdatvavat digvat kālatveti pratisādhanasadbhāvāt |
yathā ca dikkālayoḥ śrāvaṇatvaṃ tathā prāgevoktam |
yattu sparśavirahitatve satye- kendriyagrāhyatvādvādicchabdasya guṇatvamiṣyate, tattrāpi yathoktameva pratisādhanamityāstāṃ tāvat |
tasmāt hyanta- nāyatanayoḥ pratyabhijñānādvā na tāvattyucāraṇamanya- tvam |
evaṃ coccāraṇaṃ śabdasya na kāraṇaṃ kintvabhivyañjaka- miti siddham |
na coccāraṇānyānyakāraṇatvaṃ saṃbhavatītya- kāryatvam, ata evānavināśādityatvasiddhiḥ |
idameva hi nityatvaṃ yatsvarūpadāve satyupalabdhivināśarahitatvam |
siddhāntacandrikā - 'bhāṣyavārtikayoreṣṭu- payuktaṃ svadarśane |
granthakāraṃ ca tarke prameyaṃ likhyate mayā |
' nanvasu nāmaivaṃ nityatvaṃ tathāhi ānupūrvyanityatvetyatvāpaman, padaṃ hi vācakamidaṃ tatra anādhīnam, viśvakalitānāṃ varṇānāmavācakatvāt kramaśrānityaḥ |
tathāhi deśataḥ kālato vā kramo bhavati |
na ca varṇānāṃ sarvagatānāṃ nityānāṃ ca svataḥ kramaḥ saṃbhavati |
dhvanayo hi kramavartinaḥ krameṇa śabdānabhivyañjayantaḥ svīyaṃ kramaṃ varṇeṣvapi darśayanti, kramaracanā ca puruṣādhīnā yathāviśaṃ tadupapatteḥ |
ataḥ puruṣaprayatnatvāt atrāprāmāṇyapattiḥ |
ato niṣphalameva varṇānāṃ nityatvapratipādanam |
nahi tannityatve vācakatva padasya nityatvaṃ sidhyati |
nahi paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvā- dārabdhe ghaṭādau nityatvaṃ dṛṣṭam |
yathāhuḥ - 'varṇāḥ sarvagatatvādvā na svataḥ kramavattvaḥ |
anityadhvanikārya- tvātkramavato vināśitvāt |
puruṣādhīnatā cāsya taddhi- vakṣāvaśādeva |
varṇānāṃ nityatvā tena niṣpannā para- māṇuvat |
' kiñca kramaṃ vinā varṇānāṃ pratipādakatvā-

śabdanityādhikaraṇam
saṃbhavatvākramasya ca vācakatvāt padatvaṃ na kramaviśiṣṭātāṃ varṇānāṃ tasya cānityatvādvākānityatvamiti |
atro- cyate - na tāvat kramasya padatvaprasaktiḥ |
vastvantarā- dhārasya svatantrasya kramasyādīnām |
ato'tra guṇapradhāna- bhāva eva vicāraṇīyaḥ |
kiṃ kramaviśiṣṭā varṇā eva vācakāḥ |
uta varṇāśritaḥ krama iti |
evaṃ ca sati krama- vatāṃ varṇānāmeva vācakatvaṃ prādhānyāt na kramasya |
sarvapadārthānāmeva tathāyogāt |
na hyasau svatantra eva vastvantareṇa kvacidāvihyate |
ata eva kramaviśiṣṭā varṇā evāsmākaṃ prāpakāḥ na kramamātram |
nanvasu nāmaiva tathāpi kramasya puruṣārthatvāt tadviśiṣṭavācaka- syāpi pauruṣeyatvamāpadyate, tanna |
atrāhaḥ - 'na ca kramasya kāryatvaṃ pūrvasiddhaparigrahāt |
vaktā na hi kramaṃ kañcitsvātantryeṇa gamayate |
yathaivāsya parairitastathaivainaṃ vivakṣati |
paro'pyevamathāsya saṃbandhavadanāditā |
tenaiva vyavahārasyādakautasya'pi nityatvaṃ |
yatnataḥ prati- pedhyā naḥ puruṣāṇāṃ svatantratā |
iti |
nanu varṇānā- mapi vyavahāradevānirdaśamatvarūpanityatvamastu kiṃ kuṭa- sthanityatayeti cet |
naivam |
varṇānāminityatve vyavahāra- syānupapatteḥ |
tathāhi varṇeṣu nityeṣu satsu tānevādāya prayogaviśeṣaṇa śakyate kramaviśeṣo nipādayituṃ para- māṇubhiriva ghaṭādīni |
varṇānāṃ tu kimiva racanā syāt |
na hi nirupādānaṃ kāryatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
na ca nityavibhūnāṃ kramānupapattiriti vācyam |
dhvani- vaśādupapatteḥ |
tālvādi saṃyogavibhāgakramavadena tadadhi- ṣṭhānāṃ dhvanīnāmapi kramo bhavati |
ālvādyo dhvanayaśca jātyā nityāḥ |
tena gakārādiviśiṣṭānī jñānāṃ krama- micchan tadabhijñakānāṃ dhvanīnāṃ jñānānāṃ tadanurūpeṇa krameṇa preraṇaṃ cikīrṣan tālvādijātīyānāṃ sthānānāṃ saṃyogavibhāgo kramaṇārbhata iti taddeśena vyāpakanāmapi varṇānāṃ kramai iti |
kenicca kramasya kuṭasthatva- mevāhuḥ |
tathāhi - paurvāparyaṃ kramaḥ, cirakṣiprātmakaṃ ca dīrghādirūpam, pūrvāparacirakṣiprāprayathā kālalambanā- stena dhvanibhiḥ varṇeṣu pūrvāparabhāvena vyajyamānaḥ kāla eva krama iti |
nanu kāla eva cet kramaḥ sa tveko vibhurnityaśca kathaṃ pūrvāpareṇa rūpeṇa vibhakto bhāsate |
ucyate - yathā varṇo nityaḥ sarvagato'pi dīrghādirūpeṇa vibhakto bhāsate dhvanyupādhidhvāt, tathā kālo'pi svaya- mabhinno'pi ādityakriyāpādhidhvāt bhinno bhāsate, upādhayaśca vinaśvartamānānāgātāḥ |
sūryādikkriyā iti tadaṃśena kāle'pi atītādivibhāgaḥ |
kṣipratvaṃ cālya- kriyāvacchedatvāt, bahukriyāvacchedatvāt ciratvamiti kramasya nityatve padasyāpi nityatvaṃ siddham |
yathāhuḥ - 'tasmān padamapī'sti vināśī kaścideśataḥ |
tena nityaṃ padaṃ siddhaṃ varṇānātyavacādinām |
' nanu dhvani- dharmāḥ kramādayaḥ kathaṃ varṇānāmarthapratyāyakā bhavanti |
atrāhaḥ - 'parairdhvane'pi cādityavyuktamabhyupagamyate |
' kiṃ punaḥ kramādīnāṃ vyavahāranityatve pramāṇam |
arthāpattireva brūmaḥ |
pūrvoktārthyāpattirvācakatvasya nityatvaṃ kalpayati na varṇasvarūpamātrasyeti |
iti śabdityādhikaraṇam |
vi- 'vidyādi rūpo yaḥ śabdaḥ so'nityo'thā- vinaśvaraḥ |
anityo varṇavatvādvarṇe janmopalambha- nāt |
, atrādhitapratyabhijñānāt varṇasya nityatva |
uccāraṇaprayatnena vyajyate'pi na janyate |
' tasmā- ditye śabde kāraṇopābhāvāt nāsti aprāmāṇyam |
bhaṭṭa - śabdasya nityatve tadarthaḥ pratyaktavātmā saṃbandho'nādiḥ syāt |
tadeva na saṃbhavati, tālvādi- vyāpāramuccārayatoḥ gakārāderaśravaṇe'to'nityatvayo- svīkartavyatvāt |
ma evāyaṃ gakāraḥ ' iti pratyabhijñāyāḥ sādṛśyanibandhanatvena gauṇatvāt |
na ca tālvādidyāpārasya abhidhāyakatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
tacca śrotradhvanyanyatva- nigrahaprayatnājanitasaṃskārotpādakatvena, tadupalabhya- bandhakatvena syāt |
ubhayathā'pi digādi- rūpaśrautrasya nityavyāpakaśabdasya vā saṃskṛtatvāt sarva- grahaṇapattiḥ |
kiñca, nityatvapakṣe gakārādipyeka- tvājñānādeśapūrvacāraṇa deśabhedo nopalabhyate |
tena pratideśaṃ bhinnā eva śabdā anityāśca |
iti prāpte, vyaktivāhulyasya tattadabhivyañjakatvena ca kalpane ati- gauravāpattyā uktapralambhanāyāḥ gauṇatvāyogevacchedaka-
karṇaśaṣkulyāmeva saṃskārotpattau svīkāreṇa abhivyakterapi nirdopatayā gakārādiyuktyaḥ ekaikā nityā viśvaśva |
utpādavināśapratītistu dhvaniviṣayā |
ekasyaiva nānā- deśopalambhaḥ ādistasyaivāvirudvaḥ |
tasmānnityaḥ śabdo varṇātmakaḥ |
dhvanyātmakato'pi rathanādirūpo nitya eva |
ata eva 'seyaṃ gurjarī' iti pratyabhijñā'pi na gauṇītyanyatra vistaraḥ |
maṇḍana— 'vācyavācakasaṃbandhanīyatā yā prasā- dhitā |
śabdanityatā yā syāt tena tannityatocyate |
' śaṃkara— 'śabdādhikaraṇaṃ cātha |
' 23. śabdanityādhikaraṇam |
nanu kathaṃ padārtha- saṃbandhasya nityatvam |
varṇānāmanityatvena padānā- mapi anityatvāt |
tathāhi, varṇā anityāḥ |
praya- tnābhivyaṅgyatve sati prayatnottaraṃ upalabdhamānatvāt ghaṭādivat, ityanumānena anityatvam |
na ca 'sa evāyaṃ gakāraḥ' iti pratyakṣapratyayapratyabhijñābalena abhi- vyaṅgyatvakalpane iti vācyam |
utpanno gakāraḥ ; vinaṣṭo gakāraḥ ; iti pratīyamānapratyabhijñā 'eva jātiviṣayatvasya kalpanāt |
ata eva kadācit tajjātīyo'yaṃ iti pratyabhijñā upapadyate |
anyathā ekavyaktikatvena tajjāterabhāvāt tādṛśapratyabhijñā'nu- papattiḥ |
svarūpeṇa jātyupasthitau 'so'yaṃ' iti pratya- bhijñā, jātitvena jātyupasthitau 'tajjātīyo'yaṃ' iti pratyabhijñā iti viśeṣaḥ |
kiñca, jātyatiriktasya ekasya mūrtasya yugapat nānādeśopalambho nāstītyanubhavaḥ |
evaṃ ca varṇānāṃ yugapatnānādeśopalambho bhedasiddhiḥ |
tasmāt pratyabhijñāpadena anityatvasiddhiḥ |
iti cet, na |
anabhivyaṅgyatvasya asiddhatayā hetorasiddheḥ |
prayatnā- bhivyaṅgyatvasya aṅgīkārāt |
na ca śrotraniṣṭhagrahaṇa- yogyatājanakasaṃskārotpādakatvena tanniṣṭhagrahaṇaprati- bandhakatvena ca abhivyañjakatve śrotrasya ākāśa- ahaṃkāra-dignyatamarūpasya, nityavyāpakaśabda vā saṃskṛtatvāt sarvamevamapāstiḥ |
iti vācyam |
avacchedaka- karṇaśaṣkulyāmeva saṃskārotpattau svīkāreṇa abhivyakterapi jātiviṣayatvavayogācca |
na ca anekatvādādipratyayānāṃ viṣayabhedakapanamapeya ekasyāḥ |
pratyabhijñāyāḥ eva viṣayabhedakatvamanucitaṃ iti vācyam |
utpādavināśa- pratyayavat medābhedapratyayasyāpi nānātvāt |
medasya antyonmābhāvāvartakadharmatvena nānātvena tadbhāva- pratyayasyāpi nānātvāt |
dhvanīnāṃ medasya ubhayasiddha- tvena gakārādiyuktikalpanādhikyācca |
kecittu utpā- davināśapratyayayoḥ bhrāntitvakalpane vyañjakadhvaniniṣṭhayoḥ tayoḥ paraṃparāsaṃbandhena varṇaniṣṭhatvena mānamabhyupeyam |
tathā ca paraṃparāghaṭakatvayorapi viṣayatāpattyā gauravam |
pratyabhijñāyāḥ gatvagakārabhedaviṣayatveṇā |
jātiviṣayatva- kalpane'pi nātiriktaviṣayatākalpane iti lāghavamāhuḥ |
tadapi gakārādiyuktityāgamābhāvadhvaṃsakalpanāgauraveṇa nirastam |
cintāmaṇistu (gaṅgeśaḥ) tāravamandralavirudva- dharmādhyāsena pratyabhijñāyāḥ na prāmāṇyaṃ saṃbhavati iti jātiviṣayatvaṃ |
tathāhi |
sajātīyasākṣātkāra- pratibandhakatvacchedakatāyā tatpratibandhakatācchedakatāyā vā gatvādidhyāpanānātāratvamandratvādijātisiddhau pūrvapakā- rāpekṣayā uttaragakāro mandra ityanubhavaḥ |
pūrvaparagakārayoḥ aikye na saṃbhavati |
ataḥ asti gakārayoḥ medaḥ |
evaṃ gakāraniṣṭhagurupuruṣajanyatvāvacchedakajātyamedena api tadbhedaḥ |
anyathā tacchruvaṇe śukādyanumitinaṃ syāt |
ataḥ pratyabhijñāyā eva jātiviṣayatvakalpane ityāha |
tadapi 'mārutasturasi caran mandraṃ janayati svaram' ityakṣaraśikṣāyāṃ mandratvādidharmasya svaraniṣṭatvokteḥ akiṃ- citkaram |
antye tu varṇaḥ anityaḥ |
svādhikaraṇaniṣṭhādheyatā- nirūpakatvasaṃbandhāvacchinnasādhyasya siddhimārnavacchinnaprati- yogitākābhāvapratiyogiguṇatvāt |
saṃyogasaṃbandhāvacchinna- pratiyogitākagaganaparimāṇābhāvapratiyogino vyabhicāra- vāraṇāya ādheyatā nirūpakatvasaṃbandhāvacchinnatve |
ubhayā- bhāvapratiyogini tatraiva vyabhicāravāraṇāya vyāsajyeti |
īśvarajñānasya nādhyāpyavṛttitvam |
saṃyogābhāvasya na guṇatvamiti saṃyogagrahaṇāttena anityatvamāhuḥ |
tadapi guṇatvābhāvena hetvasiddhyā pratyuktam |
varṇā- tmakaśabdasya ākāśatvatva vyāpyatvena dravyatvāṅgīkārāt |
sāmānyatve sati manobhinnandriyajanya-laukikapratyakṣa- viṣayatvāt iti hetustu ākāśakaladiśāṃ ṣaḍindriya- janyapratyakṣaviṣayatvena anekāntikaḥ |
iṣyate hi viśeṣa- guṇasaṃbandhitvena ātmana iva bāhyaviṣayasaṃbandhitvena kālādipratyakṣam |
'idānīṃ ghaṭo jñātaḥ, baṭākāśe dhvanilatvaḥ' ityādyanubhavāt |
ato nānityatvam |
yattu varṇānāṃ nityatve yugapat nānādeśopalambho na syāt ityuktam, tanna, ādilopalabhyatvāt tadu- papatteḥ |
ekasyaivādityasya dṛśyatayā sataḥ svāsaṃmukhyena grahaṇam |
evaṃ vyāpakavarṇanāmapi tattaddhvanibhiḥ tatta- deśābhivyaktānāṃ svāsamīpyonmukhādikrameṇa ca grahaṇa- mupapannam |
tasmānnityaḥ śabdaḥ |
anumānaṃ ca— śabdo nityaḥ, dhvanivibhratve sati śrāvaṇatvāt, śabdatvavat |
anenaivānumānena varṇānāṃ dravyatvasiddhiḥ |
na caivaṃ 'maiveyaṃ gurjarī' iti pratyabhi- jñānāt dhvanīnāmapi nityatvaṃ syāt iti vācyam |
rathanādīnāṃ nityatvāṅgīkāreṇa iṣṭāpatteḥ |
varṇābhi- vyañjakadhvanīnāmeva anityatvāṅgīkārāt |
gurjarīdharmī tu varṇābhāve'pi pratīyamānānāṃ ratharādivat na gītirūpā |
atasteṣāmapi na bādhakam |
maṇi. pṛ. 168-170. śabdaparicchedaḥ |
śāstraṃ śabdavijñānādarśanaṃ- kuṣṭhe'tha buddhiḥ |
śabdavijñānāpekṣādātmanaḥ saṃnikarṣādya- haṣṭārthaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ tacchāstraṃ nāma pramāṇam |
kaḥ śabdo- 'bhimatiḥ ? varṇāḥ |
teṣāmeva śrotrāgrāhyatvāt |
śrotrāgrāhye hi vastuni śabdapadaṃ vartate |
na ca satvaśabdatva- yoratiprasaṅgaḥ |
sattādisāmānyamātrāt |
anuvṛttākāra- bhāsinī hi buddhiḥ sāmānyasiddhau niyantraṇam |
na ca dravyaguṇādibanbusattākāraṃ parāmṛśantī buddhireti yato mahāsāmānyaṃ sattālyeva sidhyet |
nāpi kakārakārādi- pveka ākāro'vabhāsate, yataḥ śabdatvamapyupacchedaḥ |
sadādipratītistvaupādhikī |
pramāṇagrahaṇayogyatāpādhikaḥ sacchabdaḥ |
śrotrāgrāhyatādhikaśca śabdaśabdaḥ |
nanu varṇātirikta padamapi śrotrameva |
tathāhi, nadī- dīnaiyādiṣu varṇābhede'pi padānyatvaṃ pratīyate |
na ca vācyaṃ varṇā eva padam |
nadīdīnaiyādi tu kramabhedena padabhedabuddhiriti |
varṇānāmakramikatvāt |
deśinavacanato vā kramo bhavet kālinavacanato vā |
ubhayavidho'pi na varṇeṣvapadaṃ labhate |
teṣāṃ sarvagatatvānnityatvācca buddhirastu teṣāṃ kramavatī |
tadanurodhena varṇā api kramavanta iti pratyekaṃ śravaṇe'vabhāsate |
ekakṣaṇavartinyāṃ tu padabuddhā- vekasyāṃ buddhidhano'pi kramo nopapadyate iti kutasta- dvedenāpi bhedapratibhāsopapattiḥ |
kiñca varṇā bahavaḥ : eka- viṣayā na padabuddhiriti varṇabhyo bhinnaṃ padam |
yadi ca varṇeṣyo bhinnaṃ padaṃ nābhāsate tastyebhyo'rthapratyaya eva nopapadyate |
ekaikavarṇapratīto tāvadarthasya nāvagamaḥ |
na ca sakalavarṇopalambho yugapatsambhavati, varṇānāṃ kramoccā- raṇāt |
uccāraṇānusāridhvaniśravaṇopalambheḥ |
varṇānāṃ ca vācyatve kramabhede vaktṛbhede cārthapratyayaḥ syāt |
tasmādvarṇeṣyo'saṃbhavannarthapratyayastadatiriktasminpada- pratītiṃ prasārayati |
ucyate |
nadīdīnaiyādi varṇātiriktavastvantarā- bhāso nāsti |
nakārādaya eva hi pratīyante |
buddhi- bhedastu kramabhedinivandhanaḥ |
na ceyamekā buddhiryato varṇānāṃ buddhidhano'pi kramo na syāt |
bhinnavarṇa- viṣayā bhinna eva hi buddhayo nirantarayaikatāmivā- padyante |
tathāhi |
śravaṇendriyanibandhāstāvadvarṇo- cāraṇānubandhinyo buddhayaḥ uccāraṇabhedena utpadyante |
evaṃ smṛtirapi pratyekavarṇopalambhapratibhāvita-bhāvanāvena bhavantī na sarvaviṣayaikā kalpyate, bhāvanānāṃ bhedāt |
ekapadabuddhistu ekārthapratipāyatvanibandhanā arthaprati- pattiścātra tannimittaṃ na śaknoti kalpayitum |
tasya nimittatvānupapatteḥ |
na tasya sattāmātreṇa nimi- ttatā |
sarvadā'rthapratyayapatteḥ |
pratyakṣaṃ bhinnapadabhāsi na bhavatītyuktameva, tena varṇeṣveva pratyakṣe'rthapratipa- patte kaścidviśeṣa āśrituṃ yuktaḥ |
sarvapūrvavarṇopalambha- sāpekṣatvādvarṇeṣya |
upalambhasya ca kṣaṇikatayā svato viśeṣamaśakyatvapūrvavarṇopalambhajanyaḥ saṃskāra evā-
śrīyate |
sa ca smṛtihetoḥ saṃskārādvina eva |
smṛtihetuhiṃ saṃskāro yadupalambhaprabhāvitastatraivopalambhā- ntaraṃ janayitumalaṃ nārthāntaraṃ ityarthaviṣayā tataḥ pratīti- ranupapanneti, tadatirekiṇaḥ saṃskārasyāśrayaṇam |
tasya ca kāryakalpyatvāccābhāve pratītirdarśanaṃ tathābhāva evo- tpattiranumīyate, tena kramaviparyaye vyaktibhede vyavadhāne ca kāryadarśanāttatra saṃskārasyānudayādarthapratyayābhāvaḥ |
yasya yasya cārthasya pratīto yasya yasya varṇasya nimitta- bhāvastasya tasya tadarthapratipatyanuguṇasaṃskārakatvaṃ svābhā- vikam |
sahāyavirahāttu kāryanudayaḥ sahāyeṣa kāryo- tpattiriti tebhya evārthapratyayaḥ |
tasmānna pratyakṣato nāpyanumānato vā varṇavyatiriktapadopapattiriti varṇamātra- kameva padam |
kaḥ punararthaḥ ? abhidheyaḥ |
abhidheya eva kaḥ ? yena saha śabdena apauruṣeyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
atha kaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ? pratyayapratyayākhyabhāvaḥ |
na tadapauruṣeyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
svabhāvataḥ śabdasyāpratyayākatvāt |
yadi hi svabhāvata eva śabdo'rthe pratyayayettaḥ prathamaśrutaḥ 'kiṃ na pratyayayettato'vagacchāmo'pekṣate kiṃcicchabda iti |
devadattādipadeṣu ca puruṣasaṃketāccā arthapratītirdṛṣṭeti gavādiṣvapi tadapekṣaivāśrīyate |
tadapekṣā cedarthāvagatau tarhyapyeyaṃ śabdasya pratyayākatvam |
ucyate |
yadyapi prathamaśrutāt śabdādarthaṃ nāva- budhyante tathāpi svābhāvikemeva śabdasyārthapratyayākatvaṃ punaḥ saṃketāpekṣam |
tathāhi |
buddhayeorvarṇaharetorasya vākyaṃ śrutvā parasya pravartamānasya pratyayā buddhiman- māpayati |
tasyāśca śabdaśravaṇānantarabhāvitāt śabdasya hetutāṃ tāvadavadhārayati |
kintu teṣāṃ pārśvavartināṃ vyutpa- tsūnāṃ tataḥ śabdāt svayamarthapratītāyāṃ punareṣāṃ vici- kitsodyate yadi pratyāyakaḥ śabdastato'smātkimiti nārthe pratipādayati |
athāpratyāyaka eva tato vṛddhamapi kathamavabodhayati |
teṣāmeva viviktisatāṃ punareṣā kalpanā prasarati |
nūnamasti kaścidviśeṣa vṛddhasya viśeṣo yato'rthamavabudhyate |
ko'sau viśeṣa iti nirṇītatām |
punaḥ śabdaśravaṇe vṛddhavyavahārāvagatārthapratyayatvamātreṇa svamarthāvagamadarśanāt arthapratyayākatvāgama eva viśeṣa iti nirdhāraṇāya jāyate |
na punaḥ saṃketapratīti- vṛddhasya viśeṣa iti kalpyanā śakyā, saṃketasyaiva tadānīmapratīteḥ |
vyutpannetaraśabdāthoṃ hi saṃketavākyā- darthamavabudhyamānaḥ saṃketeta pratipadyate nānyathā |
nanu uttarakālaṃ saṃketadarśanāt kimiti saṃketabhūtameva pratyā- yakatvaṃ nāśrīyete |
na, śabdasvabhāvata evārthapratyayatīrūpa- kāryasiddheḥ |
yadi hi śabdamātrādarthapratītirna saṃprayate tataḥ saṃketo'pi tatkālamiti kalpyate nānyathā upapadyate tu śabdamātrādevāvagatiḥ prācyena mārgeṇa |
nanvevaṃ sati devadattādiṣvapi kathaṃ saṃketasya kāraṇatvam |
ucyate |
pratyakṣaparicchedastatra saṃketo na tu kalpa- yitavyaḥ |
tena devadattādiṣu tasyaivārthapratītikaraṇatvam |
gavādiṣu tu kevalakāryadarśanakalpanīyo nāvakāśaṃ labhate ityapauruṣeya eteṣāmarthena pratyāyapratyayalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti siddham |
asaṃnikṛṣṭa iti kimidam ? pramāṇāntareṇāpratīta iti |
yadyevaṃ kathamasau śabdairavabodhayate ? uktaṃ vṛddha- vyavahārāvagatasaṃbandhaḥ śabdo'vabodhaka iti |
yathāthoṃ na pramāṇāntareṇāvagamyate kathaṃ tadviṣayo vṛddhavyavahāraḥ avasīyate |
kathaṃ vā tadviṣayā pratītiranūmīyate |
kathaṃ vā ca vācakaśaktiḥ śabdasya kalpyate iti |
vākyārthamātrābhyāso vidhīyatāmityuttaram |
sa punarsaṃnikṛṣṭo'rtho niyogārtha eva |
niyogo hi pramāṇāntarānavagatamapūrvamarthameva pratīti vākyārthamāt- kāyāmuktam |
na ca niyoga evaitastasyāvabodhakaḥ, vigrahavyatirekeṇa tadapratīteḥ |
padāntarāṇāmapi tadanvayi- svārthasyaiva vyutpattestena vākyenaiva niyogārthaḥ pratī- yate |
tatra liṅgādipratyayo niyogārthaśarīramevābhidhāti prakṛtitādiśyam |
padāntarāṇi ca viṣayaviśeṣaṇa nāmadheyaṃ niyojyaṃ cābhidadhatīti niyogārthapratīto vyāpriyante |
saṃnipatyopakārakājvākyanyāyena ca yadyapi niyogāntaraśūnyāni tathāpi pradhānaniyogānvitasvārthā- bhidhāyakatayā tanniyogapratītāveva padāntaravattvaṃ |
viniyuktamantrasāmānyā'pi dravyabhūtaṃ niyogajātaṃ
niyogājñatayā samarpyastadiśihiniyogatāveva upa- kṣīyate, niyogājñatā tu yogyatayā prayogātkāle naiyo- gikakarmatatsādhanasmaraṇe mantrajātasya |
anuvādā api vidheyastutimutpādayantaḥ stutiviṣayaniyogapratipattiparā eveti kṛtsna eva vedo'vagoṣe'pūrve kāryatātmani pramāṇam |
ata eva ko vedārtha iti jijñāsābhenevya- środanāsūtreṇa kāryātmā vedārtha ityuktam |
nanu siddho'pi brahmātmako vedāntānāmarthaḥ pratī- yate |
ucyate |
vyutpatyapekṣaḥ śabdo'rthamavabodhayati |
vyutpattiśca vṛddhavyavahāre |
vyavahāraśca kāryapratīti- nibandhanaḥ |
kāryapratipādakatvaiva śabdavyutpattiḥ |
tatrāpi kaścicchabdaḥ sākṣādeva kāryapratipādakatvā vyutpadyate kaścicca kāryanvitasvārthaparatayā |
nanu vinā'pi vyavahāraṃ siddhārthapratipattirapi loke'vagatārthasyaiva vyutpattiḥ |
yathā 'putraste jātaḥ' iti |
atra hi putretyādibhirliṅgaiḥ lokeḥ śroturharṣotpattiranumīyate |
harṣotpattiśca harṣahetumantareṇa na saṃbhavet |
priyatvenāpi harṣahetutvaṃ svātmani pratītaṃ tena putraste jātaḥ iti vākyena priyo'rtho bodhita iti kalpyate |
'putraste jātaḥ' ityasya priyatvamiti pramāṇāntarāvagatamiti tadarthābhidhāyakatvameva kalpyate |
pratipadamāvāpoddhārābhyāṃ vyavahāra iva svārthaviśeṣasaṃbandhā- dhyavasāyaḥ |
tathā vyutpatterapadavibhaktyarthāḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ pacatīti vartamānepade'pi yatyāve kāraṇaṃ tatkāṣṭha- śabdena pratipādyate ityavagamya pratyakṣa kāṣṭhānāṃ kāraṇa- bhāvamavagacchantaḥ kāṣṭhaśabde vyutpadyante |
kiṃca asya śabdasyāmartha ityapi vyutpattirdṛśyate |
na tatra śakyate vaktuṃ kāryānvayeva śabdasyārtha iti |
api ca yena nāmākāryābhidhāyitvaṃ tāvatā ca kāryānvitābhidhāna- syāpyupapatteḥ śakyate viśeṣānvitābhidhānaśaktiḥ kalpa- yitum |
loke ca siddhārthatveva prāyaśo vākyāni praśnottarāṇi dṛśyante |
kuśalaṃ te kuśalaṃ mametyādīni |
atrocyate |
sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ tāvadvṛddhavyavahāra eva prathamaṃ vyutpattirddhikāryate |
na khalu vyavahārantareṇa siddhānvākhyāne vyutpattirakalpyate |
yadyapi mūlaprasādā- dimirhetubhirupacaritumīyate, harṣotpatyā ca harṣahetvavagama- stannimittatā ca śabdasya tathāpi 'putraste jātaḥ' iti vākyasya putrajanmākhyaharṣahetupratipādakatā harṣahetunāmā- nyathātvaṃ duranumānā |
na ca pariśeṣeṇa tatpratipādakatvā- dhyavasāyaḥ |
bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānānāṃ saṃnihitavyavahitānāṃ pāriśeṣāvadhāraṇāyā atyantaduṣkaratvāt |
vyavahāraḥ punaḥ pratyakṣaviśiṣṭārthaviṣaya upalabhyamānastaduddhayanu- sāreṇa tadatāmeva śabdasya vācakatāmānāsenāpādayan vyutpattāvupāyātāṃ gantumalam |
vyavahāraśca vyutpatyupāyaḥ, kaḥ kāryānvitābhidhānaṃ śabdānāmaharet |
na hi kāryā- vagamaṃ vinā vyavahāro'vakalpate ityuktaṃ vākyārthamāt- kāyām |
evaṃ loke yaḥ siddhārthaparatā padānāṃ prayogaḥ sa lākṣaṇiko bhaviṣyati |
kāryānvayo hi parasparapadārthā- nvayavyabhicārittvavivakṣitā kāryānvayaṃ parasparapadārthā- nvayavivakṣayā'pi lokeḥ śabdaḥ prayujyate |
vivakṣā- balena ca lakṣaṇayā tatparatā'pi tatra nirvahati |
vede tu lakṣaṇāvikalpane kiñcit nāstīti svābhāvikakāryaparatvaṃ nāpyahetu śakyate |
evaṃ siddhapade'pi vākye yā vyutpattiḥ sā'pi kāryaparatāṃ na vihanti |
sarvapadānāmiva svābhā- vikī vṛddhavyavahārasiddhā kāryaparatā, lākṣaṇikaṃ ca siddha- parateti |
sarvavyavahāreṣu kāryānvayāvyabhicārāt tada- nvitābhidhāyitā na śakyate hātumiti na sāmānyenāthā- ntarānvitābhidhānaṃ śakyāśrayaṇam |
ataśca vedā- ntānāmapi ātmā jñātavyaḥ ityupanāgacchatye samāmnātena vidhinekvākyatāmāśritya kāryatvameva varṇanīyam |
atha siddhārthapratipattiratvena vyutpatterabhāvāt vṛddhavyava- hārāvagatatvāḥ padānāṃ anvitābhidhāyitvā evānupapatteḥ, kāryaparatve ca pramāṇāntarāgatatvasvarūpānuvādenaiva varṇanaṃ kartavyam |
apina siddhārthaparatve'pi śabdasya na vedāntānāṃ paramānandādirūpe brahmaṇaḥ prāmāṇyamava- kalpate |
tatra hi brahmasvarūpānuvādenanādirūpavidhirā- stheyaḥ |
brahmasvarūpaṃ ca pramāṇāntarasiddhamevāśrayaṇīyam |
brahmaśabdasya loke pramāṇāntarasiddhārthamācilena siddheḥ vede'pi sa evārthaḥ |
tathā ca sati nityakākṣaparamā- nandarūpavidhiḥ sakalapratipattiviruddhaḥ |
sarvapratipattiṣu
hi pramāṇambhūtātmā prakāśate |
na ca tatra paramānandaḥ saṃvedyate |
na ca sāṃsārikaduḥkhābhibhūtatvā- ttasyāprakāśaḥ |
abhibhavānupapatteḥ |
avacchinna hi duḥkhamanavacchinnajñānanda iti nālpīyasā'bhibhavaḥ saṃbhavati |
svaprakāśasya ca abhibhavāvaraṇamabhibhavī- nāmasaṃbhava eva |
abhijñātmatattvapratipādanamapi pramāṇā- ntaraviruddhamevetyuktaṃ tattvāloke |
sakalavikāraśūnyatā api vijñānādivikārotpatteḥ pramāṇāntaraviruddheti para- sparā nyāyayogyatā nānandādiparatvam |
ajarāmaratvayostu pramāṇāntaraprasiddherevānuvādavādaprāmāṇyamiti |
nanvaśāstramapi śābdamasti laukikam |
tatkimasti na lakṣitam |
ucyate |
na śāstramasti tattvataḥ śabdamasti, śabdāddhi yadvijñānamasaṃkliṣṭaṃ tacchābdaṃ syāt |
na ca vedavyatirekeṇa tatsaṃbhavati |
laukikaṃ hi vākyaṃ nārthe svayaṃ niścayamāpādayati, laukikavacasāmatadviṣayatvā- darthevyabhicārasya śaṅkitatvāt |
nanvevamapi vaidikamapi vaco nārthaniścāyakaṃ syāt śabdothāpitasya arthasya lokaivyabhicāratvāt |
athocyeta vaidikādvacanāt svatastvaniścayo jāyate |
paścānnastu saṃśayastadviṣayatvādātmānaṃ na labhate |
yathā sthāṇau samīpavartini sthāṇutvatā niścite na punarurvatā sthāṇupuruṣasaṃśayaṃ prasūte |
upalabdhau hyavasthāyāḥ saṃdeha jāyate |
yadā ca niścito'rthastadupalabdhirbhavati tato saṃśayo na yuktaḥ |
na cāvyabhicāraniścayapūrvakaṃ śabdasya niścāyakatvaṃ yena vyabhicāre niścayo na syāt |
kintu svabhānta indriyakacchabde niścayeturiti |
tatra |
śabdajanitaṃ niścayemevobhayathā dṛṣṭvā yaḥ saṃśayaḥ sa niścayenaiva na śakyate niroddhum |
vākyahetvantaro hi saṃśayo niścayena virudhyate |
yaḥ punastadbhava eva nāśo tena niṣidhyate |
ucyate |
yuktastāvat laukike vacasi saṃdehaḥ |
puruṣā hi prāyeṇānvitānvaye padāni āśayadoṣeṇa vā bhrameṇa vā pramādena vā aśaktyā vā prayuñjānā dṛśyante |
tataśca yadyapi taduktānāṃ padānamānvitābhidhānasāmarthya- masti tathāpyananvitārthavaśaṅkayā nānyayo niścīyate |
kathaṃ tarhi laukikavākyebhyo vyavahārapravṛttiḥ ? ucyate |
arthasaṃśayenāpi loko vyavaharati |
saṃdigdhamapi dṛṣṭvā vṛṣṭyādyarthaphale karmaṇi pravartate |
athavā asyaiva niścayopāyaḥ |
yo hi puruṣo evamavadhārito nāyama- śakto na pramādī saṃbhavadetadartheviṣayapramāṇaḥ |
sakalāśaya- doṣarahitaśca nāyamavijñāyārthamanvitānvayārthī prayuṅkte iti tadākyaprayojyajñānapūrvakatvādanyajñānaṃ tāvadanu- mīyate |
anvayajñānāccānvayo'pyanumīyate |
jñānaṃ hi jñeyāvinābhāvi jñeyānumāne bhavatyeva liṅgam |
tadevaṃ laukikācchabdo liṅgabhūtādaktajñānamanumīyate |
tato'rthe niścaya vyavahāraḥ pravartate |
eva ca niścite'nvaye nivṛttānvayāśaṅkādvākyadarthaniścayo jāyate |
kintu tasyāṃ daśāyamanuvādakatva |
ata eva laukike vacane na śābdaṃ pramāṇam |
abhiprāye śabdo liṅgam |
abhi- prāyo'pyeṣa liṅgam |
śabdastvarthe paścānniścayaṃ janayatya- nuvādakatvānnā pramāṇam |
nanu aśaktapramādibhrāntadṛṣṭā- śayaprayuktānāṃ padānāmananvitārthadarśanācca purupāntara- vacaneṣvanvitārthavaśaṅkā jāyate tanniṣṭamātra eva puruṣasya vaktuḥ śaktatvātpramāditā'bhrāntatvaśuddhayartha- jñānaṃ vyāpiyatām |
arthaniścayastu vākyādevopāyastade- hāstu |
mā bhūt vaktṛjñānādanumitādarthaniścaye jāte vākyānuvādakatvamiti |
ucyate |
atrāntatvaṃ nāma puruṣasya yathārthajñānayogitvam |
āśayadoṣaviraha yathā- viditārthaviṣayatvam |
śaktatvaṃ ca yathāvivakṣitapada- prayogasamarthatvam |
śaktasyāpi yathāvivakṣitāviṣayaprakṣā- pramādo yasyaitaccatuṣṭayamasti sa pratyayitaḥ |
tatsthetadatra- gatam |
samyagjñānaniyatau'sya vākyaprayoga iti |
tena tadīyākyaśravaṇe tadattasamyagjñānaniścayo jāyate eva |
samīcīnaṃ cedaṃ jñānamucyate yadarthavisaṃvādi yasya yathā- pratīyamāno'rtho'sti tena samīcīnaniścayo'nta- rbhavitārthaniścaya eveti na saṃśayanirākaraṇamātre puruṣa- viśeṣajñānaṃ vyāpiyate kitvarthaniścaya eveti niścite- 'rthe nivṛtte ca saṃśaye vākyārthaniścayaṃ kurvadantyanuvāda- katvānnā pramāṇam |
nanu tarhi vaktṛjñānasyānyato'navagatasya avagāmakaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ vākyaṃ tathaiva śābdaṃ pramāṇamastu |
na, tatrānu- mānatvāt |
vaktṛjñāne hi niścitasaṃbandhe pratyayita- vacanam |
vaktā tu dharmī |
jñānaviśeṣo'gnivākyaprayogite tasyaikadeśāviti |
ata eva ca bhagavān kāśyapo vedān pauruṣeyān manyamānaḥ śabdamanumāne'ntarbhūtamuvāca tasyedaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryamiti laiṅgikamuktvā etenaiva śābdamapyukta- miti |
vaktṛjñānaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ vākyaṃ ca kāryam |
ata evānyenāpyuktam |
vaktṛbhiprāyaṃ tu sūcayediti |
sa eva tathā pratipādyamānatayā āśraya iti |
nanu yadi vākyādvaktṛjñānānumānaṃ vaktṛjñānāccārthānumānaṃ tarhya- vagate'rthe kathaṃ jñānaviśeṣo'numānuṃ śakyaḥ |
athainaiva nirākārasya jñānasya viśeṣo na cāniśito'rtho jñāne viśeṣamāpādayati |
ucyate |
anavagate'rthe jñāna- viśeṣo'numānuṃ śakyata eva |
yādṛśārthapratipādana- yogyāni padāni prayuktāni tāhyārthaviṣayaṃ jñānamanu- mīyate |
nanvevaṃ vedasya prāmāṇyamapāstam |
nyutpatya- pekṣo hi vede śabdāt arthāvagamo vṛddhavyavahāre ca vyutpattiḥ |
vṛddhavākyāni celliṅgabhūtāni na tarhi svārthe pramāṇatayā vyutpattiḥ |
ucyate |
yāvaddhi padānāṃ arthaviśeṣavācakatvaṃ nāśrīyate tāvat vaktṛjñāna- viśeṣo'pi nānumīyate |
viśiṣṭāt hi vākyāt viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ anumātavyam |
na ca arthaviśeṣa- pratipādakatvāt anyo vākyasya viśeṣo'sti ityā- śrayaṇīya arthaviśeṣapratipādanasāmarthyameṣām |
artha- pratipādanasāmarthyadhāraṇameva ca vyutpattistatārtha- pratītiḥ |
anuvādakatve'pi ca śabdadānāmeva prati- pādakatvam |
vede ca vyutpattiśenārthapratipattau jātāyāṃ prāmāṇyamupapadyate eva |
nanu vede'pi śaṅkā bhavitavya- mityuktam |
satyamuktam, ayuktaṃ tat |
na tāvadanya- niścayānupapattiḥ vede saṃbhavati |
aśakyādikartṛdoṣa- vaśena jñānanityārthaprayogo loke dṛṣṭaḥ |
na ca vede kartā puruṣo'sti |
tena tadāśritāstavādoṣā ananvi- tārthavacane hetavo vede śabdamapi nāvatārnantītyartha- niścayastavājñāyate |
na ca pauruṣeyavākyajanyaniścayasya vyabhicārāt vaidike'pi niścaye vyabhicāraśaṅkā ucitā, śaṅkāyā darśanamūlatvāt |
yathābhūte hi yad dṛṣṭaṃ tat tathābhūte eva punaḥ śaṅkāmavatārayati |
api ca laukika- syāpi tatra vyabhicāro nāsti |
pratyayitavacanādapratyaya- vitavacanamapi medena na pratipadyamānaḥ pratyayitavacane dṛṣṭajñānapūrvakatvaṃ smaran tacca smaraṇaṃ grahaṇādvivekenāna- vabudhyamāno grahaṇavyavahāraṃ pravartayati |
tatra na kaści- dvicāraḥ |
nanu ca padasaṃghātātmakatayā vedā api pauruṣeyā eva |
padasaṃghātā hi pauruṣeyā eva dṛśyante, bhāratādi- vat |
tathā ca kāṭhakādisamākhyā'pi vede pravartate |
na ceyaṃ pravacananimittā samākhyeti kalpayituṃ yuktam |
sādhāraṇatvāt pravacanasya |
bahavo hi prabruyuḥ |
kartā punaḥ asādhāraṇo bhavati |
kṛtasya karaṇayogāt |
asādhāraṇyena vyapadeśā bhavanti |
yathā vaiyāsikī bhāratasaṃhiteti |
ataḥ pauruṣeyatvena vedānāṃ tadarthasya prāmāṇyatvaviṣayatvācciṣyate vaktuḥ prāmāṇyāvādananvi- tārthatvācca tapteṣu bhavanti kena vāryate |
ucyate |
puruṣakṛtatvaṃ tāvadvedānāṃ sākṣādattā- divyan sarvyate |
samākhyā tu pauruṣeyī pramāṇāntarānu- sāriṇī na śaknoti svayamarthavyavasthāṃ kartum |
yadi vicārayantaḥ kṛtakatāmeva nirṇayamastaḥ karaṇanibandhanā samākhyā bhaviṣyati |
atha tu yatlenāviṣyanto'pi pauruṣeyatāṃ nopalapsyāmahai tataḥ pravacananibandhanaiti vakṣyāmaḥ |
tadapi hyasādhāraṇaṃ syāt |
prakṛtaṃ hi vacanaṃ kasyacideva kutracideva tāvatsaṃghātātmakatvaṃ na pauruṣe- yatāmanumāpayituṃ alam |
vedārthaviṣayavākyaviracanā- sāmarthyānupapatteḥ |
parasparasaṃhatatayā tāvadvedā unmatta- praṇītā iti na śakyate vaktum |
unmattapraṇītasya ceyato grantharāśeḥ prathamamadhyayanaṃ kathaṃ pravartate |
ke hi sacetasaḥ unmattakametāvantaṃ grantharāśiṃ mahatā kleśenadhīya- dhārayeyurāpayeyuśca |
na ca buddhādigranthavat buddhipūrva- kāriṇā protsāhitā mahatyākhyāye pravartaren, nāto buddhipūrvairapi vedān racayitumalam |
tadarthasya buddhā-
vāropayitumaśakyatvāt |
pramāṇāntaraviṣayo hi apūrvātmā vedārthaḥ |
sa prāgvedavacanebhyo buddhisyatāmāpādayet |
na ca kālāntare śakyaḥ |
na teṣāṃ sādhyasādhanabhāvamāparatvāt |
sādhya- sādhanabhāvasya kalpitatvā'pi buddhavāropayituṃ śakya- tvāt |
jyotiṣṭomādiṣu dṛṣṭaṃ svargasādhanatvaṃ catyavandanā- dāvāropayituṃ śakyate |
apūrva tvapūrvatvādvāropaṇā'pi nāvartate |
atha kathaṃ tulye'pi liṅādiprayoge buddhā- divacanāni sādhyasādhanabhāvamāpraṇā'pi na vedavaktāni |
ucyate |
buddhivacanāni tāvat sākṣāt dṛṣṭakartṛpuru- ṣāṇi |
tena yadeva puruṣāḥ pramāṇāntareṇa buddhisyīkarta- mīśāte tadviśvāmapyucyanteveti niścityate |
puruṣaśca nāpūrvaṃ buddhau niveśayitumalama |
sādhyasādhanabhāvaṃ tvanyatra dṛṣṭaṃ buddhisyīkṛtya viracayituṃ kṣamante |
vedeṣu tu sākṣā- tkartā nopalabhyate |
tena svamahimā'nusāreṇa tāvadartho boddhavyaḥ |
sa cāpūrvātmakaḥ pratīyate |
pratīte ca tasmin śaktatā tadviṣayavākyaracane buddhivūrvakāriṇāmiti pauruṣe- yatvaṃ nāmumīyate |
ye eva hi padasaṃghātāḥ pauruṣeyai- rvicārayituṃ śakyante tatraiva pauruṣeyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamityaśakya- viracineṣu pauruṣeyatvānumānaṃ na kramate |
na ca pauruṣeyatvaṃ vinā padasaṃghātātmakatva nopapadyate |
uccāraṇavaśeṇa hi padāni saṃhatāmāpadyante |
taccoccāraṇāntarapūrvakaṃ vā syāt svabuddhiprabhavaṃ vā, dṛśyate hyanyenapi prayuktamanye- nādhīyamānaṃ bhāratādivat yathā'dyatanāḥ puruṣā bhāra- tādikamuccāraṇāntaramadhīyate tathā vedānapi sarvapuruṣā eveti kimanupapannam |
ataḥ siddhamapauruṣeyā iti |
apīruṣeyatvāścāsti pramāṇāntarāpekṣā pratyakṣavat |
ataḥ pramāṇamanapekṣatvādityuktam |
nanu 'citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityādicodanāḥ |
paścādaphilānubaddhasthārthe bodhayanti |
na ca karmānantaraṃ phalamupalabhyate |
na ca kālāntare phala bhaviṣyati śakyam |
karmābhāvāt |
ataḥ pramāṇāntarabādhāda- pramāṇaṃ śāstram |
ucyate |
na tāvacchabdenāntarabhāvitayā phalaṃ śrūyate yenānantaraphalādarśanena bādhaḥ syāt |
na ca
kālāntare karmābhāvāt phalopādāsaṃbhavaḥ |
kālāntarāva- sthāyino'pūrvādeva phalotpatyavagamāt |
na ca kālāntare pratigrahādikāraṇāntaradarśanapūrvakaṃ phalasādhanatāṃ bādhate |
kāmaṃ pramāṇadvayasamarpitaṃ ubhayaṃ phalasādhanamastu |
śāstreṇa apūrva phalasādhanamavabodhitam |
pratyakṣādibhiḥ pratigrahādikamiti |
na ca kālāntarabhāvine phale kartu- bhoktṛtvamanupapannam |
nityatvāt |
buddhīndriyaśarīrebhyo hi bhinnaḥ puruṣaḥ karmaṇāṃ kartā sa ca nityatayā kālā- ntarabhāvītyapi phalāni bhoktumalamiti na pramāṇāntara- bādhādapi śāstrasya prāmāṇyamākṣepaṃ śakyam |
atrāpi śiṣṭaiḥ śāstramiti jñānaṃ śāstram |
śiṣyate aneneti tu śabdaḥ; sa ca dvividhaḥ pratyakṣo- 'numeyaśca |
kiṃ punaḥ śabdānumāne liṅgam ? aṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ |
iti vacanam |
katham ? iyaṃ tāvatsmṛti- rbravaṇikairevāvigānena parigṛhītā |
na ca nirmūlāyāḥ parigraha upapadyate |
mūlaṃ ca na pratyakṣādi saṃbhavati |
tasya kāryatvaviṣayatvābhāvāt |
smṛtau cāpūrvakāryāvagamāt śāstraṃ saṃbhavati mūlam |
nanu ca tadapi mūlaṃ nāva- kalpate |
prayatnenā' ālocyamānasya anupalabdhāt |
na cānupalabdhaḥ śabdo'rthamavabodhayati |
na ca arthamanava- gamyamanmūlaṃ bhavitumarhati |
ucyate |
satyam |
vayamiva manavādayo'pi tacchāstraṃ pratyakṣaṃ nopalabhante |
anumānaṃ tu teṣāmapyasmākamiva saṃbhavati |
smṛtantaraṃ hi mahājana- parigṛhītaṃ dṛṣṭvā te'pi tatkartuḥ smṛtantaragamitaṃ śāstraṃ mūlabhūtamanumātuṃ śaknuvanti, evamanāditvātsmṛtipara- mparāyā liṅgabhūtāyāḥ saṃbhavāt nānumānavighātaḥ |
śabdā- rthasaṃbandhavat |
yathā hi buddhavyavahāradarśanena prayoya- buddhasyarthapratipattiṃ prakalpya tasyāśca śabdaśravaṇānantara- bhāvitvena śabdasya tatkāraṇatāṃ pratyaya kathaṃ punarmamā- pratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ asya arthapratipādaka iti ca vitarkya punaḥ svayaṃ tataḥ śabdādarthamavabodhayati pratipādaka- tvenāvagataḥ śabdo'rthamavabodhayatīti niścitya buddhasyartha- pratipattisāmarthyaṃ kalpayitvā sa kathamena buddhasyarthaprati- pādakatvā śabdo'vadhārita iti niścitya nūnamasyāpi buddhavyavahārāntaradarśanameva vyutpatyupāyabhūtaṃ mameva vṛddhā-

yo- 'pyasya candanādau prayogaḥ so'pi prītyapagame tatraivāpyatho- gāt prītisādhanavācakatvena'pi prīterapi vācyatvā- śravaṇāt prītimātravācakasya tatsādhane lakṣaṇayā api prayogopapatterlakṣaṇaiva |

ṛju. pṛ. 104. śabdabhāvanā |
arthātmikāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ liḍā- diśabdānāṃ yaḥ puruṣaṃ prati prayojakavyāpāraḥ, sā dvitīyā śabdadharmaḥ : abhidhātmikā bhāvanā vidhirityucyate |
'abhidhā bhāvanāmāturanyāmeva liḍādayaḥ |
arthātma- bhāvanā tvanyā sarvākhyāteṣu gamyate |
' vā. 2|1| 1|1 pṛ. 378. śabdabhāvanā iti śabdavyāpāratvā- ducyate |
maṇi. pṛ. 90. śabdabhāvanā liṅ-leṭ -loṭ-tavya-pratyayamāgatā liḍādibhirgamyate |
vi. 2|1|1 varṇaka 2. śabdabhāvanā vijñātoyāde yaḥ śabdasya vyāpāraḥ sa eva śabdabhāvanā'nyena ucyate |
evaṃvidhavijñātoyādaktameva śabdasya pravartakatvaṃ na tu audāsīnyaprayāvakatvam |
su. pṛ. 57. śabda- bhāvanā |
vidhiḥ, preraṇā, niyogaḥ ityekārthāḥ |
saiva ca śabdabhāvanā ityapi ucyate |
liḍādirūpaśabda- dharmatvāt |
taduktaṃ bhāvādhikāre - 'abhidhābhāvanā- māhuranyameva liḍādayaḥ |
arthātmabhāvanā tvanyā sarvākhyāteṣu gamyate |
' (vā. pṛ. 378) iti |
abhidhīyate anena iti abhidhā liḍādiḥ śabdaḥ |
taddharmaḥ abhidhābhāvanā śabdabhāvanā iti yāvat |
sā ca sāmānyato viśeṣataśca sādhyā |
svatantrapuruṣapravṛtti- dvidhā loke dṛśyate |
kacit svecchārthaṃ suvārthe prava- rtate |
kacit anyapreritaḥ ācāryaprerito'haṃ gāmānayāmi na svecchayā iti vyavahārāt |
yadyapi ācāryādirapi anicchantaṃ na śaknoti pravartayituṃ tathāpi svārasike- cchārahitamapi śiṣyādikaṃ svapravartanācalena icchāmupāya pravartayati iti dvedhopapattiḥ |
tatra śabdaśravaṇānantara- bhāvināṃ pravṛtto ācāryādeḥ svapravartanajñānajanena pravartakatvaṃ avasīyate |
kā punaḥ pravartanā ? pravṛttihetu- bhūtaḥ pravartayituḥ dharmaḥ |
'pravartayitudharmābhāve yacchabda evaṃ māṃ pravartayati na devadattaḥ iti vyavasthā'nupapatteḥ |
pravṛttihetuśrāpaktatvena tu vyavasthocyate devadattastvāṃ pravarta- yati iti pravartanājñāpanāt yacchabdasyāpi pravartakatvā- pattiḥ |
tathā laukikaliṅo'pi gurvādigatāśādijñāpakasya pravartakatvopapattiḥ |
loke ca ācāryādeḥ pravartitudharmaḥ : ahamenaṃ pravartayāmi iti pravartayituḥ mānapratyakṣavedyaḥ preṣadi rūpaḥ : nāpyetat śakyate |
vede tu puruṣābhāvena liḍādereva pravartakatvāt taddharmaḥ aṅgīkāryaḥ |
sa eva vidhiḥ |
tatra uttamapravartanaṃ adhyeṣaṇam |
samasta āma- ntraṇam |
nīcasya nimantraṇaṃ ājñākhyam |
eṣu ca liḍādeḥ anuśāsanācchaktigrahaḥ |
tatra nānā- thailaparihārāya pravartanārūpaṃ anusyūtaṃ caturdhvapi yat catuṣṭayānugataṃ ekaṃ pravartanātvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam |
īpsitānīpsitakarmaṇoriva sādhyatvaṃ dvitīyāyā miśramete |
ata eva haradattaḥ 'asti pravartanārūpamanusyūtaṃ caturdhvapi |
tatraiva liṅ vidhyātavyaḥ |
kiṃ bhedasya vivakṣayā |
' ityāśaṅkayāha 'nyāyavyutpādanādartha vā prapañcārthamapi vā |
vidhyādīnāmupādānaṃ caturṇāmāditaḥ kṛtam |
' iti |
atra laukikanimantra- ṇādibhyaḥ anyo'pi alaukiko medo'sti nyāyasiddhaḥ iti nyāyacūnaṃ nyāyavyutpādanam |
vācyatāvacchedakasya pravartanātvasya āśrayā ityayo vyaktyaḥ |
na laukikasya eva iti sūcanaṃ prapañcaḥ |
nanu lodarthapreṣitasyorapi pravartanātvāt kathaṃ catu- śaktiḥ |
maivam |
kāmacārānujñā rūpasya atisargāsya kāmacārakaraṇamātrakamantraṇarūpatvāt |
pravartanāsāmānyasya eva ca prāptaviṣayatvaviśeṣatvasya preṣatvāt |
tadu- ktam - 'pravartanasmṛtiḥ prāpte praiṣa ityabhidhīyate |
aprāptapreṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vidhitvaṃ pratipadyate |
' (vā. pṛ. 382) iti |

aprāpta- pravartanaṃ ca vidhiḥ iti vidhyāta ityuttarārthe |
atha pravartanālakṣaṇe pūrvokte (pravṛttihetubhūtaḥ pravarta- yitudharmaḥ :) padakṛtyam |

na tu medapakṣe eṣa doṣo'sti |
tasmādapi karmabhedaḥ |
nindāvacanācca |
'prātaḥprātaranṛtaṃ te vadanti puroḍāśyā''hutiṃ ye'gnihotram, divākīrtyamadivā kīrtayantaḥ sūryo jyotirna tadā jyoti- reṣām' iti kecicchākhino'nuditahomaṃ nindanti |
apare punaruditahomaṃ nindanti |
yathā atithaye pradutā- yānnamāhareyustādṛk tad yadyadite juhuyāt' iti sarvaśākhā- pratyaye viruddham, na tu karmabhede |

aśakteśca |
na śaknuyuḥ svalpapi sarvaśākhāpratyayamupasaṃha- rtum |
tatrānārabhyo'rthaṃ vidhīyate iti pratijñātaṃ bhavet |

ataḥ karmabhedaḥ iti |
samātivaca- nācca |
asamāpte'pi samāptervacanaṃ bhavati |
keci- dāhuḥ, anna asmākamagniḥ parisamāpyate iti |
apare anyaparisamāptiṃ vyapadiśanti |
tadekakarmatve nopapadyate |
na hi tadeva tatra parisamāpyeta, anyatra na |
mede tu yuktam |

prāyaścittavidhānācca |
kecidanuditahomamitikrame prāyaścittamāmananti, keci- duditahomamitikrame, vyuḍhe ca prāyaścittam |
na ca karmabhede ubhayā vyuddhiḥ saṃbhavati |
karmabhede tu yadanudite homakarmma, tadudite vyuddhimatadapyanudite |
tasmādapi medaḥ |
anyārthadarśanācca |
idaṃ śrūyate - 'yadi purā dīdīkṣāṇāḥ sūryyadi vaiṣāṃ gṛhapatiryeṣate- rvā'nusatriṇa iti, etameva bṛhatsāmānaṃ kratu- supeyurupetaṃ kṣopāṃ rathaṃtaram |
atha yadyadīkṣāṇāḥ ' iti iṣṭavatāmaniṣṭapūrvāṇāṃ ca dvādaśāhe darśanamupapadyate yadi karmabhedaḥ |
ekakarmatve nāvakalpate |
katham ?
tāṇḍayake śrūyate 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajjyotiṣṭomo ya etenāniṣṭvā''nyena yajeta garte- patyameva tannāyate pra vā mīyate' iti |
tat sarvatra syāt |
tatrādidīkṣāṇāṃ dvādaśāhaṃ darśanaṃ nopapadyate |
tasmādapi karmabhedaḥ |
athāyaṃ liṅgadarśanam |
'yatpakṣasaṃmitāṃ minuyātkanīyāṃsaṃ yaścakratumupeyātkanīyasīṃ praśnāṃ kanīyasaḥ paśūn kanīyo''nācca pāpīyān syāt |
atha yadi vediṃsamitāṃ minoti' iti pakṣasaṃmāne pratiṣiddhe vediṃsamānasya darśanaṃ bhavati |
tat karmabhede upapadyate |
katham ? eke hi samānamanti 'rathyākṣamātrāṇi yupāntarālāni bhavanti' iti |
tatsarvatra syāt |
tatra ca no pakṣasaṃmānaṃ no vediṃsamānaṃ syāt |
vedi- saṃmānadarśanaṃ nopapadyate |
tasmādapi karmabhedaḥ |
aparaṃ ca liṅgadarśanam |
keṣāṃcijyotiṣṭome dve saṃsutānāṃ virājamitiriṣyate' iti |
pareṣāṃ tisraḥ saṃsutānāṃ virājamitiriṣyante iti |
ekakarmatve virodhaḥ |
nānā- karmatve kasmiścijyotiṣṭome dve, kasmiścittrisaḥ |
tasmāt karmabheda iti |
api ca sārasvate śrūyate 'ye puroḍāśinaste upavasanti |
ye sāṃnāyyinaste vatsān vārayanti' |
sāṃnāyyina iṣṭaprathamāyāḥ |
puroḍāśino viparītāḥ |
ubhayeṣāṃ sārasvate darśanamavakalpate karmabhede |
ekakarmatve sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣṭomapūrvatvaṃ syāt |
tatra darśanaṃ nopapadyate |
api ca śrūyate 'upahavyo- niṣkaṭho'gniṣṭomo yajñaḥ, rathaṃtarasāmā''dhvaḥ |
śyāvo dakṣiṇā |
pareṣāṃ śrūyate |
upahavyo'niṛtha ukthyo yajño bṛhatsāmaḥ śvetaṃ rukmalalāṭo dakṣiṇā' |
iti |
karmabhede rathaṃtaravacca bṛhattvaṃ cānarthakam |
śākhādvayapratyayatvāt |
bṛhatsāma rathaṃtarasāmā vā syāt |
sa cāyaṃ prakṛtita evalakṣaṇaḥ prāptaḥ |
nānā- karmatve tu anyo bṛhatsāmānyonyo rathaṃtarasāmeti yuktaṃ bhavati |
tasmācchākhāntare karmabhedo bhavitumarhati |
vā - uktabhedakāraṇaṣṭakavyatirekakāraṇanirākara- ṇārthamidamārabhyate |
tatraiva kānicitkenacitprakārāntareṇa- śśaṅkāḥ pratiṣidhyante |
tacca pratyudāharaṇaṃ praviviśanto
yojayiṣyāmaḥ |
kathaṃ punaratra vedāntarāṇi nodāhriyante ? kartavya iti |
tatraikatve vipratiṣiddhadharmasamavāyaprasaṅgaḥ |
kecidāhuḥ |
śākhāntarācchabdena tānyapyudāhṛtānīti |
nānātve tu na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
aśaktidvāreṇāpi guṇa na tvetadyuktam |
kutaḥ ? śākhāntare yathā karma eṣopandyastaḥ śākhāntarīyāṇāṃ guṇānāmekarmaṇyapasaṃhārā- kutrarūpaṃ pratīyate |
kiṃcidguṇasamānānnāmaiva ca kteruparyasaṃyogaḥ |
samāsibhedo'pi guṇa eva |
nindayā vedāntareṣu tat ||
yatra hi karma nirākāṅkṣamāmnāyate gatādho'pi san prāyaścittabhedaḥ |
punarupandyate |
kadāci- tatra taddedapratipattiśca bhavati |
yathā sarvasvadharyu- datha vaikalpiktvaparihāraṃ brūyāttaccamyupalepyate |
vaikalpi- śākhāsu darśapūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomādīni samastadravyadevatā- keṣu ubhayathā'pyavaiguṇyaṃ bhavati |
atra ca prāyaścitta- diṣukttatvānyonyanirapekṣāṇi vidhīyante iti medākṣaṃ vidhānādubhayatrāpi vaiguṇyaṃ dṛśyate |
na ca tatkarmatve sahante na tvevaṃ vedāntare'pi |
tatra hi dravyadevatārahitaṃ ghaṭate |
tasmādapi medaḥ |
parihārasūtraṇa pañcānātha- karmamātraṃ prastutya stotraśastrayājyāvākyādimātraṃ vidhī- darśanānuyyante |
yadi purā dīkṣitavantastato bṛhatsāma- yate |
na ca tāvatā'sya nairākāṅkṣyaṃ bhavati |
hyadhyā- namatirānupameye |
pūrvadīkṣāyāṃ rathaṃtarasya prayuktatvāt |
nāmeva dravyadevatātsaṃskārāṇāmabhāvam |
yattu tatra atha na dīkṣitavantastato rathaṃtarasāmameveopajuriti |
dravyadevatāyuktnāmnāyate tasyā''tharvaṇe guṇamātravidhā |
dvādaśāho'niṣṭaprathamayajñatvaṃ karmabhede bhavati |
tāṇḍaka- nāt sākāṅkṣatvam |
tathā ca vakṣyati ‘bhūya- vacanena jyotiṣṭomāntarasya prāyamanīyame sati etaccha- svenobhayaśruti’ (a. 3 pā. 3 sū. 10) |
lāgatasyāniyāmāt |
ekatve tu sarvaśākhāsvajyotiṣṭoma- iti |
tasmāt śākhāntarāpyeveodāharaṇam |
tatra ca prāyamanīyamādīkṣitānāṃ darśanaṃ na syāt |
tathā yūpe- nāmabhedastāvatkāraṇaṃ dṛśyate |
tadyathā- kāṭhake'gnihotre kādaśinyāṃ pakṣevisamānayoryathāprāyorekaṃ ninditvetara- taittirīye'gnihotre idaṃ paṭhyate ityādi |
tathā rūpa- parigraho vacanāntaraprāpyasattvaṃ dyotati |
vacanāntare hi mede ekādaśakapālatvādi |
vaiśvānaradvādaśāṣṭavādi- kimekasya nindayā, kiṃ vetarasya sphuṭavidhāne sati vadābhikṣāyājinavacca na dvādaśaikadaśatvayoritaretara- stutyā |
tasānnyūnaṃ śākhāntarīya rayākṣamātrantarāla- saṃkrāntirūpapadyate iti guṇa eva mettā |
kārīryāmya- vidhireśāṃ nāsti |
tataśca karmabheda iti |
dve stotrīye śvamedheṣvapi bhūmibhojaneādakumbhāśrāddhāsa guṇā eva santa virāje daśakamatirivyate iti tisro''diricyante iti itikartavyatāsyānītyeva vādyataratvāt pūrvasmāt bhedeno- ca jyotiṣṭomātirātratve sati upapadyate |
mede pāttāḥ |
‘pare'nyaṃ dharmamācaranti’ iti virodhiguṇā- tu yathāvidhi bhavatītyavirodhaḥ |
puroḍāśāṃśānādya- ntarapradarśanātham |
‘aśvapādāse’ iti pañcamyantaṃ madhye darśanaṃ dīkṣitādīkṣitasandehaineva gataṃ parihāraprakārānta- paṭhitamubhābhyāṃ saha saṃbadhyate |
pūrveṇa tāvaddaśaśāsāderanya- ratvādādattam |
kiñca ‘pṛṣṭhadravyavikalpaḥ syācchā- muttareṇāpyadhaśāsādeniṣedhamupakāramākāṅkṣasyaśramedhādi- khāntaravidhānataḥ |
sa ca prakṛtitaḥ prāptaḥ karmatve riti |
punaruktatvena punaḥśrutirbhedikoktā |
nindayā- vṛthā bhavet ||
’ upahavyamede tu niyamārthāya punaḥ mapi uditānuditakālasaṃyogamedāt guṇa eva medakaḥ |
śrutāvarbhavatvā |
tasmādapi karmabhedaḥ |
uditahomavādino hyanuditahomaṃ nindanti anutavādina- tvena |
‘sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā’ iti hyanudite sūrye''bhidhīyamānamantraṃ jāyate |
tasmāduditahomaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
itare punarāhūḥ |
yaḥ pūjāṃ pūjyāya prathamameva gṛhītvottiṣṭhate sa sādhuḥ |
yastvatikrāntaṃ vyāhatya pūja- yati nāsau samyakpūjakaḥ |
tasmāt anuditahoma eva
ekaṃ vā saṃyogarūpacodanāsyāviśeṣāt ||
bhāṣyam— na naitadasti, yaduktam ‘śākhāntareṣu karmabhedaḥ’ iti |
sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ caikaṃ karma |
arthasaṃyogasyāviśeṣāt |
tadeva prayojanamuddiśya tadeva vidhīyamānaṃ pratyabhijñānīmaḥ |
rūpamapyasya tadeva dravyadevatām |
puruṣaprayatnaśca tādṛśa eva codyate |
nāma-
gheyaṃ cāviśiṣṭam |
tena tadeva karma sarvaśākhādhiṣṭhitaṃ vijñāte saṃkhyāvaśena vikalpasiddheḥ |
ataśca yo nāmā- pratyayaḥ |
timedhāvitvādekavedāntāni śākhāntarāṇyapi adhīte sa samuddhaḥ san vrīhiyavairepi miśrayedyata |
tasmādekaṃ karmeti |
vā— ‘sarvatra pratyabhijñānātsaṃjñārūpaguṇā- na nāmnā syāccodanā'''bhidhānatvāt |
dibhiḥ |
ekakarmatvavijñānaṃ na śāstrasyapagacchati |
’ bhāṣyam— yaduktaṃ nāmabheda iti |
parihṛtaṃ tad- sarvaśākhāpratyayamiti — ekasyāpi śākhāyāṃ brāha- granthanāmata iti |
atha yaduktaṃ karme'pi nāmasāmānā- ṇānatve'pi tadekaṃ karmetyabhiprāyaḥ |
tatrayā udāhṛtāṃ dhikaraṇadarśanāditi |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
granthasaṃyogāt karma pañcaviṃśadaśviṃśatrāhāṇayo'jyotiṣṭomādāśe |
saṃyoga kāṭhakādi, na karmasaṃyogāt granthaḥ kāṭhakaḥ |
kathaṃ iti — prādhānyāt phalasaṃyogagrahaṇam |
rūpamiti — pratyā- gamyate ? yatkarma kāṭhakādisaṃyuktaṃ tankāṭhakādiśabdena saccedravyadevatām |
codaneti — sarvārthatvebhāvanāviṣayo ucyate |
kimato''pi yadyagranthasaṃyogāt kāṭhāpakaṃ vidhiḥ |
jyotiṣṭomādi nāmadheyaṃ ca sarvaśākhāsvaviśiṣṭaṃ karmocyate |
ekatve'pi kāṭhakagranthasaṃyogāt kāṭhakaṃ dṛśyate |
tassāditaḥ pratyabhijñānakāraṇakalāpādabheda- kālāpakagranthasaṃyogāt kālāpakaṃ bhaviṣyati |
siddhiḥ |
na cānyaḥ kaścidedeturasti |
prakaraṇāntara- vacchākhāntareṣu parasparasaṃnidhānamiti cenna |
tenaivetarā- vā — yadyapi tāvat kāṭhakādikaṃ nāmadheyaṃ syāttathā- grahaṇāt |
yena hi pradeśāntare gṛhītakarma grahītaṃ vyutpattisaṃyogābhāvācca bhinnāt |
idaṃ tu naiva karma- bhavati sa eva tatsadṛśamanyopalabdhamānaḥ śaknoti nāmadheyam |
‘anyāyo hyanekārthatvam’ ityanena nyāyena tato'nyadetadityavyayatvāt |
ekaśākhāviṣaye ca sarva- granthanāmatve sati karmaṇi lakṣaṇayaiva prayogopapatteḥ |
śākhādhyayanedeva bhavati |
śākhāntare punaranyāsā- kathaṃ punaragamyate granthanāmatvaṃ karmanāmatve na puna- gatajyotiṣṭomādyanyathādupapūrvavadadhyayamāneṣu na medabuddhi- viparyaye iti |
taducyate ‘śākhayā hokyā yogādbahu- jāyate |
yattarhi dve śāstre paṭhati tasya prakaraṇāntara- karmāvabodhanam |
yujyate karmanānātvaikaśākho- nyāyena bhavitavyamekaśākhāgatatve tu brāhmaṇāntareṣu |
naiṣa palakṣaṇam ||
’ kāṭhakādiśabdo hi parasparasaṃbandhepu doṣaḥ |
śākhāntarādavagataṃ tāvadekasya puṃso naiveṣyate |
ki bahu karmasu prayujyate |
sa yadi karmanāma syāttvāntare kāraṇam ? svādhyāyagrahaṇenaikā śākhā hi pari- na prayujyeta |
na hi tatra lakṣaṇā upapadyate |
saṃbandhā- gṛhyate |
ekārthānāṃ vikalpaśca karmaikatve bhavi- bhāvāt |
sarvābhidhānaṃ tu vyutpattivadurupāpadam |
tasmā- ṣyati ||
yathaiva ākṛtiḥ prativyakti samavaiti tathaiva cchākhayaiva karmāṇi lakṣyante na karmabhiḥ śākhāḥ |
tataśca svādhyāyamekasyāṃ śākhāyām |
ataśca ‘svādhyāyo- saṃjñayā kāmaṃ śākhā eva bhidyantāṃ na karmāṇi |
saṃbandhā- 'dhyetavyaḥ’ iti karmāvabodhanaṃ pratyupadīyamānatvādidhivite- bhāvāt |
tasmāttvānyevāmihotrādīni saṃbandhamedādanyathā- kasaṃjñekā śākhā adhyetavyā |
nanvevaṃ vedāntarāsyā- 'nyathā ca vyapadiśyante |
dhyayanaṃ na prasajyate |
na |
vacanāntareṇa pratipatvāt ‘anayā ṛcyā vidyayā’ iti |
tathā ‘vedāndhīya vedī vā’ iti mānatvam |
sākāṅkṣatvād vedāntarāṇāmatulya- sarveṣāṃ caikakarmyaṃ syāt ||
kāryatvāttaḥ samuccayo'vagamyate |
śākhāntareṣu tvanyonya- bhāṣyam— yadi śabdabhede'pi bhavet, śabda- nirapekṣatvānnajyotiṣṭomādirūpapattītestulyārthatvanimitto kyācciddharmaikyaṃ bhavet |
tatra kāṭhakaśabdābhidhānādaikyaṃ vikalpaḥ |
sākāṅkṣatvādeva caikaśākhāgatabrāhmaṇāntarasamu- bhavet |
agnihotrasya darśapūrṇamāsayorjyotiṣṭomasya ca ccayāśrayaṇam |
nanvekakarmatvādidaṃ tveva vikalpaḥ karmatva- tacchabdatvāt |
na caitadevam |
tasmādapyabhedaḥ |
mityetarāśrayatvaṃ bhavet |
na |
pratyabhijñānamekatve vā — prāyeṇa hetuviṣaye kāryaviparyayo dṛśyate iti kāṭhakādisaṃjñaikatvādekaśākhāyātāgnihotrādeḥ ekatva- prasaṅgaḥ |
sādhyadharmādibhirvādibhirvā arthāpattisamā nāma
jātiḥ pūrvapakṣahetorasiddhatvopalambhapradarśanārthamevāmihitā|
sarvatra ca duṣṭe pūrvapakṣe jātīnāmuttaratvaṃ keṣāṃcidiṣṭam|
kṛtakaṃ cābhidhānam |
bhāṣyam— idānīṃtanaṃ caitadabhidhānaṃ bhavet |
asya na pūrvamāsīt |
yataḥ prabhṛti kaṇṭhasthaṃ prakṛtaṃ vacanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti pravṛttam |
pūrve nā''siddheda idānīṃ bheda iti viruddham |
vā-- 'kṛtrimaṃ kāṭhakādyuktamāsyāpravacanā- diti |
na vā'nādīni midyante karmāṇyādimatā satā |
yadyapi kāṭhāderjatitanityatvāt nityatvā'''khyā tathā'pi pravacananimittaṃ smaryate na ca karmāṇi procyante |
śabdavipayatvāt pravacanasya |
tasmādapi na saṃjñayā karmabheda iti |
ekatve'pi param |
bhāṣyam— ekakarmatve'pi rūpabhedo bhavati vaca- nāt |
na ca vācanike rūpabhede'satyāpi bhedadvau karmeṇo medo'dhyavasīyate |
vā-- na ca kapālasaṃkhyetyādeḥ |
tatsaṃbandhidvāra- medānabhyupagamāt |
tasmādekasminneva karmaṇi sādhana- vikalpo bhaviṣyati |
nanu cotpattivākyaśiṣṭatvādikalpo nāstītyuktam |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
ubhayotpattivākyaśiṣṭatvā- viśeṣeṇa tulyabalatvāt |
kathaṃ punaranenavākyāditasya ekatvaṃ vijñāyate iti |
tathya uttarasūtre parihāraṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
vidyāyāṃ dharmaśāstram |
bhāṣyam— atha yo dharmaviśeṣa ukto vidyā- grahaṇāryaḥ sa na karmaṇa upakārakaḥ |
kathaṃ gamyate ? śrutyādīnāmabhāvāddhyāsāyogānna karmaprayukta iti |
āgneyavat punarvacanam |
bhāṣyam— atha yaduktaṃ- yathā''māsyāyā- māgneyasya punaruktadoṣānmadhye pakṣo nirastaḥ, evamaya- mapi tasmādeva doṣātkarmatvapakṣo nirastavyaḥ iti |
etatparihartavyamityābhāṣyaṃ sūtram |
vā-- anubhāṣaṇasūtrametat |
athavā punaruktava- parihārāyamevaitat |
punaḥśrutervādguṇārthatvena anyārtha- tvāt |
advirvacanaṃ vā śrutisaṃyogāviśeṣāt |
bhāṣyam— naiva khalvetattadvirvacanam |
sa evā- yamarthaḥ punaḥ āvito'gnihotrādirbahubhistu puruṣaiḥ |
na caiko'dyo bahubhirucyamānaḥ punarukto bhavati |
yadi bhavet, ekasminneva vede bahubhirucyamāne bhavet |
tasmācca bahukarmasamāyo'yam |
ekamevavedaṃ karmeti |
vā-- dvitīyavyākhyāne parihārāntaranivṛtyartho vaśibdaḥ |
tatrānyārthā punaḥśrutirbhavati yatra tāvanmātrameva śrūyate |
yatra caikavākyate vidheyāntaraṃ vidyate |
na tviha tadekamapi |
samastaikitavyatopetapradhānapunaḥśruti- śravaṇāt |
etameva śrutisaṃyogāviśeṣaṃ manyate |
na caiṣā punaḥśrutiḥ |
kutaḥ ? ' ekaśākhānibaddhānāṃ jñāyate hi punaḥ śrutiḥ |

' bhāṭṭa-- audgātre sāmavede śyenaḥ śrutaḥ jyoti- ṣṭomadharmavān |
tatra prākṛtājñaiṣpattideśena nānā ṛtvijaḥ prāsāḥ aupadeśikyā audgātrasamākhyayā bādhyante iti teṣu udgātā eva kartā |

prayogaśca prayogavidhinā śāstrasya eko vidhīyate iti samākhyayā ajñeṣvapi kartṛvidhi- rupadeśena |
ataśca yathaiva 'apsavabhyuyanti caranti' ityatra apāṃ deśatvāt sāṅgabhāvanāviṣayatvapratīteḥ prākṛteṣu prayājādiṣu abhivāghakatvaṃ tathā prakṛte'pi |
na ca samākhyāyāḥ pradhānamātre śrutāyā api aṅgaviṣayakatvasya kalpanīyatvena prayogavidhyāśritatvāt tasya atideśaprāpitāṅgaviṣayatvena tadapekṣatvāt upajīvyacodakaprāpita-nānākartṛtva-bādhānupapattiriti vācyam, satyapi tṛtīyāśravaṇe apāmapi aṅgaviṣaya- tvasya kalpanīyatvenoktavidhayā abhivāghakatvānāpatteḥ |

saṃdarśane ca vikṛtermahāprakaraṇaṃ rājasūye iva na kevalaṃ vācanikaṃ vikṛtyarthaṃ saṃdarśaneva bhavati, kiṃtu saṃdaṃśasyā- nekavidhatvāt anekavidham |
tathāhi [1] prākṛtājñā- nuvādena vihitāmapi saṃdaṃśaṃ yadasaṃyuktamapi vikṛtau śrutam, tadapi prakaraṇe gṛhyate, prākṛtānuvādena vihitayoḥ pūrvapraśācanayoḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇataḥ madhye ca tadicchedakatvamāvāt |
[2] tathā vikṛteḥ pūrvai asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvihitam, tataḥ pūrvaṃ tu prākṛtānuvādena yat vihitaṃ tat asaṃyuktaṃ yat, tat vikṛtiprakaraṇe gṛhyate |
[3] tathā vikṛteranantaraṃ asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvi- dhāya prākṛtānuvādena kasimidvihite tat pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇe gṛhyate |
tadidaṃ medatrayaṃ valamalādhikaraṇavārtike uktaṃ ' yasyāṃ tu vikṛtau prākṛtaṃ kiṃcidaṅgaṃ saṃkīrtya tasya purastāt parastād vaikṛtamaṅgaṃ āmnāyate, tatra kathaṃbhāva- gṛhītāṅgamevabhaviṣyati tat prakaraṇapāṭhāt vijñāyate ' iti (2|3|7|14 pṛ. 852) |
tadetadvārtikaṃ someśvareṇa anantaramedayaparatvena yojitam |
tathā vikṛteḥ pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvihitaṃ pūrvaṃ tataḥ vikṛtyanuvādena yadi vihitam, tat asaṃyuktaṃ yat, tat vikṛtiprakaraṇe gṛhyate |
tathā vikṛteranantaraṃ asaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcidvidhāya vikṛtyanuvādena kasimidvihite tat pūrvamasaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇe gṛhyate |
tadidaṃ bhedadvayaṃ vikṛtyanuvādena vihitasya prakaraṇaprāptautarkyaiva arthāduktaṃ

jyotiṣṭomādvāt tasya cāhā samāpyamānatvāt sāhasa iti padaṃ upapadāṃ jyotiṣṭomasaṃbaṃdhanatvāt; na tu uddeśyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vaiyarthyāt |
ataśca dvādaśasya- mapi taddeva upasadudeśena vidhīyamānaṃ prakṛtāveva niveśite, ahīnapadaṃ 'na hīyate' iti vyutpattyā jyotiṣṭomānuvādakam, vikṛtitvāt hi enaṃ anye ṛtavo na jahati |
'tasya samūhaḥ' ityanuvṛtti- sahitayā 'ahnaḥ kratoḥ' iti smṛtyā ahaḥ- śabdasya ṛtusamūhavācilapratyayāntatvavidhānāt, tasya ca īnādeśavidhānāt ahīnaśabdaniṣpattāvapi ahaḥsādhya- ṛtusamūhatvasya ahīnapadavaccacchedakasya abhyāsa- samūhātmakajyotiṣṭome satvāt tadanuvādopapattiḥ |
iti pūrvapakṣayitvā, upasanmādeśena dvādaśatvavidhau saṃkhyādyasya aṣṭodaśaduvikalpapatteḥ, tadaṅgīkāre ca saṃkhyāntarasādhanatvābhāvādvākyaikavākyānupapatteḥ |
sāhnā- hīnapadavaiyarthyāpatteśca vaidikaprayogāt ahīnapadavvyāhaḥ- sādhyaṛtuviśeṣasamūhātmakahīnasaṃbaṃdhana dvādaśa- śatavidhiḥ iti prāptaḥ : siddhāntāmāha |
nanyāstu, sudharmātamātra bhāvanānyatvaniyamena ṣaṣṭhīkhaṇḍe'pi para- sparānvayā(ya)tyutpatteḥ ahīnasaṃbaṃdhanadhupasadudeśena dvādaśa- tvavidhinupapatteḥ ahīnadeśena dvādaśopasattvameva ati- deśataḥ pūrvapravṛttyā vidhīyate 'tāṃ caturbhiḥ' itivat dvādaśatvavidhaure phalaṃ ityāhaḥ |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ |
'pañcadaśānyājyāni' ityatraiva dvādaśapadārthopasatpadārthayoḥ anvayāsyāklṛptatvāt nanyo- kasya ahīnadeśena dvādaśatvavidhaure asaṃbhavaḥ |
'tāṃ caturbhiḥ' ityatra tu arthaprāpteḥ pūrvapravṛttyā ādānamāva- nāyā eva vidheyatvāt tatra catuḥpadārthavaiśiṣṭyasyetyutpatteḥ samuccayaphalakaviśiṣṭavidhivaibhavaḥ iti vaiṣamyam |
ataḥ upasadudeśenaiva dvādaśatvavidhiḥ |
upasattvarūpe ca āna- rthakyaprasaktau dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyamanyāya rūpatātparyagrāhakasya nyāyatvena durbalatvāt upasannāpūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā mupetya ahīnapadasamabhivyāhārarūpa-vākyasyaiva tātparyagrāhakatva- mupetya ahīnapūrvasādhanabhūtaupasattvalakṣaṇā aṅgīkriyate |
yatra tu dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyamanyāyena samaṃ vākyasā- virotho yathā trivavākye sāhanapadasamabhivyāhārūpa- vākyasya, tatra na tannyāyabādhaḥ |
tātparyagrāhakayorapi ca balābalabalamuktaṃ tatratatra, yathā 'abhighrāṃ juhoti' ityatra homodeśena abhikramaṇavicau homasattvarūpe ānarthakyaprasaktau darśapūrṇamāsīmayamahāprakaraṇarūpatātparyagrāhakatvat pradhāna- homāpūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vidhāya mahāpra- karaṇapekṣayā prabalaprayājīyāvāntaraprakaraṇarūpatātparyagrāhaka- balāt prayājahomāpūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā iti siddhāntitaṃ tṛtīye (bhāṭṭa. 3|1|10) |
yadyapi dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntika- gatajuhotyupasatpadayoḥ apūrvavyabhicāra eva apūrvasāmā- nyasādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakaḥ, tathāpi apūrvaviśeṣa- sādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvena vādyaniyamanyāyādīnā- mupanyāsaḥ |
yadvā upasadādiṣṭadvādaśatvasya ahīnadeśena vidhiḥ, pūrvavākye uddeśyatvenopasthitatvāt upasadādeva āśrayatvam |
upasatpadārthasyabhāvādāpi evameva yuktam |
sarvathā ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutitvābhāvāt idaṃ vākyaprakaraṇavirodho- dāharaṇam |
tadapi ca dvādaśopasattvavidhāyakavākyābhāvaṃ kṛtvācintā |
vastutastatra tadvākyasattvāt tena satarātmaka- dvādaśāhe iva ahīnātmakadvādaśāhe'pi tatprāptisaṃbhavāt ' dvādaśāhahīnasya ' iti trividhapairaiva arthavādaḥ |
mahato dvādaśāhasya mahatī saṃkhyā, jyotiṣṭomasya tu svalpatvāt tritvameva praśastaṃ iti stutiḥ |
prācāṃ mate ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutilyavahārastu gauṇaḥ |
ata eva teṣāmatra śrutiprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇatvopanyāsaḥ |
vastustu nanyoktaṃ vākyaprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇamapi ayuktam |
tathāhi, kiṃ viniyojakaprakaraṇena samaṃ atra vākyasya virodho'bhi- pretaḥ, uta apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakaprakaraṇena ? viniyojakatā''pi hi jyotiṣṭomamahāprakaraṇasya, uta upasadvāntaraprakaraṇasya ? nādyaḥ, jyotiṣṭomamahāprakaraṇasya upasaddvādaśatvagrāhakatāyogāt, jyotiṣṭomasya dvādaśa- vāramahāpratyāpatteḥ |
na dvitīyaḥ, pūrvāparavācanikāṅga- saṃdaṃśarūpopasadvāntaraprakaraṇe mānābhāvāt, pakṣadvaye'pi siddharūpatvāt dvādaśatvasya prakaraṇārthatvādyogāt, upasa- tpadasamabhivyāhārarūpavākyasyaiva tritvāṃśe iva dvādaśa- tvāṃśe'pi vinigamakatvāviraheṇa viniyojakatvopapattau
prakaraṇasya aviniyojakatvācca |
dīkṣaṇīyāvādyaniyama- nyāyena upasandanāpūrvasādhanatve lakṣaṇaye jyotiṣṭomamahā- prakaraṇasya tātparyagrāhakatvā tu na saṃbhāvataiva |
upasadā- ntaraprakaraṇasyaiva tasya tātparyagrāhakatvā'pi, upasadādampūrvā- vyabhicārasyaiva tātparyagrāhakasya satvāt nirākāryā |
uddeśyasya apūrvavyabhicāre hi prakaraṇasya apūrvasādhanatva- lakṣaṇātātparyagrāhakatvaṃ yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityādi |
ata eva ādhānaprakaraṇe 'vāraṇo yajñavatcaraḥ' iti yajñasādhanatvena śrutānāṃ vāraṇādīnāṃ sākṣādyajñarūpe ādhāne niveśayogāt ānarthakyatadnyāyena ādhānā- ṣṭapavamāneṣṭirūpaye eva niveśaḥ |
ityāśaṅkya pavamāne- ṣṭīnāṃ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti svaprakaraṇavākyena agnyādyaṅgatvān ādhānāṅgatvasyābhāve ka ānarthakya- tadnyāyāvakāśaḥ iti bhāṣyakāramatena siddhāntamabhi- dhāya vārtikakāramate tādṛśavākyānaṅgīkārāt prakaraṇena pavamāneṣṭīnāṃ ādhānāṅgatve'pi yaśodeśena vāraṇādidhau yajñasya apūrvavyabhicāre iha apūrvasādhanatvavāgamāt tadartha prakaraṇānupraveśasyābhāve vāraṇādīnāṃ ādhānāṣṭave eva pramāṇābhāvāt na tadaṣṭapavamāneṣṭiṣu avatāraḥ |
iti sakalyajñajñatvaṃ nathaiva siddhāntaṃ tṛtīye (bhāṭṭa. 3|1|12) |
ato dvādaśatvaviniyogavicau prakaraṇa- vyāpārābhāvāt nedaṃ śrutiprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇam, na vā vākyaprakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇam, api tu vākyayoḥ paraspara- virodhodāharaṇam |
pūrvapakṣimate vastutaḥ upasadāṃ jyoti- ṣṭomīyatvāt jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe dvādaśatvasya niveśaḥ, siddhānte na, ityataḥ prakaraṇavirodhodāharaṇatvena prācīna- navīnaiśca vyahriyate iti tattvam |
vākyaprakaraṇavirodho- dāharaṇaṃ tu tadavasare pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ |
tat siddhaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutitvābhāvāt taddārakaviśeṣopādānam (uktānya- tamaniṣṭhasaṃbandhatvānavacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvaṃ iti viśeṣa- ṇam) |
idaṃ tu bodhyam |
kartṛtvakarmatvādipadānāṃ vākyatve- nāvācyatvāt tatrātivyāpyasaṃbhave'pi kartṛtvādipadadā- dipadādau anivyāptirdurvārā |
na ca kartṛtvādādīnyeva anyatamatvena anugamayya tadanyatamatvānavacchinnaśaktinirūpa- katvaṃ lakṣaṇam, tadādestu buddhiviṣayatvāvacchinnatadanya- tamaniṣṭhaśrutinirūpakatvaṃ iti na doṣaḥ |
iti vācyam |
tadādito'pi viśeṣarūpakārakabodhyānurodhena viśeṣarūpā- vacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvasya tatrābhyupagamāt, kapratyaye karmatvasya śakyatā'vacchedakatā'vacchedakatvena śakya- tā'vacchedakatvābhāvāt ativyāptivāraṇaprādhānyenetyasya vaiyarthyāt |
saktūn iti dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvalakṣaṇayāmāpi vastutaḥ tādṛśāntyamatatvāvacchinnaśaktinirūpakatvāna- pāyāt atiprasaṅgāt |
ato'tra idamākalayyāmaḥ :- svaśakyatāvacchedaka- kartṛtvatvādyanyatamatvāvacchinnatātparyakapratyayatvaṃ śrutitvam |
'vrīhīna prokṣati' ityādivākyeṣu dvitīyādīnāṃ svaśakyatāvacchedaka-karmatvatvāvacchinna-tātparyakatvasya saṃsargādhikaraṇado nirṇītatvāt lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
saktūn iti dvitīyāyāstu svaśakyatāvacchedakakarmatvatvāvaccha- chinnatātparyakatvasya saktvadhikaraṇe nirastatvāt nāti- vyāptiḥ |
atra svaśakyakartṛtvavācyatvamatatātparyakatva- ṣaṣṭhyasya śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā ativyāpteḥ |
avacchedanakatvānubhavam |
tadādivā raṇāya pratyayatvaniveśaḥ |
kartṛtvavācyatvamāva- chinnatātparyakavibhaktisya saktūnītyādirakaraṇādipara- dvitīyau ativyāptivāraṇāya svaśakyatāvacchedaketi |
ata eva ' prokṣitāmāmūlalulasulamā ' ityatra kapratyayasya karmatvaviśiṣṭe śakteḥ karmatvatvasya śakyatā- 'vacchedakatā'vacchedakatvena śakyatā'vacchedakatvābhāvāt nātivyāptiḥ |
' āgneyaḥ ' ityādidevatātvasya saṃjñāyatve kartṛtvādyanyatamatvamacce devatātvatvamapi upā- deyam |
na ca devatātvaviśiṣṭadravyavācakasya taddhitasya devatātvasya śakyatā'vacchedakatvāt devatātvatvaṃ na śakyatāvacchedakaṃ iti vācyam |
ākṛtyadhikaraṇa- nyāyena devatātve eva taddhitasya śakteḥ, dravye lakṣa- ṇāṅgīkārāt |
na ca ' rājā rājasūye svārā- jyakāmo yajeta ' ityādi rājādipadottaraprathamāyāḥ sādhutvārthatvena kartṛtvādyanyatamārthatvābhāvāt avyāptiḥ, ' abhihitakārakavācinī prathamā ' iti mate prathamāyāḥ api ākhyātārthakartṛtvādyarthakatvāt ' saṃbhedenānyatara-
vaiyarthyam' iti nyāyāt, prathamāyāḥ sādhutvārthamate śrutitvābhāve'pi kṣativirahāt 'rājā rājasūyena yajeta' ityādau rājādyanvayasya vākyapramāṇakatvopapatteḥ |
na ca rājapadottaraprathamāyāḥ nirarthakatve'pi rājājñatvaṃ kartṛ- tvādyarthakāvyatātparyaśrutipramāṇakaṃ iti śaṅkyam |
ākhyātasya kartṛtvādirśaktatvāḥ karmadhikāraṇe nirasta- tvena śrutitvābhāvāt |
kartṛprathamā''khyātayoḥ asaṃ- grāhyatve śrutilakṣaṇe kartṛtvavattvāddhāraṇatvamatvaniveśavai- phalyaṃ iti tu na vācyam, kartṛtvādiyāḥ saṃgrāhyatvāt |
na ca tathā (kṣati) tasyānvayatvena kartṛtvakarmatvādi- ghaṭakībhūtakṛtiphaladiṣṭadharmāṇāmeva tattaddharmikaśakya- tā'vacchedakatvāt kartṛtvādeḥ śakyatā'vacchedakatvāt asaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam |
śakyatā'vacchedakabhūtatva- dharmadvayatvamatvaghaṭitalakṣaṇasyaiva vivakṣitatvāt, kartṛ- tvasya akhaṇḍopādhirūpatvena kartṛtvādereva śakyatā'- vacchedakatvāt uttalakṣaṇe'pi adoṣāt |
nanu 'maitrā- varuṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' ityādau maitrāvaruṇasya bhāvoddeśyasya caturthe (bhāṭṭa. 4|2|6) sthāpitatvāt daṇḍasya anīpsitakarmatvena anvayāvagāheḥ anīpsita- karmatvārthakapadapadottaradvitīyāyāḥ daṇḍājñatve apramāṇa- tvena śrutitvābhāvāt tatra utlakṣaṇatvāt iti |
īpsi- tānīpsitāsādhāraṇakarmatvatvācchabde eva dvitīyāyāḥ śakteḥ, daṇḍamiti dvitīyāyāḥ tadavacchinnatātparyakatvāt |
iti cenna |
'vyāpyavyāpyasya sutarāṃ vyāpyatvam' iti nyāyena maitrāvaruṇasya bhāvatvāt daṇḍasyāpi karmatve- nānvaye bhāvanāyāḥ ekakarmakatvabhramāpatteḥ daṇḍapadottara- dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatve lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāre karmatvāvacchinna- tātparyakatvābhāvāt |
ata eva sarvatra anīpsitakarma- padottaradvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatve lakṣaṇā |
saktūn ityatra viniyogabhaṅgasiddhānto'pi |
ata eva dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvaparatvaparyavasānāt, anīpsitakarmatvaparatvaparyavasāne iṣṭasyāpi bhāvyatvena vākyabhedāpatteḥ |
kiṃca dvitī- yāyāḥ anīpsitakarmatvaparatve saktūnāṃ homājñatve kiṃ pramāṇam ? na tāvat śrutiḥ, dvitīyāyāḥ homājñatā- prayojakakaraṇatvaśaktatvābhāvāt |
nāpi vākyam, uktakaraṇatvalakṣakatvābhāvāt |
nahi śaktyā karmatvatvena lakṣaṇayā vā anīpsitakarmatvatvena anīpsitakarmatvoktiḥ saktūnāṃ homājñatvaṃ gamayati |
pramāṇāntaraṃ tu homājñatāyāṃ asaṃbhāvitemeva |
na ca 'somena yajeta' ityatra matvarthalakṣaṇayāpe somenikkaraṇatvasya śaktyā lakṣaṇayā vā vimaktyanuktatvena śrutivākyayoḥ somanidhyājñatāyāṃ pramāṇatvasaṃbhave'pi viśeṣaṇavidhirūpakalpitaśrutereva pramāṇatvamupete, evamihāpi iti vācyam |
yajipadasa- mbhivyāhārarūpatātparyagrāhakabalena somapade somakaraṇake, karaṇatvasaṃbandhena somavati vā lakṣaṇāyāḥ yajipada- samabhivyāhṛtasomapadarūpavākyasya somanidhyājñatve pramāṇatvāt, viśeṣaṇavidhitve'dhe eva vyāpārāt |
ata eva ajñatvaghaṭitakartṛtvādyanyatamā- vagatiḥ śrutavākyāt, vidhyanvayāvagatistu viśeṣaṇa- vidhitaḥ |
viśeṣaṇavidhau hi somakaraṇakabhāvanāyāṃ vidhyanvaye svaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣatā'vacchedaka- tā'vacchedakatvasaṃbandhena vidhiviśiṣṭarūpavidhyanvaya- tvāvagatiḥ |
karaṇatvāt tu somasvarūpāde iva viśeṣaṇa- vidhiranuvāda eva |
prakṛte tu saktūnāṃ anīpsitakarma- tvenānvaye homājñatāprayojakakartṛkaraṇatayāḥ śruta- vākyādanavagateḥ |
ata eva karaṇatvāvacchepakaghaṭita- viśeṣaṇavidhikalpanāyāmapi mānābhāvāt tasyāpi homājñatve pramāṇatvābhāvāt niṣpramāṇakameva saktūnāṃ homājñatvam |
śrutividhau hi kartṛtvādyanyatamasya yasyāva- gatiḥ, tadādyakṣaṃ padadvitaviśeṣaṇavidhiḥ kalpyate, yathā 'somena yajeta' ityatra tṛtīyāntapadaghaṭitaḥ, 'amā- vāsyāyāmaparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti' ityatra 'pade juhoti' ityatra ca saptamyantapadaghaṭitaḥ, na tu somavākye adhikaraṇatāvācakapadaghaṭitaḥ, padavākye karaṇatāvācaka- padaghaṭitaḥ |
tathā saktūvākye saktūnāṃ anīpsitakarma- tvāvagatau tadādyakṣapadaghaṭitaḥ eva viśeṣaṇavidhiḥ kalpyeta, na tu karaṇatāvācakapadaghaṭitaḥ, iti na tatpramāṇakatvamajñatvasya |
ato dvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatva- lakṣaṇayā vākyapramāṇakatve eva viniyogabhaṅgāt siddhāntaparyavasānaṃ ityavagacchāmaḥ |
ata: anīpsita-
karmavācakapadottaradvitīyāyāḥ karaṇatvaparatvāt karmatvatvā- vacchinnatātparyakatvābhāvena na śrutilakṣaṇātiprasaṅgaḥ |
' ācāntena karma kartavyam ' ' vrīhīn prokṣati ' ' vrīhibhiryajeta ' ' viprāṃ gāṃ dadāti ' uttarārdhāt sviṣkṛte samavadyati ' ' yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityādinā krameṇa kartṛtvādivācakaśrutyudāharaṇāni |
' godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet ' ityādau ṣaṣṭhīśrutyā godohanasya pañcadvatva iti ṣaṣṭhyāḥ śrutilavyavahārastu gauṇa iti dhyeyam |
kecittu ajñatvapramāṇaṇabhūtā śrutiḥ trividhā- vibhaktī, abhidhātrī, viniyogakrī |
ceti |
vidhātrī- liṅādiśrutiḥ, abhidhātrī vrīhyādiśrutiḥ |
viniyogakrī trividhā- vibhaktīrūpā, samānapadarūpā, samānābhidhāna- rūpā ca |
etatsakalasādhāraṇasya ' nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ ' iti pravādāsya yacchabdajñānaṃ anyanvayavidhānamapekṣya yada- rthajñānaṃ janayati, sā tasminnarthe śrutirityarthaḥ |
na ca viniyojakamānaprastāve vidhāvyabhidhātrīsādhāraṇalakṣaṇa- kathanaṃ tannideśaśca arhagato iti śaṅkyam |
vidhi- viniyojakasthāpanena vidhisahakāritvasya tayorapi tulya- tvāt |
śeṣaśeṣitvābhimatayoḥ tattadrūpeṇāvasthitayoḥ saṃbandhabodhau vyavadhānamapekṣya yacchabdajñānena janyate, sā viniyokrī |
saṃbandhaśca ajñatvamānā, sādhanatvavā- tmanā, saṃbandhatvāramanā vā pratīyatām |
na tadiśeṣo lakṣaṇe lakṣyate |
tena 'dīkṣaṇīyām' ityādi aṭṭaḥ, tṛtīyāṣaṣṭhīpadaśrutīnāṃ ca saṃgrahaḥ ityāhuḥ |
tadatīva mandam |
śaktatvarūpābhidhātrītvasya uktaśrutilavyāpaka- tayā tadavacchinnavibhaktyaupādhitvānupapatteḥ |
na ca samānapadaśruteḥ 'yajeta' ityādipāyāḥ yāgabhāvanayoḥ saṃbandharūpāyeṃ śrutitvena tatra śaktatvarūpābhidhātrītvā- bhāvāt na tasya śrutitvavyāpakatvaṃ iti vācyam |
tathāpi śrutivibhājakopādhyantarasamānābhidhānatvena abhidhātrītvasya tadvibhākopādhitvasaṃbhavāt, samāna- padaśrutyā śeṣaśeṣiṇoḥ saṃbandharūpārthajñāne jananīye svaghaṭa- kapadārthajñānasya apekṣaṇīyatvena tvaduktaśrutitvasya samāna- padaśruto abhāvane abhidhātrītvasya uttavyāpakatvasyāpi suvacatvāt |
ata eva śrutilakṣaṇasya samānapadaśrutau avyāpteḥ tasyāḥ lakṣyatvakathanam api asaṃgatam |
na ca padārthopasthitiratiriktavyayadhāyakāpekṣātvaṃ utlakṣaṇaghaṭakaṃ iti nāvyāptiḥḥ iti vācyam |
' uccairṛcā kriyate ' ityādi saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsamānaśeṣo'pi saṃbandhake vākye ativyāpteḥ |
kiṃca ' saktūn ' ityatra prāthamikadvitīyājñānena karaṇatvajñāne jananīye śakyopasthitilakṣaṇājñānādirūpa-vyavadhāyakāpekṣatve api karaṇatvam, śakyasaṃbandhena dvitīyāvat iti jñānena kara- ṇatvajñāne jananīye vyavadhāyakāntarāpekṣatvāt dvitī- yāyāḥ karaṇatve śrutitvāpattiḥ, anapekṣānvayavaiyarthyaṃ |
yat śaktyā padārthajñānaṃ janayati, yat yatra śaktaṃ tat tatra śrutiḥ ityasyaiva suvacatvāt |
api ca śrautājña- vyavahāraviṣayībhūtaśrutitvasya vidhāvyabhidhātrīsādhāraṇe ' saktūn juhoti ' ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādau vākyī- yājñatvabodhe'pi vidhiviniyojyopasthāpanena vidhāti- padikarūpavidhāvyabhidhātryoḥ sahakāritā ajñatvapramā- ṇatā'vacchedakaṃ śrutitvaṃ vidhiprātipadikādiṣyāptameva vācyam |
evaṃ viniyokrīlakṣaṇe samānābhidhānasamāna- padaśrutisaṃgrahāya svaghaṭakapadārthopasthitivibhinna vyavadhāne viśeṣaṇabodho vācyam |
tathā ca saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsa- mānaśeṣo'pi śeṣaśeṣiṇvake ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādivākye ativyāptiḥ |
' saktūn juhoti ' ityatra karaṇatvaṃ dvitīyalakṣaṇaṃ iti dvitīyājñānena vyavadhānamapekṣya karaṇatvarūpasaṃbandhabodhāt dvitīyādeḥ viniyokrī- sthāpattiśca iti na kiṃcidetat |
ataḥ samānābhidhāna- samānapadaśrutyādiṣu śrutitvavyavahārasya gauṇatvamaṅgīkṛtya kārakavibhaktyasādhāraṇaṃ asajñatvalakṣaṇameva ucitam |

yasya hi śabdasya śravaṇādeva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate sā vini- yogaśrutiḥ |
tadyatrānekārthābhidhānamekena śabdena yugapa- dbhavati vibhaktayeva liṅgasaṃkhyākāraṇāṃ tatra teṣāma- nvitānevābhidhānaṃ ananvitānānekameṣāṃ arthānāmekena śabdena yugapadbhidhānasyaikaśeṣamantareṇāsaṃbhavāt |
akṣa- śabdena videcanādīnām |
anyathā 'gāmānaya' iti yat yāṃ kāṃcitdyakti 'akṣamānaya' iti niyukto videva- nādīnāmantyatamānayetya saṃdihīta saṃdigdhe ca kiṃparo'yaṃ prayukta iti |
tassāt anvitābhidhānam |
tatrāpi pratī- tivalena kārakaṃ pradhānato liṅgasaṃkhye guṇataḥ |
tathā coktaṃ yadā karmādayo vibhaktyarthāstairekatvādayo viśeṣaṇā- nīti |
etena vibhaktiyājyāḥ saṃkhyāyā viśeṣeṇa kārakaviśeṣaṇatvamidaṃ dhānā nirāstāḥ |
ananvitānāma- pyabhidhāne prathamakeśabdopāttena pradhānabhūtena ca kārakeṇaiva saṃkhyā saṃdhyate na prātipadikārthena viprakṛṣṭena guṇabhūtena ca |
prātipadikārthānvitaiḥ sā'bhi- dhīyate na kārakatvamiti tu svasamarthasamaṃtasatkṛtā- rthatattvānāṃ śraddhāmātraṃ na prāmāṇikaṃ pratītyaviśeṣāt |
yathā 'paśunā' ityukte paśuḥ kathaṃ pratīyate tathaikaṃ karaṇamityapi pratīyate eva |
na caikamabhidhānaṃ arthā- ntarānvitamarthāntaramabhidhānaṃ na dṛṣṭam |
liṅgapratyayasya kṛtapratyayasya ca kṛtayavacchinnābhyupāyamaṇupāmāt |
kathaṃ ca vidhākṣepaḥ ? tādarthyāditi cet |

prātipadi- kārthaṃ kārakaṃ vā prati viśeṣaṇabhūtasyaikasya tadava- dhīreṇa vidhyarthamadhīyasaṃbhavāt |
saṃbhave vā śeṣīṇādīnā- mapi vidhyarthatvaṃ syāt tadupapatte ca devatabhūtavāyu- viśeṣaṇatā kalpyateti kṣipidraguṇaviśiṣṭa eva vāyurdevatā syān vāyusvarūpamityalamanenālīkavivādena |
tadevaṃ saṃkhyāderakṣaśabdopādānalakṣaṇayā śrutyā kārakanvayaḥ |
prātipadikārthasya tu paśyatyā |
prakṛtipratyayārthayorhi śravaṇādeva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate na padadvayadvaiparāmarśamape- kṣate iti padamapi śrutipakṣe niścityate tadekamekakāra- kāntitānāṃ jātiliṅgasaṃkhyānāṃ aruṇakahāyanonīyena parasparaniyama iti |
vibhaktistu saṃbandhameva sādhyatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ vā pratipādayantī viniyogakāraṇam |
tatra dvitīyā sādhyatvaṃ pratipādayati, tṛtīyādayastu sādhana- tvam |
tatra 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti dvitīyā sādhyatvena vrīhīnabhidhānyā avaghātasya teṣu viniyogakāraṇaṃ bhavati kathaṃ tarhi sukuṣu homasyāviniyogaḥ |
teṣāmasamīhita- tvāt |
'samīhitaṃ svaśabdena vrīhayo na samī- hitāḥ |
apūrvasādhanatvena vrīhayastu samīhitāḥ |
saṃkavo hi dvitīyā sādhyatvena prāptā api samīhitatvevadhuryāt labhyante |
na hi dvitīyā samīhi- tatvaṃ pratipādayati, api tu sādhyatvameva vadati tena saknunāṃ śeṣitvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti paridṛśya homabhāvanā bhāgyāntaramapekṣate, avaghāte tu naivaṃ paricchitkāraṇamiti |
tathāhi |
avaghātabhāvanā bhavya samīhitameṣamāṇā dvitīyāprātipāditatvān vrīhīn bhāvyatvena svīkṛtya- mabhisithitā svarūpeṇa teṣāmahīhitatvādihilabhyate |
tatra yadi kathaṃcidapi teṣāṃ samīhitatvaṃ saktuvacca labhyeta tato viparivṛtya bhāgyāntaramapekṣeta saṃbhavati ca teṣāṃ prakṛtā- pūrvasādhanaviśeṣarūpeṇa samīhitatvam |
tathāhi 'vrīhi- bhiryajeta' iti yāgasādhanatvena vrīhayo vihitāḥ |
na ca teṣāṃ sākṣādyāgasādhanatvamutpattiśiṣṭo'vaghātaḥ paṭhitam |
tena puroḍāśaprakṛtitvena teṣāṃ sādhanatvamiti tena rūpeṇa samīhitāḥ |
tathaiva bhāvyā bhavanti |
vrīhi- śabdaśca tadupalakṣaṇārthaḥ |
evaṃ ca yaveṣvapyaupadeśika evā- vaghātaḥ siddho bhavati tadrūpasya teṣvapyaviśeṣatvāt |
tadevaṃ prakaraṇasahitayā śrutyā avaghātaviniyogastaddhīnatvāda- pūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayāḥ |
tathā hi darśapūrṇamāsābhyaṃ śruta- sāvaghātasya śrutisaṃyuktrīhimātreṇa prayojanāparyavasānāt 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti vākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ prakṛtena darśapūrṇa- māsavākyenaivavākyatvaṃ pratipadyate darśapūrṇamāsasaṃbandhino vrīhīnavahantīti tatsaṃbandhaśca prayojanāvinābhūtāḥ svasādhyaṃ prayojanamupasthāpayanti |
tasminnupasthite tadartha- tvamavaghātasya vrīhyarthatvaparitāyeṇa saṃpādayanti vrīhi- śabdastasya tatsādhanārthatā bhavati |
nanvevaṃ sati 'barhirmāti' ityasyāpi darśapūrṇamāsavākyenaikavākya- tvātsvasādhane barhiṣi lavanasya viniyoge'ṅgapradhānārthatā na sidhyet |
na samyagavagatamasmanmatamāyuṣmatā |
