hi darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vrīhirhiḥprabhṛtayastadarthena viśeṣe- pyante darśapūrṇamāsārthān vrīhīnīti kiṃ tarhi tatsaṃbandha- mātreṇa tatsaṃbandhittvaṃ cājñānāmapi upakārakatvādbhavatyeva tatsaṃbandhamiśra yatprayojanaṃ pradhānapūrvamanadyā apūrvamu- pasthāpyate tatsādhanarūpe vrīhirhiṅgadiśabdairlakṣitaṃ tatra viniyujyamānaṃ labanādi tasya sarvasyāṅgaṃ bhavati |
ata eva sthānādapīmopamīyāgena viśeṣite'pi yūpe vini- yujyamānānāṃ raśanādadharmāṇāmamīmopapradhānatadaṅgāpūrva- vyatirekeṇa tathūpasādhyasaṃvanīyāgāṅgatvamapi |
tataśca tadīyadvitīyapariṇyāṇe'pi raśanā taddharmāśraupadeśikā bhavanti |
yathajñāṅgeṣvapi taddharmā bhavanti vaimṛghādreṣvapi tarhi vrīhitaddharmā upadeśenaiva bhaveyuḥ |
na, tadabhāvāt |
na hi vaimṛdhasya vrīhaya upadiṣṭā bhavanti yadā tu tatra codakena prāpnuvanti tadā sahaivāvaghātana prāpnuvantīti dviruktatvānnoṣadeśasaṃbhavaḥ |
ata eva savanīyasya veśa- ṣike dvitīye eva pariṇyāṇe raśanādīnāmupadeśo nānyatra dviruktadoṣāditi |
tatsiddhaṃ prakaraṇaśanā śrutyā ava- ghātādīnāṃ viniyoga iti |
tadatra prakaraṇavaśa śrutasyaiva śabdasyārthaviśeṣalakṣaṇaparatvaṃ kalpyate |
prayājādiṣu tu śabdasvarūpameva viniyojakaṃ kalpyate ityevāvāndheṣaḥ prakaraṇādhīnatvaṃ tanmayāviśiṣṭam |
yasya tu kṛtasaṃbandhā- vyabhicāraḥ |
suvādestatsaṃbandhitvena viniyujyamānasya khādiratvādestaddvāreṇa prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ buddhāvavipari- vartamānamapi pūrvamapūrva tenaivāvyabhicāriṇā liṅgena hṛda- yamāgacchatīti vinā''pi prakaraṇaṃ tatsādhanarūpalakṣaṇayā viniyogopapattiḥ |
yatra dvayaṃ nāsti tatra sādhanalakṣaṇaṃ na ghaṭate iti prakaraṇasahitā śrutiravaghātaviniyoge kāraṇam |
syādetat dvitīyā vrīhīṇāṃ sādhyatvamātramabhidhāyate avaghātasādhyatvaṃ tu tatpadasamabhivyāhārāmakāṅkṣādeva tatkathaṃ śrutyā'vaghātasya vrīhyatvamiti |
satyaṃ yathā āha bhavān kiṃtu viniyogaḥ śrutyaiva |
saṃbandho hi viniyogaḥ |
sa ca samīhitāsamīhitayoḥ sādhyasādhana- bhāva rūpaḥ |
tatra dvitīyā vrīhīṇāṃ samīhitānāṃ sādhyatvaṃ pratipādayantī pratiyoginaḥ śeṣitvamākṣipya tadiśe- ṣamātārthe vākyamapekṣate tenobhayatrāpi śrutireva viniyoga- kāraṇamucyate |
yatra punaḥ śeṣiśeṣayoḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvo na śrutaḥ padadvayasamabhivyāhārādeva śeṣaśeṣitvayoyala- mālocya kalpyaḥ yathā 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti tatra vākyenaiva viniyoga iti |
na hi tatra svargakāmasya yāgasya vā sādhyatvaṃ sādhanatvaṃ vā kenacidupāttaṃ padadvaya- samabhivyāhārādeva tu saṃbandhaṃ kalpayantyeva asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyādityanena nyāyena kāminaḥ prādhānyaṃ yāgasya guṇatvaṃ kalpyate |
āha - 'svargakāmasya bhūtasya bhāvyatvaṃ saṃbhavatkatham |
bhūtikartṛrhi bhāvyatvaṃ bhavanasya na bhūtiṣu |
bhavanasya hyatpannaparanāmadheyasya kartā bhāvyo bhavati svargakāmastvalpo notpannumahati iti na bhāvyaḥ syāditi taducyate |
'bhūtasyāpi svarūpeṇa svargakāmasya bhāvyatā |
dharmāntaraviśiṣṭasya ṛtu- vrīhādijvedvat |
svargakāmasya tāvadbhāvanā śeṣa iti vākyādavagamyate śeṣatvaṃ ca dvedhā bhavati yadi tāvatsvarūpameva samīhitasya sādhyati tadvataṃ vā ka- ciddharmamevaṃ ubhayathā''pi ca sādhyaṃ śeṣi bhavati yathā prayājādibhāvanāyāḥ |
ṛtuḥ hi prayājādibhiḥ ṛtu- svarūpamupasthāpyate tadupakāra eva tu sādhyate atha ca kṛtvarthatvena prayājādyaḥ saṃbadhyante iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
yathā ca vrīhayo niṣpannā apyavaghātasya bhāvyā bhavanti na hi svarūpeṇotpatyārthaṃ mādhyamiti niyamaḥ samastaḥ |
dharmāntarapetenāpi rūpeṇa bhāvyatopapatteḥ |
tatra prathamaṃ bhāvyatāmātrāmake śeṣitve'vadhṛte'pi kamupakāraṃ kṛtvā asyāṃ śeṣaḥ kiṃ svarūpotpatti kiṃ vopakārāntaramiti viśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ sāmarthyena viśeṣaḥ kalpyate |
tatra svarga- kāmasya bhūtasya svarūpeṇa bhāvyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti phala- viśeṣatvenaiva bhāvyatvaṃ bhavati |
ata eva phalapade svargakāmapadaṃ mīmāṃsakairathyate |
yathā 'daṇḍī praiṣānanvāha' iti daṇḍaviśiṣṭasyaivacanājjñatvena codyamāne viśeṣyasya pūrvameva phalatvādviśeṣaṇabhūtasya daṇḍasyānu- vacanājñatvapratipādanaparaṃ vacanaṃ saṃbhavati |
tathā 'svarga- kāmo yajeta' iti vidhineva yāgabhāvanāyāḥ puruṣārthatve

prāpte puruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ na svarūpeṇa saṃbhavatīti kiṃcitkalimicchatastadviśeṣeṇa śeṣitvamiti sāmarthyādavagate svarga- kāmasya śeṣitvamucyamānaṃ svargākhyaviśeṣaṇaparameva bhavati tena svargasādhanadvāreṇa puruṣaśeṣatva- miti |
yathā''huḥ 'apekṣitatvāt māvyasya kāmaśabdā hi tatparāḥ |
viśeṣaṇapradhānatvaṃ daṇḍītyādiṣu darśitam |
' iti |
tadetadekādaśādhyāye vispaṣṭameva bhagavatyā kāraṇenoktam |
nanu naivātra svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate ityādinā phalasya vācakāmāvaṃ codayitvā anena svargakāmaśabdenetyuktvā nanu puruṣaviśeṣasya vaktetyādinā codyapūrvakaṃ puruṣaparatvaṃ phalaparatvaṃ ca svayaṃ nirasya nimittaparatvaṃ cākhyātopāt- kartṛsaṃkhvāvipakṣapratipādanāvasare spaṣṭaṃ sūtrakāreṇaiva 'phalakāmo nimittamiti cenna nityatvāt' iti paricchata- mityuktvā pariśeṣātphalasaṃyoga evāyaṃ ityupapadya kathama punaranena śakyate phalamabhidhātumiti pṛṣṭvā vacanavyakti- dvayamupanyasya 'malinaḥ khāyāt' itivat śeṣitvenānvayaṃ puruṣasya svargakāmāya yāga upadiśyate iti darśayitvā tatra ca svargākhyopakāraviśeṣapratipattiparatvameva saṃpatsyate ityante abhihitam |
anterāpi tadarthena puruṣamātra- mākhyātādeva gamyate tasmādāgataṃ svargo bhavatītyeva- mayaṃ vacanamiti |
tadevaṃ yatra sādhyasādhanamātrapratipādaka- vibhaktyabhāvastatra vrīhīmiti, śeṣe ca sādhanatva- pratipādikā vibhaktyardhyā 'somena yajeta' iti, tatra śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yatrāpyanyatratatra saṃbandhamātrapratipādikā ṣaṣṭhī yathā dabhendriyakāmasyeti śeṣiṇi yathāyathā yājyeti śeṣe tatrāpi yogyātvalocanayā saiva saṃbandhaviśeṣe vartate iti śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yatrāpi śeṣiṇi caturthī maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍamiti tatrāpi saṃpradānasya karmaṇā abhipramāṇasya sphuṭameva sādhyatvaśrutireva |
tadartha- caturthyā tu sphuṭatara eva śrutiviniyogaḥ |
yathā 'yaḥ somavāmī syāt tasmā etaṃ saumendraṃ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapet sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' iti |
yatra tu śrutiviṣayayaḥ yathā 'pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vedim' iti śeṣiṇi saptamī 'saktūn juhoti' iti śeṣe dvitīyā tatra lakṣaṇayā sādhanavācinyā sādhyatvaṃ tadvā- cinyā ca sādhanatvaṃ pratipādyam |
lakṣaṇā ca sarvatra vākyanimittā iti vākyaviniyoga iti |
evaṃ tāvat śrutiviniyogaḥ prapañcitaḥ |
āha, kathaṃ punarvinīyogāśrute- rlevidhiyuktaṃ padasya kārakavibhaktīnāṃ ca viniyojakatva- miti hi dvaividhameva darśayati |
padagrahaṇaṃ tulyābhidhāna- śruterapi darśanādyamityadoṣaḥ |

samāna- pratyayaśrutyā balīyasyā kriyājñatā |

mukhyānāṃ apūrvāṇāṃ pradhānānāṃ mede śabdāntarādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ siddhe sati śeṣāṇāṃ bhāvaḥ vidyamānatā yathā- dhikāraṃ adhikāra prakaraṇaṃ anatikramya syāt |
ye yasya apūrvasya prakaraṇe vidhīyate tasyaiva bhaveyuḥ |

ayamasya apūrvasya śeṣaḥ ; ayamasya ityatra śrutireva pramāṇam |

utpattyarthavibhāgād vā sattvavadaikamyaṃ syāt |
ajñānāṃ yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā iti siddhānte sūtre- prokte vāśabdena taṃ nirasya pūrvapakṣī āha |
na yathā- prakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā kiṃtu ekadharmaṃ syāt aindrāgnādīnā- mapi pradhānānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsapradhānaiḥ samānadharmatā syāt |

abhidhānavat dharmeṇāpi asya samānena bhavitavyam |
kiṃca abhidhāna- vat vāhīka iti abhidhānavat |
yathā 'vāhīko'- tithirāgataḥ yavācamasmai prakriyatām' ityukte yogo vāhīkaḥ tasyatasya yavācaṃ kriyate |
evamihāpi ekasya apūrvasya ye dharmāḥ śrutāḥ te sarvāpūrvāṇāṃ bhavitumarhanti |
tasmādapūrvaprayuktatve'pi sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthā iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
arthasya tvavibhaktatvāt tathā syādabhidhāneṣu, pūrvavattvāt prayogasya, karmaṇaḥ śabdabhāvyatvāt, vibhāgāccheṣāṇāmapravṛttiḥ syāt |
prayāgādyo dharmāḥ prakṛtiprāptā iti siddhāntaḥ |
prakṛtivikṛtisārvā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvapakṣiṇā ca sarvārthatve abhidhānavat iti śabdena vāhīkadṛṣṭāntaḥ uktaḥ |
tuśabdena tasya vaiṣamyaṃ sūcayan siddhāntī svapakṣaṃ sādhayati |
arthasya deśaviśeṣasaṃbandhasya sarveṣu vāhīkeṣu avibhaktatvāt anugatatvāt amitratvāt abhidhāneṣu 'vāhīkāya yavācaṃ kriyatām' ityādiśabdeṣu tathā syāt yavācasya sarvavāhīkārthatā syāt, tathā syāt sarvārthā syāt |
sarve hi vāhīkadeśasthāḥ yavācameva bhuñjate |
prayogasya yavācopabhogasya sarveṣu pūrvavatvāt pūrvasiddhatvāt |
arthasya avibhaktatvāt prayogasya ca pūrvavatvāt abhidhāneṣu tathā syāt |
prakṛte tu karmaṇaḥ prayājādyasya śabdabhāvyatvāt śraute- naiva śabdena vidheyatvāt vibhāgāt apūrvāṇāṃ vibhaktatvena jñānāt śeṣāṇāṃ prakṛteraṅgānāṃ anyatra vikṛtiṣu sauryādiṣu apravṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttirna syāt |
tasmān sarve dharmāḥ sarvārthāḥ |
kiṃtu yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā |
kutūhale tu-- abhidhāneṣu vāhīko'yaṃ ityādyupa- deśeṣu arthasya yavācamapyatvasya avibhāgāt sādhāraṇyāt tathā syāt vāhīkāntare'pi yavācapariveṣaṇaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? prayogasya vāhīko'yaṃ ityādiprayogasya pūrvava- tvāt yavācapriyatāvādhāraṇapūrvavatvāt |

pūrvavatvāt |

arthasya śabdabhāvyatvāt pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca nibandhanācchabdādevānyatra bhāvaḥ syāt |
prayājādayo dharmāḥ kiṃ apūrvaprayuktāḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoreva vidhīyante athavā sarve dharmāḥ vikṛtiṣvapi vidhīyante iti vicāre sarvaṃ sarvārthāḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ nirasya apūrvaprayuktāḥ yathāprakaraṇaṃ vyavasthā iti sādhitaṃ siddhāntaṃ nigamayati |
arthasya dharmajātasya śabdabhāvyatvāt śabdekapramāṇatvāt pratiprakaraṇaṃ ca prakaraṇe prakaraṇe tatprakaraṇe nibandhanāt vyavasthā syāt ye dharmā yasmin prakaraṇe vihitāḥ te tatraiva syuirarthaḥ |
nanu tarhi sauryādau prayājādayo na syuḥ iti cet, satrāda- śabdāt 'prakṛtitvat vikṛtiḥ kartavyā' iti codakaśabdāt anyatra sauryādāvapi vikṛtiyāge bhāvaḥ syāt vidhānāta syāt anujñeyā syāt |
kiṃca śabdāt 'eteṣāṃ rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti' 'amyatānān juhoti' iti vidhānāt anyatra vivādādapi bhāvaḥ syāt |
śabdadeva anyatra bhāvaḥ syāt vinā tu viśeṣavacanaṃ anyatra bhāvo naiva syāt |

ityukteḥ |
cotakatvapaḍe'pi colasya tadanyātuvidhānāt tayoḥ vācakatvarūpaneva iti na śrutilāvighātaḥ padasyaiva prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ ananvi- tayoramidhānapaḍe'pi viniyojakaśrutitvāt |
viniyojakanī śrutiṣu aṣṭadhā - 1 vidhiśrutiḥ, 2 parasmaipadaśrutiḥ, 3 ātmanepadaśrutiḥ, 4 subantavibha- ntyāyapadarūpā vā upaśleṣalakṣaṇā iti gīyate, 5 ekapratyayatvā, 6 kārakavibhaktiḥ, 7 upapadavibhaktiśca tādarthyacaturthī, 8 śeṣaṣaṣṭhī ceti ||
tatra vidhiśruti- yathā - 'yajeta' ityādī sā svaviṣayabhūtāṃ bhāvanāṃ apuruṣārthaṃ yāgamapekṣya puruṣārtharūpe svargādau bhāvye viniyuṅkte ||

'caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi' iti coditā 'puruṣa- mṛgaścandramase godhākālakadāryāghātāste vanaspatinām' ityādiḥ saṃpradāne ṣaṣṭhī ||

siddhāntaḥ |
ke. tena tāsāṃ dvidhupadādivikṛtau samasta vacanaṃ
candodaye sati abhyudayeṣṭiḥ prāyaścittam, jyotiṣṭomasya ekādaśo dīkṣāḥ, dvādaśāhasya dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ, ityādi nirūpitam |
ṣaṣṭhe- satrādhikāriṇastulyakalpa eva, satraṃ viprasyaiva, ityevamādikaṃ cintitam |
saptame- pitrādikaṃ na-deyam, mahābhūmirna deyā, ityevamādirvicāraḥ |
aṣṭame- laukikopa nayanahomaḥ, ṣaṣṭhīṣṭistathaiva, ityevamāyavicāraḥ kṛtaḥ |
vi. prastāvanāślokaḥ 18. ṣaṣṭhādhyāyārthanirūpaṇam |
'tadevaṃ pañcalakṣaṇyā kāryavarge nirūpite |
ko'nenādhikriyateti ṣaṣṭhe- 'dhyāye nirūpyate |
nirūpite hyanuṣṭheye śakyaṃ śaktinirūpaṇam |
tasyāṃ nirūpitāyāṃ tu tadadhīnā- 'dhikāradhīḥ |
na hyanavagate'nuṣṭheye tacchākti- raśakyaṃ śakyā |
tathā cādhikāranirūpaṇamiti bhavatya- nuṣṭheyapratipādakasyādhyāyasyakathañcidvicārahetutvam |
na-caitasminnadhyāyesya hetutvam |
tatsaṃghātasyāpyekakārya- pratipādakasya pūrvaṣaṭkasyeva uttaraṣaṭkaṃ prati tadupatteḥ |
ekasyādhyāyasya nānārthasaṃghātatātmakasya ekakāryatvadhā- nādevaikatvam |
tadadhyāyādyapyanuṣṭheyapratipādanā- daikyamāpāditasya adhikārahetutvamupapannam |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvadupoddhātatvenādhikārasadbhāvaḥ pratipādyate |
sati hi tasmin kasyāyamiti vicāraḥ saṃbhavati nānyatheti |
tatra 'svargakāmo yajeta' iti bhāvanā bhāvyākāṅkṣiṇī samānapadāpādanalakṣaṇayā śrutyopasarjanaṃ ca dhātvarthameva padāntaropanītapuruṣaviśeṣatvapragrahaṇena bhāvyatvena svīkaroti śrutervākyādyalī yastvāt svargādi- dravyeṇa yāgaṃ kuryāditi vākyārthaḥ |
kāmaśabdaśca karma kurvāṇasya |
tataścādhane tasiddhayarthaṃ kāmanā bhavatyeva itya- nuvāda iti śrutilakṣyāyāṃ vākyārthena yāgasya pradhāna- tyāgaḥ kiñcidena phalaṃ sādhyate iti nāstyevādhikāra ityuktvā vidhibhutibalena siddhāntaḥ kathitaḥ |
vidhirhi samānapadātpasāttvārthādvabhāvanāyāḥ saṃkṣipyaḥ prathamameva tāmavacchidya puruṣārthāya nayati pravartanātmakatvātpuruṣā- rthatvaṃ ca vyāpāre puruṣasya pravartitumaśakyatvāttena pravartanātmakatvenaiva samīhitarūpe bhāvaye apekṣite tadviśeṣamātraṃ vākyādavagamyate, tasmin śrāvagate samāna- padopātta dhātvarthaḥ pratyāsatteḥ karaṇatayā svīkriyate dravyādi sthitikartavyatayā |
āha- 'vidhermāva- nayā yogaḥ pūrvaṃ yathaṃśasaṃgateḥ |
paścātsaṃbadhyamā- nānāṃ tato na syādvidheyatā |
atha sarvāṃśasaṃpūrṇā bhāvanā vidhigocaraḥ |
vidhihīnā tato na syātpuruṣārthaphalā kriyā |
yadi tāvadaṃśatrayavattvātprāyoga kevala māvanā vidhīyate tato viśiṣṭabhāvanāvidhvyanavidhimānānāṃ paścāt bhāvanā'- nvaye satyapi kevalāyā eva vidhisaṃsparśācca vidheyatvaṃ syāt |
aya tu nāśaṃmanyatvātprāk bhāvanāyā vidhya- nvayaḥ, tato vidhicchidrā satī dhātvarthameva pratyāsatterbhāvya- mavalambate iti na puruṣārthasya bhāvyatvaṃ sidhyediti |
naitadevam |
'vidhibhāvanayoḥ śrutyā saṃgatiḥ pūrva- mīyate |
ayogyatvāttadā teṣāṃ nirvṛtti naiva vindati |
saṃgatipratipatteśca tadaivaṃvaṃ pratīyate |
yāhaśaiḥ paripūrṇaye bhāvanā vidhisaṃgatim |
labhate tādṛśaiḥ pūraṇīyate tadvadevat |
puruṣārthasya bhāvyatvamanāṃ ca vidheyatā |
prathamaṃ tāvadekaśabdavācyoḥ vidhibhāvanayoḥ śrutyā saṃbandho'midhīyate tasyāṃ vyavasthāyāṃ bhāvanāyāḥ kevalāyā ananuṣṭheyatvāt pratītā'pi saṃgatirnaiva niṣpadyate |
aniṣpannāyāmapi ca tasyāṃ tatpratipattyā tadaivaṃ puruṣo nirūpayati asyāstā vadvidhyanvayena bhavitavyam |
tato yāhagirmaraṃśaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ vidhyanvayaṃ bhajate tādṛbhiḥ pūra- yitavyā |
na cāpuruṣārthaphalā tadanyamarhati, tasmāt puruṣārthaphalatvavyavasāya tadviśeṣamapekṣamāṇaḥ samānapadasthaṃ dhātvarthamapuruṣārthatvādduṣpya padāntarottamapekṣate |
tatra svargakāmādiśabdena tadviśeṣasya pratipattestena saha bhāvanā saṃgacchate, tadanvitā ca karaṇapekṣā satī pratyāsatti- vaśādvākyārthādhikaraṇanyāyena samānapadopāttaṃ dhātvarthaṃ karaṇa- tayā svīkaroti, tataḥ kathaṃbhāvāpekṣayāṃ śrutyāvagatā- nyajñānītyarthabhāvena gṛhṇāti tataḥ sarvośaviśiṣṭā bhāvanā vidhīyate |
tadaiva prathamameva vidhyanvayapratītiḥ |
puruṣārthasya bhāvyatvaṃ sidhyati |
pratītyāpi ca vidhyanvayasyānāya-
saṃbhyottarakālameva nirvṛtteraśānānāmapi vidheyatvaṃ sidhyati |
ato na kaściddoṣa iti |
prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ |
tadevaṃ vidhivalena puruṣārthasya bhāvyatve'vadhārite tadviśeṣatāpekṣayā kāmasaṃbandhavagata- prādhānyasya svargādirbhāvyatvaṃ puruṣopasarjanatayā bhavati na pūrvapakṣa iva sādhanatvam |
na hi pūrvapakṣe'pi svarga- kāmaśabdaḥ puruṣaparaḥ kintu svargo'sya dravyasya kriyā- sādhanatvapratipattiparaḥ |
kathaṃ punaḥ puruṣavacanaśabdasya ubhābhyāmpi vādiprativādibhyāṃ tatparatvamavadhāryate ? ucyate |
pūrvapakṣavādī tāvadevaṃ manyate kriyāsāmyadyeva tāvattu guṇabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ |
prāta tatra svargakāmaśabdena na kaścitpuruṣaviśeṣo rājaśabdeneva vrīhyādiśabdeneva vā dravyaviśeṣaḥ samarpyate ya eva hi svargakāmaḥ sa evā- svargakāmo'pi bhavati |
yadā taskāma iti kālepakṣa- ṇatve vā sa eva doṣaḥ |
tasmānna svargakāmanāviśiṣṭasya puruṣasyātra śeṣatvenānvayaḥ |
tatra viśeṣyāṃśasya prāpta- tvādviśeṣaṇaparatvaṃ lehitoṣṇīṣādikavaditi |
tatrāpi svarga- kāmanāyāḥ śeṣatvenopadeśe ahaṣṭārthatā syāt |
na hi svargakāmanāyāḥ karmaṇi dṛṣṭopakāraḥ saṃbhavati |
gauravaṃ ca svargaviśiṣṭasya kāmasya aṅgatvopadeśe vidheḥ syāt |
svargasya tu dravyarūpasya karmatādhanatvena dṛṣṭārthatvāt- nmātrasya cākṣatvavidhāne lāghavāt drayopadeśa evāyam |
kartṛvacanastvaṇapratyayaḥ saha kāmayatinā'nuvāda iti |
siddhāntastu vidhivalenaiva vyāpārasya bhāvanāyāḥ puruṣā- rthatvamavagamyate na hyanyai karmaṇi kaścitśeṣābhāva- pravartate |
tādarthyaṃ ca tadapekṣitāpakārasādhanatvāt |
tena vicita evāpekṣitāpakārasādhanatvena puruṣārthatve bhāva- nāyāḥ samadhigate satyupakāraviśeṣatāpekṣayā svargakāma- śabdena pūrvoktanyāyācāritānupapannapuruṣaviśeṣaprati- pādakamāvena viśiṣṭatvāpekṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya śeṣatvama- bhidhīyamānaṃ viśeṣaṇabhūtasvargādyopakāraviśeṣapratipattiparaṃ bhavati |
tata eva svargakāmaśabdaḥ pakṣyade'pi na puruṣa- paraḥ |
kintu svargaparaḥ |
guṇapradhānabhāve tu vivādaḥ |
ata evoktaṃ hi svargo guṇataḥ karma pradhānataḥ uta karma guṇataḥ svargaḥ pradhānataḥ iti |
kimidānīṃ śeṣitvena phalakāma- syānvayaḥ |
vāḍham |
kathaṃ tarhi 'rājā rājasūyena svarājyakāmo yajeta' ityādiṣu rājādiśabdena śeṣa- pratipādakena kāmaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam |
ucyate |
ubhayorāpi kartṛparatvāt |
kartṛtvena hi rāja iva phalakāma- syānvayaḥ samastyeva |
sa tvanvayaḥ karmaṇā puruṣasyopa- kāraḥ kathaṃ bhavatītyevamarthaḥ |
'malinena snātavyam' 'kṣudhitenāśitavyam' itivat |
yatra hi tṛtīyāśrutyā vispaṣṭe'pi kartṛtve abhihite śeṣitvameva malināde- rbhavati tatra svargakāmādeḥ phalasabhamidhyāhārakalpyakartṛttvasya na bhavatīti kuta etat |
na khalu kartṛtvānvayaḥ śeṣi- māvasya paripanthī |
sarvakārakāṇāṃ śeṣitvasaṃbhavaḥ prayāja- śeṣādīnāṃ prāgeva darśito yataḥ |
yadyevaṃ kathaṃ tarhi dvitīyā śeṣivibhaktiḥ |
tṛtīyādyastu śeṣavibhaktaya iti viśeṣasiddhiḥ |
ucyate |
sādhyasādhanabhāvapratipāda- nādupapanno viśeṣaḥ |
dvitīyā hi sādhyabhāvaṃ pratipāda- yati sādhyatvaṃ ca śeṣitvapratyāsannam |
na hyasādhyasya śeṣitvaṃ saṃbhavati tena tadimadhinā dvitīyā tadava- gatirbhavati |
tṛtīyādyastu śeṣabhāvamātrasyānavatvā- bhidhānāttatpramāṇatocyante yatra tu tatpratipāditasādhana- bhāvasyaiva śeṣitvaṃ bhavati tatra sādhyatvamandābhihitamapi kalpayitavyamiti viśeṣasiddhiḥ |
tena kartṛtvānvayoḥ rājasvarājyākāmayorvidhivalena svarājyakāmasya śeṣitvaṃ rāśastu dravyakarmasaṃyoganyāyena sādhanatvānuguṇyātccheṣa- tvameva bhavati |
yo'pi kaiścinniyojyatvenānvayaḥ phala- kāmasyete so'pi vivicyamānaḥ śeṣitvānvaya eva yathokto bhavati |
itarathā tu kartṛtvānvayāviśeṣāt |
tathāhi- 'niyojyo nāma yaḥ kāryātmīyatvena juṣyate |
tadīyatatvaṃ ca kāryasya tatkṛtitvavyāpyatā- tmakam |
yatkṛtvā vyāpyate yacca dhruvaṃ tatkartṛkaṃ hi tat |
tatkartṛtvaniyojyatve śeṣa- śeṣitvakārite |
svargakāmasya kartṛtvānvayaṃ pūrvapakṣīyaṃ niyojyatvenānvayaḥ |
siddhāntikriyate iti yasya darśanaṃ so'pi śeṣaśeṣābhāvavyatirekeṇānvayasya medaṃ vaktuṃ na kṣamate |
tathāhi |
yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ |
tataśca 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityanena
svargakāmasyedaṃ kāryamiti pratipādayitavyam |
svargakāma- kṛtityāpyamimyarthaḥ |
tathā hi satyasau 'mamedaṃ kāryam' iti budhyate yacca yasya kṛtyā vyāpyate tattatkartṛtvameva yathā māvārthaḥ |
tasmāt rājasrarājakāmayoḥ kartṛtvenā- nyāyāt svārājakāmasya niyojyatvaṃ rājastu kartṛtva- mityayaṃ viśeṣa evaṃ samarthayitavyaḥ |
kartṛtve'pi svārājakāmasya śeṣitvaṃ kārya prati rājastu śeṣatvamiti |
, nanu - boddhṛtvena niyojyatvaṃ na śeṣitvena kimidānīṃ kāmaśabdaḥ kāminaḥ kārya viṣayāvacchinnaṃ prati boddhṛtva- mabhidhatte kathaṃkāmamīdṛkṃ yāgāvacchinnaṃ kāryamiti |
yadyevaṃ boddhṛtvatareṇa kāminaḥ kāvyābhāvājjñeyate'nena yo'rtho'bhimitastameva kevalaṃ budhyeta kāryamediti na tu mamedaṃ kāryamiti mamaśabdābhidheyasya saṃbandhasya niyogena sahāramanaḥ kasyacidapyabhāvāt |
tattraśāniyojyatvameva |
na hi yaḥ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ kiṃtu yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate |
na ca pravṛttiḥ sidhyet |
na hi kāryamityeva kaścit pravartate api tarhi mamedaṃ kārya- miti |
anarthakaśca niyojyapratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ syāt antareṇāpi tacchuddhātmāyātāye vyutpannaḥ svargakāmo budhyata eva |
tatra parisaṃkhyā syāt |
svargakāma eva vyutpanno budhyeta nānya iti sā cāśaṅkā parihartavyā- māne'pi vyutpannānāṃ boddhṛtvalakṣaṇaniyojyasadbhāvācca tadvyāhāraḥ syāt |
tasmāt svargakāmasya mamedaṃ kārya- miti evaṃvidhaboddhṛtvalakṣaṇaniyojyamicchātā''vaśyama- styedaṃ kāryamevemavacanena pratipādayitavyamiti vakta- vyam |
tathā ca kartṛtvenānyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
yattutye satya- mayamevānyaḥ |
tathā'pi tu na kartṛtvaniyojyatvasaṃkaraḥ |
viṣayabhedātkartṛtvaṃ hi bhāvārthe niyoge ca niyojyatva- miti |
'tadyuktaṃ na bhāvārthavyatirekeṇa kiṃcana |
kārya prasiddhamapyāpi niyojyatve sthite hi tat ||
etadadhikaraṇasiddha eva hi niyojyānvayaḥ kriyātiriktākāryābhidhānakalpājīyam |
ataḥ prāk na tattviddhiriti na viṣayamedāsaṃkaraḥ śakyate'bhi- dhātum |
loke ca tadabhāvāt 'devadatta gāmānaya' ityādiṣu saṃboṣanavibhaktisannadave'pi niyojyatvaṃ na syāt |
tasmāt kārye prati śeṣitvameva niyojyatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva vācyam |
yastu brūte- 'śeṣaśeṣitvabhedena satyaṃ karturniyojyate |
kṛti prati tvasya bhedaḥ kārye tu guṇatā dvayoḥ ||
yadyapi kartṛtvāniyojyatvayoḥ śeṣaśeṣitvamedādeva miśeṣastathā'pi na niyogaṃ prati niyojyasya śeṣitā, tasya sarvapradhānatvāt |
yathā''ha 'niyogasiddhī sarve tadanuguṇamiti kena neṣyate' iti |
kiṃ tarhi kṛti prati śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvam |
tāṃ ca prati śeṣatvaṃ kartṛtva- miti tenātmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kāryaṃ budhyamāno''pi niyojya ityucyate na tu kāryamevāryārtha tena 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityasya ko'rthaḥ ? yāgāvacchinnaṃ svargakāmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ |
tena kārye pratyubhayoḥ kartṛniyojyayoḥ śeṣatve satyeva kṛti prati śeṣaśeṣibhāvadaśaṃkara iti |
so'pi dvayaiva kriyati, tathāhi - 'kṛtirhi kārya- śeṣatvānyānyaśeṣatvamaśnute |
kārya taccheṣabhūte '- syāstadvāreṇa bhavedidam ||
na khalu niyogaśeṣabhūtā abhidhānata evāvagamyamānā kṛtiḥ puruṣaśeṣabhāvamanubhavitumarhati |
anyathaivānyārthatā'- navakalpanāt |
yadi tu tarkārya puruṣaśeṣo bhavet tat- sāṭadvāreṇa kṛterapi saṃskārāṇāmiva kāryadvāreṇa puruṣaśeṣatā puruṣaśeṣatvaṃ bhavedanyathā |
nanvasyapi niyogasya puruṣa- śeṣatve phalasya taccheṣattvātsyāpi tathaiva kṛtyā vyāpya- tvātdvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhaviṣyatīti |
kā vārtā naimittikaniṣedhādhikārayoḥ |
na hi tatra phalāntara- masti yadvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhavet |
asti ca tatrāpi nimittatvānniṣedhanimittakriyāprapañca niyojyaḥ sa kathamātmārthakṛtityāpyaṃ kārye jānīyāt |
tasmāt niyogapuruṣasyāpi kāryasya puruṣārthatvamavaśyamabhyupeyam |
yuktaṃ caitat |
na hyasvārthaṃ kaścidapi kāryamitya- gantumarhati |
yadi naivaṃ phalasyāpi tarhi na puruṣārthatā sidhyet, tasyāpi hi mamedaṃ kāryamityetādṛśeyamevāvati |
tasmātkāmenāpi kāryameva prati puruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvaṃ śeṣatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva viveko bhavitavyaḥ |
evaṃ ca saṃboṣanavibhaktiniyojye pramāṇamityayuktam |
'amīdagnīn vihara' ityādiṣu amīdādīnāṃ kṛti kāryaṃ vā prati śeṣibhāvādoṣiṇaścāniyojyatvāt |
āha- 'vidhyarthe kāryarūpe syāccheṣitvena niyojyatā |
pravartanātmakatve tu pravartatyasya niyojyatā ||
pravartanāso'hamidaṃ kuryāmityevaṃvidhānaḥ saṃkalpa- mūlatvāmā vidhiriti bhavārtha siddhāntaḥ |
sa ca pravarta mābhyamivāpekṣate pravartakaśca niyojyaḥ; tatra svargakāmaśabdaḥ kiṃ bhāvanāpekṣitaṃ bhāvyaṃ samarpayet āhosvitdvidhyepekṣitaṃ niyojyaṃ ubhayaparatvānupapatterva- pyāpātādanyatareṇa anyatarasiddheḥ |
na hi svargaphale karma- pyatadarthī niyojyaḥ saṃbhavatīti phalena niyojyasiddhiḥ |
svargakāmasya cānyaphale karmaṇi niyojyasyāyogyā- yojyaviśeṣaphalasiddhiḥ |
tatra svargakāmaśabdasya puruṣa- vacanatvācciyojyataiva yukteti |
ucyate |
'vidherape- kṣitaḥ satyaṃ niyojyo na tvasau tadā |
avadhāra- yituṃ śakyaḥ phalasya tvarita yogyatā ||
yadyapi phalavanniyojyo'pekṣitaḥ tathā'pi nāsānuṣṭheya- vargārdhārṇāt prāgavadhārayituṃ śakyate |
na hi phala- kāmamātrasya niyojyatvam |
kasya tarhi anuṣṭhānaśakti- yuktasya |
sā cānuṣṭheyāvagamādhīnanirūpaṇā |
agrapradhāna- yuktaiva ca kriyā anuṣṭheyā tasyāśca tathā vidhirasaṃbha- saṃbandhottarakālameva bhavati na prathamaṃ ayogyatāt tathā niyojyo'pi |
phalaṃ tu prāgevābhyantarasaṃbandhāt avagantuṃ śakyate iti tatparamevedam |
avagate ca tasmiṃścāṃśāntare cāvadhārite sarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ tatphalakāmaṃ tadanuṣṭhānasamarthaṃ puruṣaṃ vidadhadvidhiniyukte |
āha ca 'aṅgapradhānavatyāṃ ca bhāvanāyāṃ yugapatpuruṣaniyogaḥ' iti |
kiṃca niyojyānyeṣe'pi na puruṣaparatvaṃ kāma- śabdasya kiṃtu phalaviśeṣaparatvameva |
tathā hi vidhita evāvagamyate asti hi kaścididaṃ vyāpāre niyojyaḥ sa cāsau yogyasya śeṣī na hyasvārthaṃ vyāpāre kaścicciyoktuṃ śakyate sa eva śeṣī yo'sya bhāvyaṃ phalaviśeṣaṃ bhoktumabhilaṣatītyevamavagate phalaviśeṣamātre cānatatvameva svargakāmaśabdasya bhavati |
tatra mī. ko. 502
kiṃ niyojyatvena svārthamabhidadhattparaḥ uta śeṣitvena iti cintāyāmaśakyāvagamananiyojyaparityāgena śakya- pratipattiśeṣitvapratipādanameva varam |

tat padaṃ ca yathā ākhyātakṛtpātāddhitādi, tathā ghañanto dhāturapi iti yuktaḥ |

ata eva ' brāhmaṇasya kurvan, narakasya jiṣṇuḥ, chātrasya hasitam ' ityādiprayogā api saṃga- cchante |
evaṃ ' akenorabhiviṣyādarthayoḥ ' ( pā0 2|3| 70 ) iti sūtrāt bhaviṣya-akasya bhaviṣyadāha- myartha-inśa yoge ṣaṣṭhī na syāt ityarthakāt ' eghānāharako vrajati, vrajaṃ gāmī, śataṃ dāyī ' ityādi dvitīyaiva na ṣaṣṭhī |
atra bhaviṣyatkālavihita-akasyaiva grahaṇāt na kālasāmānyāvihita-ake ' odanasya pācakaḥ ' ityādau dvitīyā |
atra ca vyākhyānavaśāt na yathāsaṃkhyaṃ anvayaḥ |
apitu akasya bhaviṣyatyeva, inastu ubhayoḥ |
tena gāmī iti bhaviṣyati iniḥ, dāyī ityayaṃ ādhamarṇye ṇiniḥ |
evaṃ ' kṛtyānāṃ karttari vā ' ( pā0 2|3|71 ) iti sūtre bhāṣyakāreṇa yogavibhāgakaraṇāt kṛtyānāṃ ityasya bhinnasūtratvapratīteḥ tatra ca ubhayaprāptau na iti pūrvasūtra- sthapadadvayānukarṣaṇān ubhayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇoḥ anabhidhāna- prayuktaṅasīprasaktau ' kṛtyānāṃ yoge ṣaṣṭhī na ' ityarthakāt ' netavyā vrajaṃ gāvaḥ kṛṣṇena ' ityatra na ṣaṣṭhī, apitu dvitīyā tṛtīyā ca |
atra hi nayetadikkarmakatvāt mukhya- karmaṇaḥ kṛtyenābhidhānāt goṣu prathamā |

evaṃ ' caturthī cāśiṣyāyuṣyabhadrabhadrakuśalasukhārtha- hitaiḥ ' ( pā0 2|3|73 ) iti sūtrāt āyuṣyādyarthaka- śabdayoge āśiṣi śeṣe caturthī syāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt ityarthakāt ' āyuṣyādi ase bhūyāt ' iti caturthī pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī |

na ca ' hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā ' iti vārtikadeva tatsiddheḥ hitagrahaṇavaiyarthyam |

sa ca 'ṣoḍa- śinā vīryakāmaḥ' iti puruṣārthatayā vihito'pi punaḥ kratvarthatayā śrūyate 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhyayāt, apyukthye āghāḥ, atirātre brāhmaṇasya, uttare'hani dvirātrasya gṛhyate, caturthe'han- hīnasya gṛhyate' iti |
tatra kratvarthaṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ prati
saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ prakṛtau syāt uta vikṛtiṣveva utkṛṣṭavya iti |
'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate' ityādibacanaiḥ vikṛtisaṃbandhavācamāt 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya' ityādi- vacanasya ca vaikṛtāgniṣṭomābhiprāyatvenāpi aciredhāta prakaraṇe bādhitvā vākyena utkarṣe prāpte, brūmaḥ, prakṛti- karaṇāmmātaiḥ agniṣṭomādiśabdaiḥ tatraiva saṃbhavadbhiḥ kimiti asaṃnihitā'pi vikṛtiramidhīyate |
tasmāt vākyenaiva prakṛtau syāt |
tatra rājanyadinimittena vihitaḥ sa vikṛtiṣu anaimittiko vidhīyate 'uttare'han dvirāmasya' iti |
soma--triramyasyeva ṣoḍaśino na prakṛtivikṛti- saṃbandhaḥ, kiṃtu vikṛtimātrasaṃbandhaḥ ityutthiteḥ saṃgati- rityāhuḥ |
bādhaprasaṅgāt prakṛtisaṃbandhaḥ ṣoḍaśino bādhyate na iti cintyate ityākhyasaṃgatiḥ |
vi--'vikṛtau prakṛtau vā syāt, porasyukarṣato- 'gnimaḥ |
, aviruddhena vākyenānutkarṣāt prakṛtāvasau |
' bhāṭṭa--jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe samāptaḥ ṣoḍaśī jyotiṣṭomāt uta neti cintāṃyāṃ 'ṣoḍaśinā vīrya- kāmaḥ stuvīta' ityanena tasya puruṣārthatvāvagamena godonādivat prakaraṇatvāt na jyotiṣṭomāṅga- tvam |
na ca 'agniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt' iti vacanena saṃyogapṛthaktvanyāyena prakṛtyarthatā iti vācyam |
tasya 'uttare'han dvirāmasya gṛhyate, madhyame'han trirāmasya, caturthe'han ahīnasya' ityādivikṛtiprāṭhena vaikṛtāgniṣṭomābhiprāyatvāt |
vastutastu, agniṣṭomādipadānāṃ saṃkhyāvacchittatvāpa- nāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyāṃ prakṛtau vikṛtau vā ṣoḍaśi- saṃsthāyā niveśāyogena vidhātumaśakteḥ : dvirāmrādicce ayamevārthavāda eva |
yatra saṃsthāntareṣvapi ṣaṣṭho ayaṃ pūrvasaṃsthāyādhena grahītumucitaḥ, tatra kimu vaktavyaṃ viruddha- saṃsthāntarehitadvirāmrādau iti stuteḥ |
ataḥ prakṛtyantā- grāhakapramāṇābhāvāt na prakṛtyastvam |
iti prāpte, ṣoḍaśyādiśabdāstāvat anekeṣu prajyamānā api saṃkhyāmeva śaktāḥ |
tadat jyotiṣṭome niruḍalakṣaṇyā tadati ṛtvantare sāṃpratikalakṣaṇayā aṇe stotre ca tathaivetyādi saṃkhyādhikaraṇe kaustubhe ca dvitīye kṣuṇṇam |
tadiha 'ya evaṃ vidvān ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityatra bhāṣyakārādilikhanāt saṃsthaiva grahaṇaviśiṣṭā vidhīyate |
ṣoḍaśiśabdena nāgṛhītāviśeṣaṇatvena saṃkhyāvacanenāpi tadviśiṣṭakratoḥ upasthāpanena grahaṇena saṃkhyāvantaṃ kratuṃ kuryāt iti vākyārthapratīteḥ |
jāyate hi yāgābhyāsa- sādhanībhūtadravyasaṃskāradvārā grahaṇenāpi saṃkhyā |
ataśca tatra grahaṇaviśiṣṭasaṃsthocyate virupyate |
ṣoḍaśi- śabdasya grahaṇamātraparatvamaṅgīkṛtya tanmātraviśiṣṭu lakṣaṇā- ''pattereva ayuktaḥ |
ata eva upanayāḥ saṃsthāyā evaṃ vīryārthatvena vidhiḥ na tu stotrasya |
tasya 'eka- viṃśaṃ (stotraṃ) bhavati pratiṣṭhittye' iti vacanaprāptasya sādhutvārthamanuvādāt |
ata eva stotraṃ grahaṇaṃ ca saṃkhyā- saṃpādakatvā vākyācca tadaṅgameva, na tu jyotiṣṭomāṅgaṃ ityapyavivādameva |
ataśca saṃsthāyāḥ phalārthatvāt yadyapi prakaraṇaṃ 'catasraḥ somasaṃsthāḥ' ityādibacanaṃ ca nāṅga- tābodhanakṣamaṃ āśrayalatvenaivopapatteḥ |
tathāpi 'apyagniṣṭome rājanyasya gṛhṇīyāt, apyukthye, atirātre brāhmaṇasya gṛhṇīyāt' ityādibacanaiḥ saṃyoga- pṛthaktvanyāyena jyotiṣṭomāṅgastvasyāpyupapatteḥ |
na hi etāni arthavādarūpāṇi, liṅgaśravaṇāt vinigamanā- virahācca |
rājanyadipadasya stutau anupayuktatvācca |
etadvākyārthastu agre nirūpayiṣyate, nirūpitaḥ kaustubhe api |
naimittikapratiprasavavidhitvācca eteṣāṃ vikṛti- prāyapāṭhe'pi arkicitkaraḥ |
astu vā vidvadvākyena saṃkhyāṣṭyā grahaṇāmātrāvidhiḥ; tathāpi uktavākyenaiva saṃkhyāyā vīryāṅgatve siddhe niruktavākyenaiva tasyāḥ prakṛtyaṣṭā, saṃsthārūpaṃ tu grahaṇādividhito yājñika- prasiddhisiddhaṃ iti na kaścit virodhaḥ |
ataḥ siddhaṃ naimittikamidaṃ prakṛtyaṅgam |
tena ca nityasaṃsthāyāḥ prakṛtau rājanyasya bādhaḥ iti bādhopayogitā'pi |
na caivaṃ kāsucit vikṛtiṣu tataḥ punaḥ śravaṇaṃ anarthakamiti vācyam, anaimittikatvādyarthatvasya prayojanatvena vakṣya- māṇatvāt |

ādhānamātrasaṃskṛteṣu agniṣu agnihotrādīni niya- tāni karmāṇi aindrāgnādīni ca aniyatāni karmāṇi pravartan |

yathā 'āhitāgniḥ na klinaṃ dāru abhyādadhyāt ' ityādīni āhitāgneḥ vratāni āhitāgnereva bhavanti tadvat |

saṃskṛteṣu pavamāneṣṭibhiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu karmāṇi agnihotrā- dīni aindrāgnādīni ca pravartan |
kutaḥ ? saṃskārāṇāṃ pavamāneṣṭyādīnāṃ tadarthatvāt anyarthatvāt karmārthatvāt |
āhavanīyādiṣu siddheṣu karmāṇi bhavanti, āhavanīyā- disiddhiśca āghānena pavamāneṣṭibhiśca |

anantaraṃ vrataṃ tadbhūtatvāt |

pavamāneṣṭibhiḥ saṃskṛteṣu agniṣu agnihotrādīni karmāṇi na pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ pūrvaṃ iti siddhānte ukte pūrvapakṣamāha |
cakāro dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ |
yathā pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ parastāt karmāṇi pūrvamapi pavamāneṣṭibhyaḥ syuḥ |
'agniṃ vai suṣṭuṃ agnihotreṇānudravanti ' iti āhita- mātreṣu agniṣu agnihotraṃ darśayati |

arthavādo vā'rthasya vidyamānatvāt |
āghānānantaraṃ saṃvatsarottaraṃ vā dvādaśadinottaraṃ vā ādhānāṅgabhūtāḥ pavamāneṣṭayaḥ kartavyāḥ |
antarāle ca tūṣṇīṃhomarūpā agnihotrādyoḥ kartavyā bhavanti |

yadi hi vākyavaśena kiṃcitkaraṇanāthāṃ saṃsthābhiḥ saṃbadhyate tataḥ kimasaṃyuktsaṃbaṃdhenāpi yuktaṃ bhavitum |
na hi 'dvādaśāhinasya' ityādiṣu śeṣadharmāṇāmapyanyatva- māṃsādikṛtam |
yāvadvacanaṃ kṣayitvāddhacanānāmidayevaṃ vyācaṣṭe |
yadi hi sāmānyavihitamagniṣṭomasaṃsthasyaiva syāddinā'pi tadupādānena tadaṅgatvāsiddheḥ |
nātrāgniṣṭomaṃ saṃkīrtayet |
yatastu saṃkīrtayatastato nūnamavi- śeṣitamagniṣṭomasya na labhyate |
taccaiva na labhyate yadi saṃsthānāmapi sādhāraṇaṃ prakaraṇam |
kevalajyotiṣṭoma- prakaraṇasthe tu punaḥ śrutirnārthikā syāt |
tathokthyā- dīnāmapi yadi prakaraṇamasti tato'nyataranirdhāraṇārya yadidaśopabaṃdha grahaṇaṃ yuktam |
aprakṛtatve tu 'dvāda- śāhinasya' itivadiśenaiva saṃbadhaḥ syāt |
na hi jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe sthitasyaiva vādo yujyate |
yadi jyotiṣṭomastat etat |
yadi dvādaśāhasto''muka- miti |
anekasaṃhitāteṣveva hyetadacanaṃ bhavati |
ato'pi samānaṃ prakaraṇam |
idamaparaṃ liṅgam 'āgneyamagniṣṭoma ālabheta' 'aindrāgnamukthye dvitīyam' 'aindraṃ vṛṣṇi boḍaśini tṛtīyam' iti |
samānavidhānatve pūrva- pūrvataradarśanamupapadyate |
cikāpakṣe tu pratyakṣaśrairendrā- gnādimireme bādhyate sarvatraiva syāt |
nanu ca pratyakṣaśrutatve'pi saṃsthāntare saṃsthānāṃ saṃbhavāñji- nimittaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvo na prāpnoti |
yo agniṣṭomastotre samāpyate so'gniṣṭomo na tanmātram (mātraśabdaḥ kātsyarthācca) |
tenokthyādisaṃsthānāmagniṣṭomastotrasye- 'pi nāgniṣṭomasaṃsthātvamiti jñeyam |
yaścokthyādiṣu samāpyate nāsau pūrvatra samāpyate |
tena dvitīya- darśanātpratyakṣaḥ pakṣadvaye'pi tulyaḥ |
satyaṃ saṃsthānāṃnimi- tattve tulyaḥ |
stotrenimittatve tu samuccayaḥ |
tathā ca
saṃsthādhikaraṇam
saṃsthādhikaraṇam
bhāṣyakāra āha— 'dve hi tatra nimitte agniṣṭomastotra- mukthyastotraṃ ca' iti siddhavedatadbravīti |
kathaṃ punaḥ saṃsthāstotrāsādhāraṇāgniṣṭomadisamyiāhāre tulye stotra- nimittamevāṅgīkriyate na saṃsthānimittatvam |
tāsāṃ hi phalavatvena prayojanavatvāddeśenaiva nimittamapyate |
tatra kecidāhuḥ |
satyapi śabdasādhāramye śāstrasya mahā- viṣayatvānmahārthatvaṃ stotranimittatvāśrayaṇamiti |
athavā stotraviśeṣitāyā eva saṃsthāyā evaṃśabdakatvāt pūrvatara- pratītaviśeṣaṇanimittatvameva jaghanyaviśeṣanimittatva- kalpanā na yuktā |
yadvā ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenaiva (13|9) stotreṣu mukhyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃsthāyāṃ lākṣaṇikaḥ |
śrutyasaṃbhave ca lakṣaṇā āśrayitavyā |
śaknoti ca stotramapi saptamīnirdeśāt nimittatvaṃ pratipadyum niṣṭhalānāmpi ca medanādīnāṃ vacanasāmarthyānnimittatva- miṣṭam |
athavā 'saṃdigdheghu vākyaśeṣāt' (1|4|23- 24) ityevaṃ stotrāśrayaṇam |
satyapi vā saṃsthānāṃ mukhyatve vyavahārakalpanāyā vākyaśeṣeṇa stotrapari- grahaḥ |
evaṃ hi śrūyate 'āgneyamagniṣṭomama ālabha- meta' 'āgneyo agniṣṭomaḥ' iti |
katarasminniṣṭome, ya āgneyaḥ |
stotrasya ca stutibhāgamidaṃ vidyate na saṃsthāyāḥ |
sā hi vyāpāraparityāgātmakatvādābha- bhūtā |
na cābhāvasya devatā kāryamasti |
yāgā- bhyāse'pi hi yā devatā sā talvevā''gneyaṃ karoti na saṃsthāyāḥ |
na ca sa eva saṃsthā |
taduttara- kālodāsīnyavacanatvātpūrvasya tiṣṭhate |
na cānyagatayā devatā''dasya vyapadeśo bhavati |
tathokthyaṣoḍaśino- rapi daśītyanyam |
api ca 'aindrāgnyukthyāni' iti sphuṭameva stotragrahaṇam |
na hi saṃsthā, ukthyānītyanena (ukthyasaṃsthayā ekākyāt bahuvacanavirodhālaceriti śeṣaḥ) śabdocyate |
tasmātsati stotranimittatve yuktaḥ samuccaya iti |
nanu vikārapakṣe'pyatharvatalyānugā- nāmantyokāryārthasaṃbhavā dupapadyata eva samuccayaḥ |
tathā- hi 'nānumānikamātraṃ yattatratyena bādhyate |
virodhe sati bādho hi virodhaikāgragocaraḥ ||
' yadi hi pratyakṣaśrutameva kevalaṃ virodhanirapekṣaṃ bādha- kāraṇa syāttato na kiṃcidvādhyate ṛtvantaragataṃ dṛṣṭārtha- madṛṣṭārthe vā tulyakalpamatulyakalpaṃ vā |
na caitadiṣṭam |
ata ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ samuccayadarśanamupapannam |
tathā ca vakṣyati 'prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogāt' (10|4|9) iti |
tathā 'prājāpatyeṣu cāmrānāt' (10|4|14|6) ityādāvevaṃjātīyakānāṃ tatra tatrāvirodhālasamuccaya vakṣyati |
tatraiva samādhimāhuḥ |
asyaiva atra prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogaḥ savanīyasakhyākhyānimittaḥ |
sarvaṃ hote savanīyayajñenoktāḥ |
tasmātsāmānyāttutyakāryatve sati, asti virodha iti prāpnoti vācyam |
yathaivam, tataḥ samānavidhānatve'pi sāmānyaviśeṣalakṣaṇabādhaprasaṅgaḥ |
pūrvapūrvo hi paśumahā- viṣayatvātsāmānyavihito bhavati |
uttara uttaro'lpā- vakāśādādiśeṣavihitaḥ |
bādhyate ca sāmānyaṃ sāvakāśaṃ vā viśeṣeṇa niravakāśena vā |
kecittu āhuḥ |
sarvāvasthasya kevalasya niravakāśatvādanyaviśeṣasatvāt bādhakaṃ bhavenmadhyamayoḥ |
satyapi vahalpaviṣayatve pramāṇagatistulyā |
yathaivamasya : saṃsthātulyatvaviṣaya- tvātsādhāraṇe bhavatyevamagniṣṭo'pi saṃsthātrayasādhāraṇaḥ |
yāvattā ca yalenāsau prāpnoti tāvattā ca pūrvo'pi |
meṣyāstu saṃsthā nimittatve'pyadoṣaḥ |
na hi tadadhikā jyotiṣṭome saṃsthā'sti |
tasmādvādha iti |
ucyate |
yadyapi na bādhastathā'pi vikalpastavāpnoti |
na hi tulyārthānāṃ kacit samuccaya dṛṣṭaḥ |
seyamubhayataḥpāśā rajjuḥ |
yadi tāvatkiṃcidapi kāryānvayaṃ samuccaya- siddhayarthamapyupapadyate tato vikārapakṣe'pi samuccayaḥ |
atha tatra bādhaṃ samarthayituṃ kāryatvaṃ kalpyate tataḥ sāmānyavicche'pi (sāmānyavidyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe'pi ityarthaḥ) vrīhiyādivādasamuccaya iti |
na caitatpūrvapakṣa- vacanamātraṃ siddhānte'pi darśanamagatyā vacanīkṛtya samuccayaṃ vakṣyati 'vacanāttu samuccayaḥ' (16|1|6 45) iti |
tadarthaṃ vakṣyau viśeṣaḥ |
sa ucyate |
'samānavipathe he sarve sarvāṅgabhāvināḥ |
tannimittavaśātprāptyā samākhyā nivartayet ||
sarve hi paśavaḥ sarvatra prāpnuvantyo yatparyupadeśāt pare na bhavanti tannimittatvāt |
pratyakṣaṃ tu nimittena
pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ patra vākyaprāpnoti |
tatra kiṃ samārūyaika- kāryatvaṃ kalpayitvā bādhavikalpayoranyatara āśrīyatāmuta vākyaprāptasamuccayānusāreṇa kāryatvaṃ kalpyatāmiti vākyavalīyastvasasamuccayena bhavitavyam |
tathā prayājā- yādādīnāṃ satyapi samākhyaikatve vākyasāmarthyāt kāryā- nyatvaṃ samuccayaśca |
atideśe punaḥ , samākhyayā kārye- katvam , atideśena kāryatvaṃ ( tenāpi samuccayaḥ ) |
tatsācopadeśāntargatā ( ‘ kalpitātideśāpekṣayā ’ iti tasmāt ityasya arthaḥ ) |
samākhyaiva balīyasīti tatkṛtaṃ kāryaikatvamāśritya virodhādvādhaḥ parihrayeta |
vikāre ca prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogeṇa vidhyate iti kāryāpattirityarthaḥ |
na tu samānavibhipake prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogaḥ kaścit , yena kāryāpattiracaryeta |
kecit āhuḥ : samānavidhitve para- sparānapekṣairdvyadevatāsaṃyogaiḥ karmabhedo'vasīyate |
vikāre punaratideśaprāptāyāgānuvādena guṇāmātraṃ vidhīyate |
tata- ścaika eva yāgaḥ syācca dvitīyasya iti |
sa tvayaṃ guṇavicchindrābhe saṃmavecchendrasarasvatyoḥ |
anekadravyadevatā- vidhānena vākyabhedaprasaṅgādekāntena karmāntaratā |
tenaivaṃ samarthanīyam , karmāntaramevedaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kimapūrvāntara- sādhanatvaṃ pratipadyatāmuta prākṛtasaṃvanīyapūrvameva sādhya- tviti |
pūrvaklaptāpūrvaviniyogāmarthe saṃbhavati nāpūrvāntara- kalpayitvā tatsādhanatvādhyavasānaṃ yuktam |
tathā'tideśa- prāptasaṃvanīyapūrvamapi sādhanāpekṣāvelāyāṃ pratyakṣasatasa- nīyaparityāgena na saṃvanīyāntaraṃ gṛhṇāti |
sarvāpekṣāsu prakṛtāsaṃbhavenāprakṛtagrahaṇāt yāgato'pi vyāpāraḥ prākṛte- naivāpūrveṇa klṛptasaṃbandho na śaknotyapūrvāntarasaṃbandhaṃ prati- patum |
kathamaklaptasāmarthyaṃ saṃvanīyantaraṃ prākṛtamapūrvaṃ sādhayatīti cet |
yathā itarasminkṣetre'pūrvāntaraṃ yāgataṃ vyāpāramityadoṣaḥ |
kassrṃhi anayoḥ viśeṣaḥ |
ucyate |
yadā yāgatvavyāpāreṇāpūrvāṇyepekṣante na tadā vaikṛtasaṃva- nīyāpūrvaṃ balavat , yattasminsaṃve nipatayet |
yadā punarapūrveṇa kamāpekṣyate tadā saṃvanīyatvaprakṛtiliṅgasaṃyukte karmāntaraṃ vidyamānamevabudha prākṛtaṃ nigrakaroti |
prakṛtau cāpūrva- kalpanāvasthāt vidhīyamānasaṃvanīyatuṣṭyātānuṣyāpūrva- catuṣṭayaṃ kalpyate |
na hi tatra jñāyate karatarapūrvatat klṛptaṃ yasya sādhanatvarasaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
karmālocanavelāyāṃ hi karmarūpaṇyeva dṛśyante |
apūrvakalpanā'pi yugapadbhava- tīti na śyate viśeṣaḥ |
vikārapakṣe tu jñāyate prākṛtasya pūrvataraṃ klṛptiriti yasyāvadheye'nyatarasminkarmaṇi viprakṛṣṭaṃ prākṛtaṃ hātavyaṃ bhavatīti bādhaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu ca vikāra- pakṣe'gniṣṭomasaṃsthāyā eva vikārabhūtāḥ parāḥ saṃsthā bhavanti na paraspareṇeti kevalasya āgneyasya prāptasya parairdhātvāt sarvatra dvitīya darśanaṃ na syādityetānmātraṃ vaktavyaṃ kimucyate tṛtīyasya darśanaṃ na prāpnotīti |
naiṣa doṣaḥ |
yadi tvayamaindrādīnāṃ varatra prātānāṃ bādhada- darśanaṃ brūyāttato niṣpramāṇakaṃ vadet |
ayaṃ tvadarśanamātra vadati |
taccā''gneyasya bādhāt madhyamayoḥ prāpteḥ upa- pannameva |
tainaiva cā''gneyo bādhyatetyāha- na pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pareṇeti |
tasmātsamavidhānaḥ |
vikārastu kāmasaṃyoge sa nityasya samatvāt |
bhāṣyam- naitadasti , samānavidhānā iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? ukthyādayaḥ saṃsthāḥ vikārabhūtāḥ syuḥ |
agni- ṣṭomasaṃsthamūrīkṛtya dīkṣaṇīyādayo dharmāḥ samāmnātāḥ |
kutaḥ ? ukthyādīnāṃ kāmasaṃyogena śravaṇāt |
‘ paśukāma ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ’ |
‘ ṣoḍaśinā vīryakāmaḥ stuvīta’, ‘ atirātreṇa prajākāmaṃ yājayet ’ iti |
kāmyo guṇaḥ śrūyamāṇo nityamarthe niviśate |
katham ? guṇā- devaṃ jātīyake kāmye phalanirvṛttiḥ |
paśukāma ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyān jyotiṣṭomakāma ukthyagrahaṇakāmo vā |
yathā paśavo bhavanti , tathā gṛhṇīyādityarthaḥ |
kathamiti tatrā- vaśyamitikartavyatāpekṣitāyāḥ , saṃnidhānāt nityasyeti- kartavyateti gamyate |
kathaṃ punardravyamitikartavyatā sā nityasyevārthe , na punaḥ asyaiva kāmasya sādhāraṇī veti |
ucyate |
yatra yatra guṇe kāmo bhavati tatra tatra kriyāyāṃ sādhyamānāyām , nānyathā |
sā tatretikartavyatā yā''ntikamupanipatati |
sā sādhanasya vā sādhyasya veti saṃdihyamānā sādhyasya bhavitu- marhati |
nāsau sādhyasyārthe sādhanena saṃbadhyate |
evaṃ hi sa itikartavyatāviśeṣaśrūyate |
anena sādhanaṃ
sādhakaṃ kuryāditi |
na cāsti sa prakāraḥ , yenā- sādhyamānāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tena sādhakaḥ kṛto bhavet |
tasmāt sādhyasyāpītikartavyatāviśeṣaṃ abhyupagacchatā sādhyasyāpītyedamabhyupagamanīyam |
sādhyaśca jyotiṣṭomaḥ khādhikāḥ saṃsthāḥ |
tasmājjyotiṣṭomasya tāvattvā iti- kartavyateti siddham |
atha kassāt na sādhāraṇī |
nityadāmanāt |
yadeva jyotiṣṭomaḥ , tadeva dīkṣā |
yadā tu jyotiṣṭome paśukāmastadokthyasaṃsthā |
sarvadā jyotiṣṭome dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ |
te cokthyādi- saṃsthāsyartheti pūrvamuttareṇa virudhyate , yadi sarvadā , nokthyādināmanayena |
ayodhvyādināmadheyena , na sarvadā , ubhayaṃ vipratiṣiddham |
tasmāt sādhāraṇī |
niyacadā- mnānaṃ ca yannityasya syāt , nityadāmanāt tadanidhaṃ kriyate |
tatra niyavadāmānaṃ bādhyate |
tasmāt nitya- saṃsthasya jyotiṣṭomasya , na kāmasyokthyādisaṃstheti |
vā- ukthyādayaḥ samāptiviśeṣāḥ phalasādhanatvena codyamānāḥ |
samāptimantamāśritya pekṣamāṇāḥ prakṛtaṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ samāśrayantasya nijāmagniṣṭomasaṃsthāṃ vikṛtya niviśanta iti vikāraśabdenocyante |
nanu cokthyādīnāṃ samāptitve siddhe samāptimadapekṣā bhavati |
na caiṣāṃ prāk jyotiṣṭomasaṃsthātsamāptisiddheḥ , ārambhamadhyāpekṣa- tvātsamāptiśabdapravṛtteḥ |
atha prathamaṃ tatsaṃbhadhastataḥ prathamaṃ ṛtvarthatve avacārite phalasaṃbandhātvāt ‘ sa nityasya samatvāt ’ ityevamadhikāratvaprasaṅgaḥ |
kiṃca ‘ grahaṇau ca vispaṣṭe codyamāne phalaṃ prati |
saṃsthānāṃ phalasaṃbandhaḥ kathamadhyavasīyate |
’ tatra keci- dāhuḥ |
grahaṇadīnāmapi phalasaṃbandhecchedhikaraṇaṃ gacchatyeva ( adhikaraṇavicāraḥ saṃgacchate eva ityarthaḥ ) kiṃ jyotiṣṭomāmeva dharmavidhitaḥ grahaṇau'pīti |
saṃsthā- śabdaḥ kathameti cet |
teṣāṃ grahaṇādīnāmante vidhānā- tsamāptisaṃbandho'stīti tacchabdatvam |
‘ paśukāma ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ’ ‘ ṣoḍaśinā vīryakāmaḥ stuvīta ’ iti pūrvasamāptyuttarakālaṃ codyamānānāṃ samāptyantararūpa- deśabhāktvaṃ bhavati |
anye tvāhuḥ |
grahaṇādyo'pyatra phalavattvāpyatvena prāptā eva sādhyasādhanasaṃbandha- vidhipare vākye nirvapyatāmitadandanuyanta iti |
kutaḥ ? ‘ saṃkrāntavidhisāmarthye pratyaye dhāturucyate |
tasmātprāmaḥ phalaṃ hotṛvedinidriyakāmavat ||
’ nanu ca ‘ ukthyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt ’ iti sāmānyadhikaraṇya- prayogātprāmā grahaṇādīnāmeva syāt |
naitadevam |
ukthyastotrasaṃbhavādi samāptaureva ukthyaśabdena ucyate , tanna ca mukhyasaṃbhave gauṇaḥ parigṛhyate |
nityaṃ tu yajñasāmānādhikaraṇyenaukthyādīnāṃ prayogo dṛśyate , ‘ ukthyena yajetokthyo yajñaḥ ’ iti |
tathā ‘ ṣoḍaśinā yajate ṣoḍaśī yajñaḥ ’ |
sa vai ṣoḍaśī nāma yajño'stīti |
sa ca atyantātyantitarasamāpti- vacanatve'vakalpate na grahastotravacanatve |
ṣoḍaśīti ca puṃliṅgaḥ |
samāptivacana evaiṣopapadyate |
napuṃsakaliṅgasya stotravacanatvāt |
yastu puṃliṅgaprayogaḥ |
stotre kaścit dṛśyate yathā ‘ ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī ’ iti , sa gauṇa iti pratipattavyam |
iha vākyaśeṣe puṃliṅgaḥ ṣoḍaśī pratīyata iti saṃsthāvacanam |
‘ atirātreṇa prajākāmam ’ iti vispaṣṭameva saṃsthāvacanatvam |
na hi tatra kriyāntaramupāttam |
yadipi ca vyathopasarva- tvena śrutaḥ kleśena pradhānīkṛtya |
tasmādātri- matīyā vā samāptiḥ sā phalena saṃbadhyate |
yadi ca grahaṇastotrayoḥ phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāttatastayoḥ kriyātvādā- śrayāpekṣā nāstīti svatantrayoreva prayogaḥ prāpnoti |
tatra ca prakaraṇātprayojanajakamukthyādiṣabdaprayogaśca na jñāyeta |
tasmādapi samāptayaḥ phalamayaḥ |
kathaṃ tu prāk ṛtusaṃba- ndhātsamāptiriti |

pratinihitasya svāmidharmatve satyeva itareṣāṃ phalisaṃskārasaṃyogāt saṃyogasaṃbhavāt iti tadarthaḥ |
tatkarmasaṃyogāt iti vṛttipāṭhaḥ |
svāmikarmabhiḥ saṃyogatvāt iti tadarthaḥ |
ke.
oṃ 'sa devatārthatatsaṃyogāt' |
sa sūktavākaḥ devatākalpanārthaḥ aṅgatvena rūpeṇa praharaṇaṃ prati saṃyogāt (iti akṣarārthaḥ :) |
āgneyādiyāgeṣu agnyādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ devatātve'pi etadyāgāntargatoddeśa-nirūpitadevatātvasya lāghavena vyāsajyavṛtti-ekasyaiva kalpanam |
ataśca paraprayuktāgnyādidhṛttinā ekena devatātvena ekasyaiva etatpradravyasya tyāgaḥ kalpa-nam |
śābdatvārthe cājahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā ādhārayati-vat praharatinā lakṣaṇāt homatvasiddhiḥ |
tṛtīyāyāḥ |
('sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' ) lāghavāt prayupayogāt karaṇatve eva śakyasvīkārāt uttarasūtravakṣyamāṇanyāyena praharato jaghanye homalakṣaṇāyāḥ phalamupalatvenādoṣatvāt |
kau. 3|1|5|12-13. oṃ sa nityasa samatvāt' ( 3|1|6|143) prathamaṃ kyavarthatve'vadhārite phala-saṃnbadhābhāvāt 'sa nityasya samatvāt' ityevaṃ avi-kāraprasaṅgaḥ (ukthyādeḥ) |
vā. 3|1|6|143 pṛ. 1065-66.
oṃ sa pratyāmanet snānāt |
darśa 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātimācchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāva-modanaṃ nirvapet' ityuktaḥ karmāntararūpaḥ pañcaśarāvaḥ saḥ amāvāsyāṃ pratyāmanet |
amāvāsyāyāgasya pratyāmnāya-rūpaḥ syāt nāsau amāvāsyāyāgam |
snānāt |
yāge vinaṣṭe tasya sthāne pañcaśarāvasya vidhānāt |
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
aṅgavidhivaiyya nimittasaṃyogāt |
darśa 'yasyobhayaṃ havirātimācchet aindraṃ pañcaśarāva-modanaṃ nirvapet' ityuktaḥ karmāntararūpaḥ pañcaśarāvaḥ amāvāsyāyāgasya nātuṃ kiṃtu pratinidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣa sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena pratyāmnāya siddhāntāt |
aṅgavidhivaiyyaṃ pañcaśarāvaḥ |
darśayāgam |
nimitta-saṃyogāt |
havirātirūpeṇa nimittena yāgasya saṃyogāt saṃbandhasya vidhānāt |
tasmāt naimittikaṃ karmāṅgaṃ pañcaśarāvaḥ |
ke.
oṃ sa laukikaḥ syāt dṛṣṭapravṛttitvāt |
avihitetikartavyatākasyapi sauryādiṣu kāciditi-kartavyatā syāditi pūrvādhikaraṇe avagatam |
atha ko'sau itikartavyatāviśeṣaḥ ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ āha |
sa itikartavyatāviśeṣaḥ laukikaḥ syāt |
laukika iti gṛhyoktaḥ ucyate |
tataśca pārvaṇasthālīpākādau yasya pravṛttirdṛśyate sa dṛṣṭapravṛttitvāt gṛhyokta itikartavyatā-viśeṣaḥ syāt sauryādau |
sa hi sthālīpākādi phala-sādhakatayā siddhaḥ iti sauryādāvapi grahītuṃ yogyaḥ |
tasmāt laukikaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
vacanāttu tato'nyatvam |
sauryādau apekṣitaḥ itikartavyatāviśeṣaḥ laukiko grāhya ityuktam |
tato vailakṣaṇyaṃ tuśabdaḥ |
yatra tu vaidikasya itikartavyatāviśeṣasya viśeṣavacanaṃ syāt tatra vacanāt tatḥ laukikāt anyatvaṃ itikartavyatā-viśeṣasya |
yathā upasatsu gṛhamedhīye ca |
yathākathaṃ-cit vacanābhāve tu laukikaḥ syāt |
liṅgena vā niyamyeta liṅgasya tadguṇatvāt |
yatra itikartavyatā na paṭhitā tatrāpi sā kutaścit grāhyaiva |
sā ca kacit vacanāt iti pūrva-muktam |
tato vailakṣaṇyaṃ vāśabdaḥ |
liṅgena vā kacit vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyeta |
yathā saurye carau 'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti |
kṛṣṇalamiti kṛṣṇalamujjāparimitaṃ suvarṇamiti |
tayā aindrābārhaspatye 'ardhaṃ barhiṣo lunāti ardhaṃ na, svayaṃ-ditamardhaṃ yathā karoti ardhaṃ na' iti |
tathā pitṛyajñe 'na hotāraṃ vṛṇīte, nārdheyam' iti |
etarliṅge-jñāyate etadvaidikī itikartavyatāveti |
liṅgasya tadguṇa-tvāt |
yathā'jādayo hi tasya vaidikasya apūrvasya guṇāḥ |
tasmāt kacit liṅgena niyamaḥ |
sa:
apivā'nyāyapūrvatvād yatra nilānuvāda- vacanāni syuḥ |
sauryavadī liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyate iti siddhāntinā uktaṃ tat vyāvartyatarhi apivā'śabdaḥ |
na sauryādau liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā sidhyati |
anyāyapūrvatvāt nātra nyāyapūrvakatvam, nyāyābhāvāt |
kā tarhi liṅgānāṃ gatiḥ ? ucyate |
yatra nilānuvāda- vacanāni syuḥ nilasya siddhasya anuvādo yatra vacane dṛśyate tatra uktaiḥ liṅgaiḥ kiñcit bodhyeta |
tadarthāni tāni |
tathayā |
yatra pādyāḥ siddhāḥ tatra tadanuvādena kṛṣṇalavidhiḥ iti kṛṣṇalavākyasya sauryāt utkarṣaḥ |
athavā kṛṣṇalaviśiṣṭaprayājavidhirayam |
' nārṣeyaṃ śṛṇute ' iti vacanaṃ tu nilānuvādaḥ ' nāntarikṣe na divi agnīdhetyataḥ ' itivat |
' ardhe barhiṣo lunāti ' ityādivākyaṃ ca yatra barhiḥ siddhaṃ tatra aindrābārhaspatyāt utkarṣavyam |
tasmāt sauryādiṣu laukikī eva iti- kartavyatā na vaidikī |
iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
mitho-vipratiṣedhācca guṇānāṃ yathārthakalpanā syāt |
sauryādiṣu laukikī itikartavyatā grāhyā iti pūrva- pakṣiṇā uktaṃ kaścit brūyāt nanu laukikī ca vaidikī ca ityubhayaṃ pravartatāṃ iti |
tatrāha pūrvapakṣī |
ekatra karmaṇi laukikyā vaidikyā saha pravṛttirna sambhavati, mitho vipratiṣedhāt |
tasmāt guṇānāṃ ajñānāṃ yathārthaṃ arthe anatikramya prakṛtisiddhaṃ prayojanaṃ anatikramya kalpanā syāt |
yathārthakalpanā syāt ekasyā eva itikartavyatāyāḥ phalajanakāyāḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
yadā ca ekasyāḥ tadā laukikyā eva dṛṣṭapravṛttitvāt iti |
bhāgitvāt niyamyate, guṇānāmabhidhānatvāt, sambandhādabhidhānavat, yathā dhenuḥ : kiśoriṇa |
sauryādiṣu laukikī itikartavyatā syāt iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntī āha |
bhāgitvāt apūrvaṃ bhajate iti bhāginī vaidikī api itikartavyatā |
laukikyā vaidikyāśca ubhayoḥ samāne'pi bhāgitve guṇānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ vaidikānāmeva abhidhānatvāt - abhidadhati iti abhi-
sa:
dhānāni- abhidhāyakatvāt |
kathaṃ guṇā vaidikāmidhā- yakāḥ ? 1 saṃbandhāt prayājādīnāṃ vaidiketikartavyatayaiva saṃbandhāt |
nahi laukike sthālīpākādau prayājāḥ santi |
abhidhānavat, yathā kuṇḍapāyānāmayane agnihotraṃ ityabhi- dhānaṃ nityasya agnihotrasya sahacaritānāṃ dharmāṇām ānayati tadvat |
evaṃ bhāgitvāt, saṃbandhāt guṇānāṃ abhidhāna- tvāt abhidhānavat vaidikī itikartavyatā niyamyate |
atra bhāgitvāt iti nyāyaḥ |
itarat liṅgam |
yathā dhenuḥ kiśoriṇa |
tathayā ' kṛṣṇakiśoriṇa dhenuḥ ' iti |
atra dhenuśabdo yadyapi dhayanyāyāṃ gavi dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ tathāpi abhidhānasāmānyāt dhayanyāmāśrayāmāpi bhāgī iti kiśoraśabde hi aśvasyaiva bālake rūḍhaḥ |
evamihāpi yadyapi laukikī dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ tathāpi itikartavyatā- sāmānyena bhāgitvāt liṅgena vaidikī viśeṣā |
utpattīnāṃ samatvāt yathā'dhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt |
sauryādau prayājakṛṣṇalādi liṅgena vaidikī itikartavyatā iti siddhāntinā uktaṃ punaḥ pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate |
pakṣa- viparīvartane vāśabdaḥ |
athavā naiva liṅgena niyamyate |
prayājādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ vā utpattyaivaḥ tāsāṃ samastatvāt |
āgneyādyaṅgena tāḥ sarvāḥ samānāḥ |
tena kevalaṃ prayājāḥ sadharmākā anumīyeran na tu anu- yājādīni itarāṇyaṅgāni |
ato na sarvā vaidikī iti- kartavyatā sauryādau grahītuṃ śakyate |
etasmāt hetoḥ yathādhikāraṃ yatrayatra ye dharmāḥ śrutāḥ teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ sattvaṃ syāt na tu anyeṣām |
ataḥ sātānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śruta- mātrasya prayājādeśca sauryādau aṅgatvaṃ syāt |
utpattiśeṣavacanaṃ ca vipratiṣiddhamekasmin |
laukikī itikartavyatā, śrutaṃ ca prayājarūpaṃ vaidika- maṅgaṃ sauryaṃ carī syāt iti pūrvapakṣiṇā ukte iyaṃ śaṅkā- nanu itikartavyatāsyapradhānayā sahasraṃ syāt itikartavya- tākaṃ pradhānaṃ pradhānavidhiraiva vighaṭate |
ataśca sauryasya sāṅgapradhānasya vedena vihitatvāt vaidikī eva tatra itikartavyatā syāt |
na laukikī iti |
tatrāha pūrvapakṣī |
cakāraḥ śabdānirāsasūcakaḥ |
utpatti śeṣavacanaṃ ca tayoḥ samāhāraḥ utpattiśeṣavacanam |
ekasmin vākye śabde vā pradhānasya utpattiḥ, śeṣāṇāṃ ajñānāṃ vacanaṃ vidhiśca vipratiṣiddhaṃ viruddham, na saṃbhavati |
yadi ca ' saurye varuṃ nirvapet ' iti ākhyātena pradhānavat aṅgānyapi vidhīyeran tataḥ teṣāṃ api pradhānavat phala- saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
tataśca aṅgatvameva vyāhanyeta |
tasā- nomayavidhiḥ |
evaṃ ca laukikī eva itikartavyatā sauryādau |
vidhyanto vā prakṛtivaccodanāyāṃ pravartata tathāhi liṅgadarśanam |
sauryādau laukikī itikartavyatā grāhyā iti pūrvapakṣa vāśabdena nirasyan punaḥ siddhāntamāha |
sauryādicoda- nāyāṃ kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ vidhyantaḥ : kathaṃbhāvo vaidika eva prakṛtivat darśapūrṇamāsayoriva pravartata |
tathāhi liṅgadarśanaṃ vaidikakathaṃbhāvasyaiva savyā satyāṃ utpadyate |
prayājādiprāptau ca anuvājādīnāmapi codakataḥ prātisa- varjanīyā iti bhavati prayājādidarśanaṃ vaidikakathaṃbhāvaprāptau liṅgam |
tasmāt sauryādau vaidikī eva itikartavyatā |
liṅgahetutvādliṅge laukikaṃ syāt |
pūrvapakṣī brū
sa: |
sā
✱ ‘sa vai syāt’ iti prājñitavādo jyotiṣṭome |
saṃkarṣa, 2|2|21, mīko. pṛ. 1830 “jyotiṣṭome ‘sa vai syāt’ ityadhikaraṇa draṣṭavyam |
✱ ‘sa vai (vaimṛdhaḥ) paurṇamāsena haviṣeṣṭvā anu- nirvāpyaḥ’ anena vākyena pūrṇamāsaprayogotsakālīnatā vaimṛdhasya pratīyate |
saṃkarṣa, 1|2|6, ✱ ‘sa vai vājino nāvāhayati’ |
vaiśvadeve parvaṇi |
✱ sa khageḥ syāt sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt |
‘tasmāt pitṛbhyaḥ ‘pūrvedyuḥ karoti’ ‘vaḥ satrāyāgurate sa viśvajitā yajeta’ ityādikaṃ karma ekameva phalaṃ sādhayati iti pūrvādhikaraṇe avagatam |
tat ekaṃ kiṃnāma syāt |
iti vicāre yat ekaṃ phalaṃ sa svargaḥ syāt |
vidheyānusāraṇa ‘saḥ’ iti puṃliṅgatā |
svarga eva kutaḥ ? tatrāha, sarvān puruṣān prati nirātiśaya- prītirūpasya svargasya aviśiṣṭatvāt sarvasva prītiṃ kāmayate |
evaṃ svīkāre yajeta ityādiviśeṣa- vacanaḥ śabdaḥ na viśeṣe vyavasthāpito bhavati |
pratyayācca |
‘viśvajitā yajeta’ ityādau ekameva svargaḥ phalaṃ iti siddhānta uktaḥ, tatra detvantaramāha sūtram |
cakāraḥ samuccayārthe |
anādiphale karmaṇi svargaḥ phalaṃ iti pratyayo bhavati loke |
‘ārāmakṛdevadattaḥ’ iti kena- cidukte ‘niyatoḍasya svargaḥ’ ityapara āha |
‘taḍāga- kṛdevadattaḥ’ ityukte ‘niyatoḍasya svargaḥ’ ityapara āha |
evamatrāpi |
ke. ✱ sa svāmī syāt tatsaṃyogāt |
satre anyatame yajamāne apacarite tasya sthāne prati- nidhiḥ kartavya iti avagatam |
sa ca pratinidhir'nyaḥ svāmī syāt |
tatsaṃyogāt svāmitvena saṃyogāt |
yo hi asau anya ānīyate sa karmaṇi kriyate |
tasmāt pratinidhiḥ svāmī syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
karmakaro vā bhṛtatvāt |
satre anyatame yajamāne apacarite yo'nyaḥ prati- nidhīyate sa svāmī syāt iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasnan siddhāntamāha |
sa pratinidhīya- mānaḥ na svāmī syāt kiṃtu karmakaraḥ; darśadau ṛtvi- gtvat |
kutaḥ ? bhṛtatvāt bhṛtidānena parikrītatvāt |
parikrīyamāṇaśca na svāmī bhavati |
naivāsau satraphalaṃ prāpnoti |
kutūhale ‘bhṛtatvāt’ ityasya sthāne ‘akṛtatvāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ |
pratinidhitena ādita ārabhya karma na kṛtam |
akṛtatvāt karmaṇaḥ nāsau satraphalaṃ prāpnuyāt iti nāsau svāmī |
kṛtatvāt iti vā padacchedaḥ |
niyuktatvāt iti tadarthaḥ |
krītatvāt dravyadānena parikrītatvāt iti vṛttiḥ |
tasmi
saktvadhikaraṇam
prāpto vipratiṣedhe sati sakṛt yad bādhitaṃ tat bādhita- meva jñeyamityarthaḥ |
sthānivadbhāviṣye nirdiṣṭamānasya iti pari- bhāṣāyāḥ pravṛttau tisṛṇāṃ iyatra paratvāt tikṣādeśe sthānivadbhāvena trayādeśe āśaṅkya sakṛdgatanyāyena samādhānaparabhāṣyāsaṃgatiḥ |
paribhāṣāṃnduḥ pṛ. 59, sakṛdgatanyāyaḥ |
sakṛdgatau vipratiṣedhe yadbādhitaṃ tadbādhitameva |
pṛ. 154, kacit caritārthayoḥ eka- smin yugapadubhayoḥ kāryayoḥ asaṃbhavena bādhakābhāvāt paryāyeṇa tujāditvat śāstradvayasaṅge niyamārthe viprati- ṣedhasūtra iti sakṛdgatanyāyasiddhiḥ |
vyaktau padārthe pratilakṣyaṃ lakṣaṇaplavāt ubhayorapi śāstrayoḥ lakṣya- viṣayayoḥ acaritārthena paryāyeṇa dvayorapi prāptau parameva iti niyamārthamidaṃ iti sakṛdgatanyāyasiddhiḥ |
iti kaiyaṭādayaḥ |
(śekhara. pṛ. 154-155) |
tisṛṇāmityatra sakṛdgatanyāyena trayādeśa- vāraṇaparaṃ bhāṣyam |
bhūtiḥ pṛ. 62. 'sakṛ- tpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' iti nyāyaḥ |
atha śabda eva prathamaṃ viṣayatayā ( dhātvartha ) abhidhāya punaḥ karaṇatayā'pi abhidhatte |
kathaṃ sakṛduccarito dvirabhidadhyāt ? abhidhāne vā sādhyatvamapi punarabhi- dadhīta |
nahi niyamakamasti dvevābhidhatte na tririti |
sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena iti nyāyāt |
( yā strī sakṛt avaguṇṭhanaṃ vinā āpaṇamārgādau pravṛttā tasyāḥ punargamane avaguṇṭhanaṃ nāsti kartavyaṃ prathamapravṛttavat -iti nyāyārthaḥ) |
sā śi. 4|1|4|4 pṛ. 68. 'sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' iti nyāyaḥ |
eka- hāyanīśabdasyāpi kriyāsaṃbandhāt svātantryamapanītam |
tatra padāntagasaṃbandhe'pi 'sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' itivat tasya tādarthyena śraṇīpāḍā |
vā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 689, 'sakṛtpravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' iti nyāyaḥ |
' buddhau saṃnihitena śakyate sākāṅkṣaḥ śabdaḥ saṃbandhayitumiti |
naitadevam, yo hi asaṃbandha- mānaḥ anarthako bhavati sa saṃbadhyate nānyaḥ ' iti bhāṣyam |
atra vārtikam- yāvadyāvat hi padārtho viśeṣyate tāvattāvat śruteḥ svarasabhaṅgaḥ |
tena 'sakṛt pravṛttāyāḥ kimavaguṇṭhanena' ityevaṃ ekena kenacit viśeṣitaḥ pareṇāpi viśeṣyatāṃ ityabhyupagantavyaṃ iti |
3|1|6|12 pṛ. 690 |
yā hi kāminī sakṛt para- puruṣe pravṛttā sā punarapi pravartateva, tathā sati lokā mā drākṣuriti ki javanikayā avaguṇṭhanaṃ kāryam ? nāva- guṇṭhanasya prayojanamityarthaḥ |
ke. 'sakṛdbrakṣate kṛtaḥ śāstrārthaḥ' |
dravyaikatvāt aindrayāvat 'sakṛd' iti nyāyena sakṛt bhakṣaṇe prāpte 'dvirendrāyā- vasya bhakṣayati' iti vacanāt dvirbhakṣaṇam |
vā. 3|5| 5|18. 'sakṛdvā''rambhasaṃyogāt' ( 9|1| 10|135 ) iti nyāyena 'kṛtasya yāvajjīviksya prayo- gasya arthena ādau kṛtā ārambhaṇīyā' iti (pūrvapakṣe) |
bhā. 12|1|6|19 |

9|4|12|45-50. mīko. pṛ. 1824 'jyotiṣṭome maitrāvaruṇādimeṣu' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

saktunyāyaḥ |
'saktūn juhoti' iti dvitīyā na prādhānyabodhikā |
dravyopadeśa iti cet |
bhāṣyam- iti cet paśyasi, dvitīyādarśanāt pradhānabhūtamātra dravyamiti |
naitadevam |
guṇabhūte'pi dvitīyā bhavati |
tathāhi dṛśyate 'saktūn juhoti', 'mārutaṃ juhoti', 'ekakapālaṃ juhoti' iti |
vā- ( dvitīyāvibhaktivicāraḥ ) parastu āha ( pūrvapakṣī ) ' anvayavyatirekābhyāmupakārānu- sāritā |
śeṣatvasya, dvitīyā tu prādhānyavyami- cāriṇī |

bhāṣyam-- etadāmnāyate ‘sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānamāgurate, yaḥ satrāyā-''gurate, sa viśvajitā'tirātreṇa yajeta |
sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānaṃ niṣkrīṇīte’ iti |
satrāyā āguraṇe nimitte viśvajit bhūyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ satrāyā''gurate yaḥ satraṃ prayuṅkte tasya viśvajit, uta na prayuṅkte tasyeti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? yaśca prayuṅkte, yaśca netyaviśeṣāt |
athavā pṛṣṭhajyānsyeti |

viśvajit apravṛtte bhavet |
satrasya kriyāyā abhāve viśvajit |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? evaṃ hi śrūyate ‘yaḥ satrāyā''gurate, sa viśvajitā'tirātreṇa yajeta’ iti |
yaḥ satraṃ kariṣyatītyevamāgurate sa viśvajitā yāgena sādhyayeti |
yathaidhamarthaṃ satraṃ kartumicchati, tadarthamiti gamyate |
katham ? ya āgurate, sa tena yajeta, yāgena nirvartayediti vākyārtho gamyate, na yāgaṃ nirvartayediti |
kutaḥ ? yāgasya guṇatvena śravaṇāt |
kathaṃ tasya guṇa-svam ? tṛtīyānirdeśāt |

vi-- ‘satrāyā''gurate yo'yaṃ yajeda viśvajite-tyasau |

’ bhāṭṭa-- satraprakaraṇe ‘yaḥ satrāyāgurate sa viśva-jitā yajeta’ iti śruto viśvajit |
satrasaṃkalpa-māguraṇaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ satraṃ na karoti, tasyedaṃ satraphalārtha-tvena vidhānam, na tu satrajñatayā, tathātve āgaraṇasya nimittatvaśravaṇācca |
na ca evaṃ satrakaraṇasyāpi nimittāntaḥpraveśāt gauravāpattiḥ |
ataḥ saṃkalpamātre nimitte naimittikamidaṃ phalāntarārthaṃ vidhīyate iti vācyam |

] padottarasūtreṇa saṃsthāsveva ityavadhāraṇāt, 'ukthyā- diṣu vā' iti sūtreṇa apiśabdārthe vāśabde'dhikṛtya 'ukthyādiṣu cārthasya' iti cakārayuktameva vā pāṭhaṃ kṛtvā, ukthyaśabdena vā saṃsthāsthito'pi [ukthya- ṣoḍaśī-atirātrān ], ādiśabdena ca satrāṇi ahīnāśca uktvā saṃsthāsu satrāhīneṣu ca dīrghasoma- śabdārthasya dīrghakālasomayāgātvasya vidyamānatvāt saṃtardnaṃ syāt iti dvitīyapūrvapakṣokte, satrāhīnamātraviṣayatayā utkarṣanirāsena agniṣṭomānyamātraviṣayatayā utkarṣe siddhā- nnite, saṃsthāsu pradeyasya somasya daśamuṣṭipratve niyamena vṛddhayākhyaviśeṣābhāvāt nirālambanastutyāpatteḥ agniṣṭomānyamātraviṣayasiddhāṃtāyogo 'aviśeṣāt' iti sūtreṇa āśaṅkaya avaśiṣṭānaṃśanyūhetparimāṇasya [krītāt somāt daśamuṣṭi pṛthak kṛtāt avaśiṣṭāḥ ye aṃśāvaḥ, teṣāṃ abhyūhasya samāhārasya yat muṣṭidaśakāt adhikaṃ parimāṇam, tasya ] aniyatatvāt saṃsthāsvapi pradeyasya vṛddhayākhya viśeṣaḥ syāt iti anyathaiva parihiyate ityeva vyākhyeyāni|

śā-- avaśiṣṭānāṃmanāṃ upasamuhanavacanaṃ śrūyate 'yadā etāvāneva somaḥ syāt yāvantaṃ mimīte, yaja- mānasyaiva syāt nāpi sadasyānāṃ prajāpyasatvā ityava- śiṣṭān aṃśānpasūhati, sadasyānevānabhajati' iti|
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi anutkarṣaḥ iti pratyava- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ|
'saṃtuyed dīrghasome tat prakṛtau vikutā- vṛta|
dīrgha soma ityukte prakṛtāvastu tardnam||
, sāmānyādhikaraṇasya ṣaṣṭhīto balavattvataḥ|
dairghyayukta- kyasaṃsthāyā utkarṣo'nyathā bhāvāt||
' 16. bhāṭṭa-- jyotiṣṭome adhipavaṇaphalake prakṛsya 'na saṃtṛṇatti' ityanena asaṃtardnaṃ vidhāya 'atho khalu dīrghasome saṃtṛdyed dhṛtye' ityanena saṃtardnaṃ vihitam|
saṃtardnaṃ nāma dvayoḥ phalakayoḥ saṃrepapradeśatakaraṇena ekoparyaparasya saṃśleṣaḥ|
tadeva saṃtardnaṃ kiṃ prakaraṇe eva niścitate, uta agniṣṭomānya utkṛṣyate iti cintā- yām, prakaraṇānugrahabhādunutkarṣaḥ|
na ca vākyavirodhaḥ|

ataśca brīhyādivādvat saṃtardhanāsaṃtardhanayoḥ vikalpaḥ |
yastatra sūtre krayaṇavaditi krayaṇānto vikalpe dattaḥ, sa dvādaśa 'daśabhiḥ krīṇāti' iti vacanena samuccayasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt vacanābhāvaṃ kṛtvā bodhyaḥ |
astu vā ihyādeḥ ihānupādānāt, tadapekṣayā dīrghasya ca nityatvena dīrghasomapadavaiyarthyāpatteḥ aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpasya ca anyāyāt, dīrghasya yaja- mānasya somo dīrghasomaḥ ityevaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣamapi praka- raṇānurodhenāṅgīkṛtya yajamānadairghye nimitte saṃtardhanavidhā- nam |
yadi tu niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇanyāyena karmadhāraya- syaiva nyāyyatvāt, yajamānadairghyaṃ ca phalakavidārā- prasakteḥ taddvā (dvā, hā) raktatvena saṃtardhanasterasaṃbhavena 'ghṛtaiḥ' ityarthavādānupapatteḥ ; dīrghasāsau somaśca iti karmadhāraya evāṅgīkriyate |
tadā'pi jyotiṣṭome eva ukthyādisaṃsthāntasya ca pradānavibhuddhatve'pyetatsomacchide- rāvaśyakatvāt dīrghasomatvopapatteḥ vākyaprakaraṇayorviro- dhanideśaḥ |
na ca pradānavibhuddheḥ toyādinā saṃpādanam, somadravyasya yāgasya vinā vacanaṃ dravyāntarasaṃjñena somena karaṇādyogāt |
na ca trivarṣadaśamuṣṭirūpasoma- parimāṇatvāt, sthūladīrghaparvasomagrahaṇe tadabhāvābhāvāt |
ata eva somapadena yāgalakṣaṇayā pramāṇābhāvāt soma- dīrghaparvameva saṃtardhane nimittamapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
vastutastu — trivarṣadaśamuṣṭiraparimitasomagrahaṇottaraṃ 'avaśiṣṭānaṃśanupasampahati' ityupasamūhanevidhānāt, tatra cārthavāde 'yadai tāvāneva somaḥ syādyāvantaṃ mimīte yaja- mānastathaivā syāccāpi sadasyānāṃ prājāpatyasyetyavaśiṣṭānaṃśan upasamūhati' iti pūrvoktamānanindā uttarādohanavat yāvadapekṣitaparatvapratīteḥ kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyasya api apravṛttyā parimāṇābhāvāt pradeyavibhuddhiḥ sulabhaiva |
na ca evamapi agniṣṭomasaṃsthāyā asvatvāt anyāsāṃ kāmpānāṃ tisrāṇāṃ saṃsthānāṃ ca vikṛtitvena prakaraṇabhāvāt jyotiṣṭome ca pradānadhruvabhāvena pradeyadhruvabhāvāt kathaṃ vākyaprakaraṇayorvirodhaḥ iti vācyam |
kāmpasaṃsthāsu grahaṇavibhuddhyā āśrayabhūtajyotiṣṭomāsavibhuddherādeśya- katvāt, saṃsthānāṃ ca tisrāṇāmapi svataḥ prakaraṇabhāve ca jyotiṣṭomasya sarvatrānusyūtatvāt, kāmpasaṃkhyāka- jyotiṣṭomaprayoge saṃtardhanavidhānena prakaraṇamupapatteḥ |
ata eva agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomaprayoge asaṃtardhanam, pradānavibhuddhayabhāvāt na vikalpo'pi |
ata eva ca dīrghatvasaṃkhyāyoginaḥ kāmpasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasya prati- yoginaśca nityasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasya prakaraṇādeva lābhā- diti lāghavam |
na ca evamitarasaṃkhyākajyotiṣṭomasyāpi prakaraṇe aṅgīkriyāmāne 'eṣa vāva prathamo yajño yajñānāṃ yajjyotiṣṭomaḥ, ya etenāgniṣṭadhāyānyena yajate gatai- patyameva tadbhavati' ityatacchadena itarasaṃkhyāka- jyotiṣṭomasya grahaṇāpatteḥ agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākasyaiva prakaraṇāt grahaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ virudhyete vācyam |
jyotiṣṭoma- tvāvacchedena phalavattvena prakaraṇāṅgīkārāt, agniṣṭoma- saṃsthāyā asvatvena itarāṅgatva-chedakatvānupa- patteḥ |
etacchadena tu jyotiṣṭomatvasyaiva uktā- vapi anyaśabdena tadvikṛtitvāccaivena saṃsthānāmapi uktatvāt tāsāmapi jyotiṣṭomatvatkālavibhuddhipatteḥ : arthāt agniṣṭomasaṃkhyākasyaiva prakaraṇamapyapatteḥ |
ato vākyaprakaraṇayorvirodhāt prakaraṇe eva saṃtardhanasya niveśaḥ |
iti prāpte, bhāṣyakāreṇa tāvadihāpyaiva siddhāntitam |
pūrva- pakṣaprakāradvayenaiva kṛtaḥ |
vārtikakāreṇa tu vikṛti- mātre agniṣṭomātiriktāvibhuddhastomake niveśa ityuktam |
tasyāmāśayaḥ |
dīrghatvaṃ tāvat grahaṇavibhuddhayuktasoma- vibhuddhikṛtamiti bhavato'pi civadādam |
vibhuddhagrahaṇāni ca saṃkhyāni vacanāt na tu jyotiṣṭomāṅgāni |
ataśca dīrghasomatvasya jyotiṣṭomasaṃbhavābhāvāt vikṛtimātrapara- tvamiti |
na coktagrahaṇānāṃ jyotiṣṭomābhāve'pi saṃkhyādvārā tatsaṃbhavasattvāt tasya dīrghasomatvopapattiḥ, sarvatomukhādau pūrvādidikṣu agniṣṭomānāṃ saṃsthāke diga- ntare dīrghasomatvasya sattvāt agniṣṭomasaṃsthāke'pi saṃtardha- nāpatteḥ |

yattu-- 'kriyāhrāṇāṃ kriyākartṛtvādāṃ vivakṣite, kriyāhrāṇāṃ tadabhāve vivakṣite saptamī' yatā 'kriyāhrāṇāṃ tadabhāve kriyāhrāṇāṃ ca tasmin viva- kṣite' ityevaṃ vārtikaṃ ( vastutastu 'kārakāṇāṃ ca kārakatve, akārakāṇāṃ cākārakatve, tadapi yat sa' ityeva vārtikaśāstrapūrvam) 'satsu taratsu pūjyamāneṣu vā asanta āsate na pūjyante vā, ayatsu tiṣṭhatsu apūjyamāneṣu vā santastāranti pūjyante vā, satsu tiṣṭhatsu apūjyamāneṣu vā asantastāranti pūjyante vā, asatsu taratsu pūjyamāneṣu vā santāstiṣṭhanti na pūjyante vā' ityatra saptamīvidhāyakam, tat 'yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' ityanenaiva siddhe anarambhaṇīya iti kecit |
kaiyaṭādyastu lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvāvivakṣāyāṃ saptamīvidhānārtha ityāhuḥ; tatra, lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvātirikta- saṃbandhasya asākṣāttvāt abhāvane tasminnarthe saptamī- vidhānavaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
ataḥ arhatvāvacchinnakartṛkatvakarma- tvānyatarasaṃbandhena svasaṃbandhakriyākālakatvasya saptamyartha- syotanātha anuśāsanāntaram |

vastutaḥ avyayārthapradhānatva-avidyamānāyavayārthatva- viśiṣṭānyapadārthapradhānatvānyavyayībhāvatvam |
tena unmattagaṅgaṃ, supprati ityādyavyayībhāve nāvyāptiḥ, na vā tatpuruṣalakṣaṇatiprasaṅgaḥ |
samastamānānyatara- padārthapradhānatve sati suplopābhāvavatpadāntastatpuruṣa- tvam |
tena rājapuruṣaḥ, ardhapippalī ityāditatpuruṣe na lakṣaṇavyāptiḥ, na vā avyayībhāve lakṣaṇātiprasaṅgaḥ |
evaṃ anyapadārthapradhānatvaṃ bahuvrīhitvam |
dvibhāḥ ityatra api samastamānapadārthasaṃkhyāprādhānyena dvaṃdvatve'pi anya- padārthasaṃkhyeyaprādhānyena bahuvrīhitvam |
anyapadārthatā- vacchedakaṃ cātra alpatvam |
evaṃ ca 'saṃkhyāyā'vyayā0' (pā0 2|1|25) iti sūtraṃ saṃkhyeyaprādhānyagamakaṃ saṃkhyāvācakāvyayādipadānāṃ bahuvrīhividhāyakaṃ iti saṃgacchate |
evaṃ 'diṅmānāyantarāle' (pā0 2|1|26) ityādisūtrāṇi anyapadārthaprādhānyena bahuvrīhividhāyakāni bhavanti, yathā uttarapūrvā, keśākeśi, bhujābhuji, saputraḥ iti |
atra aṃśe tulyasaṃbandhitvaṃ anyapadārthā- vacchedakam |
ata eva 'ekadvaitarathamairā madhusīkaraiḥ |
kukṣimarāḥ paraṃ te'pi na santi khalu ketake ||
' ityādi alpatvaparicchinnavyaktīnāṃ bodhaḥ |
evaṃ 'upadaśāḥ' ityatra anyapadārthanaikadaśa- vyaktīnāṃ bodhaḥ |
ataḥ atrāpi anyapadārthaprādhānya- manvāhyam |
evaṃ 'tena saheti tulyayoge' (pā0 2|1|
28) itisūtravihite 'saputraḥ' iti bahuvrīhau tulya- kriyānvayī pitā anyapadārthaḥ iti bahuvrīhilaṃ sustham |
samāhāradvaṃdva tu samāhitamāṇānāmeva kriyānvayitvena samāhārasya aprādhānyāt na dvaṃdvalakṣaṇāvyāptiḥ bahuvrīhi- lakṣaṇānvitātiśca iti yuktam |
anye tu 'unmattagaṅgaṃ' ityādināṃ bahuvrīhitvam, dvibhā ityādi dvaṃdvavādikameva |
avyayībhāvabahuvrīha- dhikārapāṭhastu taddharmanapuṃsakatvasvarādiprāptyarthaḥ |
anyathā adhikārasūtravirodhapatteḥ |
na ca tatrāpi prakaraṇavirodhā- pattiḥ, adhikārasūtrasyānurodhena prakaraṇāvasya nyāyya- tvāt |
'anyapadārthe ca saṃjñāyām' (pā0 2|1|21) ityavyayībhāvasya sammindhyāhaviśeṣe anvarthatābādhat tena prakaraṇatvācca |
ataḥ uktānveva lakṣaṇāni ityāhuḥ |
(atha samāsavicāraḥ :-) atra vaiyākaraṇāḥ |
rājapuruṣaḥ ityāditatpuruṣadīnāṃ rājaviśiṣṭapuruṣadhau śaktiḥ |
na tu samāsāntargatarājadipadaśaktyā rājādi- bodhaḥ |
'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' (pā0 2|1|1) iti mahādhikāreṇa ekārthībhāvalakṣaṇe sāmarthye samāsādi- sakalavṛttitvidhānāt |
padodeśena vidhīyamānaḥ samāsādiḥ samarthaḥ vigrahavākyārthābhidhāne śaktiṃ prāptaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
ekārthībhāvaśca samastamānapadadvayasya svārthaparityāgena ekārthapratipādakatvam |
sa ca arthaḥ arājakīyabhinnaḥ rājasaṃbandhaśca ayaṃ iti bhedarūpaḥ saṃsargarūpaśca |
na ca klaptarājādipadaśaktita eva tādṛśopasthitisaṃbhave kiṃ samāsaśaktikalpanena iti vācyam |
rājapuruṣādipade uktarūpopasthitaye citragavādipade svāmitvenopasthitaye ca tatkalpanāt |
anyathā paṅkajādipade'pi padamatvena upasthitaye atiriktaśaktikalpanaṃ na syāt |
kiṃca samāsagatarājapadena svataḥ svatantropasthiteḥ rājā puruṣa ityatraiva viśeṣaṇavyāptiḥ |
na ca 'saviśeṣaṇānāṃ vṛttirna, vṛttasya ca viśeṣaṇayoge na' iti niṣedhena tadanāpattiḥ, tasya viśeṣaṇasiddhipadārthai- deśatvakṛtānanvayatānudāttvāt |
apica evaṃ vākya- samāsayoḥ tulyārthatvena vibhāṣāvacanasya samāsaniyama- nivāraṇārthatvaṃ kalpya iti gauravam |
kiṃca, kṛtavibhaktaḥ, prātodakaḥ, uddhṛtaudanaḥ ityādi- bahuvrīhiṣu viśvajanakṛtatimān, udakakartṛkaprāptirm, odanoddharaṇāvadhiḥ ityādyartheṣu kutādipadānāṃ lakṣaṇā- saṃbhavāt, citragavādipade ca vinigamanāvi raheṇa citra- pade gopade vā lakṣaṇāsaṃbhavāt ubhaya lakṣaṇāyāṃ bodhyāvṛttiprasakteḥ |
na ca pratyārthānvayurodhena carama- pade lakṣaṇā iti vācyam |
anekapadānāṃ anyapadārtha- pratipādakatvābhāvena bahuvrīhitvabhaṅgāpatteḥ |
na ca tātparyagrāhakatvayā anyeṣāṃ tatpratipādakatvam, ghaṭādi- padeṣvapi ādyavarṇānāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvā anyavarṇai śakyāpatteḥ |
kiṃca, śivo nāma gāyako yasya iti śivanāma- gāyakaḥ iti bahuvrīhau śivakartṛkagānakarmabhūtanāmavān iti bodhasya śaktikalpanaṃ vinā sutarāmanupapattiḥ |
ataḥ samāseṣu viśiṣṭaśaktirvidhīyate |
kiṃca, tatra śakyanaṅgīkāre arthavatvābhāve prāti- padikasaṃjñā na syāt |
na ca 'citragumānaya' ityādiṣu karmatvādyarthabodhakatvaṃ samastamānottarapadārthagatasvārthabodha- katvaṃ vā samāsottaravibhaktīnāṃ iti vācyam |
ardha- pippalī ityādi vyabhicārāt klaptanyatvātcibhaṅgāpatteśca |
kiṃca, samāsasya prātipadikatayā tadekadeśapuruṣadi- padārthasya puruṣadeḥ prātipadikatvābhāvena tatkāraka- bodho na syāt |
na syācca samastamānapadārthayoḥ paraspara- nvayaḥ, vibhaktyanyopasthityābhāvena rājapadārthakāraka- bodhādyogāt, abhedātiriktasaṃbandhena nāmārthaprakārakabodhe vibhaktijanyopasthitirahetutvāt |
kiṃca, rājapadasya saṃbandhini saṃbandhe vā lakṣaṇā |
nādyaḥ, rājaḥ puruṣa iti vākyasya samāsābhidhārthatayā tena vivaraṇavirodhāt |
nāntyaḥ, viruddhavibhaktirahita- prātipadikārthayoḥ abhedānvayavyutpattyā rājasaṃbandharūpaḥ puruṣaḥ iti bodhāpatteḥ |
ataḥ samāseṣu śaktiraṅgīkāryā ityāhuḥ |
atra gautamīyā: |
samāseṣu klasarājapadādereva saṃnnidhilakṣaṇā rājasaṃvandhinimnaḥ puruṣaḥ iti bodhasaṃbhave na śaktikalpyanaṃ yuktam |
mahādhikārasyāpi ajahatsvārtha- lakṣaṇyapekṣarāsāmarthya samāsādi vidhānena upapatteḥ |
padoddeśyena vidhīyamānaḥ samāsādiḥ samarthaḥ svārthavācaka- padāniṣṭhaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
-etena- rājapadārthe śobhanādiviśeṣaṇānvayāpattiḥ, niṣkośāmbiḥ , gorathaḥ ityādī kāntyuktādipada- kalpanā''pattiśca-parāstā |

rājādipadaśaktasyeva rājapuruṣaḥ, citraguḥ ityādau bodhābhāvena tatra śaktigrahasya āvaśyakatayā paṅkajādipadeṣu avayavaśaktyagrahe'pi bodhodayane tallakṣi- grahasyānāvaśyakatayā paṅkajādipadevalakṣaṇasya spaṣṭatvāt |

ghaṭāḥ ghaṭāḥ |
ityādisvarūpaikaśeṣe'pi na lakṣaṇa |
ghaṭapadācca śaktyaiva yugapajjñānādupasthitau dvitvavahutvā- nvayasaṃbhavāt |

atra kecit |
itaretarayoge vibhaktyupasthite dvitvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ dhave khadire cānvayaḥ |
tatra ca na dhavatvāvacchinnāvācachedakatvaṃ dvitpaparyāyavibhaktiracanāva- cchedakatvāt, vibhakteḥ prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakavyāpyasaṃkhyā- midhāyakatvaniyamāt |
ato dhavapadaṃ sāhityamāśrayatayā dhavakhadirau lakṣaṇayā upasthāpayati iti sāhityavācchede dvitvānvayaḥ |
na caivaṃ khadirapadavaiyarthyam, sāhityasyāśraya- viśeṣalābhatātparyakatvāt |
vṛttidvayavirodhāpattyā dhave'pi lakṣaṇaiva |
ataḥ itaretarayogadvaṃdva lakṣaṇa āvaśyakaḥ |
evaṃ ca mitrāvaruṇapade mitrayoḥ varuṇayoḥ iti vigraho- padaśaṃkaṃ vākyaṃ upapadyate, anyathā dvitvānupapatteḥ |
evaṃ samāhāradvaṃdveḍapi ekatvānvayārthe sāhitye lakṣaṇā āvaśyakī |
paraṃtu itaretarayogadvaṃdva sāhitye āśraye lakṣaṇā |
evaṃ ca vibhakteḥ prakṛtyarthagatasvārthabodhadhatva- nyutpattiḥ aparityaktā bhavati |
evaṃ sarūpaikaśeṣe'pi sāhityopasthitā dvitvānvayarthaṃ lakṣaṇā ityāhuḥ |
tanna |
pratyakṣeṇa padadvayenopasthite arthadvaye dvitvānvayasaṃbhavāt, yogyatāvacchedakaprakārakajñānasya śābdabodhahetutve mānābhāvāt, vibhakteḥ padārthatāvacchedaka- dharmadharmamānādhikaraṇasaṃkhyābhidhāyakatvāt |
ata eva ' ghaṭena jalamāharati ' ityatra sacchidrataratvena na ghaṭo- pasthitaḥ, kiṃtu ghaṭatvenaiva, ' ghaṭaśca paṭaśca staḥ ' iti dvitvānvayaśca |
etena sumihaḥ |
ekasaṃkhyābhidhāyakatvalakṣaṇasāmānyā- dhikaraṇyaniyamāt ekatvena upasthite dvitvānvayāsaṃbhavāt ' caitro maitraśca gacchataḥ ' ityādī cakāropāttasāhityā- nyayini dvitvānvayena, kriyāyāṃ vā dvitvānvayena bodhaḥ |
anyathā ekatvena upasthite dvitvānvaye ' ekau dvau ' iti pratīyamānaḥ |
iti parāstam |
vastuto yatra subupasthāpyasaṃkhyā tiṅupasthāpyasaṃkhyā- virodhinau tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyanopapattiḥ |
subupaya- syāpyaikatvasya tiṅupasthāpyadvitvena virodhābhāvāt ' ghaṭaśca paṭaśca staḥ ' iti prayogo yuktaḥ, na tu ' ekau dvau ' iti, tatra ekatvasya virodhivāt |
na ca samāhāralakṣaṇayāṃ pāṇṇādīnāṃ kriyānvayo na syāditi vācyam |
paraṃparayāsaṃbhavena pāṇṇādau kriyānvaya- yādṛśīkārāt |
kecittu ' evaṃ nañtatpuruṣe'pi ' aghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ ' ityādi ghaṭapratiyogikānyoyabhāve naño lakṣaṇā, tatrāpi anvayitāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvasya vyutpatti- labhyatvāt anyonyābhāvamātre lakṣaṇā |

śā-- yāni punarna doṣanidhārtārthāni, nimitte karmājñāni ' minne juhoti ' ityādīni, teṣāṃ prayājā- divat aparyāyavidhānāt samuccayaḥ |

vi-- ' bhinnaṛkṣādihomādervikalpo vā samu- ccayaḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- yāni doṣagrāhakamamāṇābhāvāt doṣanidhār- tārthāni, api tu kevalaṃ nimitte naimittikāni arhā- ryāni, tatra ekanimittakanaimittikasthale prayājā- divat samuccaya eva |
yathā anvādhānottaraṃ candrasūryo- parāge iḍābhakṣaṇāt pūrvamapi ' udayaṃtaṃ, udayantaṃ, citraṃ ' iti mantrayakaraṇakahomamayavidhau |
nahi tatra kaścidoṣaḥ vedādiprayuktasyāpi iḍābhakṣaṇāt pūrvamapravṛtteḥ |
etādṛśa- viṣaye prāyaścittasamākhyā tu prāyaścittakaṇapattitva- mātreṇa aupacārikī, yajamānakartṛvyasāmavaidikapadārtheṣu audrātrasamākhyāvat |
na tu pāpaviśoṣakatvena, pāpā- drevāprasiddheḥ |
yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa sūryodayāta pūrva- magnihotrahomākaraṇe prāyaścittadvayamāmudāhṛtam, tat ' rūpaṃ kālo'nunivāpo devatā śrapaṇaṃ tathā |
ādye ve viddhatāḥ pakṣāste sarvadā smṛtāḥ ||
' iti chandoga- pariśiṣṭānusārat anuditahomināṃ kālatikramanimitta- doṣanidhārtārthatveopapatteḥ, itarathā uditahomināṃ sarvadā
samuccayabhedāḥ
prāyaścittakaraṇapatteḥ upekṣitam |
yadapi pārthasārathinā ' minne juhoti ' ityādyudāhṛtam, tadapi ṛtvikkapāla- medananimittavaiguṇyaśamanādyarthatvopapatteḥ dvitīyaprāyaści- tālilanācca upekṣitam |
maṇḍana-- ' naimittaṃ cet tat samuccayameva |
' śaṃkara-- ' doṣābhāve samuccayaḥ |
' samuccayasaṃbhave ca bādhavikalpau, na saṃbhavati samuccayaḥ |
samuccayabhedāḥ nirūpyante |
yadyapi śābdikaiḥ ' pratyekamekakriyanvayaḥ samuccayaḥ ' iti viśeṣato'sau lakṣitaḥ; tathāpi mīmāṃsakavyavahāraḥ sāhityasāmānya eva dṛśyate |
' pareṇāvedanāt ' (5|1|129) ityatra hi samuccayapramāṇābhāvo'pi aikārthyavat vikalpaheturuktaḥ |
' samuccayapramāṇaṃ ca ekaḥ : prayogavidhiḥ ' ityuktam |
na ca prayājādiṣu pratyekaṃ ekasyāḥ darśapūrṇamāsakriyāyāḥ anyo'sti |
grahaikatvādhikaraṇe (3|1|13-16) hi vārtikakṛtā pratyekavākyaparisamāpti-samudāyavākya- parisamāptinyāyayoḥ evaṃ viṣayabheda uktaḥ :- prādhānye pūrvaḥ, guṇatve tu uttaraḥ |
yathā ' ahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi ' ' aruṇa- yaikahāyinyā krīṇāti ' iti |
prayogavidhau ca prayājā- derguṇatvāt na pratyekaṃ ekakriyā'nyo'sti, asti ca samuccayapramāṇavyavahāraḥ iti sāhityasāmānye eva mīmāṃsakānāṃ samuccayavyavahāraḥ siddhaḥ |
so'yaṃ samuccayo'pi vikalpavat prathamaṃ tāvat trividhaḥ; nyāyagamyo vācanikaḥ : aicchikaśceti |
tatra nyāyagamyaḥ samuccayo vikalpavat nāṣṭavidhaḥ; dravyādīnāṃ tadabhāvānāṃ ca samuccayāyogāt |
nāpi caturvidha evāsau jātyoḥ dravyayoḥ guṇayoḥ kriyayośceti, kiṃtu sajātīya- vijātīyaviṣayatvena dvikatrikacatuṣkaviṣayatvena ca pañcadaśavidhaḥ : samuccayaḥ |
tatra sajātīyaviṣayasyaiva trividha dravyayoḥ jātiguṇayoḥ jātikriyayoḥ, dravyaguṇayoḥ dravya- kriyayoḥ, guṇakriyayośceti |
vijātīyaviṣayaḥ caturdhā, catuṣkaviṣayastu ekaḥ |
eva pañcadaśānāṃ nyāyagamyasamuccayabhedānāṃ krameṇodāharaṇānyucyante |
tatra
(1) nyāyagamyo jātyoḥ samuccayo yathā - ' nirmanyenekā- kryakyāt tatraiva gavājādīnāṃ nyāyena samuccayaḥ sādhito dvādaśe ' krayaṇepu tu vikalpaḥ syādekārthatvāt ' ityadhikaraṇe (12|14|13) ||
(2) nyāyagamyo dravyayoḥ samuccayo yathā, āghāne ' saṃbhārān saṃbharati ' ityatra saṃbhriyante iti saṃbhārāḥ iti saṃbhāraśabdasya yaugikatvena, ' pari- dhīn paridadhāti ' ityatra ca paridhīyate agniḥ tadā- yatanaṃ vā ye iti, pari samantāt dhīyante iti vā paridhiśabdasya yaugikatvena dravyavācitvāt ' saṃkhyā- yukteṣu tu samuccayaḥ ' iti dvādaśādhikaraṇāyāt (12|14|14|30) |
' tāṃ caturbhirabhirādadhate ' ityatra mantrasamuccayāt uktāt āghāne darśapūrṇa- māsayośca parīṇāṃ samuccayaḥ iti ||
(3) nyāyagamyo guṇayoḥ samuccayo yathā ' aruṇyā ekahāyinyā ' ityatra aruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena (3|1|12) ' ekaikasyā- niyamaḥ syāt ' ityanena āruṇyasya ekahāyinyasaṃkha- yośca anyonyaniyamataḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(4) nyāyagamyaḥ kriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā, ekādaśe hi ' aṅgānāṃ tu śabdabhedāt ' ityādidvādaśasūtre dvitīya'dhikaraṇe (vārtikamatena adhikaraṇasya pañcadaśasūtrakatvam |
11|1| 215-19) prayājānuyājādīnāṃ vikalpaḥ, aṅgatvasye phalabhūtatvaṃ veti pūrvapakṣadvayaṃ nirasya eka- prayogavidhiceyatvāt samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā dvādaśe ' krayaṇepu tu ' (12|14|13) ityatra saṃnipātikya- samuccayau nyāyagamya uktaḥ |
tathā dvādaśe ' samuccaya- svadoṣanidhārtārtheṣu ' ityadhikaraṇe (12|16|17) naimittikakratvaṅgakriyāsamuccayo nyāyagamya uktaḥ ||
(5) nyāyagamyo jātidravyayoḥ samuccayo yathā ' aruṇyaikahāyinyā piṅgākṣyā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti ' iti gopadamānāti iti ākuladhikaraṇe ' adṛśyavadatvāt ' (12|13|131) iti sūtravyākhyāne vārtikakṛtā uktam |
tatra ekahāyinīpiṅgākṣīśabdābhyāṃ yaugikāmyāṃ uktasya dravyasya gośabdenoktāyataḥ aruṇādhikaraṇa- nyāyena samuccayaḥ ||
(6) jātiguṇayopi samuccayaḥ yathā - ' nirmanyenekā- pacanti ' iti |
nahi aruṇādhikaraṇe (3|1|12) niyamyamānasya svaśabdenopādānaṃ nyāyaśarīrāntargatam, kiṃtu yathākathaṃcit upādānamapekṣate |
asti cātra pākena ākṣepataḥ abhijāterupadānam |
tena nirmanyaśabdavihi- tāyā mathanakriyāyāḥ pākāśitāyāścamiśritairekakarmāt aruṇyānyāyenaiva samuccayaḥ iti ||
(8) nyāyagamyo dravyaguṇayoḥ samuccayo yathā - ekahāyinīpiṅgākṣīśabdābhyā- mabhihitasya dravyasya āruṇyasya ca samuccayaḥ ||
(9) nyāyagamyo dravyakriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā - nirmanya- śabdena yaugikena dravyopādānāt tasya mathanakriyāyāśca anyonyaniyamataḥ aruṇyānyāyenaiva samuccayaḥ ||
(10) nyāyagamyo guṇakriyayoḥ samuccayo yathā - ' lohi- toṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti ' iti |
atra hi vastate paridhīyate tat vastraṃ iti yaugiko'yaṃ vasanaśabdo nirmanyavat na vastrajātivacanaḥ |
tathā sati uṣṇīṣāpi vastrātvāt lohitavasanā ityanenaiva siddhe lohitoṣṇīṣā ityanarthakaṃ syāt |

evaṃ jātidravyaguṇānāṃ, jātidravyakriyāṇāṃ, jāti- guṇakriyāṇāṃ, dravyaguṇakriyāṇāṃ iti trikaviṣayāścatvāraḥ, catuṣkaviṣayaśca iti pañcānāṃ nyāyagamyasamuccayabhedā- nāmudāharaṇāni vācyāni |

evaṃ puruṣārthajātyādiṣvapi pañcadaśa nyāyagamyasamuccayabhedā uyante |

(6) puruṣārthajātiguṇasamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kurvīta' iti jyotiṣṭomā- ṅgāgnīṣomīyapaśvūpaprāptikhaladiranāteḥ, vīryaphalārthayāḥ 'yadi kāmayīta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāccihneḥ sado minuyāt' iti dhṛṣṭyarthaṃ nīceḥ parimāṇasya ca ubhaya- kāmanāyāḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(7) puruṣārthajātikriyāsamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'āhāryapurīṣa paśū- kāmasya vediṃ kuryāt' ityāhāryapurīṣajāteḥ 'ekaviṃśati- manuṣyātpratiṣṭhākāmasya' iti ca anuvacanāntarātkriyāyāḥ ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(8) puruṣārthadravyaguṇasamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - 'godohanena paśukamasya praṇayet' iti godohanadravyasya 'vatsa- jānuṃ paśukamasya vediṃ kuryāt' iti vatsajānvākārasya avayavasaṃyogataḥ tatparimāṇasya vā guṇasya paśuphalārtha vihitasya ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(9) puruṣārthadravyakriyāsamuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - godohanesya ekaviṃśatyanuvacanasya ca ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(10) puruṣārthaguṇakriyā- samuccaya aicchiko yathā - vatsajānvākārasya ekaviṃśatya- nuvacanasya ca ubhayaphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(11) puruṣārthajātidravyaguṇakriyā aicchikaḥ samu- ccayo yathā - darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āhāryapurīṣa-godohana- vatsajānvākārāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ paśuyakāmanāyāṃ samuccaya aicchikaḥ ||
(12) puruṣārthajātidravyakriyātrikasya aicchikaḥ samuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-godohana- ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(13) puruṣārthajātiguṇakriyātrikasya aicchikaḥ samuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-vatsajānvā- kāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(14) puruṣārthadravyaguṇakriyā- (trika) samuccayaḥ aicchiko yathā - godohana-vatsa- jānvākāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ paśudravya-pratiṣṭhākāma- nāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
(15) puruṣārtha- catuṣṭayasamuccayo yathā - āhāryapurīṣa-godohana-vatsa- jānvākāra-ekaviṃśatyanuvacanānāṃ caturṇāṃ paśudravya- pratiṣṭhākārūpaphalacatuṣṭayakāmanāyāṃ aicchikaḥ samuccayaḥ ||
