tathā 'naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛte syādapatteḥ' ityadhikaraṇe (10|2| 30|70) vāyavyādipaśau upadiṣṭaśvetaguṇasya prākṛtā- jādijāteśca samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā 'barhirdiṣṭasyeti' ityadhikaraṇe (10|3|14|23-29) amau 'ākṛti- magnim' ityādayaḥ 'ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati' iti dīkṣayateyā upadiṣṭāḥ ṣaṇmanatrāḥ atidiṣṭairdīkṣayatiḥ 'ākṛtyai prayuje- 'maye' ityādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ mantraiḥ saha samuccīyante, 'dvādaśa juhoti' iti dīkṣā''hutiviṣaye ityuktam |
tathā 'yajuryuktaḥ' (10|3|12|174) ityadhikaraṇe vājapeye 'yajuryuktaṃ rathamadhvaryave dadāti' iti yajuryukte- nopadiṣṭena atidiṣṭasyādhvaryabhāgasya samuccayaḥ ityu- ktam |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10|4|1) nakṣatreṣṭī 'so'nna juhoti' ityupadiṣṭānāṃ upahomānāṃ ati- diṣṭānāṃ ca nāriṣṭahomānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe bṛhaspatisavadau 'bārhaspatyaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti grahāntarasya upadiṣṭasya atidiṣṭānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ samuccaya ityuktam |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe vājapeye upadiṣṭānāṃ prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca saṃsthāpanānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe sāṃgrahaṇyāmupa- diṣṭānāṃ trayāṇāṃ āmanahomānāṃ atidiṣṭaiḥ trimiranyaiḥ saha samuccaya uktaḥ |
tathā 'upayeṣu' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|18-9) gavāmayane mahāvrate 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti prakṛtya 'palya upagāyanti' ityupadiṣṭānāṃ palīnāmatidiṣṭaiḥ upagātṛbhiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ samuccayaḥ uktaḥ ||
tathā 'saṃskāre ca' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|16|10-12) añjanābhyañjane 'gaugulavena prātaḥsavane'bhyañjate' ityupadiṣṭagaugulavābhyañjanasya ati- diṣṭanavanītābhyañjanena saha samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10|4|13-15) mahāvrate 'tāvyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte' ityupadiṣṭasya tāvyasya atidiṣṭasya cāhatasya samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā taduttarādhikaraṇe (10| 4|16-17) mahāvrate eva upadiṣṭaśrokādisāmānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca gāyatrādīnāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā 'stomaviṣṭhaddhau' ityadhikaraṇe (10|4|19|20) 'dvā- triṃśat pavamāno'midheyanīyaḥ' ityādiṣvupadiṣṭānāṃ rājasānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ ca samuccaya uktaḥ ||
tathā dvādaśe (12|1|4|18) 'gudenopajati' iti prati- pattatvāt paśugaṇe anekeṣāṃ gudānāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ ||

yathā vā dvādaśokaḥ eva (12|1|3|4|30) 'tāṃ caturbhirabhimādatte' ityādī mantrasamuccayaḥ ||

kiñcaivaṃ kramaprakaraṇasakṛlliṅgena sāmnāṃ ṛgakṣarā- bhivyañjitadvārā stotraprayoge ‘yajñāyajñīya stuvīta, bṛhatpṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati’ ityādistotre viniyogavaiyarthyam |
ataśca vaiyarthyaparihārārthamarādupa- kārakatvā sāmnāṃ stotrāṅgatvam |

atra ki sāmidhenī- nāmajñabhāvena havirdhānaṃ cocyate uta sāmidhenīnāṃ havirdhāna deśo lakṣyate iti saṃdehe pūrvapakṣamāha sūtram |

iti saptamyantāyayacchabdena parāmarśāt havirdhānayo: śakaṭayormadhye yasmin havirdhāne somama- bhipuṇvanti tasmin sāmidhenīranavāhu: iti śrutyartha- pratīte: |

na chātra somatvamapi vivakṣitam, phalamase sthānāpatyā- 'pi abhiśavādyāpatteḥ |
na ca nityānāmabhiśavādīnāṃ nityarutasaṃbandhe anityasya phalacamasasya dvāratānu- papattiḥ |
nityānāmapi nityasomatva anityaphalacamasasya dvāratve uddeśatva eva vā bādhakātvāt |
iṣyate eva hi 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' ityādi nityānāṃ naimittikānāṃ ca homādīnāmupāṃśutvādidhiśyatvā |
na ca evaṃ naimittyasya nityaviniyogotpattisattvena vilambitapratītikatvāt atulyatvam, tathātve pramāṇābhāvāt, kacit satte'pi vā saṃskāravidhuttaraprabhuktatve pramāṇābhāvena atulyatvā- bhāvācca |
astu vā tat, tathāpi saṃskāravidhuddeśatā- 'vacchedakāntatvasya phalacamasaseti anivāraṇāt |
na ca saṃskāravidhau apūrvasādhanatvarūpasāmānyādharmaprakā- rakṣasomaviśeṣatvabodhyāṅgīkārāt na phalacamasasaṃgraha iti vācyam |
evamapi upadeśasya somatātparyatvanivāra- ṇena vikārabhūte'pi phalacamase aprākṛtaviśeṣyatva- prasaṅgāt abhiśavādyāpatteḥ |
ataśca sarvatra saṃskāra- vidhī prakalpapūrvasādhanatvaprakārakaprakṛtyasādhanaviśeṣya- eva bodhaḥ |
iti tadatkṛtvā darśayati atideśena vikṛtapūrva- sādhane'pi samānavidhānatvābhāve'pi dharmaprāptiriva |
prakṛte tu phalacamasasya prakṛtyapūrvasādhanatvādeva yathādivat upadeśaviṣayatvam |
iti prāpte, satyaṃ sarvatra saṃskāravidhau prakṛtyapūrvasaṃbandhitavaprakārakaprakṛtyapūrvasaṃbandhiviśeṣyakaḥ |
eva pārśvantakaḥ uddeśabodhaḥ, tathāpi sā saṃbandhatā yaddharmā- vacchinnasya saṃskāravidhividhāyikaśabdabodhyāt pūrva pramīyate, taddharmāvacchinnasya saṃskāravidhyupadeśaviṣaya- tvena vyavahāro nānyasya, tasya ghaṭāderiva tattvenāpratī- tasya uddeśatvānupapatteḥ |
atra ca 'tate payasi dadhyā- nayati' ityādi prathamaṃ payastvāvacchinnoddeśena vidhīya- māne'pi dadhyānayane payastvāvacchinnasya apūrvasādhanatva- bodhottarameva apūrvasādhanatvāvacchinnoddeśyatvasya paryanta- phalatvāt payasa eva upadeśavidhiviṣayatvaṃ paryantikapado- pādānāt virudhyate |
prakṛte ca phalacamasatvāvacchedena apūrvasādhanatā abhiśavādidhividhataḥ pūrva pramitā, tathātve 'sa yadi somaṃ vibhakṣayiṣetasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet na somam' ityādyanuvādānupapatteḥ |
ataḥ tātparyanugrāha- kānurodhena satyapi uddeśyatā'vacchedakāvacchinnatve na upadeśaviṣayatvaṃ phalacamasasyeti asammānavidhānā |
ataśca tasyaiva dharmākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyapi karmaikatve kalpi- tena sthānāpatyākhyātideśena krayābhiśavādīnāṃ soma- dharmāṇāṃ prāptiḥ |

tadarthaṃ khalu yajamānārtham, yatra somo vamyate |
yat atra somendra karma, tadapi tadarthameva |

' 'yaḥ somaṃ vamati sa nirvapet' iti yacchabdatacchabdayogāt yāgavamanayoḥ ekaḥ kartā gamyate |
tatra naimittikaṃ tāvat svāmikartṛ- katvena asaṃdigdham |
tena asaṃdigdhena saṃdigdhaṃ vamanaṃ nirṇīyate |
tadapi svāmikartṛkameva sat nimittamiti |
na ca svatantrameva nimittam, śuddhena ākhyātena nimittapratyayānupādāt |
yacchabdopabaddhaṃ tat nimittaṃ pratipādayati |
tena cet saṃbadham, pūrvataṃ samānakartṛ- katvam, paścāt nimittatvapratītiḥ |
atha ṛtvijaḥ devatārtha pariikrayārthaṃ ca dravyaṃ tyajanti |
tatasteṣāṃ svātmani parikrayavirodhāt avaśyaṃ tairapi anye adhvaryādayo varītyantaḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- brahmasāmākhyaṃ stotraṃ prakṛtya samāmnātaiḥ 'yo -vṛddhikāmo yo'nyakāmo yaḥ svargakāmaḥ sa saubharena stuvīta' ityetaduruktastotrāśritaṃ saubharaṃ sāma- phalatrayoddeśena vidhīyate |
uddeśyānyanekatvena stuvīta ityasyānupaṅgena vākyabhedapravīteḥ |

tatra vṛṣṭikāmādiśabdānāṃ phalaparatvāt taduddeśenaiva hīṣādyo guṇā vidhīyante |
saubharaṃ ca prakṛtavācūpādidāśraya- nidhanādhāratayā hīṣādipāṭhasyaiva niyāmakatvāt bhāgā- ntare stobhādyakṣarāntarāvādhāpatteśca na nidhanātirikta- bhāgasyāśrayatvāpattiḥ |

tasya ca nidhanaviśeṣaṇatve viśiṣṭadeśāpekṣaśca |
ataḥ saubhara- phalāt phalāntarāṇīti hīṣādīni |
iti prāpte, niyama- vidhibalādyanurodhena vṛṣṭikāmādiyadaiḥ vṛṣṭisādhanasaubhara- lakṣaṇāṅgīkṛtyāpi hīṣādiniyamavidhirevāśrīyate pakṣa- prāptiśca pāṭhādinnavaśāta eveti niyamasyāpi tatsthāna- katvalābhaḥ |

'ājyaiḥ stuvate' 'praugaṃ śaṃsati' iti stotriśaṃsatī stuvate śaṃsati iti ākhyāte śrutisaṃyogāt prakaraṇe prakṛte māhendra- yāgādau kriyotpattiṃ kriyāyāḥ apūrvasya utpattiṃ vida- dhyātāṃ pratipādyatām |
śrutisaṃyogāt ityatra 'kavatīṣu stuvate' ityādi asamīkṣyā stotinā saṃyogaḥ |
'praugaṃ śaṃsati' ityādi dvitīyāśrutyā śaṃsatinā saṃyogaḥ |

sāmāni hi yonau yena aṃśena akṣarāṇi abhivyañjanti tena dṛṣṭameva stuterupakāraṃ kurvanti |
stobhākṣarābhivyaktinirvartena tu aṃśena stutyopadhikameva aṣṭaṃ kurvanti |
tadyadi stobhā nātidiśyeran tannirvartyasya gītyaṃśasya lopāt tatkṛtopakārasya hānyā vaiguṇyaṃ syāt, tasmādati- diśyeran |

bhinna- tvena rathaṃtarādiśabdavācyatvabalāt atideśābhāve'pi rathaṃtarādiśabdavācyagītajñatayā pradhānabhūtagītyatideśā- deva tadatideśaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

prajāpatidvayādau stobhā- kṣarādhiṣṭha eva |
tatra sāmātideśe stobhānāmapi ati- deśo bhavet vā iti cintāyāṃ sāmnaḥ ṛgakṣarābhi- kyatvavat stobhākṣarābhivyaktyarthatvasya tulyatvāt guṇātturodhena pradhānabhūtānāṃ ṛcāmiva stobhānāmapi nātideśaḥ |
na ca stobhānāṃ prāyaśaḥ anarthakatvāt stotrāśadhanatvasaṃbandhena niṣprayojanānāṃ prādhānyānupapatteḥ gītikāālaparicchedatvena gīvyakṣatvāt tadatideśe ati- deśopapattiḥ iti vācyam |
‘abhiṣarpati’ ityādi- bhāṣyakāroktastobhākṣarāṇāṃ ṛgekavākyatvāvadhe'pi svātantryeṇa guṇāmidhānarūpastotrakaraṇatvasaṃbhavena ṛgaveda prādhānyopapatteḥ |
yeṣāmapi huṃphadādistobhākṣarāṇāṃ artha- śūnyatvaṃ tatrāpi tatkāraṇasya adṛṣṭadvārā anuṣṭhānavāde- syāt pradhānaṛgakṣatvaṃ prakaraṇādinā stotrātvameva vā iti na sāmāṅgatvakalpanā'vasaraḥ |
na ca sāmno vā adṛṣṭā- rthatvaṃ stobhānāṃ vā ityatra niyāmakabhāvaḥ |
sāmno'śe dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ aṃśe ca adṛṣṭārthatvaṃ ityevaṃvidhavai rūpyāpattereva niyāmakatvāt |
iti prāpte, ‘yajñāyajñiyena stuvīta’ ityādau tatra sāmnāṃ sāmānyāto viśeṣataḥ vini- yogasyaiva niyāmakatvena sāmoccāraṇasya tadaṃśe adṛṣṭā- rthatvam, stobhānāṃ tu arthaśūnyānāṃ gītikāālapariccheda- tvena dṛṣṭārthatvameva |
anyathā hi sāmnaḥ prakaraṇādineva sarvasyāpi vivakṣitārthasya lābhe viniyogavidhirvaiyarthyā- pattiḥ |
ato viniyogavaśena jhaṭiti prayojanalābhe dvārabhūtādṛṣṭasyāpi tatraiva jhaṭiti kalpanā, na tu stomeṣu, stotrādipūraṇārthasaṃbandhakalpanāyā'pekṣatvāt |
ataḥ : stobhādīnāṃ gītikāālatvāt tadatideśe atideśo- papatteḥ na tadaṃśasya lopāpatteḥ |

sādyaskre sthāṇau sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyā na vā, sā āhutiḥ: ārādupakārikā vā yūpasaṃskāro vā iti vicāre ārādupakārikā sthāṇvāhutiḥ, sā ca agnīṣomīye paśau iva sādyaske'pi kartavyā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ nirākartuṃ apivā iti śabdaḥ |
sthāṇvāhutiḥ: agnīṣomīye paśau tāvat tatsaṃskāraḥ: yūpasya saṃskāraḥ pratīyate, śeṣabhūtatvāt sthāṇoḥ yūpaśeṣabhūtatvāt |

sādyaske ca tasya sarvasyābhāvāt sthāṇvāhuterapi: iti siddhāntaḥ |
samāsyānaṃ ca tadvat |
tadvat yūpavāntaraprakaraṇavat sthāṇvāhutiḥ: iti samā- khyānaṃ āhuteḥ: yūpasaṃskārārthatvaṃ bodhayati |
tataśca sthāṇvāhutiḥ: sthāṇudvārā yūpasaṃskāraḥ |
sādyaske ca khalevālyāṃ yūpatvena uktasaṃbhavāt sthāṇvāhuterapi: iti siddhāntaḥ |
mantravarṇaśca tadvat |
' atastvaṃ deva vanaspate śatavalśo viroha ' iti yastvaṃ mayā vṛkaṇaḥ saḥ ataḥ āvraścanāt bahuprakāro viroha iti yūpa iva sthāṇurādiśyate |

tataḥ sādyaske ayamevārthaḥ: sāṃdhāyako bhavati kiṃ sādyaske sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyā neti |
tatraitat tāvat: parīkṣyaṃ kimārādupa- kārakaṃ karma sthāṇvāhutiḥ: uta yūpasaṃskāra iti |
yadi ārādupakārakaṃ karma tadā kartavyā, atha yūpasaṃskāraḥ nivartateti |
kathamāradupakārakaṃ karma syāt, kathaṃ vā yūpasaṃskāra iti ? yathaivamabhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate yūpama- cchedyatā sthāṇvāhutiḥ: kartavyeti tato, yūpasaṃskāraḥ |
atha yūpamacchedyateti prakṛtena na saṃbadhyate tadā ārādupakārakaṃ karmeti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? ārādupa- kārakaṃ karmeti |

nanu yājurvedikajyotiṣṭomāyajñānāṃ stotraśastrādīnāmapi anenaiva nyāyena upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti |

katham ? darśapūrṇamāsayostāvat vedadyavihiteṣu aṅgeṣu nānā- vedasvare prāpte guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyena yājurveda- dikapradhānadharmaḥ upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti, tato vāca- nikaḥ svaro bhavati 'mandrayā ājyabhāgāntaṃ' , 'paraṃ madhyamayā', 'uttamayā anuśājādi' iti |
tathā vikṛtīnāṃ iṣṭiputranvādīnāṃ etasminneva prākṛte svaratraye prāpnuvati pratyakṣopadeśena pradhānavedasvara- prasaktau 'tadgrahaṇādvā svadharmaḥ syāt' ityanena nyāyena prayogavacanasya codakāpekṣitvena durbalatvāt codakāpi- tasvaragrahaṇameveṣṭam |
evaṃ jyotiṣṭomādīnāmapi dīkṣaṇī- yādīnāṃ prākṛte svare prāpte pratyakṣopadeśena bādhyamāne codakabalīyastvena punarupasthite jyotiṣṭomasya yājurvedi- katvāt klṛptopakāraprākṛtadharmāgrahaṇācca guṇamukhyavyati- kramanyāyenaiva taddoṣāttuguṇadharmaprasaṅge sati 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāmanūyāt' ityete svarā guṇamukhyavyatikramanyāyenaiva sāṅgānāṃ prātaḥ |
tata jyotiṣṭomasya vācanikasvaravibhāgāvihitamandrayamo- cchocāraṇāvadhāraṇāt tadjñānāmāpi sarveṣāṃ prākṛtasvarasya- mandradhamyoccamoccāraṇasyaiva pradhānadvāreṇa prātāni |
tato 'yatkiñcit prācīnamabhīṣomīyā tai upāṃśu caranti' ityapāṃśutve sāṅgānāṃ dīkṣaṇīyādīnāṃ prāte pradhānamātrāvidīkṣaṇīyādiśabdeśena vihitāḥ pradhānā- namātreṣu ete svaraviśeṣā bhavanti 'yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā dīkṣaṇīyāmanūyāt, mandraṃ prāyaṇīyāyām, mandrasvara- pasatsu ' iti |
tatra upāṃśutvasya pūrveṇaiva sarva- vyāpinā upāṃśutvavidhinā prāptatvāt dīkṣaṇīyādisvara- prasaṃgādyaiḥ niṣṭhānuvāda eva |
abhīṣomīye tu savana- vibhāgasvareṇaiva 'mandrā ājyabhāgām' ityādi- prākṛtasvarapratiprasavaḥ |
savanavibhāgastulyaṃ vā sāṅgaṃ prayogaṃ tredhā vibhajya mandramadhyamoccoccāraṇasaṃpādanaṃ kāryam |
etena anūbandhyā-abhyudayanīyā-udavasānīyā- svapi uccāraṇaviśeṣā vyākhyātāḥ |

yadidaṃ dravyaguṇādimāsādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ tadvyatirekena medo dharmo nāsti, svarūpamātreṇaiva medyavyavahāropapatte: |
nanu yadi svarūpamātreva meda:, tarhi svarūpamātradarśanatargeva medyavyavahāra: syāt, na ca tathā dṛśyate |
satyam, svarūpasamakāle medyavyavahāro nāsti, tathāpi svarūpātirekto medo nāstyeva kiṃtu pratiyogiāpekṣo medyavyavahāra:, svarūpa- mātradarśane tadabhāvāt medyavyavahāraprasaṅga: |
nanu tarhi pratiyogisyapekṣo meda: svarūpaṃ tu pratiyogi nirapekṣameva, kathamanayorekatvam ? naivam, medastu na pratiyogisyapekṣa: kiṃtu medyavyavahāra eva, ata eva nirvikalpake pratiyogijñānābhāvādeva meda- vyavahārābhāva: |
tarhi ko medyavyavahāraviṣaya: ? svarūpa- mātramevetyuktam |
na caitāvatā svarūpadarśanemātra meda- vyavahāraprasaṅga:, medastu svarūpata: medava, na hi svarūpa- mātraṃ meda: |
yathā devadatta: nirapekṣayā putra:, na tu devadattamātraṃ putra:, atha devadattavyatirikta'pi na bhavati putra: |
nanu kimanayā kliṣṭakalpanāyā ? medastāvat ‘ ayamasādinna: ’ iti pratyakṣeṇa pratīyate eva |

pratītirasti |
na ca svarūpāvidyat dravyadharmatvamupapadyate, dravyaguṇādiṣvantarbhāvāt, guṇādiṣvitatvāt |
na ca padārthānāntaratvakalpanāmucitam |
medapratītivyavahārayo: svarūpamātrālambanatvenopapadyamānatvāt |
nanu tarhi svarūpāṇāmanyonyadeśatvāccamekaṃ na bhavet, naivam, pratiyogisyapekṣameva svarūpamityupādhi- katvenaitadupapatte: |
nanu pratiyogisyapekṣaṃ svarūpaṃ meda ityuktam, keyaṃ pratiyogisyapekṣatā nāma ? yadi svarūpamātrameva, tarhi pūrvokto doṣa:, atha dharmāntaraṃ pratiyogisyapekṣatvam, tarhi sa eva meda iti, aṅgīkṛta: svarūpātirekto meda: |
naivam, dharmabhedādinā mithyābhedādināṃ ca medyatiriktameva pratiyogisyapekṣatvaṃ nāma dharmāntaramaṅgī- kartavyam ; itarathā ghaṭasvarūpamātreṇa tadtabhedadarśanādeka- sidveva medyavyavahāraprasaṅgāt |
atha saṃyogādidiśi- tvāccedrodaśena eva medapratīti: ; naivam, ghaṭā- dvinna: paṭa: iti medyavyavahāra:, na saṃyogadiśi- tathā, tatrāyamasātsaṃgayo: iti na kadācidapi pratīti: |
evaṃ saṃprātigotvena pratipannasya medasya paścād vyava- hāramātramanayorbheda iti, tasmādbhedātirekena pratiyogi- syapekṣatvaṃ nāma sarvabhedatvādibhiraṅgīkṛtam, tadapekṣa svarūpaṃ medyavyavahārakāraṇamastu, kimantargaṭhanā medadharmaṃ ? nanu dharmavādinā pratiyogisyapekṣatvañca dharme- syāṅgīkartumucitam, sarvatra tadapekṣadarśanāt |
svarūpaṃ tu na, pratiyoginirapekṣatayā svarūpasya kadācidapi jñānāt |
ato na prativandisiddhiriti, naivam, atrāpi prati- yogisyapekṣatvaṃ na svarūpasya svabhāva:, kiṃtu meda- vyavahārasya |
nanu vilakṣaṇavyavahāro vilakṣaṇavyavahāryenivandha- no'pi dṛṣṭa:, yathā ghaṭavyavahārāt medino bhinno meda: - iti vyavahāra:, tatra vilakṣaṇo vyavahāro'sti, na tu vilakṣaṇyam, atonaikāntiko hetu: |
abhidho medino meda ityaṅgīkāre nāmāntareṇa svarūpabhedavāda eva svīkṛta: syāt |
atha tatrā-

nanu svarūpasa pratiyogyapekṣā vaktavyā, tatra vikalpa- nīyam- kiṃ svarūpādinnaḥ pratiyogī, kiṃvā abhinnaḥ iti |
na tāvadbhinnaḥ, svayameva svasya pratiyogitva- prasaṅgāt |
na ca bhinnaḥ, mede sati pratiyogitvasiddhiḥ, pratiyogitvasiddhau ca bhedasiddhiritītaretarāśrayatvam |
atha medāntareṇa bhinnaḥ pratiyogī, tarhyanavasthāprasa ṅgati |
naivam, dharmabhedavādino'pi pratiyogisyapekṣala- mastyeva, tatrāpyevaṃ vikalpo doṣaśca samānaḥ, yastatra parihāraḥ sa evātrāpi |
nanu svarūpabhedavādaḥ pratītiviruddhaḥ |

soma— sutrārthastu- dravyāṇāṃ svargapakṣādīnāṃ karmabhiḥ saṃbhoge śrūyamāṇe dravyāṇāṃ karmajananasāmarthyāt guṇatvena saṃbandhaḥ iti |
vi— ' karmādhikāraḥ karturne kiṃvā'sti, na pada- śruteḥ |
dhātvarthabhāvyāmānāt phalabhogavivarjanāt |
, balīyasā vidhiśrutyā''ruddhā bhāvanā'tra ca |
bhābhyaḥ svargaḥ pumarthatvāt kamiyogācca so''syataḥ |
bhāṭṭa— evaṃ sakrame prayojyatvena nirūpite adhunā tatra adhikārī nirūpyate |
tatra adhikāre nāma phala- bhoktṛtvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ kartṛtvam |
śrāddhādau pitrādeḥ ṛtvijāṃ ca adhikārāvyāvṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayam |
na caiva jātehī pituḥ phalabhogābhāvāt adhikārānapattiḥ |
satyapi akaraṇe pratyayāce karaṇasya putlādiphalakatvena pāpakṣayaphalakatvābhāvāt iti vācyam |
pravṛttiprayo- jakaphalecchamānādhikaraṇākartṛttvasya vivakṣitatvāt |
jāteṣṭiādāvādāvapi phalasya anyaniṣṭhatve'pi tadicchāyā yajamānaniṣṭhatvāt adhikārāvighātaḥ |
ṛtvijāmapi 'yajamānasya phalaṃ bhūyāt' ivīcchāyāḥ svaniṣṭhakartṛttva- samānādhikaraṇatvādādhikāraprāptiḥ |
ataḥ pratīyuktam |
'dakṣiṇāprāptirme bhūyāt' ivīcchāyā eva ṛtvikpravṛtti- janakatvena uktaviśeṣāt |
pravṛttiprayojakatvābhāvāt |
arya cādhikāraḥ vidhyāśritasahādhanatvasamānādhikaraṇa- svakṛtisādhyatvabalavatvebhyatvāt vidhipramāṇakaḥ |
ayameva adhikāravidhirityucyate |
tatra adhikārasya iṣṭarūpa- pravṛttiphalavattvāt tadeva iṣṭarūpaṃ phalaṃ bhāvanāyāmiti na vā iti prathamaṃ vicāryate |
tatra bhāvanāyāḥ bhābhyā- pekṣayā padaśrutyā dhātvarthasyaiva sarvatra bhāvyatvam, na svargādeḥ, api tu tasya sādhanatvameva yogyatvāt |
pakṣāderiva svargaśabdasyāpi 'candanaṃ svargaḥ' ityādi- prayogāt dravyāvācitvameva sulabhaviśeṣabhogyatvadeśa- viśeṣavācitvāgrāhakasya anyaparatvāt |
kāmaśabdastu arjanakāmanānuvādaḥ |
athavā svargakāmaśabdaḥ kartṛviśe- ṣameva yāgājñatvena vidadhat viśeṣaṇībhūtāṃ kāmanāmapi tadaṅgatvena vidhatte iti na kaścit virodhaḥ |
na ca vidhiśrutayorudbhūta ihābhyaktatvāgamaḥ, vidheḥ pravṛtti- jananasvarūpayogatvasya vācyatvena phalopadhānainaivayā- bhāvāt, pravṛttivirahe'pi araṇyasthadaṇḍavat vidheḥ
svargakāmādhikaraṇam |
svargakāmādhikaraṇe
pravṛttijanakatvopapatteḥ |
nahi phalopahitapravṛttijanakatvaṃ vidheyarthaḥ; vidhiśravaṇe'pi keṣāṃcit pravṛttyadarśanāt |
ata eva pravṛttiviṣayasya iṣṭasādhanatvākṣepatvamapi vidherna prāmāṇikam |
yadi tu pravṛttikarūpayogyatva- mātroktau vākyasya vaiyarthyāpattiḥ śaṅkyeta tato yāgasya samānapadaśrutyā bhāvyatvāvagame'pi yāge bhramaprāsādhāraṇapravṛttikāraṇeṣu iṣṭasādhanatvasyaiva ākṣe- pāt bhramātmakaiṣṭasādhanatvājñānādeva pravṛttisiddheḥ neṣṭa- sādhanatvākṣepatvam |
athavā astu 'strīkāmaḥ prāya- ścittaṃ kuryāt' itivat svargakāmanāyā api nimitta- tvam |
tataśca nimitte naimittikakaraṇe pratyayābhāvamātram, na tu karaṇe kiṃcidiṣṭam |
akaraṇe pratyayābhāveva ca puruṣapravṛttisiddheḥ na vidhivaiyarthyamapi |
sarvathā yāgasyaiva bhāvyatvena iṣṭasādhanatvābhāvāt na pravṛttiprayojaka- pravṛttiviṣayajanyaphalasyehasamānādhikaraṇakartṛttvarūpādhikāra- siddhiḥ |
iti prāpte, na pravṛttisvarūpayogyatvamātraṃ vidhivyarthaḥ vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
nāpi iṣṭasādhanatvānumiteḥ bhrama- tvam, jñānānāṃ svataḥ pramāṇatvena bādhakaṃ vinā amatvā- nupapatteḥ |
ataśca utsargasiddhapramāṇatvavicārārthaṃ yāge iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ viṣayo'pi vakṣyaḥ eva iti bhāvanāyāṃ iṣṭabhāvyatvaṃ yāgakaraṇatvaṃ ca āpannameva |
yadapi kāmanāyāḥ nimittatvamaṅgīkṛtya vidheḥ akaraṇajanyapratya- vāyākṣepatvena pravarttakatvaṃ ityuktam, tatra, kāmanāyāḥ pravṛttijanakatve'pi nimittatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
'strīkāmaḥ' ityādāvapi na tasyāḥ nimittatvam, prāyaścittakaraṇe pratyayāntaraprasaṅgāt |
api tu pramāṇa- ntarasiddhakāmanājanitapratyayanāthāśrayatvameva iti tatrāpi iṣṭasādhanatvākṣepatvameva vidheḥ |
ata eva sarvatra naimittikasthale akaraṇe pratyayābhāvākṣepatve'pekṣā lāgha- vāt iṣṭasādhanatvameva vidhinā ākṣipyate iti tadśāt bhāvanāyāḥ iṣṭabhāvyatvasiddheḥ |
yathā caivaṃ sati naimi- ttikasthale pāpakṣayabhāvyakatvaṃ tathā yāvajjīvādhikaraṇe (2|4|1) nirūpitam |
tacca iṣṭaṃ svargaputrādi svarga- kāmādipadaiḥ samarpyate, yogyatvāt kāmaśabdayogācca |
kāmanā'pi svarasataḥ phale, dravye tu aupacārikī |
ata eva svargaśabdo'pi śrutismṛtipurāṇādivāt duḥkhā- saṃbhinnasukhabhogayogyadeśaviśeṣavācī ākṛtyadhikaraṇa- nyāyena (1|3|9) tādṛśasukhamātravācī vā, na tu candanādivācī, tatra hi ādhunikaprayogasya aupacā- rikatvāt |
ata eva svargakāmādipadamipi lakṣaṇayā svargaparaṃ prathamā ca karmatvaparā iti bhāvanāyopapatteḥ nānyopasarjanatvena svargasya tadananvayāśaṅkā |
svarga- kāmo vā adhikāritvena anvīyate iti svargādi- vācakadvitīyopadādhyāhāreṇa tadananvayaḥ iti kecit |
tatra, phalapekṣayāḥ prāthamikatvāt lakṣaṇāyāḥ adhyā- hārāpekṣayā laghvāt |
evaṃ ca balavattaravidhiśrutayā- nurodhena svargādereva bhāvyatvāvagateḥ sāmānyapravṛttā paddhatirupi yāgādeḥ karaṇatvameva lakṣaṇayā pratipādayati iti siddhaḥ |
uttādhikāraḥ |
atra ca uttaviṣecchaphalā- nyatarasamānādhikaraṇaṃ (pravṛttiyojakapravṛttiviṣayajanya- phalecchāphalānyatarasamānādhikaraṇaṃ) kartṛtvena adhikāraḥ iti bodhyam |
tena nityasthale pāpakṣayecchāyāḥ pravṛttiprayojakatvābhāve'pi nādhikāravighātaḥ |

bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsau prati samāmananti 'prokṣitābhyāmulkhalamusalābhyāmahanti' 'prokṣitābhyāṃ haṣadu palabhyāṃ pinaṣṭi' iti |

kiṃ prāptam ? saṃskāre hantipiṣye prayudhyamānasya prokṣaṇasya tatprayuktā syāt saṃskāraprayuktā |
saṃskārā- hi hantipiṣyau |
kuta etat tatprayukteti ? tādarthyāt |
yat hi yena kartavyaṃ bhavati, tat tasya prayojakam |
yadi apūrvamena kriyate, tataḥ asyāpūrva prayojakam, yadi hantipiṣyau, tatastau prayojakau |
prakaraṇācca apūrve kartavyaṃ gamyate, vākyāt hantipiṣyau, vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇāt balīya iti |
nanu hantipiṣyauḥ kriyamāṇa- pūrvāthe bhaviṣyati, tatra prakaraṇaṃ ca vākyaṃ ca ubhayamapi anugrahīṣyate |

na śakyamubhayaṃ anugrahī- tum |
na prakaraṇasāmānyāmātreṇa prakaraṇavataḥ arthena samāmnātamidaṃ gamyate |

iha tu pratyakṣābhyāṃ hantipibhyāṃ prokṣaṇasya ekavākyatā |

prakṛtena ekavākyatāṃ parokṣāṃ bādheta |

na tatpūrva- prayuktam |
dvividhaṃ hi aṅgamaṅgasyopakārakaṃ bhavati |
kiṃcidapūrvasya etadaṅgaṃ viśiṣṭamityanena kāraṇena aṅgena saṃśravyate, kiṃcit anapekṣyaiva apūrvatvaṃ svarūpeṇaiva kāraṇatvena saṃbadhyate |
yadapūrvasaṃbandhaṃ kāraṇatvena upādāya dharmajātamanyaviśeṣeṇa saṃbadhyate, tadapūrvaprayuktaṃ bhavati |

vākyāt aṅgaprayuktateti |

yatrayatra hantipiṣī prayujyeta, tatrā- tatra evaṃdharmako bhavataḥ iti |
dup- nanu adhastāt apūrvāthā dharmā iti sthite hantipiṣiprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇa iti (pūrva-) pakṣasya anuṣṭhāna- meva |

'vrīhīn prokṣati' ityatra vrīhyartha prokṣaṇaṃ bhavati |
( tatra hi ) prokṣati iti bhāvanā vidyate, tasyāśca bhāvyena bhavitavyam |
tatra kaścit kriyamāṇatayā bhāvyaḥ (yathā avaghātabhāvanāyāḥ vrīhayaḥ), kaścit saṃskāratvena (yathā vrīhayaḥ prokṣaṇabhāvanāyāḥ), kaścit utpādyatvena (yathā saṃyavanabhāvanāyāḥ puroḍāśaḥ), kaścit prāpyatvena (yathā 'gāṃ payo dogdhi' ityatra go-dohanabhāvanāyāḥ payaḥ ) |
'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti ( bhāvyavāci- ) dvitīyāyogāt vrīhayo bhāvyāḥ |

tadabhāvāt bhāvyamānasyāpi abhāvaḥ |

śāstrārthā ca trīhīṇāṃ haviḥprakṛtitayā ekasādhanatvācchinnānāṃ caturbhuṣṭiparimitānāmiva, na pratyekam, tena tatra na pratyekaṃ prokṣaṇam, iṣṭakānāṃ tu 'vajriṇī'padadhāti' ityādiṣu bhedenaiva śāstrārthatvāt pratyuddeśyaṃ bhedenaiva prokṣaṇam, graheṣu saṃmārga iva|

yathā ekādaśa- tvasya sahitaprajñā'nvayaḥ|

tatra, yatraikavākyatvena itarāyavākyatvam, yatra vā na saṃdhiśadarśanam, tatraiva śarīraghaṭādau avayavya- ntarābhyupagamaḥ|
na ceha ekeṣṭakākarṣaṇe itarekākarṣa- ṇam, saṃdhiśca purīṣacchannānāmapi iṣṭakānāṃ anumānena dṛśyate eva|

evaṃ tena
śastraṃ kriyata iti prakṛṣṭākaraṇena saṃstatraḥ sūrpasya, nikṛṣṭāni anyāni annakaraṇāni apekṣya bhaviṣyati |

anena vartamānapadena vyākhyātaḥ |
tatrāpi hi kṛtaṃ vā kariṣyamāṇaṃ vā stotuṃ kriyate ityucyate |
kathaṃ stutiḥ, sarvalokasya bhūtabhaviṣyadanādareṇa vartamānopā- rānurāgādattamānālokenanaiva ca kālāntare''pi tatra prīti- riti kriyate evanenā''nabhidhiyucyate |

hetoḥ prayojanam |
kathamaprasiddhāyāṃ vyāptau hetutvavyapadeśaḥ |
ata eva hetu- vyapadeśāt vyāptimanatareṇa anupapyamānāt vyāpti- vacanaṃ kalpyate, yena yena annaṃ kriyate tena tena hotavya- miti |
tena vacanena sarvānnakaraṇavidhāyinā śūrpasyāpi homasādhanatvasiddheḥ |
'śūrpeṇa juhoti' iti avayavānu- vādaḥ |
tena īdṛśamidaṃ vākyaṃ śrutānumitaikadeśaniṣpannaṃ śūrpasya homasādhanatvaṃ annakaraṇatvāt hetoḥ |
ataḥ śūrpaṃ anyat vā yat annakaraṇaṃ tena hotavyamiti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu śūrpasya tṛtīyāśrutyā karaṇatvaṃ gamyate, na tat ānumānikadarvīpiṭharādibhirvikalpitumarhati |
na ca vedena ucyamānaṃ śūrpasya homasādhanatvaṃ hetumevapekṣate, veda- syaiva tatra pramāṇatvāt arthavādastu apekṣitaḥ |

tasmādarthavādatvam |

nahi bhūte bhāvinā vā tādṛśī prītiḥ yādṛśī vartamāna |

vidhyarthatve tu niṣpramāṇakaṃ lakṣaṇāśrayaṇam |

hetuvannigadādhikaraṇam 4527 hetvābhāsā:
bhāṭṭa-- cāturmāsye 'śūrpeṇa juhoti' iti śūrpakaraṇahome vidhāya śrute 'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityarthavāde na stutilakṣaṇā |
api tu homasādhanatve sādhye annakaraṇatvasya hetutvaṃ vidhīyate |
na hyatra pūrva- vat bhāvyatva iva kiñcit kalpanīyamasti, hiśabdastvaidha hetutvābhidhānāt |
hetuśca vyāptimanatareṇānupapannaḥ |
yatra- dannakaraṇaṃ tenatena hotavyamiti vyāptivacanaṃ kalpayati |
tataśca śūrpadanasyāpi darvīpiṭharādemisādhanatvapratīteḥ vidhau śūrpademupalakṣaṇam, avayavānuvādo vā |
yadvā- tacchabdena śūrpasyaiva parāmarśat tadatmevānnakaraṇatvaṃ hetuḥ |
tena ca viśeṣyaiva vyāptiḥ kalpyāt annakaraṇa- samarthaśūrpavyāvṛttāvapi na vidhirathaṃ śūrpadamyathā neya- miti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
siddhāntastu -- kriyate iti laḍantanirdeśāt vartamānakālatvasya hetutvaṃ vācyam |
na ca homakāle annakaraṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
ato laṭaḥ bhūtabhaviṣyatkālalakṣaṇayā vidhī tavāpyavaśyakī |
yadyapi ceyaṃ prāśastyalakṣaṇopayogiguṇaghaṭakatayā mamāpyā- vaśyakī, tathā'pyanuvādakatvāt prāśastyotpādakatvācca na doṣaḥ, vartamānanirdeśaṃ vinā tadapratīteḥ |
kiṃca, apekṣitaprāśastyaparatve saṃbhavati nānepekṣitahetuparatvāddhī- kāro yuktaḥ |

hetvābhāsāḥ |
anumitikāraṇībhūtābhāvapratiyogi- yathārthajñānaprakāro hetuniṣṭhā doṣaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ |
bhavati ca asiddha-anaikāntikatva-bādhakādijñānābhāvaḥ |
prati- bandhakābhāvavidhayā anumitikārībhūtaḥ |
tatpratiyogi- pramāṇakārakatvaṃ asiddhatvādīnām, tena hetuniṣṭho doṣo hetvābhāsaḥ |
yādṛśaviśiṣṭaviṣayatvena yathārthajñānasya anu- mitiprātibandhakatvaṃ tattvaṃ iti yāvat |
yadvā tādṛśapramā- viṣayatvam |
(tatra ityasya sthāne) tena duṣṭo heturhetvā- bhāsaḥ |
'dhūmo vahnibhyabhicāri' ityādibhramavāraṇāya yathārtheti |
upādhivāraṇāya kāraṇeti |
upādhijñānasya sākṣāt pratibandhakatvābhāvena tadabhāvasya anumitiprayoja- katvā hetvābhāsāḥ |
te (hetvābhāsāḥ) trayaḥ : asiddhanaikāntikabādhakāḥ |
tatra asiddhiḥ svarūpasiddhiḥ saṃbandhāsiddhiḥ vyatirekā- siddhiḥ āśrayāsiddhiḥ vyāpyatvāsiddhiḥ iti pañcadhā |
tatra hetvaprasiddhiḥ svarūpasiddhiḥ |
'buddho dharmādharmavedau sarvajñatvāt' iti |
atra sarvajñatvaṃ hetuḥ aprasiddhaḥ |
pakṣe vyāpyatvena abhimatābhāvaḥ svarūpasiddhiḥ iti akṣapādīmate tu īśvare prasiddhasattve buddhe tadabhāvāt akṣatiḥ |
pakṣe vyāpyatvāsimitatvasya hetutvāvacchedakasaṃndhenābhāvaḥ saṃbandhāsiddhiḥ |
'vahnidāhakaḥ śītatvāt' iti |
pakṣatāvacchedakahetvorabhede vyatirekāsiddhiḥ |
gośabda- sāsnādimadvacanaḥ gośabdatvāt iti |
ayamasādhāraṇā- naikāntika iti akṣapādīyāḥ |
idameva pakṣamātravṛttitvaṃ asādhāraṇasya |

ataḥ brahmavaraṇaṃ na kartavyam |

nāstya, nvāhārthyavad dharmakṛtatvāda- aiṣṭivad bhavet |
' bhāṭṭa-- dārśikaṃ hotṛvaraṇamapi somāyane samantra- keṇa varaṇena dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu na prajñāyate, prakṛtau tasyā- dṛṣṭārthatvāt |
pravṛtteṣu hi keṣucit padārtheṣu paścāt 'agnirdaivyo hotā devān yakṣat' ityādinā prakṛtau hotṛvaraṇamāmnātam |
atastasya pravṛttatvena dṛṣṭārthatvānupa- patteḥ adṛṣṭārthatvāvasāyāt apravṛttābhyantaratvenā- dṛṣṭārthena saumikena na prasaṅgasiddhiḥ |
na ca pravṛttābhya- satve'pi brahmavaraṇavat adṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ brahmavaraṇasyāpi
pūrvadhuḥ vedikaraṇābhyanujñānātthaṃ pravṛttasyāpi praṇītāpraṇaya- nāt pūrvaṃ karaṇāditi vācyam, paurṇamāsyāṃ tāvat vedikaraṇasya havirabhivāsanāt uttarakālīnatvena pūrvedyuḥ- kālatvābhāvāt praṇītāpraṇayanakālī nabrahmavaraṇasya apra- vṛttābhyardhanarūpatayā dṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ, amāvāsyāyāmapi vedikaraṇapakarṣe tadaṅgabhūtābhyanujñānārthatayā brahmavaraṇasyāpi arthakrameṇa pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā apakarṣasaṃbhavena apravṛttā- bhyardhanarūpatayā dṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ |
na caivaṃ hotṛvaraṇasyāpi arthakramādanusārāt sāmidhenītaḥ pūrve karaṇāpattiḥ |
'avataḥ sāmidhenīranvāha' iti hotṛvaraṇavākyaśeṣeṇa pāṭhakramābādhakatvapravṛtteḥ |
ayaṃ hi svatantraḥ sāmi- dhenīmātre varaṇaparyadāsaḥ |
tatrātve nivinmantrebhyaḥ pūrve varaṇāpakarṣapantheḥ |
kiṃtu ekavākyatālabhāvāya pāṭhakra- mābādhamātratātparyagrāhakaḥ |

yadvacanamupapadaṃ holākādhikaraṇaṃ viciṃṣyāt |
yāstu manuṣyatvādbrahmatvādijātayaḥ tāsu vihante tāḥ sarvaiśvasāviṣyaktipaviśiṣṭā iti nā''- cārānurūpaviśeṣaṇasamarthatvena jñāyante |
' vyaktivāci tu yannāma tadekatraiva vartate |
devadattādivattena na sidhyate katraikatā |
' na jñāntamedānāṃ prācyādipuruṣaṇyakīnāṃ vyastasama- stānāṃ saṃcanacānubhāvasaṃbhavādekamadhivānamavakalpate |
etena guṇakriyājātiviśiṣṭapuruṣavyaktivacanatvaṃ prayuktam |
na hi kāścidapi guṇakriyājātirūpyaḥ pratideśavyavasthita- puruṣavyaktyapalakṣaṇayogyāḥ saṃbhāvyante |
sarvatra tatrāpi vyāvṛttyaviśeṣān |
' vyaktyākṛtiviciṃnubhuktaḥ padārtho na ca vidhate |
yamāśritya pravṛttaṃ syādadhikāri- viśeṣaṇam |
' etadeva pratipādayan bhāṣyakāra āha |
śaktamātrā''pyadhikārapravṛttavidhānaviśeṣaṃ yenopapadenā- numīyamānena kriyate ' na tasyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyaktivacanatā ' iti |
na hyete holācācārāḥ kāci- dākṛtimanutiṣṭhante na vyaktiṃ na hi yāvatsu puruṣeṣvete- 'vasthitāstāvatāmekenāpi vyapadeśonopasaṃgrahaḥ saṃbhavati |
keṣāṃcitsyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyaktivacanateti granthastheṣāmāmnāyaḥ yathaiva ' jātiṃ tu bādarāyaṇo'viśe- ṣāt ' ( 6|1|8 ) iti sūtrakāraḥ svargakāmapadaṃ yaugikamapyuddiśyamānapuṃstvaviśeṣaṇasaṃbhavāt phalārthi- mātramanuṣyajātiviṣayopapatteśca sāmarthyātkajātimātrā- dhikāraṃ vakṣyati, tathaivāpi phalārthitvakartṛtvāttvāva- bodhanāt |
deśadharmeṣu sarveṣu narajāteradhikriyā |
' kaścitpunarakhyātśabdārthamupaparṇayan imaṃ granthapāṭhaṃ
dūṣayitvā pūrvameva samarthyamānaḥ sūtragatayāvacchruti- dhānaśabdajanitārttivibhāvanayośca bhedamapaśyanubhaya- svarūpanirūpaṇaparyantayogatrāsāṅgācāryādhikaraṇasiddhāntaṃ vināśayenmāha bhāva iti vā''mnāyaiḥ svadharmeṇa |
nyadataḥ śabdajñānākārakavaditi |
tena yaḥ kaścidākhyātpratyayārthatattvaṃ jijñāsamānaḥ pṛcchati kaḥ punarayaṃ bhāvo bhāvanā ceti taṃ pratyanaya- śabdākhyaiyatāt kevalapratyayaprayogadarśanābhāvācca sarva- dhāsvarthādātmyavacanakartorityādigucāraṇamātreṇaivattara dākṣyate kuryācchabda ityarthaḥ; sarvaiṣā''khyāyamāno'thai ākṛtirūpeṇa vā''khyāyeta vyaktyākṛtigocarāti- krāntikaścillā''khyātśabdānenopāyārahitavādanākhyeyo- 'syārtha iti |
tadeva kilānenāpi granthenoktaṃ bhāṣya- kāreṇa |
' na tasyā'''kṛtvacanatā nyāyyā na vyakti- vacanatā ' iti |
vidhānaśabdo hi sūtre pūrvaṃ prakṛtastameva tacchabdena nirdiśya vyaktyākṛtivacanatādapanayati |
' kuryādityucyamāno hi karomīti prapadyate |
na vidhebhāvanā vā sā sāmānyavyaktirūpatām |
' tadidamasaṃbhavemānupapattiṃ ca śrutisāmānyābhyāmenā- nyārthameva sacchattuḥśaṅkādimanvavadhyākhyākārāmipretārthatyāgena svaprajñāvilasitaṃ prakāśayatā''tmaslevāyai yojitām |
deśācārasarvadharmopapatticāraṇārtho'yaṃ granthaḥ sa yadi pūrvakṛtayā vyākhyopapadanirakāraṇaviṣayatvena varṇyate tata etatsūtravyākhyanena saṃdhayate yathoktanyāyamārgeṇa |
yadi tu tatparityāgena''khyātpratyayārthānāmanākhyaiyatvāt |
meva vyaktyākṛtirahitārthatvena varṇyatetato'ntāsaṃbaṃdhananu- payujyamānanirupapattikārthatvena heya eva syāt |
tathāhi- ' yasmādākhyātśabdasya na vyaktyākṛtivācitā |
tasmāttaddhitaṃ karma sarvārthamiti vismayaḥ |
' yadi nāma liṅgādityayo bhāvanāyā vidhervā vyakti- mākṛtiṃ vā vadettato holākādayaḥ pratiniyatadeśa- dharmāṇāṃ bhaveyuryatastu vyaktyākṛtivinirmuko''pyadeśyo- 'thaistassāttvādihitārthaviṣayaḥ sarvapuruṣadharma ityevaṃ nīyamānamarthamudāharaṇe jyeṣṭhameva syāt |
' anākhye- yatvamuktvā ca paryāyaiḥ svavikalpitaiḥ |
anvā- khyānaṃ kṛtaṃ tacca pūrvakena virudhyate |
' vidhyupadeśakartavyatābhāvanāśabdānāṃ hyalantābhūtameva bahubhāsitaprakhyāpanaparaparyāyatvamadhyāropya ācakṣāṇena svayamānākhyeyatvamatviva sthāpitam |
yadyapi tāvadā- khyātpratyayaḥ kartṛtvādityādārahyamātraṃ vā vadettathāpi ' brāhmaṇo yajamānaḥ ' itivadupadadhātiviśeṣavākṣā- natvācchadīnajātyāditvittamanurudhyamāno na svagatavya- kyākṛtivacanatvavicārādhīnādhikāratvanirṇayaḥ |
syātika- muta yadā kartṛbhidhānanirapekṣavidhisamadhigamyādimātrāditva- mevāvasthate |
yadi caitāvanmātrameva sarvadharmatvakāraṇaṃ bhavettato rājasūyāśvamedhayajñomādīnāmevamāramakā- khyātpratyayavidheyatvāviśeṣataḥ sarvadharmatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
atha teṣāmanirdeśārthapratyayavihitatānāmapi rājādyupapadavaśāda- sarvadharmatvam |
evaṃ tatrāpyasarvadharmatvavādinā tadevo- pansanīyam |
sarvadharmastvadinā ca nirākartavyam |
taccā''cārānurūpavyaktyākṛtivacanatvārtatvenā''tmārtham |
lambyamanuṣpākṛtimātrādhikārapratipattervā nirākṛtameva |
tadyathā cottarasūtrāṇi ' liṅgābhāvācca nityasa ' ' ākhyā hi deśasaṃyogāt ' ityevamādīnyupapada- nyāsapratyākhyānārthāni saṃgṛhyante |
tasmātsarvādhikāra- nyāyadvidhānasya vyavasthādeśācāragrahadharmasūnanibaddha- dharmāṇāmapi sarvadharmatvam |
darśanādiniyogaḥ |
syāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ yathā śilākalpo vyava- tiṣṭhate iti gotravyavasthā yathā śilākalpavyavasthayā darśanaṃ spaṣṭam |
vā-- yastu jātikulagotradharmavadavyavasthitavidhyanu- mānamiti |
' tatraikaśabdavācyānāṃ jātyādīnāṃ vyava- sthayā |
darśanādiniyogaḥ syātpavāccādisiddhanakātri- vat |
' yathaiva pañcāvattaṃ tu bhṛgāṇāṃ vasiṣṭhasyakātri- vaccāṇakavaṃsakṛtarājānāṃ nārādheśo dvitīyaḥ prayāja- stanapādanveṣāmityanyato vyatirekataścopalakṣaṇasaṃbhavā- dvyavasthitiviṣayatvasānaṃ tathaiva pratijñāvigotraniyata-
holākādhikaraṇam
triśillaikaśilādikalapyavyavasthitavidhiviśeṣānumānopa- pattirastīti dṛṣṭāntārthāttikavaiṣamyam |
liṅgābhāvācca nityasya |
bhāṣyam-- idaṃ padebhyaḥ kebhyaściduttaraṃ sūtram |
kāni tāni padāni ? atha kimarthaṃ na liṅgād vyavasthā ? yathā 'śukle drotā' iti |
nāsti tannityameṣāṃ liṅgam, yadyathādarśanamanuvartate |
ye'pi śyāmā vṛhanto lohitākṣāste'pi na sarvaṃ āhīnaibukādīn kurvate |
anevaliṅgā apicānutiṣṭhanti |
tasmānna vyavasthā |
śukle hoteti pratyakṣā śrutiḥ |
vā-- 'vyaktvākṛtyabhidheye'rthe pratyākhyāte viśeṣaṇe |
lohitākṣādicihnānāṃmadhunā'nyā nirākriyā ||
' jātivyaktyācyapapadābhāve'pi kartṛ- gatasaṃsthānavarṇādiguṇaviśeṣopalakṣaṇena kṛṣṇakeśadhānavat adhikāraniyamaḥ setyatītyāśaṅkya nirākriyate-- 'liṅgābhāvācca nityasya nāsti karturviśeṣaṇam |
niyatena hi liṅgena nityaḥ kartopalakṣyate ||
yacchihaṃ dākṣiṇātyānāṃ lohitākṣādi kalpyate |
anyeṣāmāpi tad dṛṣṭaṃ tadācaratāmapi ||
dṛṣṭa- mācaraṇaṃ caitattaccihnahariteṣvapi |
tasmādyava- sthitaścihnainaudhikāro viśeṣyate ||
' yastu liṅgaviśeṣaṇaṃ nityaśabdaṃ manyate tasya upasarjanabhūta- liṅgāpekṣatvādasa marthasamāsaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu liṅgaśabdasya nityasāpekṣatvāt svārthākṣisaṃbaṃdhyantaratvena sāmarthya- vighātābhāvāt mavitavyameveha samāsena devadattasya gurukulamiti yathā |
'naitattutyameneṣṭameṣamekāntara- saṃgateḥ |
nityaṃ nāpekṣate liṅgaṃ devadattaṃ yathā guruḥ ||
' guruśabdasya hi śiṣyāpekṣa eva āramlābha iti devadattaśabdopāttaviṣayasaṃbandhānatirekānnati- svārthasyāmyadhikāpekṣatāsāmarthyapratibandhaprasaṅgaḥ |
'iha liṅgasya liṅgatvaṃ gamyate liṅgyapekṣayā |
na ca liṅgyamadhigamyatenityasyeti yat matam ||
' yadyapi caiṣa gamyamakasaṃbandhe sati liṅgaśabdaḥ pravartate tathā'pi guruśiṣyapitāputrādisaṃbandhasya tadapekṣapravṛ- ttinimittasaṃbandhaśabdatvaprasiddhiḥ |
'liṅgī yaugika- śabdatvāsadā liṅgamapekṣate |
liṅgaśabdastu dhātvarthaṃ muktvā nānyadapekṣate ||
' 'liṅgyate'neneti hi kriyā- yoganimitto yadyapi liṅgaśabda iti saṃdhiniśśabda- tvenocyate tathā'pi tu kriyāgatakārakāntarāpekṣāṃ na muñcatīti phārmaṃ 'liṅgino liṅgadarśanam' ityādi bhavedayathāvamarthaparihāraḥ |
nityatvaṃ punarlakṣaṇasyārthaliṅgā- pekṣitvaṃ taddharmatayā padyopanīyata iti tatsaṃbandhakathayā- maparihāryo'sāmarthyaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasmānnityasyeti niyata- cihnonopalakṣakatvaviśeṣamevādhikāraviśeṣaṇaṃ vā niyatasya karturnityasyādhikārasya vā na pratipādakaṃ kiṃciccihna- mastīti na tadabhidhāyyupapadaviśeṣitavyavasthitaholā- kādividhānopapattiḥ |
ākhyā hi deśasaṃyogāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha kasmānna samākhyayā niyamaḥ |
ye dākṣiṇātyā iti samākhyātāste āhīnaibukādīn kariṣyanti, ye udīcyā iti samākhyātāste uddaṣabha- yajñādīn, ye prācyā iti te holākādīn |
yathā, 'rājā rājasūyena' iti |
naitadevam |
deśasaṃyogādākhyā bhavati |
dakṣiṇadeśāccirgataḥ prāṅ vā udaṅ vā'vasthitaḥ āhīnaibukādīn karotyeva |
udīcyāśca deśāntare ud- vṛṣabhayajñādīn, prācyāśca holākādīn |
anyadeśaśca deśāntaragato na niyogataḥ parapadārthān karoti |
tasmānna vyavasthā |
'rājā rājasūyena' iti tu niyatā jātiḥ |
vā-- 'idānīṃ tu yadācāramatyantamamanuvartate |
tatrācāryādisamākhyālyapyanyasta viśeṣaṇam ||
' sarve hi deśācārāḥ prācyādākṣiṇātyādisamākhyātaḥḥ puruṣaiḥ kriyante samākhyāvatiteṣu ca nopalabhyante |
tasmātsamākhyāviśeṣavidhivyanumānāt tatsaṃyuktapramāṇapakṣa eva jyāyānniti |
tatra samādhiḥ |
'ākhyā hi deśa- saṃyogādasmāttu vartate |
ācārāṇāmataḥ prāpto vidhideśaviśeṣaṇaḥ ||
deśaśca digviśeṣitaḥ syāddi- garūpaṃ cānavasthitam |
na ca taddeśasaṃbandhanā- cāro'nuvartate ||
nirgateṣvapi dṛṣṭatvācceṣṭavya-
holākādhikaraṇam
darśanāt ||
' samākhyāyāstāvana deśānyaccinimittamasti tadviśeṣavidhivihitāśāssārāḥ kevalameva taddeśasaṃbandha- manuvartaten |
ubhayā'pi tu vyabhicāraṇa deśanimitta- samākhyāviśeṣaviśiṣṭatvena ghaṭate |
na syādeśāntareṣviti cet |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi, yadi deśasaṃyo- gāt ākhyā bhavet, deśāntarasthasya na bhavet |
bhavati ca deśāntarasthasya, 'māthuraḥ' ityasaṃjñasyāpi mathurayā |
tasmānna deśasaṃyogādākhyā |
vā-- aparasvanayaivopapattyā labdhātmīyakṣopapattiḥ pratyavatiṣṭhamāna āha-- 'na syādeśāntareṣviti cet' iti |
'yadi deśanimittatvāsamākhyā dūṣitā tavyā |
śakyamanyanimittatvaṃ vaktumayā mayā punaḥ ||
sati deśanimittatve na syādeśāntareṣvi- yam |
tasmātkimapi jātyādi dhruvamasyā nibandha- nam ||
astu vā nirnimittaiva viśeṣayati tathā'pi tu |
labdhācāranimittānāṃ kiṃ nimittāntareṇa naḥ ||
' tassādanityā samākhyayaivādhikaviśeṣa- siddhena vyabhicāradeśanimittatvamasyāḥ kalpayitavyami- tyukte abhīyate |
syād yogārakhyā hi māthuravat |
bhāṣyam-- deśasaṃyoganimittāmapyākhyāyāṃ deśā- nnirgatasya tadākhyā na viruddhā |
yata eṣā yogārakhyā yogamātrāpekṣā, na bhūtavartamānabhaviṣyatsaṃbandhāpekṣā |
yato dṛśyate mathurābhipresthito māthura iti, mathuryāṃ vasan mathurāyā nirgataśca |
yasya tvato'nyatamaḥ saṃbandho nāsti na sa māthuraḥ |
tasmānna samākhyayā vyavasthā |
vā-- 'saṃbandhairbahubhirdeśasamākhyā hi prava- rtate |
nivāsabhavajātatvatadāgamanahetubhiḥ ||
' 'so''sya nivāsaḥ' 'tatra bhavastatra jātastata āgata ityevamādinimittaparityāgena na kadācitmākhyādi- samākhyā vartate |
na caiṣā deśasaṃyogaṃ vyabhicarati |
na caināmācāro'nuvartate tannivāsināpi keṣāṃcidā- caraṇācciranirgataputrapautrādīnāṃ ca deśāntareṣvapyācaraṇā- diti na samākhyayā niyatavidhisiddhiḥ |
yattu mathurā- mabhipresthito māthura iti bhāṣyakāreṇoktaṃ tat 'tadgacchati pathi dūtyoḥ' iti vā dūtaviṣayaṃ kalpayitavyam- pratyayitotkaratvādā upekṣitavyam |
sarvasminnapi prasthite tadisatsaraṇābhāvāt |
karmadharmo vā pravaṇavat |
bhāṣyam-- atha kasmānna karmāṅgaṃ deśaḥ |
yaḥ kṛṣṇamṛttikāsthasya, 'māthuraḥ' āhīnaibukādīnām, yathā 'prācīnapravaṇe vaiśvadevena yajeta' iti |
vā-- idānīṃ kartṛviśeṣaṇavidhiviśeṣyatvenānumānāprati- hataḥ |
karmāṅgabhūtaprāgadeśādividhivyanumānasaṃbhavaṃ manyamāna āha-- 'karmadharmo vā pravaṇavat' iti |
'prāgudakpra- vaṇo yadvātprācīnapravaṇo'pi vā |
deśo bhavati karmāṅgaṃ prāgadeśādistathā bhavet ||
' iti |
tulyaṃ tu kartṛdharmeṇa |
bhāṣyam-- yathā kartavyavyavasthitaṃ liṅgaṃ śyāmādi na padārthaiḥ saṃvādamupaiti, taddeśaliṅgameva vyavasthitam |
kṛṣṇa- mṛttikāprāye'pyanye na kurvanti, tathā'nyaliṅgai'pi kurvanti |
tasmānna deśato vyavasthā |
prācīnapravaṇaṃ tu śrutyā niyataṃ vaiśvadevasya |
vā-- 'tulyaṃ tu kartṛdharmeṇa' taccihnamanava- sthitam |
dikkṛṣṇāmṛttikāprāyaprabhṛtivyabhicā- rataḥ ||
prāgadeśo yo hi keṣāṃcidanyeṣāṃ dakṣiṇa- pāthaḥ |
tathodakpratayagityevaṃ nakarūpeṇa gamyate ||
mṛttikādyapi yaccihnaṃ tatrānyātra ca tatsamam |
holākādicihnastasmān tenāpi viśeṣyate ||
puruṣāpekṣayā''cārastasminnapi na dṛśyate |
anya- sminnapi dṛṣṭaśca tasmāddeśo'pyakāraṇam ||
' iti |
śa-- smṛtīnāṃ ācārāṇāṃ ca virodhāvirodhayoḥ |
prāmāṇyāprāmāṇye pratipādite |
svātantryaṃ ca smṛtīnāṃ nirastam |
idānīṃ keṣāṃcit ācārāṇāṃ smṛtīnāṃ ca vyavasthā avyavasthā vā iti cintyate |
holākādo hi kaiścideva prācyādyābhimānibhiranuṣṭhīyante na sarvaiḥ |
i gadyāṇi mānavātiriktāśca smṛtayaḥ kaiścideva kāścit
paṭhyante na sarve|
tadetān smṛtyācārānādṛtya vicārā- ryante|
kimete teṣāmeva dharmā uta sarveṣāmiti|
tadayaṃ ca kiṃ teṣāṃ smṛtirmūlabhūtā vyavasthitaviṣayā śakyate kalpayituṃ uta sarvasādhāraṇyeva iti|
tatra 'liṅga- vyavasthāyā liṅgaṃ vyavasthāṃ pratipadyate|
dhūmo hi yatra tatraiva vahnirnyatra mīyate|
' smṛtyācāra- liṅgagabhyā śrutirna pratyakṣā|
tacca liṅgaṃ keṣucidevopa- labhyate|
atastadiyattayaiva śrutiranumātuṃ śakyate|
nahi tasyāḥ sarvaviṣayatve pramāṇamasti|
vyavasthitaviṣayatve'pi smṛtyācārayorupapatte|
yadi ca sādhāraṇa śrutiḥ syāt tatastanmūlaiḥ smṛtyācārāvapi sarvopagāminau syātām|
yadi hi ālasyādinimittamitareṣāṃ anācaraṇaṃ tadā syādapi sādhāraṇānumānam|
yattu prācyādyabhimāninā- mācaraṇaṃ itareṣāṃ ca anācaraṇaṃ na tatsādhāraṇānumāne- 'vakalpate|
tassāt vyavasthitameṣāṃ dharmatvam|
iti prāpte, abhidhīyate - 'viśeṣābhāvamātreṇa prasiddhetyetsarva- maitā|
viśeṣaṇavyavasthā syāt tacca nehopapadyate|
' yaduktaṃ sarvadharmatve pramāṇaṃ nāstīti tadayuktam|
nahi sarvadharmavādinā pramāṇamupanyasitavyam|
ubhayavādi- siddhenaiva vidhinā asati viśeṣopādāne sarvadharmatvasiddheḥ|
vyavasthāvādinā tu vaktavyaṃ viśeṣe pramāṇam|
tacca nāsti|
tathāhi smṛtayaḥ tāvat sādhāraṇyenaiva vida- dhatīti na teṣu caraṇaviśeṣopādānamasti|
smṛtyanu- sāyaiva ca śrutikalpanimiti tadapi sādhāraṇaṃ nyāyyam|
pāṭhavyavasthā tu kartuścaraṇāt|
